--- START OF FILE main.js ---

const { app, BrowserWindow, ipcMain, dialog, shell } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const configManager = require('./backend/configManager');
const serverManager = require('./backend/serverManager');
const obsManager = require('./backend/obsManager');
const updateManager = require('./backend/updateManager');
const externalSources = require('./backend/externalSources');

app.commandLine.appendSwitch('disable-gpu-shader-disk-cache');
app.setPath('userData', path.join(__dirname, '.electron-data'));

let mainWindow;

function createWindow() {
  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1080, height: 750, minWidth: 900, minHeight: 650,
    webPreferences: { preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js'), nodeIntegration: false, contextIsolation: true },
    autoHideMenuBar: true
  });
  mainWindow.loadFile('index.html');
}

function sendLog(message, type = 'info') {
  console.log(`[${type.toUpperCase()}] ${message}`);
  if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) mainWindow.webContents.send('obs-log', { message, type });
}

app.whenReady().then(() => {
  serverManager.startServers();
  createWindow();
  serverManager.setRemoteUpdateCallback((newConfig) => {
    if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) mainWindow.webContents.send('remote-config-update', newConfig);
  });
  app.on('activate', () => { if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) createWindow(); });
});

app.on('window-all-closed', () => { if (process.platform !== 'darwin') app.quit(); });

ipcMain.handle('get-config', () => configManager.getConfig());
ipcMain.handle('save-config', (event, newConfig) => {
  configManager.saveConfig(newConfig);
  serverManager.broadcastToWidgets({ event: 'CONFIG_UPDATED', data: newConfig });
  return { status: 'ok' };
});

ipcMain.handle('select-obs-path', async () => {
  const { canceled, filePaths } = await dialog.showOpenDialog(mainWindow, {
    title: 'Выберите файл obs64.exe', properties: ['openFile'], filters: [{ name: 'Executable', extensions: ['exe'] }]
  });
  return (canceled || filePaths.length === 0) ? null : filePaths[0];
});

ipcMain.handle('setup-obs', async (event, customPath) => await obsManager.runObsSetup(customPath, sendLog, serverManager.PORT_HTTP));
ipcMain.handle('get-local-ip', () => serverManager.getLocalIP());
ipcMain.handle('toggle-tunnel', async () => await serverManager.toggleTunnel());
ipcMain.handle('get-tunnel-status', () => serverManager.getTunnelStatus());

ipcMain.handle('export-layout', async () => {
  const layoutData = await obsManager.exportLayout(sendLog);
  if (!layoutData) return { status: 'error', message: 'Не удалось получить данные из OBS' };
  const { canceled, filePath } = await dialog.showSaveDialog(mainWindow, {
    title: 'Сохранить раскладку сцен (layout.json)', defaultPath: 'layout.json', filters: [{ name: 'JSON', extensions: ['json'] }]
  });
  if (canceled || !filePath) return { status: 'canceled' };
  try {
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(layoutData, null, 2), 'utf-8');
    return { status: 'ok', filePath };
  } catch (err) { return { status: 'error', message: err.message }; }
});

// === IPC: ВНЕШНИЕ ИСТОЧНИКИ (локальный ключ стримера, в репозиторий не попадает) ===
ipcMain.handle('external-status', () => {
  try {
    return externalSources.getStatus();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[EXTERNAL] getStatus упал:', e);
    return { supported: true, exists: false, ok: false, enabled: false, count: 0, activeCount: 0, sources: [], scenes: [], errors: [e.message], warnings: [] };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('external-create', () => {
  try {
    const res = externalSources.createFromExample();
    if (res.status === 'ok') sendLog(`Создан локальный ключ: ${res.path}`, 'success');
    else sendLog(res.message || 'Файл уже существует.', res.status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'warn');
    return res;
  } catch (e) {
    sendLog(`Не удалось создать ключ: ${e.message}`, 'error');
    return { status: 'error', message: e.message };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('external-import', (event, text, fileName) => {
  try {
    const safeName = String(fileName || '').slice(0, 120);
    const res = externalSources.importFromText(text, safeName);
    if (res.status === 'ok') {
      sendLog(`Ключ внешних источников импортирован${safeName ? ` из «${safeName}»` : ''}: ${res.count} источник(ов), активных ${res.activeCount}.${res.replaced ? ' Предыдущий ключ сохранён в external-sources.backup.json.' : ''}`, 'success');
      (res.warnings || []).forEach(w => sendLog(`Импорт ключа: ${w}`, 'warn'));
    } else {
      sendLog(`Импорт ключа отклонён: ${res.message || 'неизвестная ошибка'}`, 'error');
      (res.errors || []).slice(0, 5).forEach(err => sendLog(`Импорт ключа: ${err}`, 'error'));
    }
    return res;
  } catch (e) {
    sendLog(`Импорт ключа упал: ${e.message}`, 'error');
    return { status: 'error', message: e.message };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('external-reveal', async () => {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(externalSources.FILE_PATH)) {
      shell.showItemInFolder(externalSources.FILE_PATH);
    } else {
      const dir = path.dirname(externalSources.FILE_PATH);
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      await shell.openPath(dir);
    }
    return { status: 'ok' };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[EXTERNAL] reveal:', e);
    return { status: 'error', message: e.message };
  }
});

ipcMain.handle('external-apply', async (event, customPath) => await obsManager.runExternalApply(customPath, sendLog));

// === IPC: ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ ЯДРА ===
ipcMain.handle('check-updates', async () => {
  const conf = configManager.getConfig();
  return await updateManager.checkForUpdates(conf.githubRepo || null);
});

ipcMain.handle('start-update', async (event, downloadUrl) => await updateManager.performUpdate(downloadUrl, (status) => {
  if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) mainWindow.webContents.send('update-progress', status);
}));

// === IPC: ПАК СЦЕН И ГОРЯЧИЙ РЕФРЕШ OBS ===
ipcMain.handle('pack-status', () => {
  try { return serverManager.getPackStatus(); }
  catch (e) { return { installedVersion: null, baselineVersion: '1.0.0', canRollback: false, error: e.message }; }
});

ipcMain.handle('pack-check', async () => {
  try { return await serverManager.checkPackUpdate(); }
  catch (e) { return { hasUpdate: false, error: e.message }; }
});

ipcMain.handle('pack-apply', async (event, opts) => {
  sendLog(`Обновление пака сцен до v${(opts && opts.version) || '?'}...`, 'info');
  const result = await serverManager.applyPackUpdate(opts || {}, (status) => {
    if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) mainWindow.webContents.send('pack-progress', status);
  });
  sendLog(result.success ? `Пак сцен v${result.version} установлен. Сцены перезагружаются.` : `Ошибка пака сцен: ${result.error}`, result.success ? 'success' : 'error');
  return result;
});

ipcMain.handle('pack-rollback', async () => {
  const result = await serverManager.rollbackPack();
  sendLog(result.success ? `Откат пака сцен → v${result.version}` : `Откат не выполнен: ${result.error}`, result.success ? 'success' : 'warn');
  return result;
});

ipcMain.handle('scenes-refresh', async (event, payload) => await serverManager.refreshScenes(payload || {}));

--- START OF FILE preload.js ---

const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('obsAPI', {
  setup: (customPath) => ipcRenderer.invoke('setup-obs', customPath),
  selectObsPath: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('select-obs-path'),
  getConfig: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('get-config'),
  saveConfig: (config) => ipcRenderer.invoke('save-config', config),
  getLocalIP: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('get-local-ip'),
  toggleTunnel: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('toggle-tunnel'),
  getTunnelStatus: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('get-tunnel-status'),
  exportLayout: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('export-layout'),

  // Внешние источники (локальный ключ стримера)
  getExternalSources: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('external-status'),
  createExternalSources: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('external-create'),
  importExternalSources: (text, fileName) => ipcRenderer.invoke('external-import', text, fileName),
  revealExternalSources: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('external-reveal'),
  applyExternalSources: (customPath) => ipcRenderer.invoke('external-apply', customPath),

  // Обновление ядра
  checkForUpdates: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('check-updates'),
  startUpdate: (downloadUrl) => ipcRenderer.invoke('start-update', downloadUrl),
  onUpdateProgress: (callback) => ipcRenderer.on('update-progress', (event, data) => callback(data)),

  // Пак сцен (горячее обновление без перезапуска)
  getPackStatus: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('pack-status'),
  checkPackUpdate: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('pack-check'),
  applyPackUpdate: (opts) => ipcRenderer.invoke('pack-apply', opts),
  rollbackPack: () => ipcRenderer.invoke('pack-rollback'),
  onPackProgress: (callback) => ipcRenderer.on('pack-progress', (event, data) => callback(data)),

  // Горячий рефреш браузер-источников OBS
  refreshScenes: (payload) => ipcRenderer.invoke('scenes-refresh', payload),

  onLog: (callback) => ipcRenderer.on('obs-log', (event, data) => callback(data)),
  onRemoteConfigUpdate: (callback) => ipcRenderer.on('remote-config-update', (event, config) => callback(config))
});

--- START OF FILE backend/configManager.js ---

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const configPath = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'config.json');

function getConfig() {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(configPath)) {
      const data = fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf-8');
      return JSON.parse(data);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[CONFIG] Ошибка чтения конфига:', e);
  }
  // Вписали твой репозиторий по умолчанию
  return { obsPath: '', twitchChannel: 'ksusha__sher', githubRepo: 'Bagerca/New-vijet-launcher', widgets: {} };
}

function saveConfig(newConfig) {
  try {
    fs.writeFileSync(configPath, JSON.stringify(newConfig, null, 2), 'utf-8');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[CONFIG] Ошибка сохранения конфига:', e);
  }
}

module.exports = {
  getConfig,
  saveConfig
};

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/httpServer.js — v9 (пак сцен + imgproxy + ЗАПРЕТ отдачи ключа, его бэкапа и tmp-файла) */
const http = require('http');
const https = require('https');
const fs = require('fs');
const fsp = fs.promises;
const path = require('path');

const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const IMG_PROXY_TIMEOUT = 8000;
const IMG_MAX_HTML = 400 * 1024;
const IMG_MAX_BYTES = 12 * 1024 * 1024;

/* Приватные файлы никогда не отдаются по HTTP (в том числе через localtunnel).
   Бэкап и tmp импорта содержат те же токены, что и боевой ключ. */
const PRIVATE_BASENAMES = new Set([
  'external-sources.json',
  'external-sources.backup.json',
  'external-sources.json.tmp'
]);

const CONTENT_TYPES = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8',
  '.txt': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', '.map': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
  '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg', '.webp': 'image/webp', '.gif': 'image/gif',
  '.avif': 'image/avif', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.wav': 'audio/wav', '.ogg': 'audio/ogg',
  '.woff': 'font/woff', '.woff2': 'font/woff2'
};
const TEXT_EXT = new Set(['.html', '.js', '.mjs', '.css', '.json', '.txt', '.map']);

function isPrivatePath(pathname) {
  const norm = String(pathname || '').replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
  const base = norm.split('/').pop();
  return PRIVATE_BASENAMES.has(base);
}

function isInsideRoot(root, target) {
  const r = path.resolve(root);
  const t = path.resolve(target);
  return t === r || t.startsWith(r + path.sep);
}

function isPrivateHost(hostname) {
  const h = String(hostname || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!h) return true;
  if (h === 'localhost' || h.endsWith('.localhost') || h === '0.0.0.0' || h === '::1' || h === '[::1]') return true;
  if (/^127\./.test(h) || /^10\./.test(h) || /^192\.168\./.test(h) || /^169\.254\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (h.endsWith('.local') || h.endsWith('.internal')) return true;
  return false;
}

function remoteGet(urlStr, redirectsLeft) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let u;
    try { u = new URL(urlStr); } catch (e) { reject(new Error('bad url')); return; }
    if (u.protocol !== 'http:' && u.protocol !== 'https:') { reject(new Error('bad protocol')); return; }
    if (isPrivateHost(u.hostname)) { reject(new Error('private host')); return; }
    const mod = u.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
    const req = mod.get(u, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'StreamLauncher/1.0 (+imgproxy)', 'Accept': 'image/*, text/html;q=0.9, */*;q=0.8' } }, (res) => {
      const status = res.statusCode || 0;
      if (status >= 300 && status < 400 && res.headers.location) {
        res.resume();
        if (redirectsLeft <= 0) { reject(new Error('too many redirects')); return; }
        remoteGet(new URL(res.headers.location, u).href, redirectsLeft - 1).then(resolve, reject);
        return;
      }
      if (status !== 200) { res.resume(); reject(new Error('HTTP ' + status)); return; }
      resolve({ res, url: u });
    });
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.setTimeout(IMG_PROXY_TIMEOUT, () => req.destroy(new Error('timeout')));
  });
}

function readLimited(res, limit) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const chunks = [];
    let total = 0;
    res.on('data', (c) => {
      total += c.length;
      if (total > limit) { res.destroy(); reject(new Error('too large')); return; }
      chunks.push(c);
    });
    res.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks)));
    res.on('error', reject);
  });
}

function extractImageFromHtml(html, baseUrl) {
  const patterns = [
    /property=["']og:image["']\s+content=["']([^"']+)["']/i,
    /content=["']([^"']+)["']\s+property=["']og:image["']/i,
    /name=["']twitter:image["']\s+content=["']([^"']+)["']/i,
    /<img[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)["']/i
  ];
  for (const re of patterns) {
    const m = html.match(re);
    if (m && m[1]) { try { return new URL(m[1], baseUrl).href; } catch (e) {} }
  }
  return null;
}

async function handleImgProxy(req, res) {
  const send = (code, obj) => {
    res.writeHead(code, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(obj));
  };
  let target;
  try {
    const q = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost').searchParams.get('url');
    target = new URL(q);
  } catch (e) { send(400, { ok: false, error: 'bad url' }); return; }
  if (target.protocol !== 'http:' && target.protocol !== 'https:') { send(400, { ok: false, error: 'bad protocol' }); return; }
  if (isPrivateHost(target.hostname)) { send(403, { ok: false, error: 'private host' }); return; }
  try {
    let { res: upstream, url } = await remoteGet(target.href, 3);
    let ctype = String(upstream.headers['content-type'] || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!ctype.startsWith('image/')) {
      const buf = await readLimited(upstream, IMG_MAX_HTML);
      const imgUrl = extractImageFromHtml(buf.toString('utf8'), url.href);
      if (!imgUrl) { send(404, { ok: false, error: 'no image on page' }); return; }
      const second = await remoteGet(imgUrl, 3);
      upstream = second.res;
      url = second.url;
      ctype = String(second.res.headers['content-type'] || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!ctype.startsWith('image/')) { upstream.resume(); send(404, { ok: false, error: 'not an image' }); return; }
    }
    const headers = { 'Content-Type': ctype, 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400' };
    if (upstream.headers['content-length']) headers['Content-Length'] = upstream.headers['content-length'];
    res.writeHead(200, headers);
    let sent = 0;
    upstream.on('data', (c) => {
      sent += c.length;
      if (sent > IMG_MAX_BYTES) { upstream.destroy(); try { res.destroy(); } catch (e) {} }
    });
    upstream.on('error', () => { try { res.destroy(); } catch (e) {} });
    upstream.pipe(res);
  } catch (e) {
    send(502, { ok: false, error: String((e && e.message) || e) });
  }
}

function buildCandidates(pathname, resolvePackPath) {
  const list = [];
  const push = (p) => { if (p && !list.includes(p)) list.push(p); };
  const isRootPrefix = pathname.startsWith('/data/') || pathname.startsWith('/js/') || pathname.startsWith('/css/') || pathname.startsWith('/widgets/');
  if (isRootPrefix) {
    if (resolvePackPath) push(resolvePackPath(pathname));
    push(path.join(ROOT, pathname));
  } else {
    const widgetRel = '/widgets' + pathname;
    if (resolvePackPath) push(resolvePackPath(widgetRel));
    push(path.join(ROOT, widgetRel));
    if (resolvePackPath) push(resolvePackPath(pathname));
    push(path.join(ROOT, pathname));
  }
  return list;
}

function createHttpServer({ config, getDiagnostics, resolvePackPath }) {
  return http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const base = req.url.split('?')[0];
      if (base === '/api/config') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify(config.get()));
        return;
      }
      if (base === '/api/ping') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify(getDiagnostics ? getDiagnostics() : { ok: true }));
        return;
      }
      if (base === '/api/imgproxy') { await handleImgProxy(req, res); return; }

      let pathname;
      try { pathname = decodeURIComponent(base); }
      catch (e) { res.writeHead(400, { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' }); res.end('Bad path'); return; }
      if (pathname.split('/').includes('..')) {
        res.writeHead(400, { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' }); res.end('Bad path'); return;
      }
      if (isPrivatePath(pathname)) {
        console.warn('[HTTP] Заблокирована попытка получить приватный файл:', pathname);
        res.writeHead(404, { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
        res.end('File not found');
        return;
      }
      if (pathname === '/') pathname = '/frame/index.html';

      for (const candidate of buildCandidates(pathname, resolvePackPath)) {
        const resolved = path.resolve(candidate);
        if (!isInsideRoot(ROOT, resolved)) continue;
        if (isPrivatePath(resolved)) continue;
        let stat;
        try { stat = await fsp.stat(resolved); } catch (e) { continue; }
        if (!stat.isFile()) continue;
        const ext = path.extname(resolved).toLowerCase();
        const isText = TEXT_EXT.has(ext);
        const etag = `"${stat.mtimeMs.toString(36)}-${stat.size.toString(36)}"`;
        const headers = {
          'Content-Type': CONTENT_TYPES[ext] || 'application/octet-stream',
          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
          'Cache-Control': isText ? 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' : 'no-cache',
          'ETag': etag
        };
        if (!isText && req.headers['if-none-match'] === etag) { res.writeHead(304, headers); res.end(); return; }
        try {
          const content = await fsp.readFile(resolved);
          res.writeHead(200, { ...headers, 'Content-Length': content.length });
          res.end(content);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[HTTP] Ошибка чтения файла:', resolved, e.message);
          res.writeHead(500, { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' }); res.end('Read error');
        }
        return;
      }
      res.writeHead(404, { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' });
      res.end('File not found');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[HTTP] Необработанная ошибка:', e);
      try { res.writeHead(500, { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' }); res.end('Server error'); } catch (e2) {}
    }
  });
}

module.exports = { createHttpServer };

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/packManager.js — v1 (Пак сцен: версионные папки + атомарный указатель + откат) */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const os = require('os');
const EventEmitter = require('events');
const { fetchReleases, downloadFile, extractZip, compareVersions, PACK_TAG_RE } = require('./updateManager');
const PACK_DIRS = ['widgets', 'data', 'css', path.join('js', 'utils')];
const PACK_PREFIXES = ['/widgets/', '/data/', '/css/', '/js/utils/'];
function sanitizeVersion(v) {
return String(v || '0.0.0').replace(/^(?:pack-)?v/i, '').replace(/[^\w.-]/g, '_');
}
function copyDirSync(src, dst) {
fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true });
for (const item of fs.readdirSync(src)) {
const s = path.join(src, item);
const d = path.join(dst, item);
if (fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()) copyDirSync(s, d);
else fs.copyFileSync(s, d);
}
}
class PackManager extends EventEmitter {
constructor({ rootDir, getLauncherVersion }) {
super();
this.rootDir = rootDir;
this.getLauncherVersion = getLauncherVersion || (() => '1.0.0');
this.packsDir = path.join(rootDir, 'packs');
this.pointerPath = path.join(this.packsDir, 'active.json');
this.activeDir = null;
this.previousDir = null;
this.meta = null;
this.previousMeta = null;
this._loadPointer();
}
_dirPath(name) { return path.join(this.packsDir, name); }
_readMeta(name) {
try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(this._dirPath(name), '_pack-meta.json'), 'utf-8')); }
catch (e) { return null; }
}
_loadPointer() {
try {
if (!fs.existsSync(this.pointerPath)) {
console.log('[PACK] Указатель не найден — работаю со встроенными файлами.');
return;
}
const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(this.pointerPath, 'utf-8'));
if (p.active && fs.existsSync(this._dirPath(p.active))) {
this.activeDir = p.active;
this.meta = this._readMeta(p.active);
console.log(`[PACK] Активный пак: ${this.activeDir} (v${(this.meta && this.meta.version) || '?'})`);
} else {
console.warn('[PACK] Указатель ссылается на несуществующую папку:', p.active);
}
if (p.previous && fs.existsSync(this._dirPath(p.previous))) {
this.previousDir = p.previous;
this.previousMeta = this._readMeta(p.previous);
}
} catch (e) {
console.error('[PACK] Указатель повреждён, игнорирую:', e.message);
}
}
get activePath() { return this.activeDir ? this._dirPath(this.activeDir) : null; }
resolve(relUrlPath) {
if (!this.activePath) return null;
const rel = String(relUrlPath || '');
if (!PACK_PREFIXES.some(p => rel.startsWith(p))) return null;
return path.join(this.activePath, rel);
}
info() {
return {
installedVersion: (this.meta && this.meta.version) || null,
installedTag: (this.meta && this.meta.tag) || null,
appliedAt: (this.meta && this.meta.appliedAt) || null,
previousVersion: (this.previousMeta && this.previousMeta.version) || null,
canRollback: Boolean(this.previousDir && fs.existsSync(this._dirPath(this.previousDir))),
baselineVersion: this.getLauncherVersion(),
activeDir: this.activeDir
};
}
async checkForUpdate(repo) {
const current = this.info().installedVersion;
if (!repo) return { hasUpdate: false, currentVersion: current, error: 'Репозиторий не указан' };
try {
const releases = await fetchReleases(repo);
const rel = releases.find(r => !r.draft && PACK_TAG_RE.test(r.tag_name || ''));
if (!rel) return { hasUpdate: false, currentVersion: current, latestVersion: current, message: 'Пак-релизы (pack-vX.Y.Z) не найдены.' };
const version = sanitizeVersion(rel.tag_name);
let downloadUrl = null;
if (Array.isArray(rel.assets) && rel.assets.length > 0) {
const preferred = rel.assets.find(a => a.name === 'scene-pack.zip') || rel.assets.find(a => a.name.endsWith('.zip'));
if (preferred) downloadUrl = preferred.browser_download_url;
}
if (!downloadUrl) downloadUrl = rel.zipball_url;
const hasUpdate = !current || compareVersions(version, current) > 0;
console.log(`[PACK] Проверка: установлен ${current || 'встроенный'}, доступен ${version} (${hasUpdate ? 'НОВЫЙ' : 'актуально'})`);
return { hasUpdate, currentVersion: current, latestVersion: version, tag: rel.tag_name, releaseNotes: rel.body || 'Обновление сцен и виджетов.', downloadUrl };
} catch (e) {
console.warn('[PACK] Проверка пака не удалась:', e.message);
return { hasUpdate: false, currentVersion: current, error: e.message };
}
}
_writePointer() {
fs.mkdirSync(this.packsDir, { recursive: true });
const data = {
active: this.activeDir,
previous: this.previousDir,
version: (this.meta && this.meta.version) || null,
previousVersion: (this.previousMeta && this.previousMeta.version) || null,
ts: Date.now()
};
const tmp = this.pointerPath + '.tmp';
fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf-8');
fs.renameSync(tmp, this.pointerPath);
}
_cleanup() {
try {
const keep = new Set([this.activeDir, this.previousDir].filter(Boolean));
for (const name of fs.readdirSync(this.packsDir)) {
if (!name.startsWith('pack-') || keep.has(name)) continue;
try {
fs.rmSync(this._dirPath(name), { recursive: true, force: true });
console.log('[PACK] Удалена старая версия:', name);
} catch (e) { console.warn('[PACK] Не удалось удалить', name, e.message); }
}
} catch (e) {}
}
async apply({ downloadUrl, tag, version }, onStatus = () => {}) {
if (!downloadUrl || !version) return { success: false, error: 'Не переданы данные релиза (downloadUrl/version)' };
const cleanVer = sanitizeVersion(version);
const tempDir = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `scene-pack-${Date.now()}`);
const archivePath = path.join(tempDir, 'pack.zip');
const extractDir = path.join(tempDir, 'extracted');
const stagingDir = path.join(this.packsDir, `.staging-${Date.now()}`);
const finalName = `pack-${cleanVer}-${Date.now()}`;
try {
fs.mkdirSync(extractDir, { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync(this.packsDir, { recursive: true });
onStatus({ stage: 'downloading', percent: 0, text: 'Скачивание пака сцен...' });
await downloadFile(downloadUrl, archivePath, (percent) => onStatus({ stage: 'downloading', percent, text: `Скачивание: ${percent}%` }));
onStatus({ stage: 'extracting', percent: 100, text: 'Распаковка пака...' });
await extractZip(archivePath, extractDir);
let sourceRoot = extractDir;
const top = fs.readdirSync(extractDir);
if (top.length === 1 && fs.statSync(path.join(extractDir, top[0])).isDirectory()) sourceRoot = path.join(extractDir, top[0]);
onStatus({ stage: 'validating', percent: 100, text: 'Валидация пака...' });
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(sourceRoot, 'widgets'))) throw new Error('Архив не содержит папку widgets/ — это не пак сцен.');
let packManifest = {};
const manifestPath = path.join(sourceRoot, 'pack.json');
if (fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) {
try { packManifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf-8')); }
catch (e) { console.warn('[PACK] pack.json повреждён, игнорирую:', e.message); }
}
const launcherVer = this.getLauncherVersion();
if (packManifest.minLauncherVersion && compareVersions(packManifest.minLauncherVersion, launcherVer) > 0) {
throw new Error(`Пак требует ядро лаунчера v${packManifest.minLauncherVersion}+ (у вас v${launcherVer}). Сначала обновите лаунчер.`);
}
onStatus({ stage: 'applying', percent: 100, text: 'Установка пака...' });
for (const dir of PACK_DIRS) {
const src = path.join(sourceRoot, dir);
if (fs.existsSync(src)) copyDirSync(src, path.join(stagingDir, dir));
}
const meta = {
version: cleanVer,
tag: tag || `pack-v${cleanVer}`,
appliedAt: Date.now(),
sourceUrl: downloadUrl,
minLauncherVersion: packManifest.minLauncherVersion || null
};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(stagingDir, '_pack-meta.json'), JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2), 'utf-8');
fs.renameSync(stagingDir, this._dirPath(finalName));
const oldActive = this.activeDir;
const oldMeta = this.meta;
this.previousDir = oldActive;
this.previousMeta = oldMeta;
this.activeDir = finalName;
this.meta = meta;
this._writePointer();
this._cleanup();
console.log(`[PACK] ✅ Активирован пак v${cleanVer} (${finalName}). Откат: ${oldActive || 'нет'}`);
onStatus({ stage: 'completed', percent: 100, text: `Пак сцен v${cleanVer} установлен!` });
this.emit('applied', { version: cleanVer, previousVersion: (oldMeta && oldMeta.version) || null, dirName: finalName });
return { success: true, version: cleanVer, dirName: finalName };
} catch (error) {
console.error('[PACK] Ошибка применения пака:', error);
onStatus({ stage: 'error', percent: 0, text: `Ошибка: ${error.message}` });
return { success: false, error: error.message };
} finally {
try { if (fs.existsSync(tempDir)) fs.rmSync(tempDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (e) {}
try { if (fs.existsSync(stagingDir)) fs.rmSync(stagingDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (e) {}
}
}
async rollback() {
try {
if (!this.previousDir || !fs.existsSync(this._dirPath(this.previousDir))) {
return { success: false, error: 'Нет предыдущего пака для отката.' };
}
const oldActive = this.activeDir;
const oldMeta = this.meta;
this.activeDir = this.previousDir;
this.meta = this.previousMeta || this._readMeta(this.previousDir);
this.previousDir = oldActive;
this.previousMeta = oldMeta;
this._writePointer();
const version = (this.meta && this.meta.version) || '?';
console.log(`[PACK] ↩ Откат выполнен → v${version}`);
this.emit('rolledBack', { version, previousVersion: (oldMeta && oldMeta.version) || null, dirName: this.activeDir });
return { success: true, version };
} catch (e) {
console.error('[PACK] Ошибка отката:', e);
return { success: false, error: e.message };
}
}
}
module.exports = PackManager;

bg: { name: 'Виджет: Фон Общения', url: '/bg/index.html', w: 1920, h: 1080 },
tts: { name: 'Виджет: Озвучка (TTS)', url: '/tts/index.html', w: 1920, h: 1080 }
};
class SceneManager {
constructor({ port }) {
this.port = String(port);
this._busy = false;
this._lastAt = 0;
}
_parseSourceUrl(urlStr) {
try {
const u = new URL(String(urlStr || ''));
if (u.port !== this.port) return null;
const m = u.pathname.match(/^\/([a-z0-9_-]+)\/index\.html$/i);
return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : null;
} catch (e) { return null; }
}
async _collect(obs) {
const { inputs } = await obs.call('GetInputList');
const browsers = (inputs || []).filter(i => (i.unversionedInputKind || i.inputKind) === 'browser_source');
const found = [];
for (const b of browsers) {
try {
const s = await obs.call('GetInputSettings', { inputName: b.inputName });
const id = this._parseSourceUrl(s.inputSettings && s.inputSettings.url);
if (id) found.push({ name: b.inputName, id });
} catch (e) {}
}
return found;
}
async refresh(payload = {}, { force = false } = {}) {
const empty = { refreshed: [], skipped: [], notFound: [], failed: [] };
if (this._busy) return { ok: false, message: 'Перезагрузка уже выполняется', ...empty };
const since = Date.now() - this._lastAt;
if (!force && since < COOLDOWN_MS) {
return { ok: false, message: `Подождите ${Math.ceil((COOLDOWN_MS - since) / 1000)} с`, ...empty };
}
this._busy = true;
const obs = new OBSWebSocket();
try {
await obs.connect(OBS_URL, undefined, { rpcVersion: 1 });
const found = await this._collect(obs);
console.log(`[Scenes] Источники лаунчера в OBS: ${found.map(f => f.id).join(', ') || 'нет'}`);
const raw = payload.widgets;
let ids = [];
if (Array.isArray(raw)) ids = raw.map(x => String(x).toLowerCase().trim()).filter(Boolean);
else if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim()) ids = raw.toLowerCase().split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean);
const safe = ids.length === 0 || ids.includes('all');
let targets, skipped = [], notFound = [];
if (safe) {
targets = found.filter(f => f.id !== 'player');
if (found.some(f => f.id === 'player')) skipped.push('player');
} else {
const set = new Set(ids.filter(x => x !== 'all'));
targets = found.filter(f => set.has(f.id));
notFound = [...set].filter(id => !found.some(f => f.id === id));
}
if (targets.length === 0) {
this._lastAt = Date.now();
return {
ok: false,
message: notFound.length
? `Источник «${notFound.join(', ')}» не найден в OBS — нажмите «Починить источник» в дашборде виджета.`
: 'Браузер-источники лаунчера не найдены в OBS',
refreshed: [], skipped, notFound, failed: []
};
}
const refreshed = [], failed = [];
for (const t of targets) {
try {
await obs.call('PressInputPropertiesButton', { inputName: t.name, propertyName: 'refreshnocache' });
refreshed.push(t.id);
console.log(`[Scenes] ↻ ${t.id}`);
} catch (e) { failed.push(t.id); console.warn(`[Scenes] Ошибка рефреша ${t.name}:`, e.message); }
await delay(PRESS_GAP_MS);
}
this._lastAt = Date.now();
const parts = [`Перезагружено источников: ${refreshed.length}`];
if (skipped.length) parts.push('плеер не тронут');
if (notFound.length) parts.push(`не найдены: ${notFound.join(', ')}`);
if (failed.length) parts.push(`ошибки: ${failed.join(', ')}`);
return { ok: refreshed.length > 0, message: parts.join(' · '), refreshed, skipped, notFound, failed };
} catch (e) {
console.warn('[Scenes] OBS недоступен:', e.message);
return { ok: false, message: `OBS не отвечает (${e.message}). Порт 4455, аутентификация снята.`, ...empty };
} finally {
this._busy = false;
try { await obs.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
}
}
async ensure(payload = {}) {
const id = String(payload.id || 'alerts').toLowerCase();
const def = WIDGETS[id];
if (!def) return { ok: false, message: `Неизвестный виджет: ${id}`, id };
if (this._busy) return { ok: false, message: 'Другая операция с OBS уже выполняется', id };
this._busy = true;
const obs = new OBSWebSocket();
const report = { id, created: false, scenes: [], enabled: false, refreshed: false };
try {
await obs.connect(OBS_URL, undefined, { rpcVersion: 1 });
const url = `http://localhost:${this.port}${def.url}?nocache=${Date.now()}`;
const { inputs } = await obs.call('GetInputList');
const exists = (inputs || []).some(i => i.inputName === def.name);
if (!exists) {
await obs.call('CreateInput', {
sceneName: SCENES[0], inputName: def.name, inputKind: 'browser_source',
inputSettings: { url, width: def.w, height: def.h, css: 'body { background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px auto; overflow: hidden; }', shutdown: false, reroute_audio: true }
});
report.created = true;
console.log(`[Scenes] Создан источник «${def.name}»`);
} else {
await obs.call('SetInputSettings', { inputName: def.name, inputSettings: { url, width: def.w, height: def.h } });
}
const { scenes } = await obs.call('GetSceneList');
const names = (scenes || []).map(s => s.sceneName);
for (const sc of SCENES) {
if (!names.includes(sc)) continue;
try {
const { sceneItems } = await obs.call('GetSceneItemList', { sceneName: sc });
const mine = (sceneItems || []).filter(i => i.sourceName === def.name);
let itemId;
if (mine.length === 0) {
const r = await obs.call('CreateSceneItem', { sceneName: sc, sourceName: def.name });
itemId = r.sceneItemId;
} else {
itemId = mine[0].sceneItemId;
for (let i = 1; i < mine.length; i++) {
try { await obs.call('RemoveSceneItem', { sceneName: sc, sceneItemId: mine[i].sceneItemId }); } catch (e) {}
}
}
await obs.call('SetSceneItemTransform', {
sceneName: sc, sceneItemId: itemId,
sceneItemTransform: { positionX: 0, positionY: 0, scaleX: 1, scaleY: 1, cropTop: 0, cropBottom: 0, cropLeft: 0, cropRight: 0 }
});
await obs.call('SetSceneItemEnabled', { sceneName: sc, sceneItemId: itemId, sceneItemEnabled: true });
const fresh = await obs.call('GetSceneItemList', { sceneName: sc });
await obs.call('SetSceneItemIndex', { sceneName: sc, sceneItemId: itemId, sceneItemIndex: Math.max(0, (fresh.sceneItems || []).length - 1) });
report.scenes.push(sc);
report.enabled = true;
} catch (e) { console.warn(`[Scenes] Сцена ${sc}:`, e.message); }
}
try {
await obs.call('PressInputPropertiesButton', { inputName: def.name, propertyName: 'refreshnocache' });
report.refreshed = true;
} catch (e) {}
this._lastAt = Date.now();
const parts = [report.created ? 'Источник создан' : 'Источник обновлён', `сцен: ${report.scenes.length}`, 'видимость включена, поднят наверх, кэш сброшен'];
console.log(`[Scenes] ensure(${id}) → ${parts.join(' · ')}`);
return { ok: true, message: parts.join(' · '), ...report };
} catch (e) {
console.warn('[Scenes] ensure не удался:', e.message);
return { ok: false, message: `OBS не отвечает (${e.message}). Проверьте WebSocket 4455 без аутентификации.`, ...report };
} finally {
this._busy = false;
try { await obs.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
}
}
}
module.exports = SceneManager;

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/serverManager.js — v7 (фасад + пак сцен + менеджер сцен OBS + реестр виджетов) */
const path = require('path');

wired = true;

commands.on('stopTo', ({ mode }) => { if (hub) hub.sendToMode(mode, 'PLAYER_STOP', {}); });

commands.on('seek', (payload) => { if (hub) hub.sendToActive('PLAYER_SEEK', payload); });
commands.on('notice', (payload) => {

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/tunnelService.js — v5 */
const os = require('os');
const localtunnel = require('localtunnel');

let tunnel = null;

function getLocalIP() {
const interfaces = os.networkInterfaces();
for (const name of Object.keys(interfaces)) {
for (const iface of interfaces[name]) {
if (iface.family === 'IPv4' && !iface.internal) return iface.address;
}
}
return '127.0.0.1';
}

async function toggleTunnel(port) {
if (tunnel) {
tunnel.close();
tunnel = null;
return { active: false, url: null };
}
try {
const randomPrefix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6);
tunnel = await localtunnel({ port, subdomain: `stream-panel-${randomPrefix}` });
tunnel.on('close', () => { tunnel = null; });
return { active: true, url: tunnel.url + '/panel/index.html' };
} catch (error) {
return { active: false, url: null, error: error.message };
}
}

function getTunnelStatus() {
return { active: !!tunnel, url: tunnel ? tunnel.url + '/panel/index.html' : null };
}

module.exports = { getLocalIP, toggleTunnel, getTunnelStatus };

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/updateManager.js — v2 (два канала: ядро и пак сцен; общие хелперы экспортированы) */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const https = require('https');
const os = require('os');
const { exec } = require('child_process');
const configManager = require('./configManager');
const rootDir = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const versionFilePath = path.join(rootDir, 'version.json');
const PACK_TAG_RE = /^pack-v/i;
function getLocalVersionInfo() {
try {
if (fs.existsSync(versionFilePath)) return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(versionFilePath, 'utf-8'));
} catch (e) {
console.error('[UPDATER] Ошибка чтения version.json:', e);
}
return { version: '1.0.0', githubRepo: 'Bagerca/New-vijet-launcher', channel: 'stable' };
}
function compareVersions(v1, v2) {
const clean = v => String(v || '').replace(/^(?:pack-)?v/i, '').split('.').map(n => parseInt(n, 10) || 0);
const p1 = clean(v1);
const p2 = clean(v2);
const len = Math.max(p1.length, p2.length);
for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
const n1 = p1[i] || 0;
const n2 = p2[i] || 0;
if (n1 > n2) return 1;
if (n1 < n2) return -1;
}
return 0;
}
function fetchJson(url) {
return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
const options = { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Stream-Launcher-AutoUpdater', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json' } };
https.get(url, options, (res) => {
if (res.statusCode >= 300 && res.statusCode < 400 && res.headers.location) {
res.resume();
return fetchJson(res.headers.location).then(resolve).catch(reject);
}
if (res.statusCode !== 200) { res.resume(); return reject(new Error(`GitHub API вернул статус ${res.statusCode}`)); }
let rawData = '';
res.on('data', chunk => rawData += chunk);
res.on('end', () => { try { resolve(JSON.parse(rawData)); } catch (e) { reject(e); } });
}).on('error', reject);
});
}
async function fetchReleases(repo) {
const list = await fetchJson(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases?per_page=30`);
if (!Array.isArray(list)) throw new Error('Некорректный ответ GitHub API (ожидался массив релизов)');
return list;
}
async function checkForUpdates(customRepo = null) {
const localInfo = getLocalVersionInfo();
const repo = customRepo || localInfo.githubRepo;
if (!repo || repo === 'ksusha-sher/stream-launcher') {
return { hasUpdate: false, currentVersion: localInfo.version, latestVersion: localInfo.version, releaseNotes: 'Укажите актуальный репозиторий GitHub в настройках.', downloadUrl: null };
}
try {
const releases = await fetchReleases(repo);
const latestRelease = releases.find(r => !r.draft && !PACK_TAG_RE.test(r.tag_name || ''));
if (!latestRelease) {
return { hasUpdate: false, currentVersion: localInfo.version, latestVersion: localInfo.version, releaseNotes: 'Релизы ядра не найдены.', downloadUrl: null };
}
const latestTag = latestRelease.tag_name || latestRelease.name || '1.0.0';
const isNewer = compareVersions(latestTag, localInfo.version) > 0;
let downloadUrl = null;
if (Array.isArray(latestRelease.assets) && latestRelease.assets.length > 0) {
const zipAsset = latestRelease.assets.find(a => a.name.endsWith('.zip') && a.name !== 'scene-pack.zip');
if (zipAsset) downloadUrl = zipAsset.browser_download_url;
}
if (!downloadUrl) downloadUrl = latestRelease.zipball_url;
return { hasUpdate: isNewer, currentVersion: localInfo.version, latestVersion: latestTag, releaseNotes: latestRelease.body || 'Новые исправления и обновления виджетов.', downloadUrl };
} catch (error) {
console.warn('[UPDATER] Проверка обновлений завершилась с ошибкой:', error.message);
return { hasUpdate: false, currentVersion: localInfo.version, error: error.message };
}
}
function downloadFile(url, destPath, onProgress) {
return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
const fileStream = fs.createWriteStream(destPath);
const options = { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Stream-Launcher-AutoUpdater' } };
const request = https.get(url, options, (response) => {
if (response.statusCode >= 300 && response.statusCode < 400 && response.headers.location) {
fileStream.close();
try { if (fs.existsSync(destPath)) fs.unlinkSync(destPath); } catch (e) {}
return downloadFile(response.headers.location, destPath, onProgress).then(resolve).catch(reject);
}
if (response.statusCode !== 200) {
fileStream.close();
try { if (fs.existsSync(destPath)) fs.unlinkSync(destPath); } catch (e) {}
return reject(new Error(`Ошибка скачивания: HTTP ${response.statusCode}`));
}
const totalBytes = parseInt(response.headers['content-length'], 10) || 0;
let downloadedBytes = 0;
response.on('data', (chunk) => {
downloadedBytes += chunk.length;
if (totalBytes > 0 && typeof onProgress === 'function') onProgress(Math.round((downloadedBytes / totalBytes) * 100));
});
response.pipe(fileStream);
fileStream.on('finish', () => fileStream.close(() => resolve(destPath)));
});
request.on('error', (err) => {
fileStream.close();
try { if (fs.existsSync(destPath)) fs.unlinkSync(destPath); } catch (e) {}
reject(err);
});
});
}
function extractZip(archivePath, destDir) {
return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
const safeArchive = archivePath.replace(/'/g, "''");
const safeDest = destDir.replace(/'/g, "''");
const cmd = `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Expand-Archive -Path '${safeArchive}' -DestinationPath '${safeDest}' -Force"`;
exec(cmd, (error) => {
if (error) return reject(new Error(`Ошибка распаковки PowerShell: ${error.message}`));
resolve();
});
});
}
function copyFolderRecursiveSync(source, target, skipFiles = ['config.json', '.git', '.electron-data', 'node_modules', 'packs']) {
if (!fs.existsSync(target)) fs.mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true });
for (const item of fs.readdirSync(source)) {
if (skipFiles.includes(item)) continue;
const srcPath = path.join(source, item);
const dstPath = path.join(target, item);
if (fs.statSync(srcPath).isDirectory()) copyFolderRecursiveSync(srcPath, dstPath, skipFiles);
else fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, dstPath);
}
}
async function performUpdate(downloadUrl, onStatusUpdate) {
const tempDir = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `stream-launcher-upd-${Date.now()}`);
const archivePath = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `update-${Date.now()}.zip`);
const extractDir = path.join(tempDir, 'extracted');
try {
fs.mkdirSync(tempDir, { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync(extractDir, { recursive: true });
onStatusUpdate({ stage: 'downloading', percent: 0, text: 'Скачивание пакета обновления...' });
await downloadFile(downloadUrl, archivePath, (percent) => onStatusUpdate({ stage: 'downloading', percent, text: `Скачивание: ${percent}%` }));
onStatusUpdate({ stage: 'extracting', percent: 100, text: 'Распаковка файлов оверлеев...' });
await extractZip(archivePath, extractDir);
let sourceRoot = extractDir;
const extractedContents = fs.readdirSync(extractDir);
if (extractedContents.length === 1 && fs.statSync(path.join(extractDir, extractedContents[0])).isDirectory()) {
sourceRoot = path.join(extractDir, extractedContents[0]);
}
onStatusUpdate({ stage: 'applying', percent: 100, text: 'Применение виджетов и стилей...' });
copyFolderRecursiveSync(sourceRoot, rootDir, ['config.json', '.git', '.electron-data', 'node_modules', 'packs']);
const newVersionFile = path.join(sourceRoot, 'version.json');
if (fs.existsSync(newVersionFile)) {
try {
const newVerData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(newVersionFile, 'utf-8'));
fs.writeFileSync(versionFilePath, JSON.stringify(newVerData, null, 2), 'utf-8');
} catch (e) {}
}
configManager.saveConfig(configManager.getConfig());
onStatusUpdate({ stage: 'completed', percent: 100, text: 'Обновление успешно установлено!' });
return { success: true };
} catch (error) {
console.error('[UPDATER] Критическая ошибка обновления:', error);
onStatusUpdate({ stage: 'error', percent: 0, text: `Ошибка: ${error.message}` });
return { success: false, error: error.message };
} finally {
try { if (fs.existsSync(archivePath)) fs.unlinkSync(archivePath); } catch (e) {}
try { if (fs.existsSync(tempDir)) fs.rmSync(tempDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (e) {}
}
}
module.exports = {
getLocalVersionInfo, checkForUpdates, performUpdate,
compareVersions, fetchJson, fetchReleases, downloadFile, extractZip, PACK_TAG_RE
};

--- START OF FILE backend/wsHub.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/wsHub.js — v6.4 (реестр виджетов + SCENES_ENSURE/REFRESH + ALERTS_EMIT + запрос реестра) */
const WebSocket = require('ws');
class WsHub {
constructor({ server, config, queue, transport, registry, commands, scenes, onRemoteConfig }) {
this.config = config;
this.queue = queue;
this.transport = transport;
this.registry = registry;
this.commands = commands;
this.scenes = scenes || null;
this.onRemoteConfig = onRemoteConfig;
this.wss = new WebSocket.Server({ server });
this.widgets = new Map();
this._queueTimer = null;
this._configTimer = null;
this._pendingConfig = null;
this._pendingSender = null;
this._lastRosterJson = '';
this._lastWidgetJson = '';
this._bind();
this._sweepTimer = setInterval(() => { this.registry.sweep(); this._sweepWidgets(); }, 3000);
this._pingTimer = setInterval(() => this._keepalive(), 15000);
}
_bind() {
this.wss.on('connection', (ws, req) => {
ws.isAlive = true;
ws.on('pong', () => { ws.isAlive = true; });
console.log(`[WS] Подключение (${req.socket.remoteAddress}). Клиентов: ${this.wss.clients.size}`);
this.sendRaw(ws, { event: 'SERVER_HELLO', ts: Date.now() });
this.sendRoster(ws);
this.sendQueue(ws);
this.sendTransport(ws);
this.sendWidgetRoster(ws);
ws.on('message', (message) => this._onMessage(ws, message));
ws.on('close', () => {
const info = this.registry.getInfo(ws);
this.registry.unregister(ws);
if (this.widgets.delete(ws)) this.broadcastWidgetRoster();
if (!info) console.log(`[WS] Отключение клиента. Осталось: ${this.wss.clients.size}`);
});
ws.on('error', () => {});
});
}
_keepalive() {
this.wss.clients.forEach(c => {
if (c.isAlive === false) { try { c.terminate(); } catch (e) {} return; }
c.isAlive = false;
try { c.ping(); } catch (e) {}
});
}
sendRaw(client, obj) {
if (!client || client.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return false;
try { client.send(JSON.stringify(obj)); return true; } catch (e) { return false; }
}
broadcast(obj) {
const msg = JSON.stringify(obj);
this.wss.clients.forEach(c => { if (c.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) { try { c.send(msg); } catch (e) {} } });
}
widgetPayload() {
const list = [];
this.widgets.forEach(w => list.push({ widget: w.widget, source: w.source, instanceId: w.instanceId, master: !!w.master }));
list.sort((a, b) => (a.source + a.widget).localeCompare(b.source + b.widget));
return { widgets: list, ts: Date.now() };
}
sendWidgetRoster(client) {
this.sendRaw(client, { event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'WIDGET_ROSTER', payload: this.widgetPayload() });
}
broadcastWidgetRoster() {
const payload = this.widgetPayload();
const json = JSON.stringify(payload.widgets);
if (json === this._lastWidgetJson) return;
this._lastWidgetJson = json;
console.log(`[Widgets] ${payload.widgets.map(w => `${w.widget}:${w.source}`).join(', ') || 'пусто'}`);
this.broadcast({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'WIDGET_ROSTER', payload });
}
_sweepWidgets() {
const now = Date.now();
let changed = false;
this.widgets.forEach((w, ws) => {
if (now - w.lastSeen > 16000 || ws.readyState !== 1) { this.widgets.delete(ws); changed = true; }
});
if (changed) this.broadcastWidgetRoster();
}
broadcastRoster(payload) {
const json = JSON.stringify({ p: payload.players, a: payload.active, pr: payload.preferred });
if (json === this._lastRosterJson) return;
this._lastRosterJson = json;
console.log(`[Players] ${payload.players.map(p => `${p.mode}:${p.instanceId}`).join(', ') || 'пусто'} | активен: ${payload.active || 'нет'}`);
this.broadcast({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_ROSTER', payload });
}
broadcastQueue() {
if (this._queueTimer) clearTimeout(this._queueTimer);
this._queueTimer = setTimeout(() => {
this._queueTimer = null;
this.broadcast({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_QUEUE_STATE', payload: this.queue.payload() });
this.broadcastTransport();
}, 400);
}
broadcastTransport() {
this.broadcast({
event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_TRANSPORT',
payload: { ...this.transport.payload(), uid: this.queue.nowPlaying ? this.queue.nowPlaying.uid : null }
});
}
sendRoster(client) { this.sendRaw(client, { event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_ROSTER', payload: this.registry.payload() }); }
sendQueue(client) { this.sendRaw(client, { event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_QUEUE_STATE', payload: this.queue.payload() }); }
sendTransport(client) {
this.sendRaw(client, {
event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_TRANSPORT',
payload: { ...this.transport.payload(), uid: this.queue.nowPlaying ? this.queue.nowPlaying.uid : null }
});
}
sendToMode(mode, action, payload) {
const ws = this.registry.findWs(mode);
if (!ws) return false;
return this.sendRaw(ws, { event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action, payload });
}
sendToActive(action, payload) {
const mode = this.registry.computeActive();
if (!mode) return false;
return this.sendToMode(mode, action, payload);
}
clientCount() { return this.wss.clients.size; }
_validateActiveReport(ws, parsed, label) {
const info = this.registry.getInfo(ws);
if (!info) return null;
if (this.registry.computeActive() !== info.mode) return null;
const activeId = this.registry.activeInstanceId();
if (activeId && parsed.instanceId && parsed.instanceId !== activeId) return null;
if (!this.queue.nowPlaying) return null;
if (!parsed.uid || parsed.uid !== this.queue.nowPlaying.uid) return null;
return info;
}
_handleScenes(action, payload) {
(async () => {
const isEnsure = action === 'SCENES_ENSURE';
const resultAction = isEnsure ? 'SCENES_ENSURE_RESULT' : 'SCENES_REFRESH_RESULT';
let result;
if (!this.scenes) result = { ok: false, message: 'Менеджер сцен не инициализирован' };
else result = isEnsure ? await this.scenes.ensure(payload) : await this.scenes.refresh(payload);
console.log(`[Scenes] ${action} → ${result.ok ? 'ok' : 'fail'}: ${result.message}`);
this.broadcast({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: resultAction, payload: { ...result, origin: payload.origin || 'ws', ts: Date.now() } });
})().catch(e => console.error('[Scenes] Ошибка:', e));
}
_onMessage(ws, message) {
let parsed;
try { parsed = JSON.parse(message); } catch (e) { return; }
try {
if (parsed.event === 'WIDGET_HELLO') {
const prev = this.widgets.get(ws);
const entry = {
widget: String(parsed.widget || 'unknown').toLowerCase(),
source: parsed.source === 'preview' ? 'preview' : 'obs',
instanceId: String(parsed.instanceId || '?'),
master: !!parsed.master,
lastSeen: Date.now()
};
this.widgets.set(ws, entry);
const changed = !prev || prev.widget !== entry.widget || prev.source !== entry.source || prev.master !== entry.master;
if (changed) this.broadcastWidgetRoster();
else this.sendWidgetRoster(ws);
return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'WIDGET_ROSTER_REQUEST') { this.sendWidgetRoster(ws); return; }
if (parsed.event === 'PLAYER_REGISTER') {
const mode = parsed.mode === 'demo' ? 'demo' : 'obs';
const instanceId = String(parsed.instanceId || 'unknown');
const res = this.registry.register(ws, mode, instanceId);
if (res.changed) {
console.log(`[Players] Регистрация: ${mode} (${instanceId})`);
if (res.active === mode && res.active === res.previous) {
if (this.queue.nowPlaying) this.commands.adopt(mode);
else this.commands.onActiveChanged(mode);
}
} else this.sendRoster(ws);
return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'PLAYER_UNREGISTER') { this.registry.unregister(ws); return; }
if (parsed.event === 'PLAYER_ROSTER_REQUEST' || parsed.event === 'PLAYER_QUEUE_REQUEST') {
this.sendRoster(ws); this.sendQueue(ws); this.sendTransport(ws); return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'PLAYER_SET_ACTIVE') {
const mode = (parsed.mode === 'demo' || parsed.mode === 'obs') ? parsed.mode : null;
this.transport.freeze();
const res = this.registry.setPreferred(mode);
console.log(`[Players] Источник: ${mode || 'auto'} (эстафета ${this.transport.currentSeconds().toFixed(1)}s)`);
this.broadcastRoster(this.registry.payload());
const active = this.registry.computeActive();
if (active && this.queue.nowPlaying && active === res.previous) this.commands.adopt(active);
return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'PLAYER_TRANSPORT') {
const info = this.registry.getInfo(ws);
if (!info || this.registry.computeActive() !== info.mode) return;
const activeId = this.registry.activeInstanceId();
if (activeId && parsed.instanceId && parsed.instanceId !== activeId) return;
const current = this.queue.nowPlaying;
const hasUid = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, 'uid');
if (current) { if (hasUid && parsed.uid !== current.uid) return; }
else if (hasUid && parsed.uid) { return; }
this.transport.report(parsed, info.mode, info.instanceId);
this.commands.onTransportReport(parsed);
return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'PLAYER_TRACK_ENDED') {
if (!this._validateActiveReport(ws, parsed, 'TRACK_ENDED')) return;
this.commands.handleTrackEnded(parsed);
return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'PLAYER_TRACK_ERROR') {
if (!this._validateActiveReport(ws, parsed, 'TRACK_ERROR')) return;
this.commands.handleTrackError(parsed);
return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'UPDATE_CONFIG' && parsed.data) {
this._pendingConfig = parsed.data;
this._pendingSender = ws;
if (this._configTimer) clearTimeout(this._configTimer);
this._configTimer = setTimeout(() => {
this.config.update(this._pendingConfig, { persist: true });
this.wss.clients.forEach(c => {
if (c !== this._pendingSender && c.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
this.sendRaw(c, { event: 'CONFIG_UPDATED', data: this._pendingConfig });
}
});
if (this.onRemoteConfig) this.onRemoteConfig(this._pendingConfig);
this.commands.onConfigChange({ autostart: false });
this.broadcastQueue();
}, 100);
return;
}
if (parsed.event === 'WIDGET_ACTION') {
const action = this.commands.normalize(parsed.action);
const payload = parsed.payload || {};
if (action === 'REQUEST_PLAYER_SYNC' || action === 'REQUEST_SYNC_STATE') {
this.sendQueue(ws); this.sendTransport(ws); this.sendRoster(ws); return;
}
if (action === 'WIDGET_ROSTER_REQUEST') { this.sendWidgetRoster(ws); return; }
if (action === 'SCENES_REFRESH' || action === 'SCENES_ENSURE') { this._handleScenes(action, payload); return; }
if (action === 'ALERTS_EMIT') {
const body = { ...payload, target: 'all', emitId: 'e' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6) };
console.log(`[Alerts] Инъекция ${body.type} от ${body.user}`);
this.broadcast({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'ALERTS_EMIT', payload: body });
return;
}
if (this.commands.isPlayerCommand(action)) {
if (!this.config.isEnabled() && action !== 'PLAYER_STOP' && action !== 'PLAYER_MUTE') {
if (payload.cmdId) {
this.sendRaw(ws, { event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_ACK', payload: { cmdId: payload.cmdId, action, ok: false, message: 'Плеер выключен в настройках' } });
}
return;
}
const result = this.commands.handle(action, payload);
if (action !== 'PLAYER_SEEK') console.log(`[Cmd] ${action} → ${result.ok ? 'ok' : 'fail'}: ${result.message}`);
if (payload.cmdId) {
this.sendRaw(ws, { event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'PLAYER_ACK', payload: { cmdId: payload.cmdId, action, ok: result.ok, message: result.message } });
}
return;
}
this.wss.clients.forEach(c => {
if (c !== ws && c.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) { try { c.send(message); } catch (e) {} }
});
}
} catch (e) { console.error('[WS] Ошибка обработки:', e.message); }
}
}
module.exports = WsHub;

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/external/keyFile.js — v1 (запись ключа: создание из шаблона, импорт drag&drop, бэкап, атомарность) */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const schema = require('./schema');
const { buildManifest } = require('./manifest');

const { DATA_DIR, FILE_PATH, EXAMPLE_PATH, BACKUP_PATH, TMP_PATH, MAX_IMPORT_BYTES } = schema;

/** Создаёт боевой файл из шаблона. Существующий файл никогда не перезаписывает. */
function createFromExample() {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(FILE_PATH)) {
      return { status: 'exists', path: FILE_PATH, message: 'Файл уже существует — перезапись запрещена.' };
    }
    if (!fs.existsSync(EXAMPLE_PATH)) {
      return { status: 'error', message: 'Шаблон data/external-sources.example.json не найден.' };
    }
    fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
    fs.copyFileSync(EXAMPLE_PATH, FILE_PATH);
    console.log('[External] Создан локальный ключ из шаблона:', FILE_PATH);
    return { status: 'ok', path: FILE_PATH, message: 'Файл создан. Вставьте в него свои ссылки.' };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[External] Не удалось создать файл:', e);
    return { status: 'error', message: e.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Импорт ключа из перетащенного файла.
 * Валидация ДО записи: битый JSON никогда не затирает рабочий ключ.
 * Старый ключ сохраняется в external-sources.backup.json.
 */
function importFromText(text, originalName = '') {
  const safeName = String(originalName || '').slice(0, 120);
  try {
    if (typeof text !== 'string') {
      return { status: 'error', message: 'Содержимое файла не передано.' };
    }
    const raw = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    if (!raw.trim()) {
      return { status: 'invalid', message: 'Файл пуст.', errors: ['Файл пуст.'], warnings: [] };
    }
    if (Buffer.byteLength(raw, 'utf8') > MAX_IMPORT_BYTES) {
      return { status: 'invalid', message: 'Файл больше 1 МБ — это не ключ внешних источников.', errors: ['Превышен лимит размера 1 МБ.'], warnings: [] };
    }

    let data;
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e) {
      return { status: 'invalid', message: `JSON повреждён: ${e.message}`, errors: [`JSON повреждён: ${e.message}`], warnings: [] };
    }

    const check = buildManifest(data);
    if (!check.ok) {
      console.warn('[External] Импорт отклонён:', check.errors.join('; '));
      return {
        status: 'invalid',
        message: 'Файл не прошёл валидацию. Текущий ключ не изменён.',
        errors: check.errors,
        warnings: check.warnings
      };
    }

    fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
    const replaced = fs.existsSync(FILE_PATH);
    let backupPath = null;
    if (replaced) {
      fs.copyFileSync(FILE_PATH, BACKUP_PATH);
      backupPath = BACKUP_PATH;
    }

    const content = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
    fs.writeFileSync(TMP_PATH, content, 'utf-8');
    try {
      fs.renameSync(TMP_PATH, FILE_PATH);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[External] Атомарный rename не удался, пишу напрямую:', e.message);
      fs.writeFileSync(FILE_PATH, content, 'utf-8');
      try { fs.unlinkSync(TMP_PATH); } catch (e2) {}
    }

    const warnings = check.warnings.slice();
    if (check.sources.length === 0) warnings.push('В файле нет ни одного источника.');
    const activeCount = check.sources.filter(s => s.enabled).length;

    console.log(`[External] Ключ импортирован${safeName ? ` из «${safeName}»` : ''}: ${check.sources.length} источник(ов), бэкап: ${backupPath || 'не требовался'}`);
    return {
      status: 'ok',
      path: FILE_PATH,
      fileName: path.basename(FILE_PATH),
      replaced,
      backupPath,
      backupName: backupPath ? path.basename(backupPath) : null,
      count: check.sources.length,
      activeCount,
      errors: [],
      warnings,
      message: `Ключ принят: ${check.sources.length} источник(ов).`
    };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[External] Импорт упал:', e);
    return { status: 'error', message: `Не удалось записать ключ: ${e.message}` };
  }
}

module.exports = { createFromExample, importFromText };

--- START OF FILE backend/external/manifest.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/external/manifest.js — v1 (чтение и валидация ключа + безопасный срез для UI) */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const schema = require('./schema');

const {
  FILE_PATH, EXAMPLE_PATH, EXTERNAL_PREFIX, DEFAULT_SCENES, DEFAULT_CSS,
  LIMITS, MONITOR_LABELS,
  toNum, clamp, toBool, normalizeMonitor, normalizeScenes, normalizeTransform,
  maskUrl, hostOf, fullName, baseDefaults, emptyManifest
} = schema;

/** Валидация уже разобранного JSON. Общая для load() и импорта: битый ключ не затирает рабочий. */
function buildManifest(data) {
  const result = emptyManifest();
  result.exists = true;

  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {
    result.errors.push('Корень файла должен быть объектом { "sources": [...] }');
    return result;
  }

  result.enabled = toBool(data.enabled, true);
  result.namePrefix = typeof data.namePrefix === 'string' && data.namePrefix ? data.namePrefix : EXTERNAL_PREFIX;

  if (!Array.isArray(data.scenes) || data.scenes.length === 0) {
    result.warnings.push('Список scenes не задан — использую все 4 сцены пака.');
  }
  result.scenes = normalizeScenes(data.scenes, DEFAULT_SCENES);

  const d = (data.defaults && typeof data.defaults === 'object') ? data.defaults : {};
  result.defaults = {
    shutdown: toBool(d.shutdown, false),
    reroute_audio: toBool(d.reroute_audio, true),
    monitor: normalizeMonitor(d.monitor, 'both'),
    css: typeof d.css === 'string' && d.css ? d.css : DEFAULT_CSS
  };

  if (!Array.isArray(data.sources)) {
    result.errors.push('Поле sources должно быть массивом');
    return result;
  }

  const seenIds = new Set();
  data.sources.forEach((raw, index) => {
    const label = `Источник #${index + 1}`;
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
      result.errors.push(`${label}: запись должна быть объектом — пропущена`);
      return;
    }

    const errors = [];
    let id = String(raw.id || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!id) {
      id = `source-${index + 1}`;
      result.warnings.push(`${label}: не задан id, назначен "${id}"`);
    }
    if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/.test(id)) {
      result.errors.push(`${label}: некорректный id "${id}" (разрешены a-z, 0-9, дефис, подчёркивание) — пропущен`);
      return;
    }
    if (seenIds.has(id)) {
      result.errors.push(`${label}: дубликат id "${id}" — пропущен`);
      return;
    }

    const name = String(raw.name || '').trim() || id;
    const url = String(raw.url || '').trim();
    if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
      result.errors.push(`«${name}»: ссылка должна начинаться с http:// или https:// — пропущен`);
      return;
    }
    if (/ВСТАВЬТЕ|YOUR_TOKEN|PLACEHOLDER/i.test(url)) {
      result.warnings.push(`«${name}»: в ссылке остался шаблонный плейсхолдер — источник работать не будет`);
    }

    const width = Math.round(clamp(toNum(raw.width, 1920), LIMITS.size[0], LIMITS.size[1]));
    const height = Math.round(clamp(toNum(raw.height, 1080), LIMITS.size[0], LIMITS.size[1]));
    const transform = normalizeTransform(raw.transform, errors, `«${name}»`);
    errors.forEach(msg => result.warnings.push(msg));

    seenIds.add(id);
    result.sources.push({
      id,
      name,
      url,
      width,
      height,
      enabled: toBool(raw.enabled, true),
      note: String(raw.note || '').trim(),
      scenes: Array.isArray(raw.scenes) && raw.scenes.length ? normalizeScenes(raw.scenes, result.scenes) : null,
      shutdown: toBool(raw.shutdown, result.defaults.shutdown),
      reroute_audio: toBool(raw.reroute_audio, result.defaults.reroute_audio),
      monitor: normalizeMonitor(raw.monitor, result.defaults.monitor),
      css: typeof raw.css === 'string' && raw.css ? raw.css : result.defaults.css,
      transform
    });
  });

  result.ok = result.errors.length === 0;
  return result;
}

/**
 * Читает и валидирует локальный ключ. Никогда не бросает исключение.
 * @returns {{exists:boolean, ok:boolean, enabled:boolean, namePrefix:string, scenes:string[], defaults:object, sources:object[], errors:string[], warnings:string[]}}
 */
function load() {
  const result = emptyManifest();
  let rawText = '';

  try {
    if (!fs.existsSync(FILE_PATH)) {
      console.log('[External] Локальный ключ не найден:', FILE_PATH);
      return result;
    }
    result.exists = true;
    rawText = fs.readFileSync(FILE_PATH, 'utf-8');
  } catch (e) {
    result.errors.push(`Не удалось прочитать файл: ${e.message}`);
    console.error('[External] Ошибка чтения:', e);
    return result;
  }

  let data = null;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(rawText.replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));
  } catch (e) {
    result.errors.push(`JSON повреждён: ${e.message}`);
    console.error('[External] JSON повреждён:', e.message);
    return result;
  }

  const manifest = buildManifest(data);
  console.log(`[External] Ключ загружен: ${manifest.sources.length} источник(ов), ошибок ${manifest.errors.length}, предупреждений ${manifest.warnings.length}`);
  return manifest;
}

/** Безопасный срез для интерфейса: ссылки замаскированы, токенов нет. */
function getStatus() {
  const m = load();
  return {
    supported: true,
    exists: m.exists,
    ok: m.ok,
    enabled: m.enabled,
    path: FILE_PATH,
    fileName: path.basename(FILE_PATH),
    exampleExists: fs.existsSync(EXAMPLE_PATH),
    count: m.sources.length,
    activeCount: m.sources.filter(s => s.enabled).length,
    scenes: m.scenes,
    monitorDefault: m.defaults.monitor,
    errors: m.errors,
    warnings: m.warnings,
    sources: m.sources.map(s => ({
      id: s.id,
      name: s.name,
      fullName: fullName(s, m.namePrefix),
      url: maskUrl(s.url),
      host: hostOf(s.url),
      width: s.width,
      height: s.height,
      enabled: s.enabled,
      note: s.note,
      scenes: s.scenes && s.scenes.length ? s.scenes : m.scenes,
      transform: s.transform,
      monitor: s.monitor,
      monitorLabel: MONITOR_LABELS[s.monitor] || s.monitor,
      rerouteAudio: s.reroute_audio
    }))
  };
}

module.exports = { buildManifest, load, getStatus };

--- START OF FILE backend/external/schema.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/external/schema.js — v1 (чистая схема ключа: пути, лимиты, нормализаторы, маскирование) */
const path = require('path');

const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..');
const DATA_DIR = path.join(ROOT, 'data');
const FILE_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'external-sources.json');
const EXAMPLE_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'external-sources.example.json');
const BACKUP_PATH = path.join(DATA_DIR, 'external-sources.backup.json');
const TMP_PATH = FILE_PATH + '.tmp';

/** Префикс имён в OBS. По нему лаунчер отличает свои внешние источники от чужих. */
const EXTERNAL_PREFIX = '🔗 [Внешний] ';

const DEFAULT_SCENES = [
  '🔴 [Сцена] Начало',
  '🗣 [Сцена] Общение',
  '🎮 [Сцена] Игра',
  '👋 [Сцена] Конец'
];

const DEFAULT_CSS = 'body { background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0px auto; overflow: hidden; }';
const MAX_IMPORT_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;

/** Режимы звука источника → тип мониторинга OBS WebSocket 5. */
const MONITOR_OBS_TYPES = {
  both: 'OBS_MONITORING_TYPE_MONITOR_AND_OUTPUT',
  monitor: 'OBS_MONITORING_TYPE_MONITOR_ONLY',
  stream: 'OBS_MONITORING_TYPE_NONE'
};

const MONITOR_LABELS = {
  both: 'МОНИТОР+ЭФИР',
  monitor: 'ТОЛЬКО СТРИМЕР',
  stream: 'ТОЛЬКО ЭФИР'
};

const MONITOR_MODES = ['both', 'monitor', 'stream'];

const LIMITS = {
  size: [16, 8192],
  position: [-20000, 20000],
  scale: [-8, 8],
  crop: [0, 20000]
};

function toNum(value, fallback) {
  const n = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
}

function clamp(value, min, max) {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
}

function toBool(value, fallback) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
  const s = String(value).toLowerCase();
  if (s === 'true' || s === '1' || s === 'yes' || s === 'on') return true;
  if (s === 'false' || s === '0' || s === 'no' || s === 'off') return false;
  return fallback;
}

/** monitor: "both" (стример+зрители), "monitor" (только стример), "stream" (только зрители). Boolean тоже принят. */
function normalizeMonitor(value, fallback) {
  const fb = MONITOR_MODES.includes(fallback) ? fallback : 'both';
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return fb;
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? 'both' : 'stream';
  const s = String(value).toLowerCase().trim();
  if (['true', '1', 'yes', 'on', 'both', 'all', 'monitor+output', 'monitor_and_output'].includes(s)) return 'both';
  if (['false', '0', 'no', 'off', 'stream', 'output', 'none'].includes(s)) return 'stream';
  if (['monitor', 'monitor_only', 'self'].includes(s)) return 'monitor';
  return fb;
}

function normalizeScenes(raw, fallback) {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return fallback.slice();
  const list = raw.map(x => String(x || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return list.length ? list : fallback.slice();
}

function normalizeTransform(raw, errors, label) {
  const t = (raw && typeof raw === 'object') ? raw : {};
  if (raw && typeof raw !== 'object') errors.push(`${label}: transform должен быть объектом, использую значения по умолчанию`);
  let scaleX = clamp(toNum(t.scaleX, 1), LIMITS.scale[0], LIMITS.scale[1]);
  let scaleY = clamp(toNum(t.scaleY, 1), LIMITS.scale[0], LIMITS.scale[1]);
  if (scaleX === 0) { scaleX = 1; errors.push(`${label}: scaleX = 0 недопустим, заменён на 1`); }
  if (scaleY === 0) { scaleY = 1; errors.push(`${label}: scaleY = 0 недопустим, заменён на 1`); }
  return {
    positionX: Math.round(clamp(toNum(t.positionX, 0), LIMITS.position[0], LIMITS.position[1])),
    positionY: Math.round(clamp(toNum(t.positionY, 0), LIMITS.position[0], LIMITS.position[1])),
    scaleX,
    scaleY,
    cropTop: Math.round(clamp(toNum(t.cropTop, 0), LIMITS.crop[0], LIMITS.crop[1])),
    cropBottom: Math.round(clamp(toNum(t.cropBottom, 0), LIMITS.crop[0], LIMITS.crop[1])),
    cropLeft: Math.round(clamp(toNum(t.cropLeft, 0), LIMITS.crop[0], LIMITS.crop[1])),
    cropRight: Math.round(clamp(toNum(t.cropRight, 0), LIMITS.crop[0], LIMITS.crop[1]))
  };
}

/**
 * Прячет секреты в ссылке. В UI и в логах не должно быть ни токенов DA,
 * ни JWT Twitch/MemeAlerts — стример может показать лаунчер на стриме.
 */
function maskUrl(raw) {
  const s = String(raw || '');
  if (!s) return '';
  let out = s.replace(/([?&](?:token|obsToken|obs_token|key|secret|password|auth|jwt)=)[^&#]+/gi, '$1••••••••');
  out = out.replace(/#eyJ[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/g, '#••••••••');
  out = out.replace(/eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}/g, '••••••••');
  return out;
}

function hostOf(raw) {
  try { return new URL(String(raw)).hostname; }
  catch (e) { return 'некорректная ссылка'; }
}

function fullName(source, prefix) {
  const p = typeof prefix === 'string' && prefix ? prefix : EXTERNAL_PREFIX;
  return `${p}${source.name}`;
}

/** Принадлежит ли имя источника нам (защита от удаления при авто-настройке сцен). */
function isExternalName(name, prefix) {
  const s = String(name || '');
  if (s.startsWith(EXTERNAL_PREFIX)) return true;
  if (typeof prefix === 'string' && prefix && s.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
  return false;
}

function baseDefaults() {
  return { shutdown: false, reroute_audio: true, monitor: 'both', css: DEFAULT_CSS };
}

function emptyManifest() {
  return {
    exists: false,
    ok: false,
    enabled: false,
    namePrefix: EXTERNAL_PREFIX,
    scenes: DEFAULT_SCENES.slice(),
    defaults: baseDefaults(),
    sources: [],
    errors: [],
    warnings: []
  };
}

module.exports = {
  ROOT,
  DATA_DIR,
  FILE_PATH,
  EXAMPLE_PATH,
  BACKUP_PATH,
  TMP_PATH,
  EXTERNAL_PREFIX,
  DEFAULT_SCENES,
  DEFAULT_CSS,
  MAX_IMPORT_BYTES,
  MONITOR_OBS_TYPES,
  MONITOR_LABELS,
  MONITOR_MODES,
  LIMITS,
  toNum,
  clamp,
  toBool,
  normalizeMonitor,
  normalizeScenes,
  normalizeTransform,
  maskUrl,
  hostOf,
  fullName,
  isExternalName,
  baseDefaults,
  emptyManifest
};
