/* ФАЙЛ: backend/obs/applyExternal.js — v1 (размещение внешних источников + самопрослушивание + защита чужих) */
const { obs, connectObs, safeDisconnect } = require('./connection');
const { enforceSingleItem, listItems, raiseToTop, setSourceVisible } = require('./sceneItems');
const externalSources = require('../externalSources');

/**
 * Внешние браузер-источники стримера (DonationAlerts / Twitch AlertBox / MemeAlerts).
 * Работает поверх уже подключённого obs. Порядок в массиве = порядок слоёв:
 * каждый следующий поднимается наверх, последний оказывается выше всех.
 * Звук: reroute_audio ведёт звук в микшер OBS, SetInputAudioMonitorType включает
 * самопрослушивание, чтобы стример слышал донаты в наушниках.
 */
async function applyExternalSources(sendLog) {
  const result = { status: 'ok', applied: 0, skipped: 0, scenes: 0, message: '' };

  let manifest;
  try {
    manifest = externalSources.load();
  } catch (e) {
    result.status = 'error';
    result.message = `Не удалось прочитать ключ: ${e.message}`;
    sendLog(result.message, 'error');
    return result;
  }

  if (!manifest.exists) {
    result.status = 'missing';
    result.message = 'Файл data/external-sources.json не найден. Перетащите файл-ключ в Настройках → Внешние источники или создайте из шаблона.';
    sendLog(result.message, 'warn');
    return result;
  }
  if (!manifest.ok) {
    result.status = 'invalid';
    result.message = `Ошибки в external-sources.json: ${manifest.errors.join('; ')}`;
    manifest.errors.forEach(err => sendLog(`Внешние источники: ${err}`, 'error'));
    return result;
  }

  manifest.warnings.forEach(w => sendLog(`Внешние источники: ${w}`, 'warn'));

  if (!manifest.enabled) {
    result.status = 'disabled';
    result.message = 'Внешние источники выключены в конфиге (enabled: false).';
    sendLog(result.message, 'warn');
    return result;
  }
  if (manifest.sources.length === 0) {
    result.status = 'empty';
    result.message = 'В файле нет ни одного источника.';
    sendLog(result.message, 'warn');
    return result;
  }

  let sceneNames = [];
  try {
    const { scenes } = await obs.call('GetSceneList');
    sceneNames = (scenes || []).map(s => s.sceneName);
  } catch (e) {
    result.status = 'error';
    result.message = `Не удалось получить список сцен: ${e.message}`;
    sendLog(result.message, 'error');
    return result;
  }

  const targetScenes = manifest.scenes.filter(s => sceneNames.includes(s));
  if (targetScenes.length === 0) {
    result.status = 'no-scenes';
    result.message = 'Ни одна из целевых сцен не найдена в OBS. Сначала выполните «Авто-настройка OBS».';
    sendLog(result.message, 'error');
    return result;
  }
  result.scenes = targetScenes.length;

  let inputNames = new Set();
  try {
    const { inputs } = await obs.call('GetInputList');
    inputNames = new Set((inputs || []).map(i => i.inputName));
  } catch (e) {
    sendLog(`Не удалось получить список источников: ${e.message}`, 'warn');
  }

  sendLog(`Внешние источники: ${manifest.sources.length} шт. → сцен ${targetScenes.length}`, 'info');

  const monitored = manifest.sources.filter(s => s.enabled && s.monitor !== 'stream');
  if (monitored.length > 0) {
    sendLog(`Самопрослушивание активно у ${monitored.length} источник(ов). Устройство прослушивания: OBS → Настройки → Звук → Дополнительно. Рекомендуются наушники — иначе мониторинг может попасть в захват рабочего стола и дать двойной звук на стриме.`, 'info');
  }

  for (const source of manifest.sources) {
    const name = externalSources.fullName(source, manifest.namePrefix);
    const wanted = (source.scenes && source.scenes.length) ? source.scenes : manifest.scenes;
    const srcScenes = wanted.filter(s => sceneNames.includes(s));

    if (srcScenes.length === 0) {
      sendLog(`«${source.name}»: целевые сцены не найдены — пропуск`, 'warn');
      result.skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    // Выключенный источник не удаляем — просто прячем, если он уже есть.
    if (!source.enabled) {
      if (inputNames.has(name)) {
        for (const sc of srcScenes) {
          try { await setSourceVisible(sc, name, false); }
          catch (e) { console.warn('[External] hide:', sc, e.message); }
        }
        sendLog(`⏸ «${source.name}» выключен в конфиге — скрыт на сценах`, 'info');
      }
      result.skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    const settings = {
      url: source.url,
      width: source.width,
      height: source.height,
      css: source.css,
      shutdown: source.shutdown,
      reroute_audio: source.reroute_audio
    };

    try {
      if (!inputNames.has(name)) {
        await obs.call('CreateInput', {
          sceneName: srcScenes[0],
          inputName: name,
          inputKind: 'browser_source',
          inputSettings: settings
        });
        inputNames.add(name);
        sendLog(`Создан источник «${name}» (${source.width}×${source.height})`, 'success');
      } else {
        await obs.call('SetInputSettings', { inputName: name, inputSettings: settings, overlay: true });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      sendLog(`Не удалось создать/обновить «${name}»: ${e.message}`, 'error');
      result.skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    // Самопрослушивание: «Прослушивание и вывод» в расширенных свойствах аудио OBS.
    const monitorType = externalSources.MONITOR_OBS_TYPES[source.monitor] || externalSources.MONITOR_OBS_TYPES.both;
    try {
      await obs.call('SetInputAudioMonitorType', { inputName: name, monitorType });
      console.log(`[External] ${name}: мониторинг → ${source.monitor} (${monitorType})`);
    } catch (e) {
      sendLog(`«${source.name}»: самопрослушивание не применено (${e.message}). Нужен OBS 28+ со встроенным WebSocket 5. Размещение источника продолжается.`, 'warn');
    }
    if (!source.reroute_audio && source.monitor !== 'stream') {
      sendLog(`«${source.name}»: monitor="${source.monitor}" требует reroute_audio: true («Управлять звуком через OBS»), иначе звук идёт мимо микшера OBS.`, 'warn');
    }

    let placed = 0;
    for (const sc of srcScenes) {
      try {
        const itemId = await enforceSingleItem(sc, name);
        await obs.call('SetSceneItemTransform', {
          sceneName: sc,
          sceneItemId: itemId,
          sceneItemTransform: {
            positionX: source.transform.positionX,
            positionY: source.transform.positionY,
            scaleX: source.transform.scaleX,
            scaleY: source.transform.scaleY,
            cropTop: source.transform.cropTop,
            cropBottom: source.transform.cropBottom,
            cropLeft: source.transform.cropLeft,
            cropRight: source.transform.cropRight,
            alignment: 5,
            boundsType: 'OBS_BOUNDS_NONE'
          }
        });
        await obs.call('SetSceneItemEnabled', { sceneName: sc, sceneItemId: itemId, sceneItemEnabled: true });
        await raiseToTop(sc, itemId);
        placed++;
      } catch (e) {
        sendLog(`«${source.name}» на сцене ${sc}: ${e.message}`, 'warn');
      }
    }

    if (placed > 0) {
      result.applied++;
      const monitorLabel = externalSources.MONITOR_LABELS[source.monitor] || source.monitor;
      sendLog(`✅ «${source.name}» → ${placed} сцен(ы) · звук: ${monitorLabel} · ${externalSources.maskUrl(source.url)}`, 'success');
    } else {
      result.skipped++;
    }
  }

  // Осиротевшие источники: остались в OBS, но исчезли из ключа. Не удаляем — только сообщаем.
  try {
    const known = new Set(manifest.sources.map(s => externalSources.fullName(s, manifest.namePrefix)));
    const orphans = new Set();
    for (const sc of targetScenes) {
      const items = await listItems(sc);
      items.forEach(i => {
        if (externalSources.isExternalName(i.sourceName, manifest.namePrefix) && !known.has(i.sourceName)) {
          orphans.add(i.sourceName);
        }
      });
    }
    if (orphans.size > 0) {
      sendLog(`В сценах остались источники, которых нет в ключе: ${[...orphans].join(', ')}. Они НЕ удалены — уберите вручную или верните в файл.`, 'warn');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[External] Проверка осиротевших источников не удалась:', e.message);
  }

  result.message = `Внешние источники применены: ${result.applied} из ${manifest.sources.length} на ${result.scenes} сценах.`;
  if (result.applied > 0) sendLog(result.message, 'success');
  else {
    result.status = 'nothing';
    sendLog('Ни один внешний источник не удалось разместить.', 'warn');
  }
  return result;
}

/** Отдельная кнопка «Применить внешние источники» — без перестройки всех сцен. */
async function runExternalApply(customPath, sendLog) {
  try {
    sendLog('Внешние источники: подключение к OBS WebSocket...', 'info');
    const isConnected = await connectObs(customPath, sendLog);
    if (!isConnected) {
      throw new Error('OBS не отвечает. Проверьте WebSocket: порт 4455, аутентификация снята.');
    }
    const result = await applyExternalSources(sendLog);
    await safeDisconnect();
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    sendLog(error.message, 'error');
    await safeDisconnect();
    return { status: 'error', message: error.message };
  }
}

module.exports = { applyExternalSources, runExternalApply };

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/obs/connection.js — v1 (ЕДИНСТВЕННЫЙ экземпляр сокета OBS + запуск процесса + коннект) */
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const OBSWebSocket = require('obs-websocket-js').default;

const OBS_URL = 'ws://127.0.0.1:4455';

/**
 * Один сокет на всё приложение. Node кэширует модули, поэтому любой require('./connection')
 * получает тот же инстанс. НЕ создавать new OBSWebSocket() в других модулях.
 */
const obs = new OBSWebSocket();

const delay = (ms) => new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, ms));

const POSSIBLE_PATHS = [
  'D:\\PORTABLE\\obs-studio\\bin\\64bit\\obs64.exe',
  'C:\\Program Files\\obs-studio\\bin\\64bit\\obs64.exe',
  'D:\\Program Files\\obs-studio\\bin\\64bit\\obs64.exe'
];

function launchOBS(customPath, sendLog) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let obsPath = null;
    let obsDir = null;

    if (customPath && fs.existsSync(customPath)) {
      obsPath = customPath;
      obsDir = path.dirname(customPath);
    } else {
      for (const checkPath of POSSIBLE_PATHS) {
        if (fs.existsSync(checkPath)) {
          obsPath = checkPath;
          obsDir = path.dirname(checkPath);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!obsPath) {
      sendLog('OBS не найден! Укажите путь вручную в настройках.', 'error');
      return resolve(false);
    }

    sendLog(`Запускаем OBS из: ${obsPath}`, 'info');
    try {
      const obsProcess = spawn(obsPath, [], { cwd: obsDir, detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' });
      obsProcess.unref();
    } catch (e) {
      sendLog(`Не удалось запустить OBS: ${e.message}`, 'error');
      return resolve(false);
    }
    setTimeout(() => resolve(true), 2000);
  });
}

/** Единая точка подключения: сначала пробуем сокет, потом запускаем OBS и ждём плагины. */
async function connectObs(customPath, sendLog) {
  try {
    await obs.connect(OBS_URL, undefined, { rpcVersion: 1 });
    sendLog('Успешное подключение!', 'success');
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    sendLog('OBS не отвечает. Пытаемся запустить процесс...', 'warn');
    const isLaunched = await launchOBS(customPath, sendLog);
    if (!isLaunched) return false;

    sendLog('Ожидание загрузки плагинов OBS (до 15 сек)...', 'info');
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      await delay(3000);
      sendLog(`Попытка подключения ${i + 1}/5...`, 'info');
      try {
        await obs.connect(OBS_URL, undefined, { rpcVersion: 1 });
        sendLog('Успешное подключение после запуска!', 'success');
        return true;
      } catch (retryError) {}
    }
    return false;
  }
}

async function safeDisconnect() {
  try { await obs.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
}

module.exports = { obs, OBS_URL, delay, launchOBS, connectObs, safeDisconnect };

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/obs/exportLayout.js — v1 (глубокий экспорт раскладки + диагностика аудио/видео и фильтров) */
const { obs, OBS_URL, safeDisconnect } = require('./connection');
const { listItems } = require('./sceneItems');
const { PACK_SCENES, INPUT_KINDS } = require('./layout');

async function readVolume(inputName) {
  try {
    const v = await obs.call('GetInputVolume', { inputName });
    return Number(Number(v.inputVolumeDb).toFixed(2));
  } catch (e) { return 0; }
}

async function readMute(inputName) {
  try {
    const m = await obs.call('GetInputMute', { inputName });
    return Boolean(m.inputMuted);
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

async function readSettings(inputName) {
  try {
    const s = await obs.call('GetInputSettings', { inputName });
    return s.inputSettings || {};
  } catch (e) { return {}; }
}

async function readFilters(sourceName) {
  const detailed = [];
  try {
    const fList = await obs.call('GetSourceFilterList', { sourceName });
    for (const fl of fList.filters || []) {
      let settings = {};
      try {
        const fData = await obs.call('GetSourceFilter', { sourceName, filterName: fl.filterName });
        settings = fData.filterSettings;
      } catch (e) {}
      detailed.push({ name: fl.filterName, kind: fl.filterKind, enabled: fl.filterEnabled, settings });
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return detailed;
}

async function collectSceneLayout(sendLog) {
  const layout = {};
  for (const sceneName of PACK_SCENES) {
    layout[sceneName] = {};
    try {
      const items = await listItems(sceneName);
      for (const item of items) {
        if (String(item.sourceName || '').startsWith('⚙️ [Ядро]')) continue;
        const { sceneItemTransform } = await obs.call('GetSceneItemTransform', { sceneName, sceneItemId: item.sceneItemId });
        const exportItem = {
          index: item.sceneItemIndex,
          positionX: Math.round(sceneItemTransform.positionX),
          positionY: Math.round(sceneItemTransform.positionY),
          scaleX: Number(sceneItemTransform.scaleX.toFixed(2)),
          scaleY: Number(sceneItemTransform.scaleY.toFixed(2))
        };
        if (sceneItemTransform.cropTop) exportItem.cropTop = sceneItemTransform.cropTop;
        if (sceneItemTransform.cropBottom) exportItem.cropBottom = sceneItemTransform.cropBottom;
        if (sceneItemTransform.cropLeft) exportItem.cropLeft = sceneItemTransform.cropLeft;
        if (sceneItemTransform.cropRight) exportItem.cropRight = sceneItemTransform.cropRight;
        layout[sceneName][item.sourceName] = exportItem;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      sendLog(`Сцена ${sceneName} не найдена или пуста.`, 'warn');
    }
  }
  return layout;
}

async function collectDiagnostics() {
  const diagnostics = { globalAudio: [], localAudio: [], videoInputs: [], rawErrors: [] };

  try {
    const specialInputs = await obs.call('GetSpecialInputs');
    for (const [key, sourceName] of Object.entries(specialInputs)) {
      if (!sourceName) continue;
      diagnostics.globalAudio.push({
        type: key,
        name: sourceName,
        volumeDb: await readVolume(sourceName),
        muted: await readMute(sourceName),
        settings: await readSettings(sourceName),
        filters: await readFilters(sourceName)
      });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    diagnostics.rawErrors.push(`SpecialInputs: ${e.message}`);
  }

  try {
    const { inputs } = await obs.call('GetInputList');
    for (const input of inputs || []) {
      const kind = input.unversionedInputKind || input.inputKind;
      const sourceName = input.inputName;

      if (INPUT_KINDS.audioAny.includes(kind)) {
        diagnostics.localAudio.push({
          name: sourceName,
          kind,
          volumeDb: await readVolume(sourceName),
          muted: await readMute(sourceName),
          settings: await readSettings(sourceName),
          filters: await readFilters(sourceName)
        });
      }
      if (INPUT_KINDS.videoAny.includes(kind)) {
        diagnostics.videoInputs.push({
          name: sourceName,
          kind,
          settings: await readSettings(sourceName),
          filters: await readFilters(sourceName)
        });
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    diagnostics.rawErrors.push(`GetInputList: ${e.message}`);
  }

  return diagnostics;
}

async function exportLayout(sendLog) {
  try {
    sendLog('Подключение к OBS для глубокого экспорта и диагностики...', 'info');
    try {
      await obs.call('GetVersion');
    } catch (e) {
      await obs.connect(OBS_URL, undefined, { rpcVersion: 1 });
    }

    const layout = await collectSceneLayout(sendLog);
    layout._diagnostics = await collectDiagnostics();

    await safeDisconnect();
    return layout;
  } catch (error) {
    sendLog(`Ошибка экспорта: ${error.message}`, 'error');
    await safeDisconnect();
    return null;
  }
}

module.exports = { exportLayout };

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/obs/sceneItems.js — v1 (операции над элементами сцены: дедуп, удаление, подъём, видимость) */
const { obs } = require('./connection');

/** Список элементов сцены. Пустой массив вместо null/undefined. */
async function listItems(sceneName) {
  const { sceneItems } = await obs.call('GetSceneItemList', { sceneName });
  return sceneItems || [];
}

/** Гарантирует ровно один элемент источника на сцене: создаёт или убирает дубли. */
async function enforceSingleItem(sceneName, sourceName) {
  const items = await listItems(sceneName);
  const matching = items.filter(i => i.sourceName === sourceName);

  if (matching.length === 0) {
    const response = await obs.call('CreateSceneItem', { sceneName, sourceName });
    return response.sceneItemId;
  }
  if (matching.length > 1) {
    for (let i = 1; i < matching.length; i++) {
      await obs.call('RemoveSceneItem', { sceneName, sceneItemId: matching[i].sceneItemId });
    }
  }
  return matching[0].sceneItemId;
}

async function removeIfPresent(sceneName, sourceName) {
  const items = await listItems(sceneName);
  for (const item of items.filter(i => i.sourceName === sourceName)) {
    await obs.call('RemoveSceneItem', { sceneName, sceneItemId: item.sceneItemId });
  }
}

/** Поднимает элемент на самый верх порядка слоёв. */
async function raiseToTop(sceneName, sceneItemId) {
  const items = await listItems(sceneName);
  const topIndex = Math.max(0, items.length - 1);
  await obs.call('SetSceneItemIndex', { sceneName, sceneItemId, sceneItemIndex: topIndex });
}

/** Включает/выключает видимость всех элементов источника на сцене. */
async function setSourceVisible(sceneName, sourceName, enabled) {
  const items = await listItems(sceneName);
  for (const item of items.filter(i => i.sourceName === sourceName)) {
    await obs.call('SetSceneItemEnabled', { sceneName, sceneItemId: item.sceneItemId, sceneItemEnabled: enabled });
  }
}

module.exports = { listItems, enforceSingleItem, removeIfPresent, raiseToTop, setSourceVisible };

--- START OF FILE backend/obs/setupScenes.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/obs/setupScenes.js — v1 (авто-настройка коллекции, сцен, виджетов и лейаута пака) */
const { obs, delay, connectObs, safeDisconnect } = require('./connection');
const { enforceSingleItem, removeIfPresent, listItems } = require('./sceneItems');
const {
  COLLECTION_NAME, SYS_AUDIO_SCENE, MIC_AUDIO_SCENE, LEGACY_AUDIO_SCENE,
  PACK_SCENES, BROWSER_CSS, WIDGETS, INPUT_KINDS, LAYOUT
} = require('./layout');
const externalSources = require('../externalSources');
const { applyExternalSources } = require('./applyExternal');

/** Ищет уже существующее железо стримера, чтобы не плодить дубликаты устройств. */
function detectHardware(inputs) {
  const found = { micName: null, desktopName: null, webcamName: null, screenName: null };
  for (const input of inputs || []) {
    const kind = input.unversionedInputKind || input.inputKind;
    if (!found.micName && INPUT_KINDS.mic.includes(kind)) found.micName = input.inputName;
    if (!found.desktopName && INPUT_KINDS.desktop.includes(kind)) found.desktopName = input.inputName;
    if (!found.webcamName && INPUT_KINDS.webcam.includes(kind)) found.webcamName = input.inputName;
    if (!found.screenName && INPUT_KINDS.screen.includes(kind)) found.screenName = input.inputName;
  }
  return found;
}

function resolvePlaceholder(placeholder, ctx) {
  if (placeholder === '__SYS_AUDIO__') return ctx.sysAudioScene;
  if (placeholder === '__MIC_AUDIO__') return ctx.micAudioScene;
  if (placeholder === '__WEBCAM__') return ctx.webcamName;
  if (placeholder === '__SCREEN__') return ctx.screenName;
  return placeholder;
}

async function setupScenes(sendLog, portHttp) {
  try {
    const { sceneCollections, currentSceneCollectionName } = await obs.call('GetSceneCollectionList');
    if (!sceneCollections.includes(COLLECTION_NAME)) {
      await obs.call('CreateSceneCollection', { sceneCollectionName: COLLECTION_NAME });
      await delay(1000);
    } else if (currentSceneCollectionName !== COLLECTION_NAME) {
      await obs.call('SetCurrentSceneCollection', { sceneCollectionName: COLLECTION_NAME });
      await delay(1000);
    }

    sendLog('Поиск оборудования стримера...', 'info');
    const { inputs } = await obs.call('GetInputList');
    const { micName, desktopName, webcamName, screenName } = detectHardware(inputs);
    if (micName) sendLog(`✅ Найден микрофон: "${micName}"`, 'success');
    if (webcamName) sendLog(`✅ Найдена камера: "${webcamName}"`, 'success');

    const { scenes } = await obs.call('GetSceneList');
    const existingSceneNames = (scenes || []).map(s => s.sceneName);
    const allScenesToCreate = [SYS_AUDIO_SCENE, MIC_AUDIO_SCENE, ...PACK_SCENES];
    for (const sName of allScenesToCreate) {
      if (!existingSceneNames.includes(sName)) await obs.call('CreateScene', { sceneName: sName });
    }
    await obs.call('SetCurrentProgramScene', { sceneName: PACK_SCENES[0] });

    if (desktopName) await enforceSingleItem(SYS_AUDIO_SCENE, desktopName);
    if (micName) await enforceSingleItem(MIC_AUDIO_SCENE, micName);

    for (const [sourceName, config] of Object.entries(WIDGETS)) {
      const url = `http://localhost:${portHttp}${config.url}?nocache=${Date.now()}`;
      const exists = (inputs || []).some(i => i.inputName === sourceName);
      if (!exists) {
        await obs.call('CreateInput', {
          sceneName: PACK_SCENES[0],
          inputName: sourceName,
          inputKind: 'browser_source',
          inputSettings: {
            url, width: config.w, height: config.h,
            css: BROWSER_CSS, shutdown: false, reroute_audio: true
          }
        });
      } else {
        await obs.call('SetInputSettings', {
          inputName: sourceName,
          inputSettings: { url, width: config.w, height: config.h }
        });
      }
    }

    for (const sceneName of PACK_SCENES) {
      await removeIfPresent(sceneName, LEGACY_AUDIO_SCENE);
    }

    // Префикс внешних источников читаем один раз — он может быть переопределён в ключе.
    const extManifest = externalSources.load();
    const extPrefix = extManifest.namePrefix || externalSources.EXTERNAL_PREFIX;
    const hardwareNames = [micName, desktopName, webcamName, screenName].filter(Boolean);
    const placeholderCtx = { sysAudioScene: SYS_AUDIO_SCENE, micAudioScene: MIC_AUDIO_SCENE, webcamName, screenName };

    for (const sceneName of PACK_SCENES) {
      const layoutItems = LAYOUT[sceneName] || {};
      const layoutWidgetNames = [];

      for (const [placeholderName, transform] of Object.entries(layoutItems)) {
        const actualName = resolvePlaceholder(placeholderName, placeholderCtx);
        if (!actualName) continue;
        layoutWidgetNames.push(actualName);
        try {
          const itemId = await enforceSingleItem(sceneName, actualName);
          await obs.call('SetSceneItemTransform', {
            sceneName,
            sceneItemId: itemId,
            sceneItemTransform: {
              positionX: transform.positionX,
              positionY: transform.positionY,
              scaleX: transform.scaleX,
              scaleY: transform.scaleY,
              cropTop: transform.cropTop || 0,
              cropBottom: transform.cropBottom || 0,
              cropLeft: transform.cropLeft || 0,
              cropRight: transform.cropRight || 0
            }
          });
          await obs.call('SetSceneItemIndex', {
            sceneName,
            sceneItemId: itemId,
            sceneItemIndex: transform.index
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn(`[OBS] ${sceneName} / ${actualName}:`, e.message);
        }
      }

      // Чистка мусора. НЕ трогаем: наши виджеты, железо стримера и внешние источники.
      const protectedNames = new Set([...layoutWidgetNames, ...hardwareNames]);
      const sceneItems = await listItems(sceneName);
      for (const item of sceneItems) {
        if (protectedNames.has(item.sourceName)) continue;
        if (externalSources.isExternalName(item.sourceName, extPrefix)) continue;
        try {
          await obs.call('RemoveSceneItem', { sceneName, sceneItemId: item.sceneItemId });
          console.log(`[OBS] ${sceneName}: удалён лишний источник "${item.sourceName}"`);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[OBS] Не удалось удалить источник:', item.sourceName, e.message);
        }
      }
    }

    sendLog('✅ Сцены перестроены! Выгруженный конфиг применен успешно.', 'success');
    await applyExternalSources(sendLog);
  } catch (error) {
    sendLog(`Ошибка настройки сцен: ${error.message}`, 'error');
  }
}

async function runObsSetup(customPath, sendLog, portHttp) {
  try {
    sendLog('Подключение к OBS WebSocket...', 'info');
    const isConnected = await connectObs(customPath, sendLog);
    if (!isConnected) {
      throw new Error('Убедитесь, что в OBS -> Инструменты -> Настройки WebSocket -> Порт: 4455 и СНЯТА галочка "Аутентификация"!');
    }
    await setupScenes(sendLog, portHttp);
    await safeDisconnect();
    return { status: 'ok' };
  } catch (error) {
    sendLog(error.message, 'error');
    await safeDisconnect();
    return { status: 'error', message: error.message };
  }
}

module.exports = { setupScenes, runObsSetup };

--- START OF FILE backend/player/configBridge.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/player/configBridge.js — v5 */
const EventEmitter = require('events');
const configManager = require('../configManager');

class ConfigBridge extends EventEmitter {
constructor() {
super();
this.cfg = configManager.getConfig();
}

get() { return this.cfg; }

player() {
return (this.cfg && this.cfg.widgets && this.cfg.widgets.player) ? this.cfg.widgets.player : {};
}

isEnabled() {
const v = this.player().enabled;
return !(v === false || String(v) === 'false');
}

isBgEnabled() {
const v = this.player().playlistEnabled;
return v === true || String(v) === 'true';
}

isShuffle() {
const v = this.player().playlistShuffle;
return v === true || String(v) === 'true';
}

update(newConfig, { persist = true } = {}) {
if (!newConfig) return;
this.cfg = newConfig;
if (persist) {
try { configManager.saveConfig(newConfig); }
catch (e) { console.error('[ConfigBridge] Ошибка сохранения:', e.message); }
}
this.emit('change', this.cfg);
}

reload() {
this.cfg = configManager.getConfig();
this.emit('change', this.cfg);
return this.cfg;
}
}

module.exports = ConfigBridge;

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/player/playerCommands.js — v6.2 (стоп по умолчанию + разовое перемешивание плейлиста) */
const EventEmitter = require('events');

const ALIASES = {
    PLAYER_CMD_ADD: 'PLAYER_ADD_TRACK',
    PLAYER_CMD_PLAY_UID: 'PLAYER_PLAY_SPECIFIC',
    PLAYER_CMD_REMOVE: 'PLAYER_REMOVE_TRACK'
};

const COMMANDS = new Set([
    'PLAYER_ADD_TRACK', 'PLAYER_PLAY_SPECIFIC', 'PLAYER_REMOVE_TRACK', 'PLAYER_RESTORE_TRACK',
    'PLAYER_CLEAR', 'PLAYER_SKIP', 'PLAYER_PREV', 'PLAYER_PLAYLIST_RESTART', 'PLAYER_SHUFFLE_PLAYLIST',
    'PLAYER_STOP', 'PLAYER_PAUSE', 'PLAYER_MUTE', 'PLAYER_SEEK'
]);

const ADVANCE_COOLDOWN = 1500;
const MAX_ERRORS_PER_TRACK = 2;
const MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES = 3;

class PlayerCommands extends EventEmitter {
    constructor({ config, queue, transport, registry }) {
        super();
        this.config = config;
        this.queue = queue;
        this.transport = transport;
        this.registry = registry;
        // Сервер стартует в состоянии «остановлен».
        // Музыку запускают только: заказ (!play / форма / панель), скип, клик по треку,
        // «плейлист с начала» или кнопка ▶ в дашборде.
        this.userStopped = true;
        this.pendingAdvance = false;
        this.pendingReason = '';
        this._advanceTimer = null;
        this._lastAdvanceAt = 0;
        this._errors = new Map();
        this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
        console.log('[PlayerCommands] v6.2: автозапуск при подключении отключён — старт только вручную или по заказу.');
    }

    normalize(action) { return ALIASES[action] || action; }
    isPlayerCommand(action) { return COMMANDS.has(action); }
    hasActivePlayer() { return this.registry.hasActive(); }

    notice(level, text) {
        console.log(`[Notice:${level}] ${text}`);
        this.emit('notice', { level, text, ts: Date.now() });
    }

    _load(track, startSeconds = 0, state = 'PLAYING') {
        this.queue.setCurrent(track);
        this.transport.start(track, startSeconds, state);
        this.userStopped = false;
        this.pendingAdvance = false;
        this._lastAdvanceAt = Date.now();
        this.emit('load', { track: { ...track }, startSeconds, state, muted: this.transport.muted });
    }

    _scheduleAdvance(reason, delay) {
        if (this._advanceTimer) clearTimeout(this._advanceTimer);
        this._advanceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this._advanceTimer = null;
            this.advance(reason, { force: true });
        }, Math.max(0, delay));
    }

    advance(reason, { force = false } = {}) {
        if (!this.hasActivePlayer()) {
            this.pendingAdvance = true;
            this.pendingReason = reason;
            console.log(`[Queue] ${reason}: нет активного плеера — отложено до подключения`);
            return { ok: true, deferred: true, message: 'Плеер не подключён — трек запустится автоматически' };
        }
        if (this.userStopped && !force) {
            return { ok: false, message: 'Плеер остановлен вручную' };
        }
        const since = Date.now() - this._lastAdvanceAt;
        if (!force && since < ADVANCE_COOLDOWN) {
            this._scheduleAdvance(reason, ADVANCE_COOLDOWN - since);
            return { ok: true, deferred: true, message: 'Команда принята (защита от частых переключений)' };
        }
        const next = this.queue.pickNext();
        if (next) {
            console.log(`[Queue] ${reason}: ${next.title || next.id}`);
            this._load(next, 0, 'PLAYING');
            return { ok: true, message: 'Следующий трек' };
        }
        this.queue.clearCurrent();
        this.transport.stop();
        this.pendingAdvance = false;
        this._lastAdvanceAt = Date.now();
        this.emit('stop');
        return { ok: true, message: 'Очередь пуста' };
    }

    retryCurrent(reason) {
        const track = this.queue.nowPlaying;
        if (!track) return false;
        const seconds = this.transport.currentSeconds();
        console.log(`[Queue] ${reason}: повторная загрузка ${track.title || track.id} @ ${seconds.toFixed(1)}s`);
        this.transport.start(track, seconds, 'PLAYING');
        this._lastAdvanceAt = Date.now();
        this.emit('load', { track: { ...track }, startSeconds: seconds, state: 'PLAYING', muted: this.transport.muted });
        return true;
    }

    stop(byUser = true) {
        if (this._advanceTimer) { clearTimeout(this._advanceTimer); this._advanceTimer = null; }
        this.pendingAdvance = false;
        this._errors.clear();
        this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
        this.queue.clearCurrent();
        this.transport.stop();
        if (byUser) this.userStopped = true;
        this._lastAdvanceAt = Date.now();
        this.emit('stop');
    }

    adopt(mode) {
        if (!mode) return;
        if (this.queue.nowPlaying) {
            this.emit('loadTo', {
                mode,
                track: { ...this.queue.nowPlaying },
                startSeconds: this.transport.currentSeconds(),
                state: this.transport.state === 'PAUSED' ? 'PAUSED' : 'PLAYING',
                muted: this.transport.muted
            });
        } else {
            this.emit('stopTo', { mode });
        }
    }

    onActiveChanged(active) {
        if (!active) return;
        // Продолжение уже идущей сессии (эстафета/переподключение).
        if (this.queue.nowPlaying) { this.adopt(active); return; }
        // Заказ, пришедший пока плеер был офлайн.
        if (this.pendingAdvance) {
            const reason = this.pendingReason || 'ОТЛОЖЕННЫЙ СТАРТ';
            this.pendingAdvance = false;
            this.advance(reason, { force: true });
            return;
        }
        if (!this.userStopped && this.config.isEnabled() && (this.queue.orders.length > 0 || this.config.isBgEnabled())) {
            this.advance('АВТОСТАРТ', { force: true });
        }
    }

    onConfigChange({ autostart = false } = {}) {
        if (!this.config.isEnabled()) { this.stop(false); return; }
        if (!autostart) return;
        if (!this.hasActivePlayer()) return;
        if (this.queue.nowPlaying || this.userStopped) return;
        if (this.queue.orders.length > 0 || this.config.isBgEnabled()) this.advance('КОНФИГ', { force: true });
    }

    onTransportReport(payload) {
        if (!payload) return;
        if (payload.state === 'PLAYING' && Number(payload.currentTime) > 0.5) {
            this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
            const uid = this.queue.nowPlaying ? this.queue.nowPlaying.uid : null;
            if (uid) this._errors.delete(uid);
        }
    }

    handleTrackEnded(payload = {}) {
        const uid = this.queue.nowPlaying ? this.queue.nowPlaying.uid : null;
        if (!uid || payload.uid !== uid) return;
        this._errors.delete(uid);
        this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
        this.advance('КОНЕЦ ТРЕКА', { force: true });
    }

    handleTrackError(payload = {}) {
        const current = this.queue.nowPlaying;
        if (!current || payload.uid !== current.uid) return;
        const count = (this._errors.get(current.uid) || 0) + 1;
        this._errors.set(current.uid, count);
        console.warn(`[Queue] Ошибка трека (${count}/${MAX_ERRORS_PER_TRACK}) ${current.title || current.id}: ${payload.reason || 'unknown'}`);
        if (count < MAX_ERRORS_PER_TRACK) {
            this.retryCurrent('ПОВТОР ПОСЛЕ ОШИБКИ');
            return;
        }
        this._errors.delete(current.uid);
        this._consecutiveFailures++;
        if (this._consecutiveFailures >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES) {
            this.stop(true);
            this.notice('error', 'YouTube не отвечает: 3 трека подряд не запустились. Проверь сеть и доступность видео, затем нажми «Скип».');
            return;
        }
        this.advance('ОШИБКА ТРЕКА', { force: true });
    }

    handle(action, payload = {}) {
        switch (action) {
            case 'PLAYER_ADD_TRACK': {
                const res = this.queue.addOrder(payload.url, payload.user);
                if (res.ok) {
                    this.userStopped = false;
                    if (!this.queue.nowPlaying && this.config.isEnabled()) this.advance('ДОБАВЛЕНО', { force: true });
                }
                return res;
            }
            case 'PLAYER_PLAY_SPECIFIC': {
                const found = this.queue.findTrack(payload.uid);
                if (!found) return { ok: false, message: 'Трек не найден в очереди' };
                if (!this.hasActivePlayer()) return { ok: false, message: 'Нет активного плеера' };
                if (found.source === 'order') this.queue.takeOrder(payload.uid);
                if (found.source === 'playlist' && this.queue.removed.includes(payload.uid)) this.queue.restoreTrack(payload.uid);
                this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
                this._errors.delete(payload.uid);
                this._load(found.track, 0, 'PLAYING');
                return { ok: true, message: 'Трек запущен' };
            }
            case 'PLAYER_REMOVE_TRACK': {
                const res = this.queue.removeTrack(payload.uid);
                if (res.ok && res.wasPlaylist && this.queue.nowPlaying && this.queue.nowPlaying.uid === payload.uid) {
                    this.advance('УДАЛЁН ТЕКУЩИЙ', { force: true });
                }
                return res;
            }
            case 'PLAYER_RESTORE_TRACK':
                return this.queue.restoreTrack(payload.uid);
            case 'PLAYER_CLEAR':
                return this.queue.clearOrders();
            case 'PLAYER_SKIP':
                this.userStopped = false;
                this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
                return this.advance('СКИП', { force: true });
            case 'PLAYER_PREV': {
                if (!this.hasActivePlayer()) return { ok: false, message: 'Нет активного плеера' };
                this.userStopped = false;
                this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
                if (this.queue.history.length === 0) {
                    if (this.queue.nowPlaying) {
                        this._load(this.queue.nowPlaying, 0, 'PLAYING');
                        return { ok: true, message: 'Трек с начала' };
                    }
                    return { ok: false, message: 'История пуста' };
                }
                const track = this.queue.previous();
                if (!track) return { ok: false, message: 'Предыдущий трек недоступен' };
                this.queue.setCurrent(track, { pushHistory: false });
                this.transport.start(track, 0, 'PLAYING');
                this.pendingAdvance = false;
                this._lastAdvanceAt = Date.now();
                this.emit('load', { track: { ...track }, startSeconds: 0, state: 'PLAYING', muted: this.transport.muted });
                return { ok: true, message: 'Предыдущий трек' };
            }
            case 'PLAYER_PLAYLIST_RESTART': {
                if (!this.hasActivePlayer()) return { ok: false, message: 'Нет активного плеера' };
                const track = this.queue.restartPlaylist();
                if (!track) return { ok: false, message: 'Плейлист пуст' };
                this._consecutiveFailures = 0;
                this._load(track, 0, 'PLAYING');
                return { ok: true, message: 'Плейлист запущен с начала' };
            }
            case 'PLAYER_SHUFFLE_PLAYLIST':
                return this.queue.shuffleNow();
            case 'PLAYER_STOP':
                this.stop(true);
                return { ok: true, message: 'Плеер остановлен' };
            case 'PLAYER_PAUSE': {
                if (!this.queue.nowPlaying) return { ok: false, message: 'Нечего ставить на паузу' };
                const next = this.transport.togglePause();
                this.emit('pause', { state: next });
                return { ok: true, message: next === 'PAUSED' ? 'Пауза' : 'Продолжаем' };
            }
            case 'PLAYER_MUTE':
                this.transport.setMuted(payload.muted);
                this.emit('mute', { muted: this.transport.muted });
                return { ok: true, message: this.transport.muted ? 'Звук выключен' : 'Звук включён' };
            case 'PLAYER_SEEK': {
                if (!this.queue.nowPlaying) return { ok: false, message: 'Нет активного трека' };
                this.transport.seek(payload.seconds);
                this.emit('seek', { seconds: this.transport.currentTime });
                return { ok: true, message: 'Перемотка' };
            }
            default:
                return { ok: false, message: 'Неизвестная команда' };
        }
    }
}

module.exports = PlayerCommands;

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/player/playerRegistry.js — v6 */
const EventEmitter = require('events');

const PLAYER_TTL = 12000;

class PlayerRegistry extends EventEmitter {
constructor() {
super();
this.players = new Map();
this.preferred = null;
}

computeActive() {
const modes = new Set();
this.players.forEach(p => modes.add(p.mode));
if (this.preferred && modes.has(this.preferred)) return this.preferred;
if (modes.has('obs')) return 'obs';
if (modes.has('demo')) return 'demo';
return null;
}

hasActive() { return this.computeActive() !== null; }

findWs(mode) {
let found = null;
this.players.forEach((info, ws) => {
if (info.mode === mode && ws.readyState === 1) found = ws;
});
return found;
}

activeInstanceId() {
const mode = this.computeActive();
if (!mode) return null;
const ws = this.findWs(mode);
if (!ws) return null;
const info = this.players.get(ws);
return info ? info.instanceId : null;
}

payload() {
const list = [];
this.players.forEach(p => list.push({ mode: p.mode, instanceId: p.instanceId }));
return { players: list, active: this.computeActive(), preferred: this.preferred, ts: Date.now() };
}

register(ws, mode, instanceId) {
const previous = this.computeActive();
const prev = this.players.get(ws);
const info = { mode, instanceId, lastSeen: Date.now() };
this.players.set(ws, info);
const changed = !prev || prev.mode !== mode || prev.instanceId !== instanceId;
const active = this.computeActive();
if (changed) this.emit('change', { payload: this.payload(), active, previous });
return { changed, info, active, previous };
}

unregister(ws) {
const previous = this.computeActive();
const info = this.players.get(ws);
const had = this.players.delete(ws);
if (had) {
const active = this.computeActive();
console.log(`[Players] Отключился плеер: ${info.mode} (${info.instanceId}) → активен: ${active || 'нет'}`);
this.emit('change', { payload: this.payload(), active, previous });
}
return had ? info : null;
}

setPreferred(mode) {
const previous = this.computeActive();
this.preferred = mode;
const active = this.computeActive();
this.emit('change', { payload: this.payload(), active, previous, force: true });
return { active, previous };
}

sweep() {
const now = Date.now();
const previous = this.computeActive();
let changed = false;
this.players.forEach((info, ws) => {
if (now - info.lastSeen > PLAYER_TTL || ws.readyState !== 1) {
console.log(`[Players] Таймаут плеера: ${info.mode} (${info.instanceId})`);
this.players.delete(ws);
changed = true;
}
});
if (changed) {
const active = this.computeActive();
this.emit('change', { payload: this.payload(), active, previous });
}
return changed;
}

getInfo(ws) { return this.players.get(ws) || null; }
}

module.exports = PlayerRegistry;

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/player/queueStore.js — v6 (разовое перемешивание кнопкой + флаг фактического порядка) */
const EventEmitter = require('events');

function extractYouTubeId(url) {
    if (!url) return null;
    const s = String(url).trim();
    const list = s.match(/[?&]list=([^#&?]+)/);
    if (list) return { type: 'playlist', id: list[1] };
    const video = s.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/|embed\/|shorts\/|live\/)([\w-]{11})/);
    if (video) return { type: 'video', id: video[1] };
    if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(s)) return { type: 'video', id: s };
    return null;
}

function shuffleArray(arr) {
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
    }
}

class QueueStore extends EventEmitter {
    constructor(config, titles) {
        super();
        this.config = config;
        this.titles = titles;
        this.orders = [];
        this.playlist = [];
        this.order = [];
        this.played = [];
        this.removed = [];
        this.cursor = -1;
        this.nowPlaying = null;
        this.history = [];
        this.seq = 0;
        this._lastKey = '';
        this._lastRaw = null;
        this._shuffledOnce = false;
        titles.on('title', ({ id, title }) => this.applyTitle(id, title));
        config.on('change', () => this.rebuildFromConfig());
    }

    init() { this.rebuildFromConfig(true); }

    rebuildFromConfig(force = false) {
        const conf = this.config.player();
        const raw = String(conf.playlistUrls || '').split(/\r?\n/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const shuffle = this.config.isShuffle();
        const key = JSON.stringify(raw) + '|' + shuffle;
        if (!force && key === this._lastKey) return;
        const rawChanged = JSON.stringify(raw) !== JSON.stringify(this._lastRaw || []);
        this._lastKey = key;
        this._lastRaw = raw;

        const list = [];
        raw.forEach((u, i) => {
            const d = extractYouTubeId(u);
            if (!d) return;
            list.push({
                uid: `pl:${i}:${d.id}`,
                id: d.id,
                type: d.type,
                index: i,
                title: d.type === 'playlist' ? 'Плейлист YouTube' : 'Загрузка названия…',
                user: 'Фоновая музыка',
                isBackground: true
            });
        });

        this.playlist = list;
        this.order = list.map(t => t.uid);
        if (shuffle) shuffleArray(this.order);
        // Пересборка порядка сбрасывает разовое перемешивание кнопкой.
        this._shuffledOnce = false;
        this.played = this.played.filter(uid => this.order.includes(uid));
        this.removed = rawChanged ? [] : this.removed.filter(uid => this.order.includes(uid));
        if (this.nowPlaying && this.nowPlaying.isBackground && !this.order.includes(this.nowPlaying.uid)) {
            this.nowPlaying = null;
        }
        this.cursor = this.nowPlaying ? this.order.indexOf(this.nowPlaying.uid) : -1;
        this.titles.request(list);
        this.emit('change');
    }

    /** Разовое перемешивание fokнового порядка. Текущий трек не перезапускается. */
    shuffleNow() {
        if (this.order.length < 2) {
            return { ok: false, message: 'Плейлист слишком короткий для перемешивания' };
        }
        shuffleArray(this.order);
        this._shuffledOnce = true;
        this.cursor = this.nowPlaying ? this.order.indexOf(this.nowPlaying.uid) : -1;
        console.log('[Queue] Плейлист перемешан вручную');
        this.emit('change');
        return { ok: true, message: 'Плейлист перемешан' };
    }

    applyTitle(id, title) {
        let changed = false;
        this.playlist.forEach(t => { if (t.id === id && t.title !== title) { t.title = title; changed = true; } });
        this.orders.forEach(t => { if (t.id === id && t.title !== title) { t.title = title; changed = true; } });
        if (this.nowPlaying && this.nowPlaying.id === id && this.nowPlaying.title !== title) {
            this.nowPlaying.title = title;
            changed = true;
        }
        if (changed) this.emit('change');
    }

    payload() {
        return {
            orders: this.orders.map(t => ({ ...t })),
            playlist: this.playlist.map(t => ({ ...t, played: this.played.includes(t.uid), removed: this.removed.includes(t.uid) })),
            order: this.order.slice(),
            nowPlaying: this.nowPlaying ? { ...this.nowPlaying } : null,
            cursor: this.cursor,
            shuffle: this.config.isShuffle() || this._shuffledOnce,
            bgEnabled: this.config.isBgEnabled(),
            enabled: this.config.isEnabled(),
            canPrev: this.history.length > 0,
            ts: Date.now()
        };
    }

    addOrder(url, user) {
        const d = extractYouTubeId(url);
        if (!d) return { ok: false, message: 'Не распознал ссылку YouTube' };
        const track = {
            uid: `ord:${++this.seq}:${d.id}`,
            id: d.id,
            type: d.type,
            title: d.type === 'playlist' ? 'Плейлист YouTube' : 'Загрузка названия…',
            user: user || 'Гость',
            isBackground: false
        };
        this.orders.push(track);
        this.titles.request([track]);
        this.emit('change');
        return { ok: true, message: 'Трек добавлен в очередь', track };
    }

    takeOrder(uid) {
        const t = this.orders.find(x => x.uid === uid);
        if (!t) return null;
        this.orders = this.orders.filter(x => x.uid !== uid);
        this.emit('change');
        return t;
    }

    findTrack(uid) {
        const o = this.orders.find(t => t.uid === uid);
        if (o) return { track: o, source: 'order' };
        const p = this.playlist.find(t => t.uid === uid);
        if (p) return { track: p, source: 'playlist' };
        if (this.nowPlaying && this.nowPlaying.uid === uid) return { track: this.nowPlaying, source: 'current' };
        return null;
    }

    setCurrent(track, { pushHistory = true } = {}) {
        if (!track) return;
        if (pushHistory && this.nowPlaying && this.nowPlaying.uid !== track.uid) {
            this.history.push(this.nowPlaying.uid);
            if (this.history.length > 60) this.history.shift();
        }
        this.nowPlaying = { ...track };
        if (track.isBackground) {
            const avail = this.order.filter(uid => !this.removed.includes(uid));
            if (this.played.length >= avail.length && avail.length > 0) this.played = [];
            if (!this.played.includes(track.uid)) this.played.push(track.uid);
            const idx = this.order.indexOf(track.uid);
            if (idx >= 0) this.cursor = idx;
        }
        this.titles.request([this.nowPlaying]);
        this.emit('change');
    }

    clearCurrent() {
        this.nowPlaying = null;
        this.emit('change');
    }

    pickNext() {
        if (this.orders.length > 0) return this.orders.shift();
        if (!this.config.isBgEnabled()) return null;
        const avail = this.order.filter(uid => !this.removed.includes(uid));
        if (avail.length === 0) return null;
        const total = this.order.length;
        const start = this.cursor < 0 ? -1 : this.cursor;
        for (let i = 1; i <= total; i++) {
            const idx = ((start + i) % total + total) % total;
            const uid = this.order[idx];
            if (this.removed.includes(uid)) continue;
            const track = this.playlist.find(t => t.uid === uid);
            if (!track) continue;
            this.cursor = idx;
            return track;
        }
        return null;
    }

    removeTrack(uid) {
        const before = this.orders.length;
        this.orders = this.orders.filter(t => t.uid !== uid);
        if (this.orders.length !== before) {
            this.emit('change');
            return { ok: true, message: 'Заказ удалён', wasOrder: true };
        }
        if (this.playlist.some(t => t.uid === uid)) {
            if (!this.removed.includes(uid)) this.removed.push(uid);
            this.emit('change');
            return { ok: true, message: 'Трек скрыт из плейлиста', wasPlaylist: true };
        }
        return { ok: false, message: 'Трек не найден' };
    }

    restoreTrack(uid) {
        this.removed = this.removed.filter(u => u !== uid);
        this.emit('change');
        return { ok: true, message: 'Трек возвращён в плейлист' };
    }

    clearOrders() {
        this.orders = [];
        this.emit('change');
        return { ok: true, message: 'Очередь заказов очищена' };
    }

    restartPlaylist() {
        this.played = [];
        this.cursor = -1;
        this.removed = [];
        const firstUid = this.order.find(uid => !this.removed.includes(uid));
        return this.playlist.find(t => t.uid === firstUid) || null;
    }

    previous() {
        if (this.history.length === 0) return null;
        const uid = this.history.pop();
        const found = this.findTrack(uid);
        return found ? found.track : null;
    }
}

module.exports = QueueStore;

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/player/titleService.js — v5 */
const EventEmitter = require('events');
const https = require('https');

const CONCURRENCY = 2;
const TIMEOUT = 6000;
const MAX_CACHE = 500;

class TitleService extends EventEmitter {
constructor() {
super();
this.cache = new Map();
this.jobs = [];
this.active = 0;
}

fetchTitle(id) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const url = `https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https%3A//www.youtube.com/watch%3Fv%3D${id}&format=json`;
const req = https.get(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'StreamLauncher/5.0' }, timeout: TIMEOUT }, (res) => {
if (res.statusCode !== 200) { res.resume(); resolve(null); return; }
let raw = '';
res.setEncoding('utf8');
res.on('data', (c) => { raw += c; if (raw.length > 200000) req.destroy(); });
res.on('end', () => {
try {
const data = JSON.parse(raw);
resolve(data.title || null);
} catch (e) { resolve(null); }
});
});
req.on('timeout', () => { req.destroy(); resolve(null); });
req.on('error', () => resolve(null));
});
}

request(tracks) {
if (!Array.isArray(tracks)) return;
tracks.forEach((t) => {
if (!t || !t.id) return;
if (t.type === 'playlist') {
this.emit('title', { id: t.id, title: 'Плейлист YouTube' });
return;
}
const cached = this.cache.get(t.id);
if (cached) {
this.emit('title', { id: t.id, title: cached });
return;
}
if (!this.jobs.some(j => j.id === t.id)) this.jobs.push({ id: t.id });
});
this._pump();
}

_pump() {
while (this.active < CONCURRENCY && this.jobs.length > 0) {
const job = this.jobs.shift();
this.active++;
this.fetchTitle(job.id).then((title) => {
this.active--;
const finalTitle = title || `YouTube ${job.id}`;
if (title) {
this.cache.set(job.id, title);
this._trim();
}
this.emit('title', { id: job.id, title: finalTitle });
this._pump();
}).catch(() => {
this.active--;
this.emit('title', { id: job.id, title: `YouTube ${job.id}` });
this._pump();
});
}
}

_trim() {
while (this.cache.size > MAX_CACHE) {
const first = this.cache.keys().next().value;
this.cache.delete(first);
}
}
}

module.exports = TitleService;

/* ФАЙЛ: backend/player/transportState.js — v5 */
const EventEmitter = require('events');

class TransportState extends EventEmitter {
constructor() {
super();
this.state = 'IDLE';
this.currentTime = 0;
this.duration = 0;
this.muted = false;
this.ts = 0;
this.mode = null;
this.instanceId = null;
}

currentSeconds() {
let cur = this.currentTime;
if (this.state === 'PLAYING' && this.duration > 0) {
cur = Math.min(this.duration, cur + Math.max(0, (Date.now() - this.ts) / 1000));
}
return Math.max(0, cur);
}

payload() {
return {
state: this.state,
currentTime: this.currentSeconds(),
duration: this.duration,
muted: this.muted,
mode: this.mode,
instanceId: this.instanceId,
ts: Date.now()
};
}

report({ state, currentTime, duration, muted }, mode, instanceId) {
this.state = state === 'PAUSED' ? 'PAUSED' : (state === 'PLAYING' ? 'PLAYING' : 'IDLE');
this.currentTime = Number(currentTime) || 0;
this.duration = Number(duration) || 0;
this.muted = !!muted;
this.ts = Date.now();
this.mode = mode;
this.instanceId = instanceId;
this.emit('change');
}

start(track, seconds = 0, state = 'PLAYING') {
this.state = state;
this.currentTime = Math.max(0, Number(seconds) || 0);
this.duration = 0;
this.ts = Date.now();
this.emit('change');
}

stop() {
this.state = 'IDLE';
this.currentTime = 0;
this.duration = 0;
this.ts = Date.now();
this.emit('change');
}

freeze() {
this.currentTime = this.currentSeconds();
this.ts = Date.now();
}

togglePause() {
const next = this.state === 'PLAYING' ? 'PAUSED' : 'PLAYING';
this.currentTime = this.currentSeconds();
this.state = next;
this.ts = Date.now();
this.emit('change');
return next;
}

setMuted(muted) {
this.muted = !!muted;
this.emit('change');
}

seek(seconds) {
const sec = Math.max(0, Number(seconds) || 0);
this.currentTime = this.duration > 0 ? Math.min(this.duration, sec) : sec;
this.ts = Date.now();
this.emit('change');
}
}

module.exports = TransportState;

--- START OF FILE data/v2Registry.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: data/v2Registry.js — v1 (единый реестр «Оверлеев 2.0»: какие виджеты уже перенесены) */

/**
 * Единственный источник правды о дашбордах 2.0.
 * Его читают: js/views/widgetsV2View.js (навигация и загрузка модулей)
 * и js/views/widgetsView.js + sidebar (очередь на перенос).
 *
 * covers — какие записи widgetsManifest закрывает дашборд.
 * Один дашборд может закрывать несколько виджетов (frame закрывает и лису).
 * Добавил новый дашборд в widgets/<id>/dashboard/Dashboard.js — допиши строку сюда,
 * и старый список сам уберёт виджет из очереди.
 */
const RAW_DASHBOARDS = [
  { id: 'player', ownParams: ['demo'], covers: [{ id: 'player', label: 'Медиаплеер' }] },
  { id: 'media', ownParams: ['cat', 'sort'], covers: [{ id: 'media', label: 'Карточка активности' }] },
  { id: 'socials', ownParams: [], covers: [{ id: 'socials', label: 'Ротатор соцсетей' }] },
  { id: 'deaths', ownParams: [], covers: [{ id: 'deaths', label: 'Счётчик смертей' }] },
  { id: 'chat', ownParams: ['view'], covers: [{ id: 'chat', label: 'Чат Twitch' }] },
  {
    id: 'frame',
    ownParams: [],
    covers: [
      { id: 'frame', label: 'Рамка вебки' },
      { id: 'pet', label: 'Лиса-питомец' }
    ]
  },
  { id: 'alerts', ownParams: [], covers: [{ id: 'alerts', label: 'Оповещения' }] }
];

export const V2_DASHBOARDS = RAW_DASHBOARDS.map((d) => {
  const id = String(d.id || '').toLowerCase();
  const covers = (Array.isArray(d.covers) && d.covers.length ? d.covers : [{ id, label: id }])
    .map(c => ({ id: String(c.id || '').toLowerCase(), label: String(c.label || c.id) }))
    .filter(c => Boolean(c.id));
  return {
    id,
    ownParams: Array.isArray(d.ownParams) ? d.ownParams.slice() : [],
    covers
  };
}).filter(d => Boolean(d.id));

export const V2_IDS = V2_DASHBOARDS.map(d => d.id);
export const V2_DEFAULT_ID = V2_IDS[0] || 'player';

/** manifestId → { dashboard, label } */
export const MIGRATION_MAP = (() => {
  const map = new Map();
  V2_DASHBOARDS.forEach(d => {
    d.covers.forEach(c => {
      if (!map.has(c.id)) map.set(c.id, { dashboard: d.id, label: c.label });
    });
  });
  return map;
})();

function key(id) { return String(id || '').toLowerCase(); }

/** Есть ли у id собственный дашборд (файл widgets/<id>/dashboard/Dashboard.js). */
export function hasDashboard(id) { return V2_IDS.includes(key(id)); }

/** Закрыт ли виджет новым интерфейсом (в том числе чужим дашбордом). */
export function isMigrated(id) { return MIGRATION_MAP.has(key(id)); }

export function migrationOf(id) { return MIGRATION_MAP.get(key(id)) || null; }

export function dashboardEntry(id) { return V2_DASHBOARDS.find(d => d.id === key(id)) || null; }

/** Deep link на нужный дашборд 2.0 (для лисы ведёт на frame). */
export function v2Href(id) {
  const mig = migrationOf(id);
  const target = mig ? mig.dashboard : (hasDashboard(id) ? key(id) : V2_DEFAULT_ID);
  return `#/widgets-v2?id=${encodeURIComponent(target)}`;
}

/**
 * Сводка переноса по манифесту.
 * @param {Array} manifest state.widgetsManifest
 */
export function migrationStats(manifest) {
  const list = Array.isArray(manifest) ? manifest : [];
  const done = [];
  const todo = [];
  list.forEach(w => { (isMigrated(w && w.id) ? done : todo).push(w); });
  const total = list.length;
  const percent = total ? Math.round((done.length / total) * 100) : 0;
  return { total, done, todo, doneCount: done.length, todoCount: todo.length, percent };
}

/** Короткие подписи перенесённых виджетов для чипов. */
export function migratedChips(manifest) {
  const list = Array.isArray(manifest) ? manifest : [];
  return list.filter(w => isMigrated(w && w.id)).map(w => ({
    id: w.id,
    label: (migrationOf(w.id) || {}).label || w.title || w.id,
    href: v2Href(w.id)
  }));
}

/* ФАЙЛ: js/app.js — v3 (error boundary вместо чёрного экрана + безопасный bootstrap пака) */
import { store } from './store.js';
import { Router } from './router.js';
import { Sidebar } from './components/sidebar.js';
import { HomeView } from './views/homeView.js';
import { WidgetsView } from './views/widgetsView.js';
import { WidgetsV2View } from './views/widgetsV2View.js';
import { RemoteView } from './views/remoteView.js';
import { SettingsView } from './views/settingsView.js';
import { GuideView } from './views/guideView.js';
const appContainer = document.getElementById('app');
const routes = {
'#/home': HomeView,
'#/widgets': WidgetsView,
'#/widgets-v2': WidgetsV2View,
'#/remote': RemoteView,
'#/settings': SettingsView,
'#/guide': GuideView
};
function escapeHtml(str) {
return String(str ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}
/** Никогда не оставляем пустой #app: любая ошибка экрана превращается в читаемую карточку. */
function renderAppLayout(path, ViewObj, params, state) {
let viewHtml = '';
try {
viewHtml = ViewObj.render(state, params);
} catch (e) {
console.error('[App] Экран упал при рендере:', e);
try { store.addLog(`Ошибка экрана ${path}: ${e.message}`, 'error'); } catch (e2) {}
viewHtml = `
<header class="view-header">
<h1 class="view-title">Экран не собрался</h1>
<p class="view-subtitle">Ядро лаунчера работает — упал только этот экран. Ниже текст ошибки.</p>
</header>
<section class="card" style="border-color: var(--color-danger-dim);">
<h3 class="text-lg text-bold mb-sm" style="color: var(--color-danger);">${escapeHtml(path)}</h3>
<pre style="white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-warning); background: var(--bg-input); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-left: 3px solid var(--color-danger); padding: 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); max-height: 260px; overflow: auto;">${escapeHtml((e && e.stack) || (e && e.message) || e)}</pre>
<div class="d-flex gap-sm mt-md flex-wrap">
<a href="#/home" class="btn btn-primary">На дашборд</a>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="location.reload()">Перезагрузить интерфейс</button>
</div>
<p class="text-secondary text-sm mt-md">Если ошибка повторяется — пришлите текст из консоли (Ctrl+Shift+I).</p>
</section>`;
}
appContainer.innerHTML = `
${Sidebar(path)}
<main class="main-wrapper" id="main-wrapper">${viewHtml}</main>`;
}
function monitorOBSConnection() {
const checkConnection = () => {
let ws;
try { ws = new WebSocket('ws://127.0.0.1:4455'); }
catch (e) { setTimeout(checkConnection, 5000); return; }
ws.onopen = () => {
if (store.getState().obsStatus !== 'connected') store.setState({ obsStatus: 'connected' });
try { ws.close(); } catch (e) {}
};
ws.onerror = () => {
if (store.getState().obsStatus !== 'disconnected') store.setState({ obsStatus: 'disconnected' });
};
ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(checkConnection, 5000);
};
checkConnection();
}
function api() { return window.obsAPI || null; }
function has(name) { const a = api(); return Boolean(a && typeof a[name] === 'function'); }
async function checkBackgroundUpdates() {
if (!store.state.isElectronEnv) return;
if (has('checkForUpdates')) {
try {
const updateInfo = await api().checkForUpdates();
store.setUpdateInfo(updateInfo);
if (updateInfo && updateInfo.hasUpdate) store.addLog(`Доступна новая версия ядра: v${updateInfo.latestVersion}!`, 'info');
} catch (err) {
console.warn('[BOOTSTRAP] Проверка обновлений ядра пропущена:', err.message);
}
}
if (has('checkPackUpdate')) {
try {
const packInfo = await api().checkPackUpdate();
store.setPackInfo({ ...packInfo, isChecking: false, supported: true });
if (packInfo && packInfo.hasUpdate) store.addLog(`Доступен пак сцен v${packInfo.latestVersion} — обновляется без перезапуска!`, 'info');
} catch (err) {
console.warn('[BOOTSTRAP] Проверка пака сцен пропущена:', err.message);
store.setPackInfo({ supported: false, isChecking: false });
}
} else {
store.setPackInfo({ supported: false });
}
}
function subscribeServerActions() {
store.onAction((action, payload) => {
if (action === 'SCENES_REFRESH_RESULT' || action === 'SCENES_ENSURE_RESULT') {
const p = payload || {};
store.addLog(p.message || 'Перезагрузка сцен завершена', p.ok ? 'success' : 'warn');
store.setPackInfo({ isRefreshing: false, lastRefresh: { ok: Boolean(p.ok), message: p.message || '', ts: p.ts || Date.now() } });
return;
}
if (action === 'PACK_UPDATED') {
const p = payload || {};
store.addLog(p.kind === 'rollback' ? `Пак сцен откачен к v${p.version}` : `Пак сцен обновлён до v${p.version}`, 'success');
store.setPackInfo({ hasUpdate: false, isApplying: false, statusText: '' });
if (has('getPackStatus')) {
api().getPackStatus().then(st => store.setPackInfo({
installedVersion: st.installedVersion,
baselineVersion: st.baselineVersion,
previousVersion: st.previousVersion,
canRollback: st.canRollback,
repo: st.repo
})).catch(() => {});
}
}
});
}
async function bootstrap() {
if (store.state.isElectronEnv) {
const a = api();
if (a && typeof a.onLog === 'function') a.onLog((data) => store.addLog(data.message, data.type));
if (a && typeof a.onRemoteConfigUpdate === 'function') a.onRemoteConfigUpdate((config) => store.syncFromRemote(config));
if (a && typeof a.onUpdateProgress === 'function') {
a.onUpdateProgress((status) => {
store.setUpdateInfo({
isUpdating: status.stage !== 'completed' && status.stage !== 'error',
progressPercent: status.percent,
statusText: status.text
});
if (status.stage === 'completed') store.setUpdateInfo({ hasUpdate: false, isUpdating: false });
});
}
if (a && typeof a.onPackProgress === 'function') {
a.onPackProgress((status) => {
store.setPackInfo({
isApplying: status.stage !== 'completed' && status.stage !== 'error',
progressPercent: status.percent,
statusText: status.text
});
if (status.stage === 'completed') store.setPackInfo({ hasUpdate: false, isApplying: false });
});
}
if (has('getConfig')) {
try {
const config = await a.getConfig();
if (config) store.updateConfig(config);
} catch (e) { store.addLog('Не удалось загрузить конфиг при старте', 'warn'); }
}
if (has('getPackStatus')) {
try {
const st = await a.getPackStatus();
store.setPackInfo({
installedVersion: st.installedVersion,
baselineVersion: st.baselineVersion,
previousVersion: st.previousVersion,
canRollback: st.canRollback,
repo: st.repo,
supported: true
});
console.log('[BOOTSTRAP] Пак сцен:', st.installedVersion ? `v${st.installedVersion}` : 'встроенный');
} catch (e) {
console.warn('[BOOTSTRAP] Статус пака сцен недоступен:', e.message);
store.setPackInfo({ supported: false });
}
} else {
store.setPackInfo({ supported: false });
}
} else {
store.setPackInfo({ supported: false });
}
subscribeServerActions();
monitorOBSConnection();
const router = new Router(routes, store, renderAppLayout);
router.init();
setTimeout(checkBackgroundUpdates, 1500);
}
bootstrap();

/* ФАЙЛ: js/router.js — v4 (fallback-render: сломанный экран не оставляет пустой #app) */
export class Router {
constructor(routes, store, renderLayout) {
this.routes = routes;
this.store = store;
this.renderLayout = renderLayout;
this.currentViewObj = null;
this.currentPath = null;
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => this.handleHash());
}
parseHash(hash) {
const raw = hash || '#/home';
const [path, query] = raw.split('?');
const params = {};
if (query) {
try {
for (const [k, v] of new URLSearchParams(query).entries()) params[k] = v;
} catch (e) { console.error('[Router] query parse:', e); }
}
return { path: path || '#/home', params };
}
_fallback(path, error) {
const app = document.getElementById('app');
if (!app) return;
const msg = String((error && error.stack) || (error && error.message) || error || 'Неизвестная ошибка');
const safe = msg.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
app.innerHTML = `
<main class="main-wrapper">
<header class="view-header">
<h1 class="view-title">Интерфейс не собрался</h1>
<p class="view-subtitle">Маршрут ${path} упал до рендера. Ядро и сервер продолжают работать.</p>
</header>
<section class="card" style="border-color: var(--color-danger-dim);">
<pre style="white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-warning); background: var(--bg-input); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-left: 3px solid var(--color-danger); padding: 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); max-height: 300px; overflow: auto;">${safe}</pre>
<div class="d-flex gap-sm mt-md flex-wrap">
<a href="#/home" class="btn btn-primary">На дашборд</a>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="location.reload()">Перезагрузить интерфейс</button>
</div>
</section>
</main>`;
}
handleHash() {
const { path, params } = this.parseHash(window.location.hash);
const View = this.routes[path] || this.routes['#/home'];
console.log(`[Router] → ${path}`, params);
if (this.currentPath === path && this.currentViewObj && typeof this.currentViewObj.onParamsChange === 'function') {
let handled = false;
try { handled = this.currentViewObj.onParamsChange(params, this.store.getState()); }
catch (e) { console.error('[Router] onParamsChange:', e); handled = false; }
if (handled !== false) return;
}
if (this.currentViewObj && typeof this.currentViewObj.unmount === 'function') {
try { this.currentViewObj.unmount(); } catch (e) { console.error('[Router] unmount:', e); }
}
this.currentPath = path;
this.currentViewObj = View;
try {
this.renderLayout(path, View, params, this.store.getState());
} catch (e) {
console.error('[Router] render:', e);
this._fallback(path, e);
return;
}
if (typeof View.mount === 'function') {
const mounted = path;
setTimeout(() => {
if (this.currentPath !== mounted) return;
try { View.mount(params, this.store.getState()); }
catch (e) { console.error('[Router] mount:', e); }
}, 0);
}
}
init() {
if (!window.location.hash) window.location.hash = '#/home';
else this.handleHash();
}
}

--- START OF FILE js/store.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: js/store.js — v3.3 (срез packInfo + тихие служебные опросы + атомарная замена userSkins) */
import { widgetsManifest } from '../data/widgetsManifest.js';
function isObject(item) { return (item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item)); }
function deepMerge(target, ...sources) {
if (!sources.length) return target;
const source = sources.shift();
if (isObject(target) && isObject(source)) {
for (const key in source) {
if (isObject(source[key])) {
if (!target[key]) Object.assign(target, { [key]: {} });
deepMerge(target[key], source[key]);
} else Object.assign(target, { [key]: source[key] });
}
}
return deepMerge(target, ...sources);
}
/* Пути-«словари»: заменяются целиком, а не сливаются по ключам. */
const ATOMIC_PATHS = [
['widgets', 'chat', 'userSkins']
];
/* Служебные опросы состояния: не пишутся в журнал и не пугают предупреждениями. */
const QUIET_ACTIONS = new Set([
'REQUEST_PLAYER_SYNC', 'REQUEST_SYNC_STATE',
'WIDGET_ROSTER_REQUEST',
'ALERTS_REQUEST_STATE', 'CHAT_REQUEST_STATE',
'DEATHS_REQUEST_STATE', 'SOCIALS_REQUEST_STATE', 'FRAME_REQUEST_STATE'
]);
export const PACK_DEFAULTS = {
installedVersion: null,
baselineVersion: '1.0.0',
previousVersion: null,
canRollback: false,
repo: null,
hasUpdate: false,
isChecking: false,
latestVersion: null,
tag: null,
releaseNotes: '',
downloadUrl: null,
isApplying: false,
progressPercent: 0,
statusText: '',
isRefreshing: false,
lastRefresh: null,
supported: true
};
function applyAtomicKeys(merged, source) {
if (!isObject(source)) return;
for (const path of ATOMIC_PATHS) {
let src = source;
let found = true;
for (const k of path) {
if (isObject(src) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(src, k)) src = src[k];
else { found = false; break; }
}
if (!found) continue;
let dst = merged;
for (let i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
const k = path[i];
if (!isObject(dst[k])) dst[k] = {};
dst = dst[k];
}
const last = path[path.length - 1];
try {
dst[last] = isObject(src) ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src)) : src;
} catch (e) {
console.error('[Store] Атомарная замена не удалась:', path.join('.'), e);
dst[last] = src;
}
console.log(`[Store] Атомарная замена: ${path.join('.')}`);
}
}
export class Store {
constructor() {
this.STORAGE_KEY = 'stream_pack_config';
this.ACTION_KEY = 'stream_pack_action';
this.state = {
isProcessing: false,
obsStatus: 'disconnected',
serverOnline: false,
logs: [],
logFilter: 'all',
widgetsManifest: widgetsManifest,
config: { obsPath: '', twitchChannel: 'ksusha__sher', githubRepo: 'Bagerca/New-vijet-launcher', widgets: {} },
updateInfo: { hasUpdate: false, isChecking: false, currentVersion: '1.0.0', latestVersion: '1.0.0', releaseNotes: '', downloadUrl: null, isUpdating: false, progressPercent: 0, statusText: '' },
packInfo: { ...PACK_DEFAULTS },
isElectronEnv: typeof window !== 'undefined' && Boolean(window.obsAPI)
};
this.listeners = new Set();
this.actionListeners = new Set();
this._lastSaveTime = 0;
this._saveTimeout = null;
this._lastConfigJson = '';
this.ws = null;
this._retry = 1500;
this._timer = null;
this._wasOnline = false;
this._initializeDefaults();
this._loadStandaloneConfig();
this._initWS();
window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
if (e.key === this.STORAGE_KEY && e.newValue) {
try { this.syncFromRemote(JSON.parse(e.newValue)); } catch (err) {}
}
if (e.key === this.ACTION_KEY && e.newValue) {
try {
const d = JSON.parse(e.newValue);
if (d && d.action) this._dispatch(d.action, d.payload || {});
} catch (err) {}
}
});
console.log('[Store] v3.3 готов. Electron:', this.state.isElectronEnv);
}
_initWS() {
if (this._timer) { clearTimeout(this._timer); this._timer = null; }
if (this.ws) {
const old = this.ws;
this.ws = null;
old.onopen = old.onmessage = old.onerror = old.onclose = null;
try { old.close(); } catch (e) {}
}
let sock;
try { sock = new WebSocket('ws://127.0.0.1:42069'); }
catch (e) { this._schedule(); return; }
this.ws = sock;
sock.onopen = () => {
if (this.ws !== sock) return;
this._retry = 1500;
if (!this.state.serverOnline) this.setState({ serverOnline: true });
if (!this._wasOnline) {
this._wasOnline = true;
this.addLog('Связь с локальным сервером установлена.', 'success');
}
};
sock.onmessage = (e) => {
if (this.ws !== sock) return;
try {
const msg = JSON.parse(e.data);
if (msg.event === 'WIDGET_ACTION') this._dispatch(msg.action, msg.payload || {});
else if (msg.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED' && msg.data) this.syncFromRemote(msg.data);
} catch (err) {}
};
sock.onerror = () => { try { sock.close(); } catch (e) {} };
sock.onclose = () => {
if (this.ws !== sock) return;
this.ws = null;
if (this.state.serverOnline) this.setState({ serverOnline: false });
if (this._wasOnline) {
this._wasOnline = false;
this.addLog('Связь с локальным сервером потеряна. Переподключение...', 'warn');
}
this._schedule();
};
}
_schedule() {
if (this._timer) clearTimeout(this._timer);
this._timer = setTimeout(() => { this._timer = null; this._initWS(); }, this._retry);
this._retry = Math.min(Math.round(this._retry * 1.5), 8000);
}
ensureConnection() {
if (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1) return true;
this._retry = 1500;
this._initWS();
return false;
}
isServerOnline() { return Boolean(this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1); }
_dispatch(action, payload) {
this.actionListeners.forEach(l => {
try { l(action, payload); } catch (e) { console.error('[Store] слушатель действия:', e); }
});
}
_sanitize(widgetsConfig) {
if (!widgetsConfig) return {};
const s = deepMerge({}, widgetsConfig);
this.state.widgetsManifest.forEach(widget => {
if (s[widget.id]) {
widget.controls.forEach(control => {
if (control.type === 'button') return;
const val = s[widget.id][control.key];
if (val !== undefined) {
if (control.type === 'checkbox') s[widget.id][control.key] = (val === true || String(val).toLowerCase() === 'true');
else if (control.type === 'number' || control.type === 'range') {
const n = Number(val);
s[widget.id][control.key] = isNaN(n) ? control.default : n;
} else s[widget.id][control.key] = String(val);
}
});
}
});
return s;
}
_initializeDefaults() {
this.state.widgetsManifest.forEach(widget => {
if (!this.state.config.widgets[widget.id]) this.state.config.widgets[widget.id] = {};
widget.controls.forEach(control => {
if (control.type !== 'button' && this.state.config.widgets[widget.id][control.key] === undefined) {
this.state.config.widgets[widget.id][control.key] = control.default;
}
});
});
}
_loadStandaloneConfig() {
if (!this.state.isElectronEnv) {
try {
const saved = localStorage.getItem(this.STORAGE_KEY);
if (saved) {
this.state.config = deepMerge({}, this.state.config, JSON.parse(saved));
this.state.config.widgets = this._sanitize(this.state.config.widgets);
}
} catch (e) {
console.error('[Store] Локальный конфиг повреждён, стартую с дефолтов:', e);
}
}
this._lastConfigJson = JSON.stringify(this.state.config);
}
getState() { return this.state; }
setState(partial) { this.state = { ...this.state, ...partial }; this.notify(); }
setUpdateInfo(info) { this.state.updateInfo = { ...this.state.updateInfo, ...(info || {}) }; this.notify(); }
setPackInfo(info) {
this.state.packInfo = { ...PACK_DEFAULTS, ...this.state.packInfo, ...(info || {}) };
this.notify();
}
async updateConfig(partial) {
const merged = deepMerge({}, this.state.config, partial);
applyAtomicKeys(merged, partial);
if (partial.widgets) merged.widgets = this._sanitize(merged.widgets);
this.state.config = merged;
this._lastConfigJson = JSON.stringify(merged);
this.notify();
const now = Date.now();
const save = async () => {
this._lastSaveTime = Date.now();
try { localStorage.setItem(this.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.state.config)); } catch (e) {}
if (this.state.isElectronEnv && window.obsAPI && typeof window.obsAPI.saveConfig === 'function') {
try { await window.obsAPI.saveConfig(this.state.config); }
catch (err) { this.addLog(`Ошибка сохранения: ${err.message}`, 'error'); }
}
};
if (now - this._lastSaveTime > 100) { clearTimeout(this._saveTimeout); await save(); }
else { clearTimeout(this._saveTimeout); this._saveTimeout = setTimeout(save, 100); }
}
syncFromRemote(newConfig) {
if (!newConfig) return;
const merged = deepMerge({}, this.state.config, newConfig);
applyAtomicKeys(merged, newConfig);
if (newConfig.widgets) merged.widgets = this._sanitize(merged.widgets);
const json = JSON.stringify(merged);
if (json === this._lastConfigJson) return;
this._lastConfigJson = json;
this.state.config = merged;
this.notify();
}
resetWidgetToDefaults(widgetId) {
const manifest = this.state.widgetsManifest.find(w => w.id === widgetId);
if (!manifest) return;
const conf = {};
manifest.controls.forEach(c => { if (c.type !== 'button') conf[c.key] = c.default; });
this.updateConfig({ widgets: { [widgetId]: conf } });
this.addLog(`Виджет "${manifest.title}" сброшен.`, 'success');
}
broadcastAction(action, payload = {}) {
let sent = false;
if (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1) {
try { this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action, payload })); sent = true; } catch (e) {}
}
try { localStorage.setItem(this.ACTION_KEY, JSON.stringify({ action, payload, _n: Date.now() + Math.random() })); } catch (e) {}
if (!QUIET_ACTIONS.has(action)) {
if (sent) this.addLog(`Действие: ${action}`, 'info');
else this.addLog(`Команда ${action}: сервер недоступен`, 'warn');
}
return sent;
}
addLog(message, type = 'info') {
const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU');
this.setState({ logs: [...this.state.logs, { time, message, type }] });
}
clearLogs() { this.setState({ logs: [] }); }
subscribe(listener) { this.listeners.add(listener); return () => this.listeners.delete(listener); }
notify() {
this.listeners.forEach(l => {
try { l(this.state); } catch (e) { console.error('[Store] слушатель:', e); }
});
}
onAction(listener) { this.actionListeners.add(listener); return () => this.actionListeners.delete(listener); }
}
export const store = new Store();

/* ФАЙЛ: js/components/toast.js — v5 */
export class Toast {
constructor(container, { duration = 3200, className = 'pd-toast' } = {}) {
this.container = container;
this.duration = duration;
this.className = className;
}

show(text, type = 'info') {
if (!this.container) return;
const el = document.createElement('div');
el.className = `${this.className} ${type === 'success' ? 'is-success' : type === 'error' ? 'is-error' : ''}`;
el.textContent = text;
this.container.appendChild(el);
setTimeout(() => {
el.classList.add('is-out');
setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 350);
}, this.duration);
}

success(text) { this.show(text, 'success'); }
error(text) { this.show(text, 'error'); }
info(text) { this.show(text, 'info'); }
}
