/* ФАЙЛ: js/views/widgetsView.js — v3 (очередь на перенос: перенесённые в 2.0 скрыты, карта миграции, живые фильтры) */
import { store } from '../store.js';
import { icons } from '../utils/icons.js';
import { UIControls } from '../components/UIControls.js';
import { paintRange, paintRanges } from '../utils/rangeFill.js';
import { setHashParams } from '../utils/hashParams.js';
import { isMigrated, migrationOf, v2Href, migrationStats, migratedChips } from '../../data/v2Registry.js';

const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'Все' },
  { id: 'overlay', label: 'Оверлеи' },
  { id: 'scene', label: 'Сцены' },
  { id: 'chat', label: 'Чат' },
  { id: 'media', label: 'Медиа' }
];

const MASTER_KEYS = ['enabled', 'isActive', 'isVisible', 'playlistEnabled'];

function esc(s) {
  return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

/** Ссылка на вкладку с сохранением остальных параметров (кроме открытого превью). */
function tabHref(params, updates) {
  const merged = { ...(params || {}), preview: null, ...updates };
  const sp = new URLSearchParams();
  Object.entries(merged).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return;
    if (k === 'cat' && v === 'all') return;
    sp.set(k, String(v));
  });
  const q = sp.toString();
  return `#/widgets${q ? `?${q}` : ''}`;
}

function renderMigrationPanel(stats, manifest, showDone) {
  const chips = migratedChips(manifest);
  const segments = manifest.map(w => {
    const done = isMigrated(w.id);
    const mig = migrationOf(w.id);
    const title = done
      ? `${w.title} — перенесён в 2.0 (${mig ? mig.label : w.id})`
      : `${w.title} — ещё в очереди`;
    return `<span class="wg-seg ${done ? 'is-done' : ''}" title="${esc(title)}"></span>`;
  }).join('');

  const doneChips = chips.map(c => `
<a class="wg-chip is-done" href="${c.href}" title="Открыть дашборд 2.0: ${esc(c.label)}">
${icons.check()}<span>${esc(c.label)}</span>
</a>`).join('');

  const todoChips = stats.todo.map(w => `
<button class="wg-chip is-todo" type="button" data-wg-jump="${esc(w.id)}" title="Показать карточку ${esc(w.title)}">
${icons.chevronDown()}<span>${esc(w.title)}</span>
</button>`).join('');

  return `
<section class="card wg-migration">
  <header class="wg-mig-head">
    <div class="wg-mig-left">
      <span class="wg-mig-ic">${icons.layers()}</span>
      <div class="wg-mig-copy">
        <h3 class="wg-mig-title">Очередь на перенос в «Оверлеи 2.0»</h3>
        <p class="wg-mig-sub">
          Ниже — только виджеты, у которых ещё нет нового дашборда.
          Готовые скрыты из списка, но их настройки никуда не делись: они живут в 2.0 и в мобильной панели.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="wg-mig-score">
      <span class="wg-mig-big">${stats.todoCount}</span>
      <span class="wg-mig-big-label">осталось перенести</span>
      <span class="wg-mig-fraction">${stats.doneCount} / ${stats.total} готово · ${stats.percent}%</span>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="wg-map" role="img" aria-label="Карта переноса: ${stats.doneCount} из ${stats.total} виджетов готовы">${segments}</div>

  <div class="wg-mig-rows">
    <div class="wg-mig-row">
      <span class="wg-row-label is-done">${icons.check()} Готово · ${stats.doneCount}</span>
      <div class="wg-chip-row">${doneChips || '<span class="wg-row-empty">Пока ничего не перенесено</span>'}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="wg-mig-row">
      <span class="wg-row-label is-todo">${icons.flask()} В очереди · ${stats.todoCount}</span>
      <div class="wg-chip-row">${todoChips || '<span class="wg-row-empty">Всё перенесено — очередь пуста</span>'}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <footer class="wg-mig-foot">
    <label class="wg-toggle" title="Показать карточки уже перенесённых виджетов отдельным блоком">
      <input type="checkbox" id="wg-show-done" ${showDone ? 'checked' : ''}>
      <span class="wg-toggle-track"></span>
      <span class="wg-toggle-label">Показывать перенесённые (${stats.doneCount})</span>
    </label>
    <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#/widgets-v2">${icons.layers()} Открыть 2.0</a>
  </footer>
</section>`;
}

function renderCard(widget, config, searchQuery) {
  const widgetConfig = config[widget.id] || {};
  const masterControl = widget.controls.find(c => c.type === 'checkbox' && MASTER_KEYS.includes(c.key));
  const bodyControls = widget.controls.filter(c => c !== masterControl);

  const controlsHtml = bodyControls.map(control => {
    if (control.type === 'button') return UIControls.Button(control.label, control.action, control.payload);
    const val = widgetConfig[control.key] !== undefined ? widgetConfig[control.key] : control.default;
    let inputHtml = '';
    if (control.type === 'range') inputHtml = UIControls.RangeSlider(widget.id, control.key, val);
    else if (control.type === 'checkbox') inputHtml = UIControls.ToggleSwitch(widget.id, control.key, val, control.label);
    else if (control.type === 'color') inputHtml = UIControls.ColorInput(widget.id, control.key, val);
    else if (control.type === 'select') inputHtml = UIControls.Select(widget.id, control.key, val, control.options);
    else if (control.type === 'textarea') inputHtml = UIControls.Textarea(widget.id, control.key, val, control.label);
    else if (control.type === 'number') inputHtml = UIControls.NumberInput(widget.id, control.key, val);
    else inputHtml = UIControls.TextInput(widget.id, control.key, val, control.label);
    if (control.type === 'checkbox') return inputHtml;
    return UIControls.LabelWrapper(control.label, inputHtml, control.description);
  }).join('');

  let masterToggleHtml = '';
  let isMasterActive = true;
  if (masterControl) {
    const val = widgetConfig[masterControl.key] !== undefined ? widgetConfig[masterControl.key] : masterControl.default;
    masterToggleHtml = UIControls.ToggleSwitch(widget.id, masterControl.key, val, '');
    isMasterActive = val === true || String(val) === 'true';
  }

  const mig = migrationOf(widget.id);
  const done = Boolean(mig);
  const haystack = `${widget.title} ${widget.description}`.toLowerCase();
  const visibleBySearch = !searchQuery || haystack.includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

  const statusBadge = done
    ? `<span class="badge badge-success mb-xs" id="status-${widget.id}">ПЕРЕНЕСЁН</span>`
    : `<span class="badge ${isMasterActive ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-danger'} mb-xs" id="status-${widget.id}">${isMasterActive ? 'АКТИВЕН' : 'ОТКЛЮЧЕН'}</span>`;

  const queueTag = done
    ? `<span class="wg-card-tag is-done">${icons.check()} есть дашборд 2.0</span>`
    : `<span class="wg-card-tag is-todo">${icons.flask()} нужен дашборд 2.0</span>`;

  const v2Button = done
    ? `<a class="btn btn-primary wg-btn-v2" href="${v2Href(widget.id)}" title="Открыть новый дашборд">${icons.layers()} В 2.0</a>`
    : '';

  return `
<article class="card widget-card wg-card ${done ? 'is-migrated' : ''}" id="widget-${widget.id}"
  data-search="${esc(haystack)}" data-kind="${done ? 'done' : 'todo'}"
  style="display: ${visibleBySearch ? 'flex' : 'none'};">
  <header class="wg-card-head">
    <div class="flex-1">
      ${statusBadge}
      <h3 class="text-lg text-bold wg-card-title">${widget.title}</h3>
      <p class="text-secondary text-sm wg-card-desc">${widget.description}</p>
      ${queueTag}
    </div>
    <div class="wg-card-master">${masterToggleHtml}</div>
  </header>
  <form onsubmit="return false;" class="d-flex flex-column flex-1 justify-between">
    <fieldset class="wg-fieldset">
      ${controlsHtml}
    </fieldset>
    <div class="wg-card-foot">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-preview" data-preview="${widget.id}" type="button">${icons.eye()} Предпросмотр</button>
      ${v2Button}
      <button class="btn btn-danger btn-reset" data-reset="${widget.id}" type="button">${icons.trash()} Сброс</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</article>`;
}

function renderSection(kind, list, config, searchQuery, showDone) {
  const isTodo = kind === 'todo';
  const title = isTodo ? 'Осталось перенести' : 'Уже в «Оверлеях 2.0»';
  const hint = isTodo
    ? 'Эти виджеты настраиваются только здесь — новых дашбордов у них ещё нет.'
    : 'Правки лучше делать в новом интерфейсе. Старые контролы работают, но могут разъехаться с 2.0.';
  const emptyDefault = isTodo
    ? 'В этой категории всё перенесено — новых задач нет.'
    : 'Перенесённых виджетов в этой категории нет.';

  const cards = list.map(w => renderCard(w, config, searchQuery)).join('');

  return `
<section class="wg-section">
  <div class="wg-section-head">
    <div>
      <h2 class="wg-section-title ${isTodo ? 'is-todo' : 'is-done'}">
        ${isTodo ? icons.flask() : icons.check()} ${title}
        <span class="wg-count-pill" id="wg-count-${kind}">${list.length}</span>
      </h2>
      <p class="wg-section-hint">${hint}</p>
    </div>
    ${!isTodo ? `<a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#/widgets-v2">${icons.layers()} Перейти к 2.0</a>` : ''}
  </div>
  <div class="wg-grid" id="wg-grid-${kind}">${cards}</div>
  <div class="wg-empty ${list.length ? 'is-hidden' : ''}" id="wg-empty-${kind}">
    ${icons.search()}
    <span class="wg-empty-text" id="wg-empty-text-${kind}" data-default="${esc(emptyDefault)}">${esc(emptyDefault)}</span>
    ${isTodo && !showDone ? `<a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#/widgets-v2">${icons.layers()} Открыть готовые дашборды</a>` : ''}
  </div>
</section>`;
}

export const WidgetsView = {
  _inputHandler: null,
  _changeHandler: null,
  _clickHandler: null,
  _searchHandler: null,
  _unsubStore: null,
  _resizeObserver: null,
  _lastParams: {},
  _silentClose: false,
  _jumpTimers: new Map(),

  render: (state, params) => {
    const manifest = Array.isArray(state.widgetsManifest) ? state.widgetsManifest : [];
    const config = state.config.widgets || {};
    const stats = migrationStats(manifest);
    const showDone = params?.done === '1';
    const activeCategory = params?.cat || 'all';
    const searchQuery = params?.search || '';

    WidgetsView._lastParams = { ...(params || {}) };

    const pool = showDone ? manifest : stats.todo;
    const counts = { all: pool.length };
    CATEGORIES.forEach(c => {
      if (c.id !== 'all') counts[c.id] = pool.filter(w => w.category === c.id).length;
    });

    const tabsHtml = CATEGORIES.map(t => {
      const n = counts[t.id] || 0;
      return `<a href="${tabHref(params, { cat: t.id })}" class="tab wg-tab ${activeCategory === t.id ? 'active' : ''}">
        <span>${t.label}</span><span class="wg-tab-count ${n === 0 ? 'is-zero' : ''}">${n}</span>
      </a>`;
    }).join('');

    const filtered = activeCategory === 'all' ? pool : pool.filter(w => w.category === activeCategory);
    const todoList = filtered.filter(w => !isMigrated(w.id));
    const doneList = filtered.filter(w => isMigrated(w.id));

    console.log(`[Widgets] Очередь: ${stats.todoCount} из ${stats.total} · категория ${activeCategory} · перенесённые ${showDone ? 'видны' : 'скрыты'}`);

    return `
<header class="view-header">
  <h1 class="view-title">Оверлеи 1.0 — очередь на перенос</h1>
  <p class="view-subtitle">Старый интерфейс настроек. Показаны только виджеты без дашборда в «Оверлеях 2.0».</p>
</header>

${renderMigrationPanel(stats, manifest, showDone)}

<div class="wg-toolbar">
  <nav class="tabs wg-tabs">${tabsHtml}</nav>
  <div class="search-wrapper wg-search">
    ${icons.search()}
    <input type="text" id="widget-search" class="search-input" value="${esc(searchQuery)}" placeholder="Поиск по виджетам..." aria-label="Поиск по виджетам">
    <button class="wg-search-clear ${searchQuery ? '' : 'is-hidden'}" id="wg-search-clear" type="button" title="Очистить поиск" aria-label="Очистить поиск">${icons.close()}</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="widgets-root">
  ${renderSection('todo', todoList, config, searchQuery, showDone)}
  ${showDone ? renderSection('done', doneList, config, searchQuery, showDone) : ''}
</div>

<dialog id="preview-modal" class="modal-dialog">
  <div class="modal-content">
    <header class="modal-header">
      <h3 class="modal-title" id="preview-title">Live Preview</h3>
      <form method="dialog"><button class="modal-close" id="preview-close" type="submit">${icons.close()}</button></form>
    </header>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <div class="preview-container" id="preview-box">
        <iframe id="preview-iframe" class="preview-iframe" src=""></iframe>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>`;
  },

  /* ---------- параметры маршрута ---------- */

  onParamsChange: (params, state) => {
    const prev = WidgetsView._lastParams || {};
    const structural =
      (params?.cat || 'all') !== (prev.cat || 'all') ||
      (params?.done === '1') !== (prev.done === '1') ||
      (params?.search || '') !== (prev.search || '');
    if (structural) return false; // роутер перерисует экран целиком
    WidgetsView._syncPreview(params, state);
    return true;
  },

  _syncPreview: (params, state) => {
    const modal = document.getElementById('preview-modal');
    const iframe = document.getElementById('preview-iframe');
    const title = document.getElementById('preview-title');
    if (!modal || !iframe) return;
    const id = params?.preview;
    if (id) {
      const widget = (state.widgetsManifest || []).find(w => w.id === id);
      if (!widget) return;
      if (title) title.textContent = `Превью: ${widget.title}`;
      const src = `widgets/${id}/index.html?preview=1`;
      if (iframe.getAttribute('src') !== src) iframe.setAttribute('src', src);
      if (!modal.open) { try { modal.showModal(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[Widgets] showModal:', e); } }
    } else if (modal.open) {
      WidgetsView._silentClose = true;
      modal.close();
      iframe.setAttribute('src', '');
    }
  },

  /* ---------- живой поиск ---------- */

  _applySearch: (term) => {
    const root = document.getElementById('widgets-root');
    if (!root) return;
    const q = String(term || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    root.querySelectorAll('.widget-card').forEach(card => {
      const hay = card.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
      card.style.display = !q || hay.includes(q) ? 'flex' : 'none';
    });
    ['todo', 'done'].forEach(kind => {
      const grid = document.getElementById(`wg-grid-${kind}`);
      if (!grid) return;
      const visible = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.widget-card')).filter(c => c.style.display !== 'none').length;
      const counter = document.getElementById(`wg-count-${kind}`);
      if (counter) counter.textContent = String(visible);
      const empty = document.getElementById(`wg-empty-${kind}`);
      const text = document.getElementById(`wg-empty-text-${kind}`);
      if (text) text.textContent = q ? `По запросу «${term}» ничего не найдено.` : (text.dataset.default || '');
      if (empty) empty.classList.toggle('is-hidden', visible > 0);
    });
    const clear = document.getElementById('wg-search-clear');
    if (clear) clear.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !q);
  },

  _jumpTo: (id) => {
    const search = document.getElementById('widget-search');
    if (search && search.value) { search.value = ''; WidgetsView._applySearch(''); }
    const card = document.getElementById(`widget-${id}`);
    if (!card) return;
    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    card.classList.remove('is-flash');
    void card.offsetWidth;
    card.classList.add('is-flash');
    const old = WidgetsView._jumpTimers.get(id);
    if (old) clearTimeout(old);
    WidgetsView._jumpTimers.set(id, setTimeout(() => {
      WidgetsView._jumpTimers.delete(id);
      if (card.isConnected) card.classList.remove('is-flash');
    }, 1300));
  },

  /* ---------- жизненный цикл ---------- */

  mount: (params, state) => {
    const root = document.getElementById('widgets-root');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('widget-search');
    const previewModal = document.getElementById('preview-modal');
    const previewBox = document.getElementById('preview-box');
    const previewIframe = document.getElementById('preview-iframe');
    if (!root) return;

    paintRanges(root);
    if (params?.search) WidgetsView._applySearch(params.search);

    WidgetsView._resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (previewIframe) previewIframe.style.transform = `scale(${entry.contentRect.width / 1920})`;
      }
    });
    if (previewBox) WidgetsView._resizeObserver.observe(previewBox);

    if (previewModal) {
      previewModal.addEventListener('close', () => {
        if (WidgetsView._silentClose) { WidgetsView._silentClose = false; return; }
        setHashParams({ preview: null }, { base: '#/widgets' });
        setTimeout(() => { if (previewIframe && previewIframe.isConnected) previewIframe.setAttribute('src', ''); }, 280);
      });
      previewModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === previewModal) previewModal.close(); });
    }
    if (params?.preview) WidgetsView._syncPreview(params, state);

    WidgetsView._searchHandler = (e) => WidgetsView._applySearch(e.target.value);
    if (searchInput) searchInput.addEventListener('input', WidgetsView._searchHandler);

    WidgetsView._changeHandler = (e) => {
      if (e.target && e.target.id === 'wg-show-done') {
        setHashParams({ done: e.target.checked ? '1' : null }, { base: '#/widgets' });
      }
    };
    root.addEventListener('change', WidgetsView._changeHandler);
    const panelToggle = document.getElementById('wg-show-done');
    if (panelToggle) panelToggle.addEventListener('change', WidgetsView._changeHandler);

    WidgetsView._inputHandler = (e) => {
      const target = e.target;
      if (!target.hasAttribute || !target.hasAttribute('data-widget') || !target.hasAttribute('data-key')) return;
      const widgetId = target.getAttribute('data-widget');
      const key = target.getAttribute('data-key');
      const value = target.type === 'checkbox' ? target.checked : target.value;
      if (target.type === 'range') {
        const valLabel = document.getElementById(`val-${widgetId}-${key}`);
        if (valLabel) valLabel.textContent = value;
        paintRange(target);
      }
      const newWidgetsConfig = { ...store.getState().config.widgets };
      if (!newWidgetsConfig[widgetId]) newWidgetsConfig[widgetId] = {};
      newWidgetsConfig[widgetId] = { ...newWidgetsConfig[widgetId], [key]: value };
      store.updateConfig({ widgets: newWidgetsConfig });
    };
    root.addEventListener('input', WidgetsView._inputHandler);

    WidgetsView._clickHandler = (e) => {
      const jump = e.target.closest('[data-wg-jump]');
      if (jump) { e.preventDefault(); WidgetsView._jumpTo(jump.getAttribute('data-wg-jump')); return; }
      if (e.target.closest('#wg-search-clear')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (searchInput) { searchInput.value = ''; searchInput.focus(); }
        WidgetsView._applySearch('');
        return;
      }
      const btnReset = e.target.closest('.btn-reset');
      if (btnReset) { store.resetWidgetToDefaults(btnReset.getAttribute('data-reset')); return; }
      const btnTest = e.target.closest('.btn-test-action');
      if (btnTest) {
        let payload = {};
        try { payload = JSON.parse(btnTest.getAttribute('data-payload')); } catch (err) {}
        store.broadcastAction(btnTest.getAttribute('data-action'), payload);
        return;
      }
      const btnPreview = e.target.closest('.btn-preview');
      if (btnPreview) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setHashParams({ preview: btnPreview.getAttribute('data-preview') }, { base: '#/widgets' });
      }
    };
    root.addEventListener('click', WidgetsView._clickHandler);

    const panel = document.querySelector('.wg-migration');
    if (panel) panel.addEventListener('click', WidgetsView._clickHandler);

    WidgetsView._unsubStore = store.subscribe((newState) => {
      const config = newState.config.widgets;
      (newState.widgetsManifest || []).forEach(widget => {
        let isMasterActive = true;
        widget.controls.forEach(control => {
          if (control.type === 'button') return;
          const newVal = config[widget.id]?.[control.key] ?? control.default;
          if (MASTER_KEYS.includes(control.key)) isMasterActive = newVal === true || String(newVal) === 'true';
          const input = root.querySelector(`[data-widget="${widget.id}"][data-key="${control.key}"]`);
          if (!input || document.activeElement === input) {
            if (input && control.type === 'range') paintRange(input);
            return;
          }
          let isChanged = false;
          if (input.type === 'checkbox') {
            const isChecked = newVal === true || String(newVal) === 'true';
            if (input.checked !== isChecked) { input.checked = isChecked; isChanged = true; }
          } else if (input.value !== String(newVal)) {
            input.value = newVal;
            isChanged = true;
            if (control.type === 'range') {
              const valLabel = document.getElementById(`val-${widget.id}-${control.key}`);
              if (valLabel) valLabel.textContent = newVal;
            }
          }
          if (control.type === 'range') paintRange(input);
          if (isChanged) {
            const wrapper = input.closest('.control-group');
            if (wrapper) {
              wrapper.classList.remove('flash-update');
              void wrapper.offsetWidth;
              wrapper.classList.add('flash-update');
            }
          }
        });
        if (isMigrated(widget.id)) return; // у перенесённых бейдж статичный: «ПЕРЕНЕСЁН»
        const dot = document.getElementById(`status-${widget.id}`);
        if (dot) {
          dot.className = isMasterActive ? 'badge badge-success mb-xs' : 'badge badge-danger mb-xs';
          dot.textContent = isMasterActive ? 'АКТИВЕН' : 'ОТКЛЮЧЕН';
        }
      });
    });
  },

  unmount: () => {
    const root = document.getElementById('widgets-root');
    const panel = document.querySelector('.wg-migration');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('widget-search');
    const panelToggle = document.getElementById('wg-show-done');
    const modal = document.getElementById('preview-modal');

    if (WidgetsView._resizeObserver) { WidgetsView._resizeObserver.disconnect(); WidgetsView._resizeObserver = null; }
    if (root) {
      if (WidgetsView._inputHandler) root.removeEventListener('input', WidgetsView._inputHandler);
      if (WidgetsView._clickHandler) root.removeEventListener('click', WidgetsView._clickHandler);
      if (WidgetsView._changeHandler) root.removeEventListener('change', WidgetsView._changeHandler);
    }
    if (panel && WidgetsView._clickHandler) panel.removeEventListener('click', WidgetsView._clickHandler);
    if (panelToggle && WidgetsView._changeHandler) panelToggle.removeEventListener('change', WidgetsView._changeHandler);
    if (searchInput && WidgetsView._searchHandler) searchInput.removeEventListener('input', WidgetsView._searchHandler);
    if (WidgetsView._unsubStore) { WidgetsView._unsubStore(); WidgetsView._unsubStore = null; }
    for (const t of WidgetsView._jumpTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
    WidgetsView._jumpTimers.clear();
    if (modal && modal.open) {
      WidgetsView._silentClose = true;
      modal.close();
    }
    const iframe = document.getElementById('preview-iframe');
    if (iframe) iframe.setAttribute('src', '');
  }
};

--- START OF FILE js/views/settings/coreBindings.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: js/views/settings/coreBindings.js — v1 (обработчики системных настроек: Twitch, репозиторий, путь OBS, экспорт) */
import { store } from '../../store.js';

class CoreBindings {
  constructor() {
    this._saveTwitch = null;
    this._saveRepo = null;
    this._browseObs = null;
    this._exportLayout = null;
  }

  mount(state) {
    const btnSaveTwitch = document.getElementById('btn-save-twitch');
    const inputTwitch = document.getElementById('twitch-input');
    const btnSaveRepo = document.getElementById('btn-save-repo');
    const inputRepo = document.getElementById('repo-input');
    const btnBrowse = document.getElementById('btn-browse');
    const inputObs = document.getElementById('obs-path-input');
    const btnExport = document.getElementById('btn-export-layout');
    const isEnvOK = Boolean(state && state.isElectronEnv);

    this._saveTwitch = () => {
      if (!inputTwitch) return;
      const channel = inputTwitch.value.trim();
      if (!channel) { store.addLog('Имя канала Twitch не может быть пустым.', 'warn'); return; }
      store.updateConfig({ twitchChannel: channel });
      store.addLog(`Канал Twitch изменен на: ${channel}`, 'success');
    };

    this._saveRepo = () => {
      if (!inputRepo) return;
      const repo = inputRepo.value.trim();
      if (!repo) { store.addLog('Репозиторий обновлений не может быть пустым.', 'warn'); return; }
      store.updateConfig({ githubRepo: repo });
      store.addLog(`Репозиторий обновлений изменен на: ${repo}`, 'info');
    };

    this._browseObs = async () => {
      if (!isEnvOK || !window.obsAPI || typeof window.obsAPI.selectObsPath !== 'function') return;
      try {
        const selectedPath = await window.obsAPI.selectObsPath();
        if (!selectedPath) return;
        if (inputObs) inputObs.value = selectedPath;
        store.updateConfig({ obsPath: selectedPath });
        store.addLog(`Путь к OBS установлен: ${selectedPath}`, 'info');
      } catch (err) {
        store.addLog(`Не удалось выбрать путь: ${err.message}`, 'error');
      }
    };

    this._exportLayout = async () => {
      if (!isEnvOK || !window.obsAPI || typeof window.obsAPI.exportLayout !== 'function') return;
      if (btnExport) btnExport.disabled = true;
      store.addLog('Сбор координат из OBS...', 'info');
      try {
        const result = await window.obsAPI.exportLayout();
        if (result && result.status === 'ok') store.addLog(`Раскладка сохранена: ${result.filePath}`, 'success');
        else if (result && result.status === 'error') store.addLog(`Ошибка экспорта: ${result.message}`, 'error');
        else store.addLog('Экспорт отменён.', 'info');
      } catch (err) {
        store.addLog(`Ошибка экспорта: ${err.message}`, 'error');
      } finally {
        if (btnExport && btnExport.isConnected) btnExport.disabled = false;
      }
    };

    if (btnSaveTwitch) btnSaveTwitch.addEventListener('click', this._saveTwitch);
    if (btnSaveRepo) btnSaveRepo.addEventListener('click', this._saveRepo);
    if (btnBrowse) btnBrowse.addEventListener('click', this._browseObs);
    if (btnExport) btnExport.addEventListener('click', this._exportLayout);
  }

  unmount() {
    const pairs = [
      ['btn-save-twitch', this._saveTwitch],
      ['btn-save-repo', this._saveRepo],
      ['btn-browse', this._browseObs],
      ['btn-export-layout', this._exportLayout]
    ];
    pairs.forEach(([id, handler]) => {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el && handler) el.removeEventListener('click', handler);
    });
    this._saveTwitch = null;
    this._saveRepo = null;
    this._browseObs = null;
    this._exportLayout = null;
  }
}

export const coreBindings = new CoreBindings();

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/alerts/script.js — v4.1 (самодостаточный; телеметрия уходит сразу после открытия WS) */
import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';
import { icons } from '../../js/utils/icons.js';

const PARAMS = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const IS_PREVIEW = PARAMS.get('preview') === '1';
const DEBUG = PARAMS.get('debug') === '1';
const SOURCE = IS_PREVIEW ? 'preview' : 'obs';
const HEARTBEAT_MS = 4000;
const OUT_MS = 500;
const QUEUE_MAX = 50;

const DEFAULTS = { enabled: true, soundEnabled: true, volume: 40, duration: 5, scale: 100, position: 'top' };
const LIMITS = { volume: [0, 100], duration: [1, 30], scale: [60, 150] };
const POSITIONS = ['top', 'center', 'bottom'];

const TYPES = [
{ id: 'follow', kind: 'standard', emoji: '💖', color: '#ff69b4', sound: 'follow.mp3', chat: 'follow', phrase: 'отслеживает канал!', many: 'новых фолловеров!' },
{ id: 'sub', kind: 'standard', emoji: '⭐', color: '#00ff66', sound: 'sub.mp3', chat: 'sub', phrase: 'оформил подписку!' },
{ id: 'resub', kind: 'standard', emoji: '🔥', color: '#ff4500', sound: 'resub.mp3', chat: 'resub', phrase: 'с нами уже {v} мес.!' },
{ id: 'gift', kind: 'standard', emoji: '🎁', color: '#ff007f', sound: 'gift.mp3', chat: 'gift', phrase: 'подарил подписку!' },
{ id: 'streak', kind: 'standard', emoji: '📺', color: '#00e5ff', sound: 'streak.mp3', chat: 'streak', phrase: 'смотрит {v} стримов подряд!' },
{ id: 'cheer', kind: 'standard', emoji: '💎', color: '#9146ff', sound: 'cheer.mp3', chat: 'cheer', phrase: 'задонатил {v} битов!' },
{ id: 'raid', kind: 'standard', emoji: '🚀', color: '#00ff66', sound: 'raid.mp3', chat: 'raid', phrase: 'привёл {v} зрителей!' },
{ id: 'reward_series', kind: 'reward', icon: 'alert_series', color: '#a29bfe', sound: 'series.mp3', chat: 'series', badge: 'СЕРИАЛ' },
{ id: 'reward_movie', kind: 'reward', icon: 'alert_movie', color: '#fdcb6e', sound: 'movie.mp3', chat: 'movie', badge: 'ФИЛЬМ' },
{ id: 'reward_video', kind: 'reward', icon: 'alert_video', color: '#74b9ff', sound: 'video.mp3', chat: 'video', badge: 'ВИДЕО' },
{ id: 'reward_game', kind: 'reward', icon: 'alert_game', color: '#55efc4', sound: 'game.mp3', chat: 'game', badge: 'ИГРА' },
{ id: 'reward_music', kind: 'reward', icon: 'alert_music', color: '#ff7675', sound: 'music.mp3', chat: 'music', badge: 'МУЗЫКА' }
];

function isTrue(v) { return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }
function clampInt(v, min, max, fb) { const n = parseInt(v, 10); return isNaN(n) ? fb : Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n)); }
function esc(s) { return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;'); }
function typeOf(id) { return TYPES.find(t => t.id === String(id || '').toLowerCase()) || null; }
function typeByChat(arg) {
const a = String(arg || '').toLowerCase();
if (!a) return null;
return typeOf(a) || TYPES.find(t => t.chat === a) || null;
}
function normalize(raw) {
const c = { ...DEFAULTS, ...(raw || {}) };
const n = (k) => clampInt(c[k], LIMITS[k][0], LIMITS[k][1], DEFAULTS[k]);
return {
enabled: c.enabled === undefined ? DEFAULTS.enabled : isTrue(c.enabled),
soundEnabled: c.soundEnabled === undefined ? DEFAULTS.soundEnabled : isTrue(c.soundEnabled),
volume: n('volume'), duration: n('duration'), scale: n('scale'),
position: POSITIONS.includes(String(c.position)) ? String(c.position) : DEFAULTS.position
};
}
function phrase(t, value) {
if (!t || !t.phrase) return '';
const v = Math.max(0, parseInt(value, 10) || 0);
if (t.many && v > 1) return `${v} ${t.many}`;
return t.phrase.replace('{v}', String(v));
}

const Dbg = {
el: null,
init() {
if (!DEBUG) return;
this.el = document.createElement('div');
this.el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:99999;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(6,7,10,.9);border:1px solid #00ff66;color:#00ff66;font:700 12px/1.5 monospace;pointer-events:none;max-width:520px;';
document.body.appendChild(this.el);
this.set('загрузка…');
},
set(text) {
if (!this.el) return;
this.el.textContent = `ALERTS ${SOURCE} · ${text}`;
}
};

const AppAlerts = {
container: document.getElementById('alert-container'),
config: normalize({}),
queue: [],
current: null,
isPlaying: false,
shown: 0,
dropped: 0,
lastEventAt: 0,
seen: new Set(),
_outTimer: null,
_endTimer: null,
_lastSoundAt: 0,
_lastReport: 0,
_reportTimer: null,

applyConfig(raw) {
if (!this.container) return;
this.config = normalize(raw);
const c = this.config;
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--alert-scale', (c.scale / 100).toFixed(3));
this.container.dataset.pos = c.position;
if (!c.enabled) this.reset(true);
this.report();
this.debug();
},

debug() {
if (!DEBUG) return;
const c = this.config;
Dbg.set(`enabled=${c.enabled} sound=${c.soundEnabled} queue=${this.queue.length} shown=${this.shown} master=${WidgetCore.isMaster} ws=${WidgetCore.ws ? WidgetCore.ws.readyState : 'null'}`);
},

_clearTimers() {
if (this._outTimer) { clearTimeout(this._outTimer); this._outTimer = null; }
if (this._endTimer) { clearTimeout(this._endTimer); this._endTimer = null; }
},

reset(dropQueue) {
this._clearTimers();
if (dropQueue) this.queue = [];
this.isPlaying = false;
this.current = null;
if (this.container) {
this.container.classList.remove('alert-in', 'alert-out');
this.container.classList.add('hidden');
this.container.innerHTML = '';
}
this.report();
},

add(user, type, message = '', value = 0, origin = 'test', eventId = null) {
if (eventId) {
if (this.seen.has(eventId)) return false;
this.seen.add(eventId);
if (this.seen.size > 400) this.seen.clear();
}
if (!this.config.enabled) {
this.dropped++;
console.warn('[Alerts] Событие отброшено: мастер-тумблер выключен.');
this.report();
return false;
}
const meta = typeOf(type);
if (!meta) { console.warn('[Alerts] Неизвестный тип:', type); return false; }
if (this.queue.length >= QUEUE_MAX) { this.dropped++; this.report(); return false; }
this.lastEventAt = Date.now();
this.queue.push({
id: 'a' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
user: String(user || 'Зритель').substring(0, 40),
type: meta.id,
message: String(message || '').substring(0, 160),
value: Math.max(0, parseInt(value, 10) || 0),
origin
});
console.log(`[Alerts:${SOURCE}] Принято «${meta.id}» от ${user} (${origin}), очередь ${this.queue.length}`);
if (!this.isPlaying) this.playNext();
this.report();
return true;
},

playNext() {
if (!this.config.enabled) { this.reset(true); return; }
if (this.queue.length === 0) { this.isPlaying = false; this.current = null; this.report(); return; }
this.isPlaying = true;
this.render(this.queue.shift());
},

render(data) {
const meta = typeOf(data.type);
if (!meta || !this.container) { this.playNext(); return; }
this._clearTimers();
this.current = data;
const color = meta.color;
const user = esc(data.user);
const message = esc(data.message);
const isReward = meta.kind === 'reward';
const iconHtml = meta.icon && typeof icons[meta.icon] === 'function' ? icons[meta.icon]() : esc(meta.emoji || '🔔');
const title = isReward
? `<span class="alert-user" style="color: ${color}">${user}</span>`
: `<span class="alert-user" style="color: ${color}">${user}</span> ${esc(phrase(meta, data.value))}`;

this.container.style.setProperty('--alert-color', color);
this.container.style.setProperty('--alert-glow', `${color}55`);
this.container.innerHTML = isReward ? `
<div class="alert-card reward-card">
<div class="alert-icon-wrap reward-icon-wrap" style="border-color: ${color};"><div class="alert-icon reward-svg" style="color: ${color}; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${color});">${iconHtml}</div></div>
<div class="alert-info">
<div class="reward-badge" style="color: ${color};">ЗАКАЗ ЗА БАЛЛЫ: ${esc(meta.badge || '')}</div>
<div class="alert-title reward-title">${title}</div>
${message ? `<div class="alert-message reward-msg">"${message}"</div>` : ''}
</div>
</div>` : `
<div class="alert-card">
<div class="alert-icon-wrap"><div class="alert-icon" style="text-shadow: 0 0 15px ${color};">${iconHtml}</div></div>
<div class="alert-info">
<div class="alert-title">${title}</div>
${message ? `<div class="alert-message">"${message}"</div>` : ''}
</div>
</div>`;

this.container.classList.remove('hidden', 'alert-out', 'alert-in');
void this.container.offsetWidth;
this.container.classList.add('alert-in');

if (data.origin === 'live' && IS_PREVIEW) { /* живые события озвучивает только OBS */ }
else this.playSound(data.type);

this.shown++;
WidgetCore.sendAction('PET_EMOTION', { emotion: isReward ? 'hype' : 'love', duration: 4000 });
WidgetCore.sendAction('ALERTS_EVENT', {
source: SOURCE, id: data.id, type: data.type, user: data.user,
message: data.message, value: data.value, origin: data.origin, ts: Date.now()
});
this.report();
this.debug();

this._outTimer = setTimeout(() => {
this._outTimer = null;
if (!this.container) return;
this.container.classList.remove('alert-in');
this.container.classList.add('alert-out');
this._endTimer = setTimeout(() => {
this._endTimer = null;
if (this.container) {
this.container.classList.add('hidden');
this.container.classList.remove('alert-out');
this.container.innerHTML = '';
}
this.current = null;
this.isPlaying = false;
this.playNext();
}, OUT_MS);
}, this.config.duration * 1000);
},

skip() {
if (!this.isPlaying && !this.current) return false;
this._clearTimers();
if (this.container) {
this.container.classList.add('hidden');
this.container.classList.remove('alert-in', 'alert-out');
this.container.innerHTML = '';
}
this.current = null;
this.isPlaying = false;
this.playNext();
return true;
},

clearQueue() {
const n = this.queue.length;
this.queue = [];
console.log(`[Alerts] Очередь очищена: ${n}`);
this.report();
return n;
},

playSound(type) {
if (!this.config.soundEnabled || this.config.volume <= 0) return;
if (document.hidden) return;
const now = Date.now();
if (now - this._lastSoundAt < 100) return;
this._lastSoundAt = now;
const meta = typeOf(type);
const path = `../../data/sounds/${meta ? meta.sound : 'sub.mp3'}`;
try {
const audio = new Audio(path);
audio.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, this.config.volume / 100));
audio.onerror = () => console.warn('[Alerts] Нет файла звука:', path);
audio.onended = () => { audio.src = ''; };
audio.play().catch(e => console.warn('[Alerts] Звук не проигрался:', e && e.message));
} catch (e) { console.warn('[Alerts] Audio не создан:', e); }
},

report(force) {
const now = Date.now();
if (!force && now - this._lastReport < 300) {
if (this._reportTimer) return;
this._reportTimer = setTimeout(() => { this._reportTimer = null; this.report(true); }, 320);
return;
}
this._lastReport = now;
WidgetCore.sendAction('ALERTS_STATE', {
source: SOURCE,
enabled: this.config.enabled,
soundEnabled: this.config.soundEnabled,
volume: this.config.volume,
duration: this.config.duration,
scale: this.config.scale,
position: this.config.position,
playing: this.isPlaying,
queue: this.queue.length,
current: this.current ? { type: this.current.type, user: this.current.user } : null,
shown: this.shown,
dropped: this.dropped,
master: WidgetCore.isMaster,
channel: WidgetCore.currentChannel || null,
lastEventAt: this.lastEventAt,
ts: now
});
this.debug();
},

handleAction(action, payload = {}) {
if (action === 'ALERTS_REQUEST_STATE') { this.report(true); return; }
if (action === 'ALERTS_SKIP') { this.skip(); return; }
if (action === 'ALERTS_CLEAR') { this.clearQueue(); return; }
if (action === 'TEST_ALERT' || action === 'ALERTS_EMIT') {
const target = String(payload.target || 'all').toLowerCase();
if (target !== 'all' && target !== SOURCE) return;
this.add(payload.user, payload.type, payload.message, payload.value, 'test', payload.emitId || null);
return;
}
if (action === 'TWITCH_EVENT') {
this.add(payload.user, payload.kind, payload.message, payload.value, 'live', payload.eventId || null);
}
},

handleEvent(kind, payload = {}) {
this.add(payload.user, kind, payload.message, payload.value, 'live', payload.eventId || null);
},

handleChat(cmd, args) {
if (!WidgetCore.isMaster) return;
if (cmd === '!alert') {
const t = typeByChat(args[0]);
if (!t) return;
this.add('ТестИзЧата', t.id, '', t.id === 'resub' ? 12 : (t.id === 'cheer' ? 100 : 0), 'chat');
return;
}
const conf = { ...(WidgetCore.globalConfig?.widgets?.alerts || {}) };
if (cmd === '!alerts') {
const a = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
const cur = conf.enabled === undefined ? true : isTrue(conf.enabled);
conf.enabled = a === 'on' ? true : (a === 'off' ? false : !cur);
WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('alerts', conf);
return;
}
if (cmd === '!alertvol') {
const v = clampInt(args[0], 0, 100, NaN);
if (!isNaN(v)) WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('alerts', { volume: v });
return;
}
if (cmd === '!alertdur') {
const v = clampInt(args[0], 1, 30, NaN);
if (!isNaN(v)) WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('alerts', { duration: v });
}
}
};

Dbg.init();

window.addEventListener('error', (e) => {
console.error('[Alerts] Необработанная ошибка:', e.message);
Dbg.set('ОШИБКА: ' + e.message);
});
window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (e) => {
console.error('[Alerts] Отклонённый промис:', e.reason);
});

if (!AppAlerts.container) {
console.error('[Alerts] В DOM нет #alert-container — проверь widgets/alerts/index.html');
Dbg.set('НЕТ КОНТЕЙНЕРА');
} else {
WidgetCore.init({
widgetId: 'alerts',
source: SOURCE,
onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
if (config?.widgets?.alerts) AppAlerts.applyConfig(config.widgets.alerts);
},
onSocketOpen: () => AppAlerts.report(true),
onTwitchEvent: (kind, payload) => AppAlerts.handleEvent(kind, payload),
onWidgetAction: (action, payload) => AppAlerts.handleAction(action, payload),
onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => AppAlerts.handleChat(cmd, args)
});
setInterval(() => AppAlerts.report(true), HEARTBEAT_MS);
setTimeout(() => AppAlerts.report(true), 500);
setTimeout(() => AppAlerts.report(true), 2500);
if (DEBUG) setTimeout(() => AppAlerts.add('DebugUser', 'sub', 'Виджет жив и рендерит', 0, 'test'), 900);
console.log(`[Alerts] v4.1 запущен (${SOURCE}). Каталог встроен, внешних зависимостей нет.`);
}

export const LIVE_EVENTS = [

{ kind: 'gift', label: 'Подарки сабов', note: 'включая массовые раздачи' },

{ kind: 'raid', label: 'Рейды', note: 'с числом зрителей' }

export function isTrue(v) { return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }

export function clampInt(value, min, max, fallback) {
const n = parseInt(value, 10);
if (isNaN(n)) return fallback;
return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));
}

export function esc(s) {
return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

export function getType(id) {
return ALERT_TYPES.find(t => t.id === String(id || '').toLowerCase()) || null;
}

export function typeIds() { return ALERT_TYPES.map(t => t.id); }

export function soundFile(id) {
const t = getType(id);
return t ? t.sound : 'follow.mp3';
}

export function phraseFor(type, value, user) {
if (!type || !type.phrase) return '';
const n = Math.max(0, parseInt(value, 10) || 0);
if (type.phraseMany && n > 1) return `${n} ${type.phraseMany}`;
return type.phrase.replace('{value}', String(n));
}

export function chatArgToType(arg) {
const a = String(arg || '').toLowerCase();
if (!a) return null;
const direct = getType(a);
if (direct) return direct.id;
const byChat = ALERT_TYPES.find(t => t.chat === a);
return byChat ? byChat.id : null;
}

export function normalizeAlertConfig(raw) {
const c = { ...ALERT_DEFAULTS, ...(raw || {}) };
const n = (k) => clampInt(c[k], ALERT_LIMITS[k][0], ALERT_LIMITS[k][1], ALERT_DEFAULTS[k]);
const pos = POSITIONS.some(p => p.id === String(c.position)) ? String(c.position) : ALERT_DEFAULTS.position;
return {
enabled: c.enabled === undefined ? ALERT_DEFAULTS.enabled : isTrue(c.enabled),
soundEnabled: c.soundEnabled === undefined ? ALERT_DEFAULTS.soundEnabled : isTrue(c.soundEnabled),
volume: n('volume'),
duration: n('duration'),
scale: n('scale'),
position: pos
};
}

export function isTrue(v) { return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }
export function clampInt(v, min, max, fb) { const n = parseInt(v, 10); return isNaN(n) ? fb : Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n)); }
export function getType(id) { return ALERT_TYPES.find(t => t.id === String(id || '').toLowerCase()) || null; }
export const typeIcon = (t) => (t && t.icon ? ic(t.icon) : `<span class="ad-type-emoji">${esc((t && t.emoji) || '🔔')}</span>`);

export function normalizeAlertConfig(raw) {
const c = { ...ALERT_DEFAULTS, ...(raw || {}) };
const n = (k) => clampInt(c[k], ALERT_LIMITS[k][0], ALERT_LIMITS[k][1], ALERT_DEFAULTS[k]);
return {
enabled: c.enabled === undefined ? ALERT_DEFAULTS.enabled : isTrue(c.enabled),
soundEnabled: c.soundEnabled === undefined ? ALERT_DEFAULTS.soundEnabled : isTrue(c.soundEnabled),
volume: n('volume'), duration: n('duration'), scale: n('scale'),
position: POSITIONS.some(p => p.id === String(c.position)) ? String(c.position) : ALERT_DEFAULTS.position
};
}

export function setText(id, value) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
const next = String(value);
if (el && el.textContent !== next) el.textContent = next;
}
export function val(id, fb = '') { const el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : fb; }
export function paintRange(input) {
if (!input) return;
const min = Number(input.min || 0);
const max = Number(input.max || 100);
const value = Number(input.value);
const pct = max > min ? ((value - min) / (max - min)) * 100 : 0;
input.style.setProperty('--range-fill', `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct)).toFixed(2)}%`);
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/alerts/dashboard/Dashboard.js — v3.1 (честная диагностика: живая телеметрия важнее реестра, без ложных тревог) */
import { store } from '../../../js/store.js';
import { Toast } from '../../../js/components/toast.js';
import { renderTemplate } from './template.js';
import { StageController } from './stage.js';
import { LabPanel } from './labPanel.js';

CSS_FILES, CSS_TIMEOUT, LIVE_TTL, normalizeAlertConfig, getType,
ic, esc, typeIcon, setText, alertsOf
} from './constants.js';

export default { render: renderTemplate, preload, mount, onParamsChange, unmount };

const RELOAD_GRACE_MS = 9000;
const ROSTER_POLL_MS = 5000;

let ctx = null;
let cssPromise = null;

function loadOneCss({ id, href }) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const existing = document.getElementById(id);
if (existing) {
if (existing.dataset.loaded === '1') { resolve(true); return; }
existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(true), { once: true });
existing.addEventListener('error', () => resolve(false), { once: true });
return;
}
const link = document.createElement('link');
link.id = id;
link.rel = 'stylesheet';
link.href = href;
link.dataset.loaded = '0';
link.onload = () => { link.dataset.loaded = '1'; resolve(true); };
link.onerror = () => { console.error('[AlertsDash:css] не загрузился:', href); link.remove(); resolve(false); };
document.head.appendChild(link);
});
}

function preload() {
if (cssPromise) return cssPromise;
const t0 = performance.now();
const all = Promise.all(CSS_FILES.map(loadOneCss)).then((r) => {
const ok = r.every(Boolean);
if (ok) console.log(`[AlertsDash:css] стили готовы за ${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}мс`);
else console.warn('[AlertsDash:css] часть стилей недоступна');
return ok;
});
let timer = null;
const guard = new Promise((resolve) => { timer = setTimeout(() => { console.warn('[AlertsDash:css] таймаут'); resolve(false); }, CSS_TIMEOUT); });
cssPromise = Promise.race([all, guard]).then((ok) => {
if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
if (!ok) cssPromise = null;
return ok;
});
return cssPromise;
}

function pickLive() {
if (!ctx) return null;
const now = Date.now();
const { obs, preview } = ctx.live;
if (obs && now - obs.ts < LIVE_TTL) return obs;
if (preview && now - preview.ts < LIVE_TTL) return preview;
return null;
}
function setBadge(id, cls, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (!el) return;
el.className = `ad-badge ${cls}`;
el.innerHTML = `<span class="ad-badge-dot"></span>${text}`;
}
function obsWidgets() {
if (!ctx) return [];
return ctx.roster.filter(w => w.source === 'obs');
}
function hasObsAlerts() { return obsWidgets().some(w => w.widget === 'alerts'); }
function obsStateFresh() { return Boolean(ctx && ctx.live.obs && Date.now() - ctx.live.obs.ts < LIVE_TTL); }
function inGrace() { return Boolean(ctx && Date.now() < ctx.busyUntil); }

function renderRoster(state) {
const el = document.getElementById('ad-roster');
if (!el) return;
const obs = obsWidgets();
const sig = `${state.serverOnline}|${obs.map(w => w.widget + (w.master ? '*' : '')).join(',')}`;
if (sig === ctx._rosterSig) return;
ctx._rosterSig = sig;
if (!obs.length) {
const text = !state.serverOnline
? 'Нет связи с сервером лаунчера.'
: (inGrace() ? 'Перезапускаю источник — список обновится через пару секунд…' : 'Получаю список виджетов из OBS…');
el.innerHTML = `<span class="ad-roster-empty">${esc(text)}</span>`;
return;
}
const html = obs.map(w => `
<span class="ad-roster-chip ${w.widget === 'alerts' ? 'is-alerts' : ''}">${esc(w.widget)}${w.master ? '<em>master</em>' : ''}</span>`).join('');
el.innerHTML = `<span class="ad-roster-label">В OBS сейчас:</span>${html}`;
}

function renderDiag(state) {
const el = document.getElementById('ad-diag');
if (!el) return;
const online = state.serverOnline;
const fresh = obsStateFresh();
const listed = hasObsAlerts();
const total = obsWidgets().length;
let text, level = 'ok';

if (!online) {
text = 'Сервер лаунчера недоступен. Запустите лаунчер через npm start — сервер поднимается вместе с ним.';
level = 'error';
} else if (fresh) {
// Живая телеметрия — главный аргумент. Реестр может отставать, это не поломка.
const ch = ctx.live.obs.channel ? `#${ctx.live.obs.channel}` : 'канал не задан';
text = ctx.live.obs.master
? `OBS-виджет на связи (${ch}), мастер. Подписки, ресабы, подарки, биты и рейды показываются автоматически.`
: `OBS-виджет на связи (${ch}). Мастером стал другой виджет — это нормально: события канала приходят по шине всем.`;
} else if (inGrace()) {
text = 'Перезапускаю источник в OBS. Первый пакет состояния придёт в течение 5 секунд.';
} else if (listed) {
text = 'Источник alerts в OBS подключён, ждём первый пакет состояния (до 5 секунд). Если статус не меняется — откройте http://localhost:42069/alerts/index.html?debug=1 и посмотрите индикатор внизу слева.';
level = 'warn';
} else if (total === 0) {
text = 'Реестр виджетов ещё не получен. Откройте OBS со сценами пака; если сцены не созданы — «Авто-настройка OBS» на Дашборде.';
level = 'warn';
} else {
text = `В OBS живут ${total} виджетов, но «alerts» среди них нет. Нажмите «Починить источник» — он создаст источник, добавит на все сцены, поднимет наверх и включит видимость.`;
level = 'error';
}
if (el.textContent !== text) el.textContent = text;
el.classList.toggle('is-error', level === 'error');
el.classList.toggle('is-warn', level === 'warn');
}

function renderStatus(state, live) {
const c = normalizeAlertConfig(alertsOf(state));
const online = Boolean(state.serverOnline);
const queue = live ? live.queue : 0;
const obsLive = obsStateFresh();
setBadge('ad-badge-server', online ? 'ad-badge-live' : 'ad-badge-off', online ? 'СЕРВЕР ONLINE' : 'СЕРВЕР OFFLINE');
setBadge('ad-badge-state', c.enabled ? 'ad-badge-live' : 'ad-badge-warn', c.enabled ? 'НА ЭКРАНЕ' : 'ВЫКЛЮЧЕНЫ');
setBadge('ad-badge-source',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'ad-badge-live' : 'ad-badge-info') : 'ad-badge-off',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ OBS' : 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ ПРЕВЬЮ') : 'НЕТ СИГНАЛА');
setBadge('ad-badge-queue', queue > 0 ? 'ad-badge-warn' : 'ad-badge-info', `ОЧЕРЕДЬ ${queue}`);

const current = live && live.current ? live.current : null;
const meta = current ? getType(current.type) : null;
const iconEl = document.getElementById('ad-now-ic');
if (iconEl) {
const key = meta ? meta.id : 'idle';
if (iconEl.dataset.key !== key) {
iconEl.dataset.key = key;
iconEl.innerHTML = meta ? typeIcon(meta) : ic('target');
}
iconEl.style.setProperty('--now-accent', meta ? meta.color : 'var(--ad-ink-3)');
}
setText('ad-now-title', current ? `${meta ? meta.label : current.type} · ${current.user}` : (c.enabled ? 'Ничего не показывается' : 'Оповещения выключены'));
setText('ad-now-meta', current ? (queue > 0 ? `В очереди ещё ${queue}` : 'Очередь пуста') : (c.enabled ? 'Отправьте тест из лаборатории ниже' : 'Включите мастер-тумблер'));
setText('ad-now-source', live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'OBS STUDIO' : 'ПРЕВЬЮ') : 'НЕТ СИГНАЛА');

const now = document.getElementById('ad-now');
if (now) {
now.classList.toggle('is-off', !c.enabled);
now.style.setProperty('--now-accent', meta ? meta.color : 'var(--ad-line-2)');
}
const skip = document.getElementById('ad-skip');
if (skip) skip.disabled = !current;
const clear = document.getElementById('ad-clear-queue');
if (clear) clear.disabled = queue <= 0;
['ad-obs-refresh', 'ad-obs-fix'].forEach(id => {
const b = document.getElementById(id);
if (b && !b.classList.contains('is-spin')) b.disabled = !online;
});
const fix = document.getElementById('ad-obs-fix');
if (fix) fix.classList.toggle('ad-btn-primary', !obsLive && !inGrace());
}

function evaluate() {
if (!ctx) return;
try {
const state = store.getState();
const live = pickLive();
renderDiag(state);
renderRoster(state);
renderStatus(state, live);
ctx.stage.evaluate(state, live);
ctx.settings.render(state);
ctx.lab.render(state, live);
} catch (e) { console.error('[AlertsDash] evaluate провален:', e); }
}

function requestRoster() { store.broadcastAction('WIDGET_ROSTER_REQUEST', {}); }

function onClick(e) {
if (!ctx) return;
const btn = e.target.closest('[data-ad-act]');
if (!btn || btn.disabled) return;
const act = btn.getAttribute('data-ad-act');
const arg = btn.getAttribute('data-arg');
e.preventDefault();
switch (act) {
case 'refresh':
btn.classList.add('is-spin');
setTimeout(() => { if (btn.isConnected) btn.classList.remove('is-spin'); }, 900);
ctx.stage.refresh();
ctx.toast.info('Превью перезапущено.');
return;
case 'obs-refresh':
if (!store.getState().serverOnline) { ctx.toast.error('Нет связи с сервером лаунчера.'); return; }
ctx.busyUntil = Date.now() + RELOAD_GRACE_MS;
ctx._rosterSig = '';
btn.classList.add('is-spin');
setTimeout(() => { if (btn.isConnected) btn.classList.remove('is-spin'); }, 1200);
store.broadcastAction('SCENES_REFRESH', { widgets: ['alerts'], origin: 'alerts-dash' });
ctx.toast.info('Перезагружаю источник в OBS…');
evaluate();
return;
case 'obs-fix':
if (!store.getState().serverOnline) { ctx.toast.error('Нет связи с сервером лаунчера.'); return; }
ctx.busyUntil = Date.now() + RELOAD_GRACE_MS;
ctx._rosterSig = '';
btn.classList.add('is-spin');
setTimeout(() => { if (btn.isConnected) btn.classList.remove('is-spin'); }, 1600);
store.broadcastAction('SCENES_ENSURE', { id: 'alerts', origin: 'alerts-dash' });
ctx.toast.info('Проверяю и чиню источник оповещений в OBS…');
evaluate();
return;
case 'show': ctx.settings._set({ enabled: true }); ctx.toast.success('Оповещения снова на экране.'); return;
case 'skip': store.broadcastAction('ALERTS_SKIP', {}); ctx.toast.info('Текущее оповещение пропущено.'); return;
case 'clear-queue': store.broadcastAction('ALERTS_CLEAR', {}); ctx.toast.info('Очередь очищена.'); return;
case 'type': ctx.lab.pickType(arg); return;
case 'target': ctx.lab.setTarget(arg); return;
case 'preset': ctx.lab.applyPreset(arg); return;
case 'send': ctx.lab.send(); return;
case 'send-obs': ctx.lab.sendObs(); return;
case 'storm': ctx.lab.storm(); return;
case 'pos': ctx.settings.setPosition(arg); return;
case 'reset': ctx.settings.reset(); return;
case 'copy': ctx.settings.copyChip(btn, arg || ''); return;
case 'log-pause':
case 'log-clear': ctx.log.handleAction(act); return;
default: return;
}
}

function mount(params, state) {
const root = document.getElementById('ad-main');
if (!root) return;
unmount();
preload();
const toast = new Toast(document.getElementById('ad-toasts'), { className: 'ad-toast' });
ctx = {
root, toast,
stage: new StageController({ root, store, toast }),
lab: new LabPanel({ root, store, toast }),
settings: new SettingsPanel({ root, store, toast }),
log: new LogPanel({ root, toast }),
live: { obs: null, preview: null },
roster: [],
seen: new Set(),
busyUntil: 0,
_rosterSig: '',
_lastRosterPoll: 0,
unsub: null, unsubAction: null, tick: null, handlers: {}
};
ctx.stage.mount();
ctx.lab.mount();
ctx.settings.mount();
ctx.log.mount();
ctx.handlers.click = (e) => onClick(e);
ctx.handlers.input = (e) => ctx.settings.onInput(e);
ctx.handlers.change = (e) => ctx.settings.onChange(e);
ctx.handlers.key = (e) => ctx.lab.onKey(e);
root.addEventListener('click', ctx.handlers.click);
root.addEventListener('input', ctx.handlers.input);
root.addEventListener('change', ctx.handlers.change);
root.addEventListener('keydown', ctx.handlers.key);
ctx.unsub = store.subscribe(() => evaluate());
ctx.unsubAction = store.onAction((action, payload) => {
if (!ctx) return;
if (action === 'WIDGET_ROSTER') {
ctx.roster = Array.isArray(payload && payload.widgets) ? payload.widgets : [];
evaluate();
return;
}
if (action === 'SCENES_REFRESH_RESULT' || action === 'SCENES_ENSURE_RESULT') {
const p = payload || {};
ctx.busyUntil = Date.now() + 6000;
ctx._rosterSig = '';
ctx.toast.show(p.message || 'Готово', p.ok ? 'success' : 'error');
setTimeout(() => {
if (!ctx) return;
store.broadcastAction('ALERTS_REQUEST_STATE', {});
requestRoster();
}, 1400);
evaluate();
return;
}
if (!payload) return;
if (action === 'ALERTS_STATE') {
const source = payload.source === 'obs' ? 'obs' : 'preview';
ctx.live[source] = {
source,
enabled: payload.enabled !== false,
soundEnabled: payload.soundEnabled !== false,
queue: Number(payload.queue ?? 0),
playing: Boolean(payload.playing),
current: payload.current || null,
shown: Number(payload.shown ?? 0),
master: Boolean(payload.master),
channel: payload.channel || null,
ts: Number(payload.ts || Date.now())
};
if (source === 'obs') ctx.busyUntil = 0;
evaluate();
return;
}
if (action === 'ALERTS_EVENT') {
const key = `${payload.source}:${payload.id}`;
if (ctx.seen.has(key)) return;
ctx.seen.add(key);
if (ctx.seen.size > 500) ctx.seen.clear();
const obsFresh = obsStateFresh();
if (payload.source === 'preview' && obsFresh) return;
ctx.log.push(payload);
evaluate();
}
});
ctx.tick = setInterval(() => {
evaluate();
const now = Date.now();
if (now - ctx._lastRosterPoll >= ROSTER_POLL_MS) {
ctx._lastRosterPoll = now;
requestRoster();
}
}, 2000);
evaluate();
store.broadcastAction('ALERTS_REQUEST_STATE', {});
requestRoster();
ctx._lastRosterPoll = Date.now();
console.log('[AlertsDash] v3.1 смонтирован', params);
}

function onParamsChange(params) {
if (!ctx) return false;
return (params?.id || 'player') === 'alerts';
}

function unmount() {
if (!ctx) return;
console.log('[AlertsDash] Размонтирование');
if (ctx.unsub) ctx.unsub();
if (ctx.unsubAction) ctx.unsubAction();
if (ctx.tick) clearInterval(ctx.tick);
if (ctx.root && ctx.handlers) {
ctx.root.removeEventListener('click', ctx.handlers.click);
ctx.root.removeEventListener('input', ctx.handlers.input);
ctx.root.removeEventListener('change', ctx.handlers.change);
ctx.root.removeEventListener('keydown', ctx.handlers.key);
}
ctx.log.unmount();
ctx.settings.unmount();
ctx.lab.unmount();
ctx.stage.unmount();
ctx = null;
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#ad-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/alerts/dashboard/labPanel.js — v3 (импорты из constants, отправка через серверный ALERTS_EMIT) */
import { getType, ALERT_TYPES, PRESETS, STORM, STORM_GAP, TARGETS, val, setText } from './constants.js';

export class LabPanel {
constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
this.root = root;
this.store = store;
this.toast = toast;
this.typeId = (ALERT_TYPES[1] || ALERT_TYPES[0]).id;
this.target = 'preview';
this.stormTimer = null;
this._mounted = false;
}
mount() { this._mounted = true; this._syncType(true); console.log('[AlertsDash:lab] смонтирован'); }
unmount() {
this._mounted = false;
if (this.stormTimer) { clearTimeout(this.stormTimer); this.stormTimer = null; }
}
_type() { return getType(this.typeId) || ALERT_TYPES[0]; }
pickType(id) { const t = getType(id); if (!t) return; this.typeId = t.id; this._syncType(true); }
applyPreset(id) {
const p = PRESETS.find(x => x.id === id);
if (!p) return;
this.typeId = p.type;
this._syncType(false);
const put = (elId, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(elId); if (el) el.value = v; };
put('ad-lab-user', p.user);
put('ad-lab-message', p.message);
put('ad-lab-value', p.value);
this.send();
}
setTarget(id) {
if (!TARGETS.some(t => t.id === id)) return;
this.target = id;
this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-ad-act="target"]').forEach(b => {
const on = b.getAttribute('data-arg') === id;
b.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
});
this.toast.info({
preview: '«Отправить» шлёт только в превью лаунчера.',
obs: '«Отправить» шлёт в OBS — на живой стрим.',
all: '«Отправить» шлёт и в превью, и в OBS.'
}[id]);
}
_syncType(fillSample) {
const t = this._type();
this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-ad-act="type"]').forEach(b => {
const on = b.getAttribute('data-arg') === t.id;
b.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
});
const vf = document.getElementById('ad-lab-value-field');
if (vf) vf.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !t.valueLabel);
setText('ad-lab-value-label', t.valueLabel || 'Значение');
if (fillSample) {
const u = document.getElementById('ad-lab-user');
const m = document.getElementById('ad-lab-message');
const v = document.getElementById('ad-lab-value');
if (u) u.value = t.sample.user;
if (m) m.value = t.sample.message;
if (v) v.value = String(t.sample.value || t.defaultValue || 0);
}
this._note();
}
_note(live) {
const t = this._type();
const note = document.getElementById('ad-lab-note');
if (!note) return;
const mute = live && live.soundEnabled === false ? ' Звук выключен в настройках.' : '';
const auto = t.live ? ' Приходит из чата автоматически.' : ' Только тест или !alert.';
const text = `Звук: data/sounds/${t.sound}.${auto} Enter — отправка.${mute}`;
if (note.textContent !== text) note.textContent = text;
}
build(target) {
const t = this._type();
return {
type: t.id,
user: val('ad-lab-user', t.sample.user).trim() || t.sample.user,
message: val('ad-lab-message', '').trim(),
value: Math.max(0, parseInt(val('ad-lab-value', '0'), 10) || 0),
target: target || this.target
};
}
_guard(target) {
const state = this.store.getState();
const c = state.config.widgets.alerts || {};
const enabled = c.enabled === undefined ? true : (c.enabled === true || String(c.enabled) === 'true');
if (!enabled) { this.toast.info('Сначала включите оповещения мастер-тумблером.'); return false; }
if (target !== 'preview' && !state.serverOnline) {
this.toast.error('Нет связи с сервером — тест в OBS не доставлен.');
return false;
}
return true;
}
send(forceTarget) {
const payload = this.build(forceTarget);
if (!this._guard(payload.target)) return;
// Через сервер: он проставит emitId и разошлёт всем экземплярам (дедуп на виджете).
if (payload.target === 'preview') this.store.broadcastAction('TEST_ALERT', payload);
else this.store.broadcastAction('ALERTS_EMIT', payload);
const t = this._type();
const where = { preview: 'в превью', obs: 'в OBS — на стрим', all: 'в превью и OBS' }[payload.target];
this.toast.success(`«${t.label}» отправлено ${where}.`);
}
sendObs() { this.send('obs'); }
storm() {
if (!this._guard(this.target)) return;
if (this.stormTimer) { clearTimeout(this.stormTimer); this.stormTimer = null; }
let i = 0;
const step = () => {
if (!this._mounted) return;
if (i >= STORM.length) { this.stormTimer = null; return; }
const body = { ...STORM[i], target: this.target };
if (this.target === 'preview') this.store.broadcastAction('TEST_ALERT', body);
else this.store.broadcastAction('ALERTS_EMIT', body);
i++;
this.stormTimer = setTimeout(step, STORM_GAP);
};
step();
this.toast.info('Шторм из 5 событий пошёл — проверьте очередь.');
}
onKey(e) {
if (!e.target || !e.target.id) return false;
if (!['ad-lab-user', 'ad-lab-message', 'ad-lab-value'].includes(e.target.id)) return false;
if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); this.send(); return true; }
return false;
}
render(state, live) {
if (!this._mounted) return;
const liveType = live && live.current ? getType(live.current.type) : null;
this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-ad-act="type"]').forEach(b => {
b.classList.toggle('is-live', Boolean(liveType) && b.getAttribute('data-arg') === liveType.id);
});
this._note(live);
}
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/alerts/dashboard/logPanel.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/alerts/dashboard/logPanel.js — v2 (импорты из constants) */
import { getType, ic, esc, typeIcon, setText, LOG_KEY, LOG_MAX, ARM_MS } from './constants.js';

function fmtTime(ts) {
try { return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }); }
catch (e) { return '--:--:--'; }
}

export class LogPanel {
constructor({ root, toast }) {
this.root = root;
this.toast = toast;
this.entries = [];
this.paused = false;
this.armed = false;
this.armTimer = null;
this._sig = '';
this._mounted = false;
}
mount() { this._mounted = true; this.load(); this.render(); console.log('[AlertsDash:log] смонтирован'); }
unmount() {
this._mounted = false;
if (this.armTimer) { clearTimeout(this.armTimer); this.armTimer = null; }
this.armed = false;
}
load() {
try {
const raw = localStorage.getItem(LOG_KEY);
if (!raw) return;
const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return;
this.entries = parsed.filter(e => e && typeof e.ts === 'number' && typeof e.type === 'string').slice(0, LOG_MAX);
console.log(`[AlertsDash:log] записей: ${this.entries.length}`);
} catch (e) { this.entries = []; }
}
save() {
try { localStorage.setItem(LOG_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.entries.slice(0, LOG_MAX))); }
catch (e) { console.warn('[AlertsDash:log] не сохранился:', e); }
}
push(payload) {
if (!this._mounted || this.paused || !payload) return;
this.entries.unshift({
ts: Number(payload.ts) || Date.now(),
source: payload.source === 'obs' ? 'obs' : 'preview',
type: String(payload.type || 'follow'),
user: String(payload.user || '—'),
message: String(payload.message || ''),
value: Number(payload.value) || 0
});
if (this.entries.length > LOG_MAX) this.entries.length = LOG_MAX;
this.save();
this.render();
}
_disarm() {
this.armed = false;
if (this.armTimer) { clearTimeout(this.armTimer); this.armTimer = null; }
const btn = document.getElementById('ad-log-clear');
if (btn) { btn.classList.remove('is-armed'); btn.innerHTML = ic('trash'); }
}
handleAction(act) {
if (act === 'log-pause') {
this.paused = !this.paused;
const btn = document.getElementById('ad-log-pause');
if (btn) { btn.classList.toggle('is-armed', this.paused); btn.innerHTML = this.paused ? ic('play') : ic('pause'); }
this.toast.info(this.paused ? 'Журнал на паузе.' : 'Журнал снова пишет.');
return true;
}
if (act === 'log-clear') {
if (this.entries.length === 0) { this.toast.info('Журнал уже пуст.'); return true; }
if (!this.armed) {
this.armed = true;
const btn = document.getElementById('ad-log-clear');
if (btn) { btn.classList.add('is-armed'); btn.innerHTML = ic('check'); }
this.toast.info('Очистка журнала — подтвердите повторным нажатием.');
if (this.armTimer) clearTimeout(this.armTimer);
this.armTimer = setTimeout(() => this._disarm(), ARM_MS);
return true;
}
this._disarm();
this.entries = [];
this._sig = '';
this.save();
this.render();
this.toast.success('Журнал очищен.');
return true;
}
return false;
}
stats() {
let subs = 0, rewards = 0, follows = 0;
this.entries.forEach(e => {
const t = getType(e.type);
if (!t) return;
if (t.kind === 'reward') rewards++;
else if (e.type === 'follow') follows++;
else subs++;
});
return { total: this.entries.length, subs, rewards, follows };
}
render() {
if (!this._mounted) return;
const s = this.stats();
setText('ad-stat-total', s.total);
setText('ad-stat-subs', s.subs);
setText('ad-stat-rewards', s.rewards);
setText('ad-stat-follows', s.follows);
setText('ad-log-count', this.entries.length);
const empty = document.getElementById('ad-log-empty');
if (empty) empty.classList.toggle('is-hidden', this.entries.length > 0);
const sig = `${this.entries.length}:${this.entries[0]?.ts || 0}`;
if (sig === this._sig) return;
this._sig = sig;
const list = document.getElementById('ad-log');
if (!list) return;
list.innerHTML = this.entries.map(e => {
const t = getType(e.type);
const color = t ? t.color : '#a1a1aa';
const label = t ? t.label : e.type;
const valueTag = e.value > 0 ? `<span class="ad-log-tag is-value">×${e.value}</span>` : '';
const kindTag = t && t.kind === 'reward' ? '<span class="ad-log-tag is-reward">баллы</span>' : '';
return `
<div class="ad-log-row" style="--row-color:${esc(color)}">
<span class="ad-log-time">${fmtTime(e.ts)}</span>
<span class="ad-log-ic">${t ? typeIcon(t) : ''}</span>
<span class="ad-log-body">
<span class="ad-log-user">${esc(e.user)}<em class="ad-log-src">${e.source === 'obs' ? 'OBS' : 'PREVIEW'}</em></span>
<span class="ad-log-text">${esc(e.message || label)}</span>
</span>
<span class="ad-log-tags">${valueTag}${kindTag}<span class="ad-log-tag">${esc(label)}</span></span>
</div>`;
}).join('');
const scroll = document.getElementById('ad-log-scroll');
if (scroll) scroll.scrollTop = 0;
}
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/alerts/dashboard/settingsPanel.js — v2 (импорты из constants) */
import { normalizeAlertConfig, ALERT_LIMITS, clampInt, POSITIONS, ic, paintRange, setText, alertsOf } from './constants.js';
import { copyText } from '../../../js/utils/clipboard.js';

export class SettingsPanel {
constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
this.root = root;
this.store = store;
this.toast = toast;
this.chipTimers = new Map();
}
mount() { console.log('[AlertsDash:settings] смонтирован'); }
unmount() {
for (const t of this.chipTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
this.chipTimers.clear();
}
_set(patch) {
try { this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { alerts: patch } }); return true; }
catch (e) {
console.error('[AlertsDash:settings] Не сохранилось:', e);
this.toast.error('Настройка не сохранилась.');
return false;
}
}
onInput(e) {
const t = e.target;
if (!t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-ad-key')) return false;
if (t.type !== 'range') return false;
const key = t.getAttribute('data-ad-key');
const [min, max] = ALERT_LIMITS[key] || [0, 100];
const value = clampInt(t.value, min, max, min);
paintRange(t);
setText(`${t.id}-val`, `${value}${key === 'duration' ? ' с' : '%'}`);
this._set({ [key]: value });
return true;
}
onChange(e) {
const t = e.target;
if (!t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-ad-key')) return false;
if (t.type !== 'checkbox') return false;
const key = t.getAttribute('data-ad-key');
this._set({ [key]: t.checked });
if (key === 'enabled') {
this.toast.show(t.checked ? 'Оповещения снова на экране.' : 'Оповещения выключены, очередь сброшена.', t.checked ? 'success' : 'info');
} else if (key === 'soundEnabled') {
this.toast.show(t.checked ? 'Звук включён.' : 'Звук выключен.', t.checked ? 'success' : 'info');
}
return true;
}
setPosition(id) {
if (!POSITIONS.some(p => p.id === id)) return;
this._set({ position: id });
this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-ad-act="pos"]').forEach(b => {
const on = b.getAttribute('data-arg') === id;
b.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
});
}
reset() {
this.store.resetWidgetToDefaults('alerts');
this.toast.success('Настройки оповещений сброшены.');
}
async copyChip(chip, text) {
const ok = await copyText(text);
if (!ok) { this.toast.error(`Не удалось скопировать. Команда: ${text}`); return; }
this.toast.success(`Скопировано: ${text}`);
const iconEl = chip.querySelector('.ad-chip-ic');
if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = ic('check');
chip.classList.add('is-copied');
const old = this.chipTimers.get(chip);
if (old) clearTimeout(old);
this.chipTimers.set(chip, setTimeout(() => {
this.chipTimers.delete(chip);
if (!chip.isConnected) return;
chip.classList.remove('is-copied');
const el = chip.querySelector('.ad-chip-ic');
if (el) el.innerHTML = ic('copy');
}, 1400));
}
render(state) {
const c = normalizeAlertConfig(alertsOf(state));
const master = document.getElementById('ad-master');
if (master && document.activeElement !== master && master.checked !== c.enabled) master.checked = c.enabled;
const sound = document.getElementById('ad-sound');
if (sound && document.activeElement !== sound && sound.checked !== c.soundEnabled) sound.checked = c.soundEnabled;
[['ad-volume', 'volume', '%'], ['ad-duration', 'duration', ' с'], ['ad-scale', 'scale', '%']].forEach(([id, key, unit]) => {
const input = document.getElementById(id);
if (input && document.activeElement !== input) {
if (input.value !== String(c[key])) input.value = String(c[key]);
paintRange(input);
}
setText(`${id}-val`, `${c[key]}${unit}`);
});
const volRow = document.getElementById('ad-volume-row');
if (volRow) volRow.classList.toggle('is-muted', !c.soundEnabled);
const vol = document.getElementById('ad-volume');
if (vol) vol.disabled = !c.soundEnabled;
this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-ad-act="pos"]').forEach(b => {
const on = b.getAttribute('data-arg') === c.position;
b.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
});
}
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/alerts/dashboard/stage.js — v2 (импорты из constants, стенд 1920×1080) */
import { normalizeAlertConfig, WIDGET_W, WIDGET_H, alertsOf, setText } from './constants.js';

export class StageController {
constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
this.root = root;
this.store = store;
this.toast = toast;
this.iframe = null;
this.loaded = false;
this.resizeObs = null;
this.loadTimer = null;
}
mount() {
const stage = document.getElementById('ad-stage');
this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.scale());
if (stage) this.resizeObs.observe(stage);
this.createIframe();
console.log('[AlertsDash:stage] смонтирован');
}
unmount() {
if (this.resizeObs) { this.resizeObs.disconnect(); this.resizeObs = null; }
this.destroyIframe();
}
refresh() { this.destroyIframe(); this.createIframe(); }
createIframe() {
if (this.iframe) return;
const host = document.getElementById('ad-frame-host');
if (!host) return;
this.loaded = false;
const loading = document.getElementById('ad-stage-loading');
if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');
const f = document.createElement('iframe');
f.id = 'ad-preview-iframe';
f.className = 'ad-iframe';
f.title = 'Превью виджета оповещений';
f.setAttribute('scrolling', 'no');
f.src = `widgets/alerts/index.html?preview=1&cb=${Date.now()}`;
f.onload = () => {
if (this.iframe !== f) return;
this.loaded = true;
const l = document.getElementById('ad-stage-loading');
if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
this.scale();
this.store.broadcastAction('ALERTS_REQUEST_STATE', {});
};
f.onerror = () => {
if (this.iframe !== f) return;
const l = document.getElementById('ad-stage-loading');
if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
this.toast.error('Не удалось загрузить превью виджета.');
};
host.appendChild(f);
this.iframe = f;
clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
this.loadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
if (!this.loaded) {
const l = document.getElementById('ad-stage-loading');
if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
}
}, 6000);
this.scale();
}
destroyIframe() {
clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
this.loadTimer = null;
if (this.iframe) {
const f = this.iframe;
this.iframe = null;
try { f.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (e) {}
f.remove();
}
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#ad-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
this.loaded = false;
}
scale() {
const stage = document.getElementById('ad-stage');
const inner = document.getElementById('ad-stage-inner');
if (!stage || !inner) return;
const w = stage.clientWidth;
const h = stage.clientHeight;
if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
const s = Math.min(w / WIDGET_W, h / WIDGET_H) * 0.97;
inner.style.width = `${WIDGET_W}px`;
inner.style.height = `${WIDGET_H}px`;
inner.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${s.toFixed(4)})`;
}
evaluate(state, live) {
const c = normalizeAlertConfig(alertsOf(state));
const stage = document.getElementById('ad-stage');
if (stage) stage.classList.toggle('is-off', !c.enabled);
const off = document.getElementById('ad-stage-off');
if (off) off.classList.toggle('is-hidden', c.enabled);
const loading = document.getElementById('ad-stage-loading');
if (loading && this.loaded) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');
const slot = document.getElementById('ad-slot');
if (slot && slot.dataset.pos !== c.position) slot.dataset.pos = c.position;
const queue = live ? live.queue : 0;
setText('ad-hud-queue', `ОЧЕРЕДЬ: ${queue}`);
const chip = document.getElementById('ad-hud-queue');
if (chip) chip.classList.toggle('is-warn', queue > 0);
this.scale();
}
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/alerts/dashboard/template.js — v3 (+ починка источника, реестр виджетов OBS) */
import {
ic, esc, typeIcon, normalizeAlertConfig, ALERT_LIMITS, ALERT_TYPES, POSITIONS,
LIVE_EVENTS, TARGETS, PRESETS, COMMANDS, alertsOf
} from './constants.js';

function slider(id, key, label, value, unit) {
const [min, max] = ALERT_LIMITS[key];
const fill = max > min ? ((value - min) / (max - min)) * 100 : 0;
return `
<div class="ad-slider" id="${id}-row">
<span class="ad-slider-name">${esc(label)}</span>
<input type="range" id="${id}" data-ad-key="${key}" min="${min}" max="${max}" step="1" value="${value}" style="--range-fill:${fill.toFixed(2)}%;" aria-label="${esc(label)}">
<span class="ad-slider-val" id="${id}-val">${value}${unit}</span>
</div>`;
}

export function renderTemplate(state) {
const c = normalizeAlertConfig(alertsOf(state));
const first = ALERT_TYPES[1] || ALERT_TYPES[0];
const types = ALERT_TYPES.map(t => `
<button class="ad-type ${t.id === first.id ? 'is-active' : ''}" type="button" data-ad-act="type" data-arg="${t.id}" style="--type-accent:${t.color}" title="${esc(t.label)} · звук ${esc(t.sound)}${t.live ? ' · приходит из чата автоматически' : ''}">
<span class="ad-type-ic">${typeIcon(t)}</span>
<span class="ad-type-label">${esc(t.label)}</span>
</button>`).join('');
const targets = TARGETS.map(t => `
<button class="ad-seg-btn ${t.id === 'preview' ? 'is-active' : ''}" type="button" data-ad-act="target" data-arg="${t.id}" aria-pressed="${t.id === 'preview'}" title="${esc(t.title)}">${esc(t.label)}</button>`).join('');
const positions = POSITIONS.map(p => `
<button class="ad-seg-btn ${p.id === c.position ? 'is-active' : ''}" type="button" data-ad-act="pos" data-arg="${p.id}" aria-pressed="${p.id === c.position}">${esc(p.label)}</button>`).join('');
const presets = PRESETS.map(p => `<button class="ad-preset" type="button" data-ad-act="preset" data-arg="${p.id}">${esc(p.label)}</button>`).join('');
const chips = COMMANDS.map(i => `
<button class="ad-chip" type="button" data-ad-act="copy" data-arg="${esc(i.copy)}" title="${esc(i.title)}">
<span class="ad-chip-ic">${ic('copy')}</span><code>${esc(i.cmd)}</code>
</button>`).join('');
const liveRows = LIVE_EVENTS.map(e => `<li><b>${esc(e.label)}</b> — ${esc(e.note)}</li>`).join('');

return `
<div class="ad-main" id="ad-main">
<section class="ad-card card">
<header class="ad-head">
<div class="ad-head-left">
<h3 class="ad-title">${ic('target')} Оповещения</h3>
<span class="ad-badge" id="ad-badge-server">СЕРВЕР</span>
<span class="ad-badge" id="ad-badge-state">НА ЭКРАНЕ</span>
<span class="ad-badge" id="ad-badge-source">СИГНАЛ</span>
<span class="ad-badge" id="ad-badge-queue">ОЧЕРЕДЬ 0</span>
</div>
<div class="ad-head-right">
<label class="ad-toggle ad-toggle-head" title="Мастер-выключатель: выключенные оповещения не показываются и не копятся">
<span>АЛЕРТЫ ВКЛ.</span>
<input type="checkbox" id="ad-master" data-ad-key="enabled" ${c.enabled ? 'checked' : ''}>
<div class="ad-track"></div>
</label>
<button class="ad-btn ad-btn-primary ad-btn-sm" type="button" data-ad-act="obs-fix" id="ad-obs-fix" title="Создать источник в OBS, добавить на все сцены, поднять наверх, включить видимость и сбросить кэш">${ic('plus')} Починить источник</button>
<button class="ad-btn ad-btn-ghost ad-btn-sm" type="button" data-ad-act="obs-refresh" id="ad-obs-refresh" title="Только перезагрузить кэш источника в OBS">${ic('sync')} Перезагрузить</button>
<button class="ad-icon-btn" type="button" data-ad-act="refresh" title="Перезапустить превью виджета" aria-label="Перезапустить превью">${ic('sync')}</button>
