--- START OF FILE widgets/chat/runtime/bubbleRenderer.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/chat/runtime/bubbleRenderer.js — v3 (фикс запуска загрузки + image-proxy для страниц расширений) */
import { AvatarManager } from '../../shared/AvatarManager.js';
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { rgbString, shiftHue } from '../config.js';
import { getSkin, resolvePersonal, ensureSkinCss, DEFAULT_SKIN } from '../skins.js';
import { esc, BADGE_DEFS } from './messageSource.js';

const effectCleanups = new WeakMap();
const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');

const PROXY_BASE = (() => {
	try {
		if (window.location.protocol === 'http:' || window.location.protocol === 'https:') {
			return `${window.location.protocol}//${window.location.host}/api/imgproxy`;
		}
	} catch (e) {}
	return 'http://localhost:42069/api/imgproxy';
})();
const proxyUrl = (u) => `${PROXY_BASE}?url=${encodeURIComponent(u)}`;

/** Безопасные HTML-фрагменты для шаблонов (custom-скины собирают из них свою структуру). */
export function buildBubbleParts(meta) {
	const flagLabel = meta.kind === 'first' ? 'ПЕРВОЕ СООБЩЕНИЕ'
		: meta.kind === 'highlight' ? 'ВЫДЕЛЕННОЕ СООБЩЕНИЕ'
		: meta.kind === 'system' ? 'СИСТЕМА' : '';
	const flag = flagLabel
		? `<div class="chat-flag"><span class="chat-flag-dot"></span><span class="chat-flag-text">${flagLabel}</span></div>`
		: '';
	const reply = meta.reply ? `
<div class="chat-reply" style="--reply-color:${esc(meta.reply.color)};--reply-rgb:${rgbString(meta.reply.color)}">
	<span class="chat-reply-bar"></span><span class="chat-reply-avatar"></span>
	<span class="chat-reply-name"></span><span class="chat-reply-text"></span>
</div>` : '';
	const badges = BADGE_DEFS
		.filter(b => meta.badges && meta.badges[b.key])
		.map(b => `<span class="chat-badge" data-b="${b.id}" title="${b.title}">${b.label}</span>`)
		.join('');
	const images = Array.isArray(meta.images) ? meta.images : [];
	const media = images.length ? `
<div class="chat-media">${images.map((im, i) => `
	<figure class="chat-img-box" data-state="loading" data-idx="${i}">
		<img class="chat-img" alt="Фото из чата" decoding="async">
		<span class="chat-img-skeleton"></span>
		<span class="chat-img-fallback">
			<span class="chat-img-fallback-ic">${ic('noSignal')}</span>
			<span class="chat-img-fallback-text">Фото не загрузилось</span>
			<span class="chat-img-fallback-host">${esc(im.host)}</span>
		</span>
		<span class="chat-img-host">${esc(im.host)}</span>
	</figure>`).join('')}
</div>` : '';
	return { flag, reply, badges, media };
}

/** Стандартный скелет бабла (используется и как fallback для сломанных custom-шаблонов). */
export function defaultBubbleTemplate(meta, parts) {
	const textBlock = meta.html
		? `<div class="chat-text"><span class="chat-text-inner">${meta.html}</span></div>`
		: '';
	return `
<div class="chat-inner">
	${parts.flag}${parts.reply}
	<header class="chat-head">
		<span class="chat-avatar-slot"><span class="chat-avatar"></span><span class="chat-avatar-ring"></span></span>
		<span class="chat-identity"><span class="chat-user"></span><span class="chat-badges">${parts.badges}</span></span>
		<time class="chat-time">${esc(meta.time)}</time>
	</header>
	${textBlock}
	${parts.media}
</div>`;
}

function resolveFor(meta, config) {
	const personal = resolvePersonal(config, meta.user);
	const descriptor = getSkin((personal && personal.skin) || config.skin);
	return { descriptor, personal };
}

function fillTexts(el, meta) {
	const userEl = el.querySelector('.chat-user');
	if (userEl) userEl.textContent = meta.user;
	const timeEl = el.querySelector('.chat-time');
	if (timeEl && !timeEl.textContent) timeEl.textContent = meta.time;
	if (meta.reply) {
		const rn = el.querySelector('.chat-reply-name');
		const rt = el.querySelector('.chat-reply-text');
		if (rn) rn.textContent = meta.reply.user;
		if (rt) rt.textContent = meta.reply.text;
	}
}

function wireAvatars(el, meta) {
	const av = el.querySelector('.chat-avatar');
	if (av) {
		const initials = String(meta.user || '?').replace(/[^a-zA-Zа-яА-Я0-9]/g, '').substring(0, 2) || '?';
		av.style.setProperty('--avatar-initials', `"${initials}"`);
		AvatarManager.get(meta.user, meta.color).then(url => {
			if (!av.isConnected || !url) return;
			av.style.setProperty('--avatar-img', `url("${url}")`);
			av.classList.add('is-ready');
		}).catch(() => {});
	}
	if (meta.reply) {
		const ra = el.querySelector('.chat-reply-avatar');
		if (ra) {
			AvatarManager.get(meta.reply.user, meta.reply.color).then(url => {
				if (ra.isConnected && url) ra.style.setProperty('--reply-avatar', `url("${url}")`);
			}).catch(() => {});
		}
	}
}

/* ================= ФОТО ИЗ ЧАТА ================= */

function candidatesFor(entry) {
	// Прокси первым: резолвит страницы расширений (og:image) и обходит CORS/hotlink.
	const list = [proxyUrl(entry.url)];
	if (entry.kind === 'direct') list.push(entry.url);
	const hishi = entry.url.match(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?img\.hishi\.icu\/post\/([\w-]+)/i);
	if (hishi) {
		list.push(
			`https://img.hishi.icu/img/${hishi[1]}`,
			`https://img.hishi.icu/i/${hishi[1]}.png`,
			`https://img.hishi.icu/post/${hishi[1]}.png`
		);
	}
	const imgur = entry.url.match(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?imgur\.com\/(\w+)$/i);
	if (imgur) list.push(`https://i.imgur.com/${imgur[1]}.png`, `https://i.imgur.com/${imgur[1]}.jpg`);
	return list;
}

function wireImage(box, entry) {
	const img = box.querySelector('.chat-img');
	if (!img || !entry) { box.dataset.state = 'error'; return; }
	const token = (box._imgToken = (box._imgToken || 0) + 1);
	const list = candidatesFor(entry);
	let i = 0;
	let resolving = false;
	// ВАЖНО: не гейтим по isConnected — бабл ещё не в DOM в момент первого next().
	const current = () => box._imgToken === token;
	const fail = () => { if (current()) box.dataset.state = 'error'; };
	const next = () => {
		if (!current()) return;
		if (i < list.length) { img.src = list[i++]; return; }
		if (entry.kind === 'page' && !resolving) {
			resolving = true;
			// Прокси уже пробовал og:image; здесь прямой fetch как последний шанс.
			fetch(entry.url, { mode: 'cors' })
				.then(r => (r.ok ? r.text() : ''))
				.then(html => {
					const m = html.match(/property=["']og:image["']\s+content=["']([^"']+)["']/i)
						|| html.match(/<img[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)["']/i);
					if (m && current()) img.src = new URL(m[1], entry.url).href;
					else fail();
				})
				.catch(fail);
			return;
		}
		fail();
	};
	img.onload = () => { if (current()) box.dataset.state = 'ready'; };
	img.onerror = next;
	next();
}

function wireImages(el, meta) {
	const images = Array.isArray(meta.images) ? meta.images : [];
	el.querySelectorAll('.chat-img-box').forEach(box => {
		const idx = Number(box.dataset.idx || 0);
		wireImage(box, images[idx]);
	});
}

/** Акцент: личный → fixed → цвет ника Twitch. */
export function paintBubble(el, meta, config) {
	const personal = resolvePersonal(config, meta.user);
	const accent = (personal && personal.accent)
		|| (config.accentMode === 'fixed' ? config.accentColor : meta.color);
	el.dataset.skin = el._skinId || config.skin;
	el.dataset.kind = meta.kind;
	el.dataset.user = String(meta.user || '').toLowerCase();
	el.style.setProperty('--user-color', accent);
	el.style.setProperty('--user-rgb', rgbString(accent));
	el.style.setProperty('--user2-rgb', rgbString(shiftHue(accent, 140)));
}

export function mountEffects(el, meta, config) {
	const skin = getSkin(el._skinId);
	if (!skin.effects || typeof skin.effects.onMount !== 'function') return;
	try {
		const ret = skin.effects.onMount(el, {
			meta, config,
			accent: el.style.getPropertyValue('--user-color')
		});
		if (typeof ret === 'function') effectCleanups.set(el, ret);
	} catch (e) {
		console.error(`[Chat:skin] Эффект "${skin.id}" не запустился:`, e);
	}
}

export function unmountEffects(el) {
	const skin = getSkin(el._skinId);
	const fn = effectCleanups.get(el);
	effectCleanups.delete(el);
	try {
		if (fn) fn();
		else if (skin.effects && typeof skin.effects.onUnmount === 'function') skin.effects.onUnmount(el);
	} catch (e) {
		console.warn(`[Chat:skin] Очистка эффекта "${skin.id}" упала:`, e);
	}
}

function buildContent(el, meta, config) {
	const { descriptor } = resolveFor(meta, config);
	ensureSkinCss(descriptor).catch(() => {});
	const parts = buildBubbleParts(meta);
	let skinId = descriptor.id;
	let html;
	try {
		const tpl = descriptor.template || defaultBubbleTemplate;
		html = tpl(meta, parts);
		if (typeof html !== 'string' || !html) throw new Error('template вернул не строку');
	} catch (e) {
		console.error(`[Chat:skin] Шаблон "${descriptor.id}" упал — fallback на дефолтный скелет:`, e);
		skinId = DEFAULT_SKIN;
		html = defaultBubbleTemplate(meta, parts);
	}
	el.innerHTML = html;
	el._skinId = skinId;
	fillTexts(el, meta);
	wireAvatars(el, meta);
	wireImages(el, meta);
	paintBubble(el, meta, config);
	mountEffects(el, meta, config);
}

export function createBubble(meta, config) {
	const el = document.createElement('article');
	el.className = 'chat-block is-in';
	el.dataset.id = meta.id;
	buildContent(el, meta, config);
	return el;
}

/** Живой апдейт при смене конфига: сменился скин — пересборка структуры, иначе только перекраска. */
export function repaintBubble(el, meta, config) {
	const { descriptor } = resolveFor(meta, config);
	if (descriptor.id !== el._skinId) {
		unmountEffects(el);
		buildContent(el, meta, config);
		return;
	}
	paintBubble(el, meta, config);
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/chat/runtime/chatApp.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/chat/runtime/chatApp.js — v2 (лента + детект фото перед рендером + телеметрия с images) */
import { WidgetCore } from '../../shared/WidgetCore.js';
import { normalizeChatConfig, chatTokens, chatFlags, splitList, CHAT_DEFAULTS } from '../config.js';
import { getSkin, ensureSkinCss } from '../skins.js';
import { createBubble, repaintBubble, unmountEffects } from './bubbleRenderer.js';
import { esc, nowTime, fromTest, detectImages, stripImageUrls } from './messageSource.js';

const OUT_MS = 420;
const HEARTBEAT_MS = 4000;
const ACTION_KEY = 'stream_pack_action';

export function createChatApp({ container, list, source }) {
	const App = {
		config: normalizeChatConfig(CHAT_DEFAULTS),
		alive: new Map(),
		queue: [],
		seen: new Set(),
		unique: new Set(),
		counters: { total: 0, emotes: 0, dropped: 0 },

		init() {
			if (!container || !list) { console.error('[Chat] Контейнер виджета не найден.'); return; }
			container.dataset.preview = source === 'preview' ? 'on' : 'off';
			this.applyConfig(CHAT_DEFAULTS);
			console.log(`[Chat] v4 старт (${source}), модульный рантайм + фото`);
		},

		send(action, payload) {
			const body = { ...payload, source };
			if (WidgetCore.ws && WidgetCore.ws.readyState === 1) {
				try {
					WidgetCore.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action, payload: body }));
					return;
				} catch (e) { console.warn('[Chat] WS send:', e); }
			}
			try {
				localStorage.setItem(ACTION_KEY, JSON.stringify({ action, payload: body, _n: Date.now() + Math.random() }));
			} catch (e) {}
		},

		report() {
			this.send('CHAT_STATE', {
				visible: this.config.isActive,
				count: this.alive.size,
				unique: this.unique.size,
				emotes: this.counters.emotes,
				dropped: this.counters.dropped,
				skin: this.config.skin,
				paused: this.config.paused,
				queued: this.queue.length,
				ts: Date.now()
			});
		},

		warmSkinCss(c) {
			const ids = new Set([c.skin]);
			for (const v of Object.values(c.userSkins)) ids.add(typeof v === 'string' ? v : v.skin);
			ids.forEach(id => ensureSkinCss(getSkin(id)).catch(() => {}));
		},

		applyConfig(raw) {
			if (!container || !list) return;
			try {
				const prevLife = this.config.messageLife;
				const prevMax = this.config.maxMessages;
				const wasPaused = this.config.paused;
				this.config = normalizeChatConfig(raw);
				const c = this.config;
				Object.entries(chatTokens(c)).forEach(([k, v]) => container.style.setProperty(k, v));
				container.dataset.dir = c.direction;
				container.dataset.mask = c.fadeMask ? 'on' : 'off';
				container.dataset.paused = c.paused ? 'on' : 'off';
				container.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !c.isActive);
				Object.entries(chatFlags(c)).forEach(([k, v]) => list.setAttribute(k, v));
				this.warmSkinCss(c);
				for (const entry of this.alive.values()) repaintBubble(entry.el, entry.meta, c);
				if (c.maxMessages < prevMax) this.cap();
				if (c.messageLife !== prevLife) for (const e of this.alive.values()) this.schedule(e);
				if (wasPaused && !c.paused) this.flush();
				this.report();
			} catch (e) {
				console.error('[Chat] applyConfig провален:', e);
			}
		},

		reason(meta) {
			const c = this.config;
			if (!c.isActive) return 'чат скрыт';
			const nick = String(meta.user || '').toLowerCase();
			if (splitList(c.blockedUsers).includes(nick)) return 'игнор-лист';
			const low = String(meta.text || '').toLowerCase();
			if (splitList(c.blockedWords).some(w => w && low.includes(w))) return 'бан-слово';
			if (c.hideCommands && String(meta.text || '').trim().startsWith('!')) return 'команда';
			const b = meta.badges || {};
			const isMod = b.mod || b.broadcaster;
			if (c.allowMode === 'mods' && !isMod) return 'только модераторы';
			if (c.allowMode === 'subs' && !isMod && !b.subscriber && !b.founder) return 'только сабы';
			if (c.allowMode === 'vip' && !isMod && !b.subscriber && !b.founder && !b.vip) return 'только VIP/сабы';
			return null;
		},

		push(meta) {
			if (!meta || this.seen.has(meta.id)) return;
			this.seen.add(meta.id);
			if (this.seen.size > 600) this.seen.clear();
			const why = this.reason(meta);
			if (why) {
				this.counters.dropped++;
				this.send('CHAT_FILTERED', { user: meta.user, color: meta.color, text: meta.text, reason: why, ts: Date.now() });
				this.report();
				return;
			}
			try {
				const found = detectImages(meta.text, this.config);
				meta.images = found;
				if (found.length) {
					meta.html = stripImageUrls(meta.html, found);
					console.log(`[Chat] Фото распознано: ${found.length} (${found.map(f => f.host).join(', ')})`);
				}
			} catch (e) {
				console.warn('[Chat] Детект фото упал, показываю текстом:', e);
				meta.images = [];
			}
			if (this.config.paused) {
				this.queue.push(meta);
				if (this.queue.length > 40) this.queue.shift();
				this.report();
				return;
			}
			this.render(meta);
		},

		render(meta) {
			try {
				const c = this.config;
				const el = createBubble(meta, c);
				if (c.direction === 'top') list.prepend(el);
				else list.appendChild(el);
				const entry = { el, meta, timer: null };
				this.alive.set(meta.id, entry);
				this.unique.add(String(meta.user || '').toLowerCase());
				if (this.unique.size > 400) this.unique.clear();
				this.counters.total++;
				this.counters.emotes += meta.emoteCount || 0;
				this.schedule(entry);
				this.cap();
				this.send('CHAT_MESSAGE', {
					id: meta.id, user: meta.user, color: meta.color, text: meta.text,
					skin: el.dataset.skin, kind: meta.kind, emotes: meta.emoteCount || 0,
					images: (meta.images || []).length,
					reply: meta.reply ? meta.reply.user : null, ts: Date.now()
				});
				this.report();
			} catch (e) {
				console.error('[Chat] Рендер сообщения провален:', e, meta);
			}
		},

		schedule(entry) {
			if (entry.timer) { clearTimeout(entry.timer); entry.timer = null; }
			const life = this.config.messageLife;
			if (!life) return;
			entry.timer = setTimeout(() => this.remove(entry.meta.id, true), life * 1000);
		},

		remove(id, animate) {
			const entry = this.alive.get(id);
			if (!entry) return;
			this.alive.delete(id);
			if (entry.timer) clearTimeout(entry.timer);
			unmountEffects(entry.el);
			if (!animate) { entry.el.remove(); this.report(); return; }
			entry.el.classList.remove('is-in');
			entry.el.classList.add('is-out');
			setTimeout(() => { entry.el.remove(); this.report(); }, OUT_MS);
		},

		cap() {
			while (this.alive.size > this.config.maxMessages) {
				this.remove(this.alive.keys().next().value, true);
			}
		},

		clear(silent) {
			for (const id of Array.from(this.alive.keys())) this.remove(id, true);
			this.queue = [];
			if (!silent) this.system('Чат очищен модератором.');
			this.report();
		},

		flush() {
			const pending = this.queue.splice(0, this.queue.length);
			pending.forEach(m => this.render(m));
			if (pending.length) console.log(`[Chat] Пауза снята — выпущено ${pending.length}`);
		},

		system(text) {
			this.render({
				id: 'sys-' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
				user: 'Система', color: '#00e5ff', text, html: esc(text),
				time: nowTime(), kind: 'system', badges: {}, emoteCount: 0, reply: null, images: []
			});
		},

		handleAction(action, payload) {
			if (action === 'CHAT_TEST') { this.push(fromTest(payload)); return; }
			if (action === 'CHAT_CLEAR') { this.clear(false); return; }
			if (action === 'CHAT_REQUEST_STATE') { this.report(); return; }
			if (action === 'CHAT_FLUSH') { this.flush(); }
		}
	};

	App.heartbeat = setInterval(() => App.report(), HEARTBEAT_MS);
	setTimeout(() => App.report(), 600);
	return App;
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/chat/runtime/commands.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/chat/runtime/commands.js — v1 (модераторские !chat*-команды; скины проверяются по реестру) */
import { WidgetCore } from '../../shared/WidgetCore.js';
import { isTrue, CHAT_LIMITS } from '../config.js';
import { isKnownSkin } from '../skins.js';

export function handleChatCommand(cmd, args, app) {
	if (!WidgetCore.isMaster) return;
	const conf = { ...(WidgetCore.globalConfig?.widgets?.chat || {}) };
	const arg = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
	let changed = false;

	const numCmd = (key) => {
		const [min, max] = CHAT_LIMITS[key] || [0, 100];
		const n = parseInt(args[0], 10);
		if (!isNaN(n)) { conf[key] = Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n)); changed = true; }
	};
	const colorCmd = (key) => {
		let h = String(args[0] || '').trim();
		if (!h) return;
		if (!h.startsWith('#')) h = '#' + h;
		if (/^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(h)) { conf[key] = h; changed = true; }
	};

	if (cmd === '!chat') {
		const cur = conf.isActive === undefined ? true : isTrue(conf.isActive);
		conf.isActive = arg === 'on' ? true : (arg === 'off' ? false : !cur);
		changed = true;
	} else if (cmd === '!chatskin') {
		if (isKnownSkin(arg)) { conf.skin = arg; changed = true; }
	} else if (cmd === '!chatlife') numCmd('messageLife');
	else if (cmd === '!chatmax') numCmd('maxMessages');
	else if (cmd === '!chatsz') numCmd('fontSize');
	else if (cmd === '!chatop') numCmd('bgOpacity');
	else if (cmd === '!chatbg') colorCmd('bgColor');
	else if (cmd === '!chatc') colorCmd('textColor');
	else if (cmd === '!chatpause') {
		const cur = isTrue(conf.paused);
		conf.paused = arg === 'on' ? true : (arg === 'off' ? false : !cur);
		changed = true;
	} else if (cmd === '!chatclear') { app.clear(false); return; }

	if (changed) {
		WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('chat', conf);
		console.log(`[Chat] ${cmd} применена`);
	}
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/chat/runtime/messageSource.js — v2 (Twitch/тест → meta + детект фото-ссылок из расширений) */
import { WidgetCore } from '../../shared/WidgetCore.js';
import { splitList } from '../config.js';

export const BADGE_DEFS = [
	{ key: 'broadcaster', id: 'broadcaster', label: 'HOST', title: 'Стример' },
	{ key: 'mod', id: 'mod', label: 'MOD', title: 'Модератор' },
	{ key: 'vip', id: 'vip', label: 'VIP', title: 'VIP' },
	{ key: 'artist', id: 'artist', label: 'ART', title: 'Художник' },
	{ key: 'founder', id: 'founder', label: 'FND', title: 'Основатель' },
	{ key: 'subscriber', id: 'sub', label: 'SUB', title: 'Подписчик' }
];

const TEST_EMOTES = {
	Kappa: '25', LUL: '425618', Keepo: '1902', Kreygasm: '41',
	BibleThump: '86', WutFace: '28087', HeyGuys: '30259', SeemGood: '64138',
	PogChamp: '305954156', CoolStoryBob: '123171'
};

const URL_RE = /https?:\/\/[^\s<>"')\]]+/gi;
const DIRECT_EXT_RE = /\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|avif|bmp)(\?|#|$)/i;
const MAX_IMAGES_PER_MESSAGE = 4;

export function esc(s) {
	return String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

export function nowTime() {
	try { return new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); }
	catch (e) { return '--:--'; }
}

export function countEmotes(emotes) {
	if (!emotes) return 0;
	return Object.values(emotes).reduce((s, p) => s + (Array.isArray(p) ? p.length : 0), 0);
}

export function buildTestEmotes(text) {
	const emotes = {};
	Object.keys(TEST_EMOTES).forEach(name => {
		let from = 0;
		while (true) {
			const idx = text.indexOf(name, from);
			if (idx < 0) break;
			const before = idx === 0 ? ' ' : text[idx - 1];
			const after = idx + name.length >= text.length ? ' ' : text[idx + name.length];
			if (/\s/.test(before) && /\s/.test(after)) {
				const id = TEST_EMOTES[name];
				emotes[id] = emotes[id] || [];
				emotes[id].push(`${idx}-${idx + name.length - 1}`);
			}
			from = idx + name.length;
		}
	});
	return Object.keys(emotes).length ? emotes : null;
}

/**
 * Классификация ссылки как «фото из чата».
 * kind 'direct' — URL уже указывает на файл картинки;
 * kind 'page'   — страница доверенного хоста (img.hishi.icu/post/… от расширения),
 *                 рендерер пробует загрузить её как img и резолвит og:image.
 */
export function classifyImageUrl(url, c) {
	let u;
	try { u = new URL(url); } catch (e) { return null; }
	if (u.protocol !== 'https:' && u.protocol !== 'http:') return null;
	const host = u.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '');
	const trusted = splitList(c.imageHosts).some(h => h && (host === h || host.endsWith('.' + h)));
	const direct = DIRECT_EXT_RE.test(u.pathname);
	if (direct && (c.imageAllHosts || trusted)) return { url: u.href, host, kind: 'direct' };
	if (trusted) return { url: u.href, host, kind: 'page' };
	return null;
}

export function detectImages(text, c) {
	if (!c || c.showImages === false) return [];
	const out = [];
	const seen = new Set();
	const src = String(text || '');
	URL_RE.lastIndex = 0;
	let m;
	while ((m = URL_RE.exec(src)) !== null) {
		if (out.length >= MAX_IMAGES_PER_MESSAGE) break;
		const url = m[0].replace(/[.,!?;:]+$/, '');
		if (seen.has(url)) continue;
		const entry = classifyImageUrl(url, c);
		if (entry) { seen.add(url); out.push(entry); }
	}
	return out;
}

/** Убирает фото-ссылки из уже собранного HTML, не трогая позиции смайлов. */
export function stripImageUrls(html, images) {
	let out = String(html || '');
	(images || []).forEach(entry => {
		[out, out] = [out.split(entry.url).join(''), out];
		out = out.split(esc(entry.url)).join('');
	});
	return out.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
}

export function fromTwitch(tags, message) {
	const user = tags['display-name'] || tags.username || 'Зритель';
	const color = tags.color || '#ff4d85';
	let text = String(message || '').trim();
	let reply = null;
	if (tags['reply-parent-msg-id']) {
		const rUser = tags['reply-parent-display-name'] || tags['reply-parent-user-login'] || 'зритель';
		let rBody = String(tags['reply-parent-msg-body'] || '').replace(/\\s/g, ' ');
		const m1 = `@${rUser}`;
		const m2 = `@${tags['reply-parent-user-login']}`;
		if (text.toLowerCase().startsWith(m1.toLowerCase())) text = text.substring(m1.length).trim();
		else if (m2 && text.toLowerCase().startsWith(m2.toLowerCase())) text = text.substring(m2.length).trim();
		rBody = rBody.replace(/^@[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\s+/, '').trim();
		reply = { user: rUser, text: rBody, color: tags['reply-parent-user-color'] || '#a1a1aa' };
	}
	const b = tags.badges || {};
	return {
		id: tags.id || ('tw-' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)),
		user, color, text,
		html: WidgetCore.parseMessageToHTML(text, tags.emotes),
		time: nowTime(),
		kind: tags['first-msg'] === '1' ? 'first' : (tags['msg-id'] === 'highlighted-message' ? 'highlight' : 'normal'),
		badges: {
			broadcaster: b.broadcaster === '1',
			mod: tags.mod === true || b.moderator === '1',
			vip: b.vip === '1',
			subscriber: tags.subscriber === true || Boolean(b.subscriber || b.founder),
			founder: b.founder === '1',
			artist: b.artist === '1'
		},
		emoteCount: countEmotes(tags.emotes),
		reply,
		images: []
	};
}

export function fromTest(p) {
	const d = p || {};
	const user = String(d.user || 'Зритель').trim().substring(0, 28) || 'Зритель';
	const color = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(String(d.color || '')) ? String(d.color) : '#00e5ff';
	const text = String(d.text || 'Привет, стрим!').substring(0, 400);
	const emotes = buildTestEmotes(text);
	const b = d.badges || {};
	return {
		id: 'test-' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7),
		user, color, text,
		html: WidgetCore.parseMessageToHTML(text, emotes),
		time: nowTime(),
		kind: d.first ? 'first' : (d.highlighted ? 'highlight' : 'normal'),
		badges: {
			broadcaster: !!b.broadcaster, mod: !!b.mod, vip: !!b.vip,
			subscriber: !!b.subscriber, founder: !!b.founder, artist: !!b.artist
		},
		emoteCount: countEmotes(emotes),
		reply: d.reply && d.reply.text ? {
			user: String(d.reply.user || 'зритель').substring(0, 28),
			text: String(d.reply.text).substring(0, 160),
			color: /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(String(d.reply.color || '')) ? String(d.reply.color) : '#a1a1aa'
		} : null,
		images: []
	};
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/deaths/script.js — v2 (мастер-тумблер главный, параметризованное оформление, живой сигнал) */
import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';

const PARAMS = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const IS_PREVIEW = PARAMS.get('preview') === '1';
const SOURCE = IS_PREVIEW ? 'preview' : 'obs';
const HEARTBEAT_MS = 4000;
const SOUND_PATH = '../../data/sounds/death.mp3';

function num(value, fallback) {
    const n = parseInt(value, 10);
    return isNaN(n) ? fallback : n;
}
function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }
function isTrue(v) { return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }

function normalizeHex(value, fallback) {
    let h = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!h) return fallback;
    if (!h.startsWith('#')) h = '#' + h;
    if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(h)) h = '#' + h.slice(1).split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
    return /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(h) ? h : fallback;
}

function restartAnimation(element, className) {
    if (!element) return;
    element.classList.remove(className);
    void element.offsetWidth;
    element.classList.add(className);
}

const AppDeaths = {
    container: document.getElementById('deaths-container'),
    countText: document.getElementById('deaths-count'),
    comboEl: document.getElementById('deaths-combo'),
    shakerEl: document.getElementById('deaths-shaker'),
    titleEl: document.querySelector('.deaths-title'),

    count: 0,
    isVisible: false,
    comboCount: 0,
    comboTimer: null,
    _booted: false,

    config: {
        enabled: false,
        color: '#ff0050',
        comboColor: '#ff8c00',
        label: 'DEATHS',
        fontSize: 64,
        shake: 1,
        comboWindow: 8,
        comboThreshold: 2,
        soundEnabled: true,
        soundVolume: 60
    },

    applyConfig(conf) {
        if (!conf || !this.container) return;

        this.config.enabled = isTrue(conf.enabled);
        this.config.color = normalizeHex(conf.color, '#ff0050');
        this.config.comboColor = normalizeHex(conf.comboColor, '#ff8c00');
        this.config.label = String(conf.label ?? 'DEATHS');
        this.config.fontSize = clamp(num(conf.fontSize, 64), 24, 140);
        this.config.shake = clamp(num(conf.shakeIntensity, 100), 0, 100) / 100;
        this.config.comboWindow = clamp(num(conf.comboWindow, 8), 1, 60);
        this.config.comboThreshold = clamp(num(conf.comboThreshold, 2), 2, 20);
        this.config.soundEnabled = conf.soundEnabled === undefined ? true : isTrue(conf.soundEnabled);
        this.config.soundVolume = clamp(num(conf.soundVolume, 60), 0, 100);

        this.applyAppearance();

        const nextCount = Math.max(0, num(conf.deathsCount, 0));
        const delta = nextCount - this.count;
        this.count = nextCount;

        this.setVisible(this.config.enabled);

        if (delta > 0 && this.config.enabled) {
            this.handleHit(delta);
        } else {
            this.render();
        }

        if (delta !== 0 && this._booted) this.reportChange(delta);
        this._booted = true;
        this.report();
    },

    applyAppearance() {
        const root = document.documentElement;
        root.style.setProperty('--death-color', this.config.color);
        root.style.setProperty('--death-glow', `${this.config.color}80`);
        root.style.setProperty('--combo-color', this.config.comboColor);
        root.style.setProperty('--death-size', `${this.config.fontSize}px`);
        root.style.setProperty('--death-shake', String(this.config.shake));
        if (this.titleEl && this.titleEl.textContent !== this.config.label) {
            this.titleEl.textContent = this.config.label;
        }
    },

    setVisible(on) {
        if (on === this.isVisible) return;
        this.isVisible = on;
        if (on) {
            this.container.classList.remove('hidden');
            restartAnimation(this.countText, 'animate-pop-red');
        } else {
            this.container.classList.add('hidden');
            this.clearCombo();
        }
    },

    clearCombo() {
        if (this.comboTimer) { clearTimeout(this.comboTimer); this.comboTimer = null; }
        this.comboCount = 0;
        if (this.comboEl) this.comboEl.classList.remove('combo-in', 'combo-out');
        if (this.container) this.container.classList.remove('has-combo');
    },

    handleHit(delta) {
        restartAnimation(this.shakerEl, 'damage-shake');
        this.comboCount += delta;

        if (this.comboCount >= this.config.comboThreshold) {
            this.comboEl.textContent = `x${this.comboCount} COMBO!`;
            this.comboEl.classList.remove('combo-out');
            restartAnimation(this.comboEl, 'combo-in');
            this.container.classList.add('has-combo');
        }

        if (this.comboTimer) clearTimeout(this.comboTimer);
        this.comboTimer = setTimeout(() => this.clearCombo(), this.config.comboWindow * 1000);

        this.playSound();
        this.render();
        this.pet();
    },

    testHit() {
        if (!this.config.enabled) {
            console.log('[Deaths] Тест пропущен: счётчик скрыт мастер-тумблером.');
            return;
        }
        restartAnimation(this.shakerEl, 'damage-shake');
        restartAnimation(this.countText, 'animate-pop-red');
        this.playSound();
        this.pet();
        this.report();
    },

    playSound() {
        if (!this.config.soundEnabled || this.config.soundVolume <= 0) return;
        if (document.hidden) return;
        try {
            const audio = new Audio(SOUND_PATH);
            audio.volume = this.config.soundVolume / 100;
            audio.play().catch(e => console.warn('[Deaths] Звук не проигрался:', e && e.message));
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[Deaths] Не удалось создать звук:', e);
        }
    },

    pet() {
        WidgetCore.sendAction('PET_EMOTION', { emotion: 'scared', duration: 4000 });
    },

    render() {
        if (!this.countText) return;
        const next = String(this.count);
        if (this.countText.textContent !== next) {
            this.countText.textContent = next;
            restartAnimation(this.countText, 'animate-pop-red');
        }
    },

    reportChange(delta) {
        WidgetCore.sendAction('DEATHS_CHANGE', {
            source: SOURCE,
            delta,
            count: this.count,
            combo: this.comboCount,
            ts: Date.now()
        });
    },

    report() {
        WidgetCore.sendAction('DEATHS_STATE', {
            source: SOURCE,
            count: this.count,
            visible: this.config.enabled,
            combo: this.comboCount,
            label: this.config.label,
            ts: Date.now()
        });
    },

    handleAction(action) {
        if (action === 'DEATHS_TEST') { this.testHit(); return; }
        if (action === 'DEATHS_REQUEST_STATE') { this.report(); }
    },

    handleChat(cmd, args) {
        // Команды приходят и мастеру, и слейвам через шину — пишет только мастер.
        if (!WidgetCore.isMaster) return;
        const conf = { ...(WidgetCore.globalConfig?.widgets?.deaths || {}) };
        const current = Math.max(0, num(conf.deathsCount, 0));
        let changed = false;

        if (cmd === '!deathshow') {
            const arg = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
            conf.enabled = arg === 'on' || arg === 'show' ? true
                : (arg === 'off' || arg === 'hide' ? false : !isTrue(conf.enabled));
            changed = true;
        } else if (cmd === '!deathset') {
            const value = num(args[0], NaN);
            if (!isNaN(value)) {
                conf.deathsCount = Math.max(0, value);
                conf.enabled = true;
                changed = true;
            }
        } else if (cmd === '!deathc') {
            const color = normalizeHex(args[0], null);
            if (color) { conf.color = color; changed = true; }
        } else if (cmd === '!death' || cmd === '!deaths' || cmd === '!смерть') {
            const arg = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
            if (!arg || arg === '+') {
                conf.deathsCount = current + 1;
                conf.enabled = true;
                changed = true;
            } else if (arg === '-' || arg === 'sub') {
                conf.deathsCount = Math.max(0, current - 1);
                changed = true;
            } else if (arg === 'reset' || arg === 'clear') {
                conf.deathsCount = 0;
                changed = true;
            } else if (arg === 'set' && args[1] !== undefined) {
                const value = num(args[1], NaN);
                if (!isNaN(value)) {
                    conf.deathsCount = Math.max(0, value);
                    conf.enabled = true;
                    changed = true;
                }
            } else if (arg === 'on' || arg === 'show') {
                conf.enabled = true; changed = true;
            } else if (arg === 'off' || arg === 'hide') {
                conf.enabled = false; changed = true;
            }
        }

        if (changed) {
            WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('deaths', conf);
            console.log(`[Deaths] ${cmd} → счётчик ${conf.deathsCount ?? current}, видимость ${conf.enabled}`);
        }
    }
};

WidgetCore.init({
    onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
        if (config?.widgets?.deaths) AppDeaths.applyConfig(config.widgets.deaths);
    },
    onWidgetAction: (action) => AppDeaths.handleAction(action),
    onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => AppDeaths.handleChat(cmd, args)
});

setInterval(() => AppDeaths.report(), HEARTBEAT_MS);
console.log(`[Deaths] v2 инициализирован (${SOURCE})`);

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/deaths/dashboard/counterPanel.js — v1 (+1, −1, точное значение, обнуление с возвратом, тест) */

const UNDO_MS = 8000;
const ARM_MS = 3000;

function toInt(v, d) { const n = parseInt(v, 10); return isNaN(n) ? d : n; }

export class CounterPanel {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.inputHandler = null;
        this.changeHandler = null;
        this.keyHandler = null;
        this.armed = false;
        this.armTimer = null;
        this.undoValue = null;
        this.undoTimer = null;
    }

    mount() {
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
        this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
        this.keyHandler = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target && e.target.id === 'dd-count-input') {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.target.blur();
            }
        };
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.inputHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        if (this.changeHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        if (this.keyHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        if (this.armTimer) clearTimeout(this.armTimer);
        if (this.undoTimer) clearTimeout(this.undoTimer);
        this.armed = false;
        this.undoValue = null;
    }

    _count() {
        return Math.max(0, toInt(this.store.getState().config.widgets.deaths?.deathsCount, 0));
    }

    _write(value) {
        const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(99999, toInt(value, 0)));
        try {
            // Меняем ТОЛЬКО счёт: мастер-тумблер остаётся как есть.
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { deaths: { deathsCount: next } } });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[DeathsCounter] Не удалось сохранить счёт:', e);
            this.toast.error('Счёт не сохранился.');
        }
        return next;
    }

    _disarm() {
        this.armed = false;
        if (this.armTimer) { clearTimeout(this.armTimer); this.armTimer = null; }
        const btn = document.getElementById('dd-reset');
        if (btn) { btn.classList.remove('is-armed'); btn.innerHTML = btn.dataset.label || btn.innerHTML; }
    }

    _hideUndo() {
        this.undoValue = null;
        if (this.undoTimer) { clearTimeout(this.undoTimer); this.undoTimer = null; }
        const btn = document.getElementById('dd-undo');
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('is-hidden');
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.closest('#dd-plus')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const next = this._write(this._count() + 1);
            const btn = document.getElementById('dd-plus');
            if (btn) { btn.classList.remove('is-hit'); void btn.offsetWidth; btn.classList.add('is-hit'); }
            this.toast.show(`Смерть отмечена: ${next}`, 'info');
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#dd-minus')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const current = this._count();
            if (current <= 0) return;
            this._write(current - 1);
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#dd-test')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.store.broadcastAction('DEATHS_TEST', {});
            this.toast.info('Тестовый удар: тряска и звук, счёт не меняется.');
            return;
        }

        const reset = t.closest('#dd-reset');
        if (reset) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!this.armed) {
                const current = this._count();
                if (current === 0) { this.toast.info('Счётчик уже на нуле.'); return; }
                this.armed = true;
                reset.dataset.label = reset.innerHTML;
                reset.classList.add('is-armed');
                reset.textContent = 'Точно обнулить? Нажмите ещё раз';
                this.toast.info('Обнуление счётчика — подтвердите повторным нажатием.');
                if (this.armTimer) clearTimeout(this.armTimer);
                this.armTimer = setTimeout(() => this._disarm(), ARM_MS);
                return;
            }
            const previous = this._count();
            this._disarm();
            this._write(0);
            this.undoValue = previous;
            const undo = document.getElementById('dd-undo');
            const label = document.getElementById('dd-undo-label');
            if (label) label.textContent = `Вернуть ${previous}`;
            if (undo) undo.classList.remove('is-hidden');
            if (this.undoTimer) clearTimeout(this.undoTimer);
            this.undoTimer = setTimeout(() => this._hideUndo(), UNDO_MS);
            this.toast.success(`Счётчик обнулён. Можно вернуть ${previous}.`);
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#dd-undo')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (this.undoValue === null) return;
            const value = this.undoValue;
            this._hideUndo();
            this._write(value);
            this.toast.success(`Возвращено значение ${value}.`);
        }
    }

    _onInput(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.id !== 'dd-count-input') return;
        if (t.value === '') return;
        this._write(t.value);
    }

    _onChange(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.id === 'dd-count-input') {
            t.value = String(this._count());
            return;
        }
        if (t.type === 'checkbox' && t.hasAttribute('data-dd-key') && t.getAttribute('data-dd-key') === 'enabled') {
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { deaths: { enabled: t.checked } } });
            this.toast.show(t.checked ? 'Счётчик показан на стриме.' : 'Счётчик скрыт со стрима.', t.checked ? 'success' : 'info');
            if (!t.checked) this._disarm();
        }
    }

    render(state) {
        const c = state.config.widgets.deaths || {};
        const enabled = c.enabled === true || String(c.enabled) === 'true';
        const count = Math.max(0, toInt(c.deathsCount, 0));

        const input = document.getElementById('dd-count-input');
        if (input && document.activeElement !== input && input.value !== String(count)) input.value = String(count);

        const minus = document.getElementById('dd-minus');
        if (minus) minus.disabled = count <= 0;

        const test = document.getElementById('dd-test');
        if (test) {
            test.disabled = !enabled;
            test.title = enabled ? 'Тряска и звук без изменения счёта' : 'Сначала включите счётчик мастер-тумблером';
        }

        const master = this.root.querySelector('[data-dd-key="enabled"]');
        if (master && document.activeElement !== master && master.checked !== enabled) master.checked = enabled;
    }
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/deaths/dashboard/Dashboard.js — v2 (CSS-first: параллельные стили + preload, кэш линков в head) */
import { store } from '../../../js/store.js';
import { renderTemplate } from './template.js';
import { StageController } from './stage.js';
import { CounterPanel } from './counterPanel.js';
import { TuningPanel } from './tuningPanel.js';
import { LogPanel } from './logPanel.js';
import { Toast } from '../../../js/components/toast.js';
const LIVE_TTL = 12000;
let ctx = null;
// === CSS-first загрузчик: параллельные <link> вместо @import-водопада ===
const CSS_VERSION = 'v2';
const CSS_TIMEOUT = 3000;
const CSS_FILES = [
{ id: 'dd-css-base', href: `widgets/deaths/dashboard/styles/base.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'dd-css-stage', href: `widgets/deaths/dashboard/styles/stage.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'dd-css-panels', href: `widgets/deaths/dashboard/styles/panels.css?${CSS_VERSION}` }
];
let cssPromise = null;
function loadOneCss({ id, href }) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const existing = document.getElementById(id);
if (existing) {
if (existing.dataset.loaded === '1') { resolve(true); return; }
existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(true), { once: true });
existing.addEventListener('error', () => resolve(false), { once: true });
return;
}
const link = document.createElement('link');
link.id = id;
link.rel = 'stylesheet';
link.href = href;
link.dataset.loaded = '0';
link.onload = () => { link.dataset.loaded = '1'; resolve(true); };
link.onerror = () => {
console.error(`[DeathsDash:css] Файл стиля не загрузился: ${href}`);
link.remove();
resolve(false);
};
document.head.appendChild(link);
});
}
/** Идемпотентно грузит стили дашборда. Резолвится true/false, никогда не реджектится. */
function preload() {
if (cssPromise) return cssPromise;
const t0 = performance.now();
console.log('[DeathsDash:css] preload: параллельная загрузка стилей...');
const loadAll = Promise.all(CSS_FILES.map(loadOneCss)).then((results) => {
const ok = results.every(Boolean);
if (ok) console.log(`[DeathsDash:css] Стили готовы за ${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}мс`);
else console.warn('[DeathsDash:css] Часть стилей недоступна — возможен деградированный вид.');
return ok;
});
let guardTimer = null;
const guard = new Promise((resolve) => {
guardTimer = setTimeout(() => {
console.warn(`[DeathsDash:css] Таймаут ${CSS_TIMEOUT}мс — рендерим без ожидания стилей.`);
resolve(false);
}, CSS_TIMEOUT);
});
cssPromise = Promise.race([loadAll, guard]).then((ok) => {
if (guardTimer) { clearTimeout(guardTimer); guardTimer = null; }
if (!ok) cssPromise = null;
return ok;
});
return cssPromise;
}
function pickLive() {
if (!ctx) return null;
const now = Date.now();
const { obs, preview } = ctx.live;
if (obs && now - obs.ts < LIVE_TTL) return obs;
if (preview && now - preview.ts < LIVE_TTL) return preview;
return null;
}
function setBadge(id, cls, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (!el) return;
el.className = `dd-badge ${cls}`;
el.innerHTML = `<span class="dd-badge-dot"></span>${text}`;
}
function setText(id, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (el && el.textContent !== text) el.textContent = text;
}
function renderStatus(state, live) {
const c = state.config.widgets.deaths || {};
const enabled = c.enabled === true || String(c.enabled) === 'true';
const online = Boolean(state.serverOnline);
setBadge('dd-badge-server', online ? 'dd-badge-live' : 'dd-badge-off', online ? 'СЕРВЕР ONLINE' : 'СЕРВЕР OFFLINE');
setBadge('dd-badge-state', enabled ? 'dd-badge-live' : 'dd-badge-warn', enabled ? 'НА ЭКРАНЕ' : 'СКРЫТ');
setBadge('dd-badge-source',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'dd-badge-live' : 'dd-badge-info') : 'dd-badge-off',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ OBS' : 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ ПРЕВЬЮ') : 'НЕТ СИГНАЛА');
const configCount = Math.max(0, parseInt(c.deathsCount, 10) || 0);
const shown = live ? live.count : configCount;
setText('dd-now-count', String(shown));
setText('dd-now-label', live && live.label ? live.label : String(c.label ?? 'DEATHS'));
setText('dd-now-source', live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'OBS STUDIO' : 'ПРЕВЬЮ') : 'НЕТ СИГНАЛА');
const combo = live ? live.combo : 0;
const comboEl = document.getElementById('dd-now-combo');
if (comboEl) {
comboEl.textContent = combo > 1 ? `x${combo} COMBO` : 'КОМБО НЕТ';
comboEl.classList.toggle('is-active', combo > 1);
}
const strip = document.getElementById('dd-now');
if (strip) {
strip.classList.toggle('is-off', !enabled);
strip.style.setProperty('--now-accent', String(c.color || '#ff0050'));
strip.style.setProperty('--now-combo', String(c.comboColor || '#ff8c00'));
}
}
function evaluate() {
if (!ctx) return;
const state = store.getState();
const live = pickLive();
renderStatus(state, live);
ctx.stage.evaluate(state, live);
ctx.counter.render(state, live);
ctx.tuning.render(state);
ctx.log.render();
}
function mount(params, state) {
const root = document.getElementById('dd-main');
if (!root) return;
unmount();
// V2-вью уже дождалась preload() — здесь мгновенный no-op (страховка для прямого монтажа).
preload();
const toast = new Toast(document.getElementById('dd-toasts'), { className: 'dd-toast' });
const stage = new StageController({ root, store, toast });
const counter = new CounterPanel({ root, store, toast });
const tuning = new TuningPanel({ root, store, toast });
const log = new LogPanel({ root, toast });
ctx = {
root, toast, stage, counter, tuning, log,
live: { obs: null, preview: null },
seen: new Set(),
unsub: null, unsubAction: null, tick: null
};
stage.mount();
counter.mount();
tuning.mount();
log.mount();
ctx.unsub = store.subscribe(() => evaluate());
ctx.unsubAction = store.onAction((action, payload) => {
if (!payload) return;
if (action === 'DEATHS_STATE') {
const source = payload.source === 'obs' ? 'obs' : 'preview';
ctx.live[source] = {
source,
count: Number(payload.count ?? 0),
visible: payload.visible !== false,
combo: Number(payload.combo ?? 0),
label: payload.label || 'DEATHS',
ts: Number(payload.ts || Date.now())
};
evaluate();
return;
}
if (action === 'DEATHS_CHANGE') {
const source = payload.source === 'obs' ? 'obs' : 'preview';
const obsFresh = ctx.live.obs && Date.now() - ctx.live.obs.ts < LIVE_TTL;
if (source === 'preview' && obsFresh) return;
const ts = Number(payload.ts || Date.now());
const key = `${source}:${ts}:${payload.count}:${payload.delta}`;
if (ctx.seen.has(key)) return;
ctx.seen.add(key);
if (ctx.seen.size > 400) ctx.seen.clear();
ctx.log.push({
ts,
delta: Number(payload.delta ?? 0),
count: Number(payload.count ?? 0),
combo: Number(payload.combo ?? 0)
});
evaluate();
}
});
ctx.tick = setInterval(() => evaluate(), 2000);
evaluate();
store.broadcastAction('DEATHS_REQUEST_STATE', {});
console.log('[DeathsDash] v2 смонтирован', params);
}
function onParamsChange(params) {
if (!ctx) return false;
return (params?.id || 'player') === 'deaths';
}
function unmount() {
if (!ctx) return;
console.log('[DeathsDash] Размонтирование');
if (ctx.unsub) ctx.unsub();
if (ctx.unsubAction) ctx.unsubAction();
if (ctx.tick) clearInterval(ctx.tick);
ctx.stage.unmount();
ctx.counter.unmount();
ctx.tuning.unmount();
ctx.log.unmount();
ctx = null;
// Стили (dd-css-*) намеренно остаются в <head> — кэш между вкладками против FOUC.
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#dd-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
}
export default {
render: (state, params) => renderTemplate(state, params),
preload,
mount,
onParamsChange,
unmount
};

--- START OF FILE widgets/deaths/dashboard/logPanel.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/deaths/dashboard/logPanel.js — v1 (реальный журнал изменений счёта + метрики) */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');
const STORAGE_KEY = 'dd_deaths_log_v1';
const MAX_ENTRIES = 80;
const ARM_MS = 3000;

function formatTime(ts) {
    try {
        return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString('ru-RU', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
    } catch (e) { return '--:--:--'; }
}

function formatGap(sec) {
    if (!isFinite(sec) || sec <= 0) return '—';
    if (sec < 60) return `${Math.round(sec)}с`;
    const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    const s = Math.round(sec % 60);
    return `${m}м ${s}с`;
}

export class LogPanel {
    constructor({ root, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.entries = [];
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.armed = false;
        this.armTimer = null;
        this._sig = '';
        this.load();
    }

    mount() {
        const panel = this.root.querySelector('.dd-log-panel');
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        if (panel) panel.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
    }

    unmount() {
        const panel = this.root.querySelector('.dd-log-panel');
        if (panel && this.clickHandler) panel.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.armTimer) clearTimeout(this.armTimer);
        this.armed = false;
    }

    load() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
            if (!raw) return;
            const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return;
            this.entries = parsed
                .filter(e => e && typeof e.ts === 'number' && typeof e.delta === 'number')
                .map(e => ({ ts: e.ts, delta: e.delta, count: Number(e.count) || 0, combo: Number(e.combo) || 0 }))
                .slice(0, MAX_ENTRIES);
            console.log(`[DeathsLog] Загружено записей: ${this.entries.length}`);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[DeathsLog] Журнал не читается, начинаю с пустого:', e);
            this.entries = [];
        }
    }

    save() {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.entries.slice(0, MAX_ENTRIES)));
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[DeathsLog] Не удалось сохранить журнал:', e);
        }
    }

    push(entry) {
        if (!entry || !entry.delta) return;
        this.entries.unshift(entry);
        if (this.entries.length > MAX_ENTRIES) this.entries.length = MAX_ENTRIES;
        this.save();
        this.render();
    }

    _disarm() {
        this.armed = false;
        if (this.armTimer) { clearTimeout(this.armTimer); this.armTimer = null; }
        const btn = document.getElementById('dd-log-clear');
        if (btn) { btn.classList.remove('is-armed'); btn.innerHTML = btn.dataset.label || btn.innerHTML; }
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const btn = e.target.closest('#dd-log-clear');
        if (!btn) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (this.entries.length === 0) { this.toast.info('Журнал уже пуст.'); return; }

        if (!this.armed) {
            this.armed = true;
            btn.dataset.label = btn.innerHTML;
            btn.classList.add('is-armed');
            btn.textContent = 'Точно очистить?';
            this.toast.info('Очистка журнала — подтвердите повторным нажатием.');
            if (this.armTimer) clearTimeout(this.armTimer);
            this.armTimer = setTimeout(() => this._disarm(), ARM_MS);
            return;
        }
        this._disarm();
        this.entries = [];
        this.save();
        this.render();
        this.toast.success('Журнал очищен.');
    }

    stats() {
        const positives = this.entries.filter(e => e.delta > 0);
        const deaths = positives.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.delta, 0);
        const maxCombo = this.entries.reduce((m, e) => Math.max(m, e.combo || 0), 0);
        let gap = '—';
        if (positives.length >= 2) {
            const sorted = positives.slice().sort((a, b) => a.ts - b.ts);
            let total = 0;
            for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) total += (sorted[i].ts - sorted[i - 1].ts) / 1000;
            gap = formatGap(total / (sorted.length - 1));
        }
        return { deaths, maxCombo, gap };
    }

    render() {
        const list = document.getElementById('dd-log');
        if (!list) return;

        const { deaths, maxCombo, gap } = this.stats();
        const set = (id, value) => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el && el.textContent !== String(value)) el.textContent = String(value);
        };
        set('dd-stat-deaths', deaths);
        set('dd-stat-combo', maxCombo > 1 ? `x${maxCombo}` : '0');
        set('dd-stat-gap', gap);
        set('dd-log-count', this.entries.length);

        const empty = document.getElementById('dd-log-empty');
        if (empty) empty.classList.toggle('is-hidden', this.entries.length > 0);

        const sig = `${this.entries.length}:${this.entries[0]?.ts || 0}`;
        if (sig === this._sig) return;
        this._sig = sig;

        list.innerHTML = this.entries.map(entry => {
            const isReset = entry.delta < 0 && entry.count === 0;
            const kind = entry.delta > 0 ? 'is-up' : (isReset ? 'is-reset' : 'is-down');
            const label = entry.delta > 0 ? `+${entry.delta}` : (isReset ? 'СБРОС' : String(entry.delta));
            const combo = entry.combo > 1 ? `<em class="dd-log-combo">x${entry.combo}</em>` : '';
            return `
<div class="dd-log-row ${kind}">
<span class="dd-log-time">${formatTime(entry.ts)}</span>
<span class="dd-log-delta">${label}</span>
<span class="dd-log-count">→ ${entry.count}</span>
${combo}
</div>`;
        }).join('');

        const scroll = document.getElementById('dd-log-scroll');
        if (scroll) scroll.scrollTop = 0;
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/deaths/dashboard/stage.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/deaths/dashboard/stage.js — v1 (живое превью настоящего виджета) */

const WIDGET_W = 250;
const WIDGET_H = 200;

export class StageController {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.iframe = null;
        this.loaded = false;
        this.resizeObs = null;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.loadTimer = null;
    }

    mount() {
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        const stage = document.getElementById('dd-stage');
        this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.scale());
        if (stage) this.resizeObs.observe(stage);
        this.createIframe();
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.resizeObs) this.resizeObs.disconnect();
        this.destroyIframe();
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.closest('#dd-refresh')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('dd-refresh');
            if (btn) { btn.classList.add('is-spin'); setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('is-spin'), 900); }
            this.destroyIframe();
            this.createIframe();
            this.toast.info('Превью перезапущено.');
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#dd-off-show')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { deaths: { enabled: true } } });
            this.toast.success('Счётчик снова на экране.');
        }
    }

    createIframe() {
        if (this.iframe) return;
        const frame = document.getElementById('dd-stage-frame');
        if (!frame) return;
        this.loaded = false;
        const loading = document.getElementById('dd-stage-loading');
        if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');

        const f = document.createElement('iframe');
        f.id = 'dd-preview-iframe';
        f.className = 'dd-iframe';
        f.title = 'Превью счётчика смертей';
        f.setAttribute('scrolling', 'no');
        // Относительный путь: работает и в Electron (file://), и по http.
        f.src = `widgets/deaths/index.html?preview=1&cb=${Date.now()}`;
        f.onload = () => {
            if (this.iframe !== f) return;
            this.loaded = true;
            const l = document.getElementById('dd-stage-loading');
            if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            this.scale();
        };
        f.onerror = () => {
            if (this.iframe !== f) return;
            const l = document.getElementById('dd-stage-loading');
            if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            this.toast.error('Не удалось загрузить превью виджета.');
        };
        frame.appendChild(f);
        this.iframe = f;

        clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
        this.loadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (!this.loaded) {
                const l = document.getElementById('dd-stage-loading');
                if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            }
        }, 6000);

        this.scale();
    }

    destroyIframe() {
        clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
        if (this.iframe) {
            const f = this.iframe;
            this.iframe = null;
            try { f.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (e) {}
            f.remove();
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('iframe#dd-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
        this.loaded = false;
    }

    scale() {
        const stage = document.getElementById('dd-stage');
        if (!stage || !this.iframe) return;
        const s = Math.min(stage.clientWidth / WIDGET_W, stage.clientHeight / WIDGET_H) * 0.9;
        this.iframe.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${s.toFixed(4)})`;
    }

    evaluate(state) {
        const c = state.config.widgets.deaths || {};
        const enabled = c.enabled === true || String(c.enabled) === 'true';

        const stage = document.getElementById('dd-stage');
        if (stage) {
            stage.classList.toggle('is-off', !enabled);
            stage.style.setProperty('--stage-accent', String(c.color || '#ff0050'));
        }

        const off = document.getElementById('dd-stage-off');
        if (off) off.classList.toggle('is-hidden', enabled);

        const loading = document.getElementById('dd-stage-loading');
        if (loading && this.loaded) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');

        this.scale();
    }
}

                    <div class="dd-track"></div>
                </label>
                <div class="dd-slider ${soundOn ? '' : 'is-muted'}" id="dd-volume-row">
                    <span class="dd-slider-name">Громкость</span>
                    <input type="range" id="dd-volume" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="${volume}" style="--range-fill:${fill(volume, 0, 100)}%;" aria-label="Громкость звука смерти">
                    <span class="dd-slider-val" id="dd-volume-val">${volume}%</span>

--- START OF FILE widgets/deaths/dashboard/tuningPanel.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/deaths/dashboard/tuningPanel.js — v1 (8 живых параметров оформления и поведения) */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');
const BRAND_COLOR = '#ff0050';
const BRAND_COMBO = '#ff8c00';

async function copyText(text) {
    const value = String(text ?? '');
    if (!value) return false;
    try {
        if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
            return true;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[DeathsTuning] Clipboard API недоступен, пробую fallback:', e);
    }
    let ta = null;
    try {
        ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = value;
        ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
        ta.style.position = 'fixed';
        ta.style.top = '-1000px';
        ta.style.opacity = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(ta);
        ta.select();
        ta.setSelectionRange(0, value.length);
        return document.execCommand('copy');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[DeathsTuning] Копирование не удалось:', e);
        return false;
    } finally {
        if (ta && ta.parentNode) ta.remove();
    }
}

function toInt(v, d) { const n = parseInt(v, 10); return isNaN(n) ? d : n; }
function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

export class TuningPanel {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.inputHandler = null;
        this.changeHandler = null;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.chipTimers = new Map();
    }

    mount() {
        this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
        this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.root.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.inputHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        if (this.changeHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        for (const t of this.chipTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
        this.chipTimers.clear();
    }

    _set(patch) {
        try {
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { deaths: patch } });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[DeathsTuning] Не удалось сохранить настройку:', e);
            this.toast.error('Настройка не сохранилась.');
        }
    }

    _paint(input) {
        if (!input) return;
        const min = Number(input.min || 0);
        const max = Number(input.max || 100);
        const val = Number(input.value);
        const pct = max > min ? ((val - min) / (max - min)) * 100 : 0;
        input.style.setProperty('--range-fill', `${clamp(pct, 0, 100).toFixed(2)}%`);
    }

    _onInput(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.id === 'dd-font') {
            const v = clamp(toInt(t.value, 64), 24, 140);
            this._paint(t);
            const num = document.getElementById('dd-font-num');
            if (num && document.activeElement !== num) num.value = String(v);
            this._set({ fontSize: v });
            return;
        }
        if (t.id === 'dd-font-num') {
            if (t.value === '') return;
            const v = clamp(toInt(t.value, 64), 24, 140);
            const range = document.getElementById('dd-font');
            if (range) { range.value = String(v); this._paint(range); }
            this._set({ fontSize: v });
            return;
        }
        if (t.id === 'dd-shake') {
            const v = clamp(toInt(t.value, 100), 0, 100);
            this._paint(t);
            const lbl = document.getElementById('dd-shake-val');
            if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `${v}%`;
            this._set({ shakeIntensity: v });
            return;
        }
        if (t.id === 'dd-window') {
            const v = clamp(toInt(t.value, 8), 1, 60);
            this._paint(t);
            const num = document.getElementById('dd-window-num');
            if (num && document.activeElement !== num) num.value = String(v);
            this._set({ comboWindow: v });
            return;
        }
        if (t.id === 'dd-window-num') {
            if (t.value === '') return;
            const v = clamp(toInt(t.value, 8), 1, 60);
            const range = document.getElementById('dd-window');
            if (range) { range.value = String(Math.min(30, v)); this._paint(range); }
            this._set({ comboWindow: v });
            return;
        }
        if (t.id === 'dd-volume') {
            const v = clamp(toInt(t.value, 60), 0, 100);
            this._paint(t);
            const lbl = document.getElementById('dd-volume-val');
            if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `${v}%`;
            this._set({ soundVolume: v });
            return;
        }

        if (!t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-dd-key')) return;
        const key = t.getAttribute('data-dd-key');
        if (t.type === 'color') {
            const hex = document.getElementById(key === 'color' ? 'dd-color-hex' : 'dd-combo-hex');
            if (hex) hex.textContent = t.value;
            this._set({ [key]: t.value });
        } else if (t.type === 'text') {
            this._set({ [key]: t.value });
        }
    }

    _onChange(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.id === 'dd-font-num') { t.value = String(clamp(toInt(t.value, 64), 24, 140)); this._set({ fontSize: Number(t.value) }); return; }
        if (t.id === 'dd-window-num') { t.value = String(clamp(toInt(t.value, 8), 1, 60)); this._set({ comboWindow: Number(t.value) }); return; }
        if (t.type === 'checkbox' && t.hasAttribute('data-dd-key')) {
            const key = t.getAttribute('data-dd-key');
            if (key === 'enabled') return; // мастер-тумблер обрабатывает counterPanel
            this._set({ [key]: t.checked });
            if (key === 'soundEnabled') this.toast.show(t.checked ? 'Звук смерти включён.' : 'Звук смерти выключен.', t.checked ? 'success' : 'info');
        }
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        const chip = t.closest('.dd-chip');
        if (chip) { e.preventDefault(); this._copyChip(chip); return; }

        if (t.closest('#dd-color-brand')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this._set({ color: BRAND_COLOR });
            this.toast.info('Цвет счётчика возвращён к фирменному.');
            return;
        }
        if (t.closest('#dd-combo-brand')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this._set({ comboColor: BRAND_COMBO });
            this.toast.info('Цвет комбо возвращён к фирменному.');
            return;
        }

        const c = this.store.getState().config.widgets.deaths || {};
        const threshold = clamp(toInt(c.comboThreshold, 2), 2, 20);

        if (t.closest('#dd-th-minus')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (threshold <= 2) return;
            this._set({ comboThreshold: threshold - 1 });
            return;
        }
        if (t.closest('#dd-th-plus')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (threshold >= 20) return;
            this._set({ comboThreshold: threshold + 1 });
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#dd-widget-reset')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.store.resetWidgetToDefaults('deaths');
            this.toast.success('Настройки счётчика сброшены.');
        }
    }

    async _copyChip(chip) {
        const text = chip.getAttribute('data-copy') || '';
        const ok = await copyText(text);
        if (!ok) { this.toast.error(`Не удалось скопировать. Команда: ${text}`); return; }
        this.toast.success(`Скопировано: ${text}`);
        const iconEl = chip.querySelector('.dd-chip-ic');
        if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = ic('check');
        chip.classList.add('is-copied');
        const old = this.chipTimers.get(chip);
        if (old) clearTimeout(old);
        this.chipTimers.set(chip, setTimeout(() => {
            this.chipTimers.delete(chip);
            if (!chip.isConnected) return;
            chip.classList.remove('is-copied');
            const el = chip.querySelector('.dd-chip-ic');
            if (el) el.innerHTML = ic('copy');
        }, 1400));
    }

    render(state) {
        const c = state.config.widgets.deaths || {};
        const fontSize = clamp(toInt(c.fontSize, 64), 24, 140);
        const shake = clamp(toInt(c.shakeIntensity, 100), 0, 100);
        const win = clamp(toInt(c.comboWindow, 8), 1, 60);
        const threshold = clamp(toInt(c.comboThreshold, 2), 2, 20);
        const volume = clamp(toInt(c.soundVolume, 60), 0, 100);
        const soundOn = c.soundEnabled === undefined ? true : (c.soundEnabled === true || String(c.soundEnabled) === 'true');

        const pairs = [
            ['dd-font', 'dd-font-num', fontSize, 24, 140],
            ['dd-window', 'dd-window-num', win, 1, 30]
        ];
        pairs.forEach(([rangeId, numId, value, min, max]) => {
            const range = document.getElementById(rangeId);
            if (range && document.activeElement !== range) {
                const v = String(clamp(value, min, max));
                if (range.value !== v) range.value = v;
                this._paint(range);
            }
            const num = document.getElementById(numId);
            if (num && document.activeElement !== num && num.value !== String(value)) num.value = String(value);
        });

        const shakeEl = document.getElementById('dd-shake');
        if (shakeEl && document.activeElement !== shakeEl) {
            if (shakeEl.value !== String(shake)) shakeEl.value = String(shake);
            this._paint(shakeEl);
        }
        const shakeVal = document.getElementById('dd-shake-val');
        if (shakeVal) shakeVal.textContent = `${shake}%`;

        const volEl = document.getElementById('dd-volume');
        if (volEl && document.activeElement !== volEl) {
            if (volEl.value !== String(volume)) volEl.value = String(volume);
            this._paint(volEl);
        }
        const volVal = document.getElementById('dd-volume-val');
        if (volVal) volVal.textContent = `${volume}%`;
        const volRow = document.getElementById('dd-volume-row');
        if (volRow) volRow.classList.toggle('is-muted', !soundOn);
        if (volEl) volEl.disabled = !soundOn;

        const thVal = document.getElementById('dd-th-val');
        if (thVal) thVal.textContent = String(threshold);
        const thMinus = document.getElementById('dd-th-minus');
        const thPlus = document.getElementById('dd-th-plus');
        if (thMinus) thMinus.disabled = threshold <= 2;
        if (thPlus) thPlus.disabled = threshold >= 20;

        const colors = [
            ['dd-color', 'dd-color-hex', c.color || BRAND_COLOR],
            ['dd-combo-color', 'dd-combo-hex', c.comboColor || BRAND_COMBO]
        ];
        colors.forEach(([inputId, hexId, value]) => {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            if (input && document.activeElement !== input && input.value !== String(value)) input.value = String(value);
            const hex = document.getElementById(hexId);
            if (hex && hex.textContent !== String(value)) hex.textContent = String(value);
        });

        this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-dd-key]').forEach(input => {
            const key = input.getAttribute('data-dd-key');
            if (key === 'enabled' || key === 'color' || key === 'comboColor') return;
            const val = c[key];
            if (val === undefined || document.activeElement === input) return;
            if (input.type === 'checkbox') {
                const checked = val === true || String(val) === 'true';
                if (input.checked !== checked) input.checked = checked;
            } else if (input.type === 'text') {
                if (input.value !== String(val)) input.value = String(val);
            }
        });
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/emotes/script.js ---

import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';

const AppEmotes = {
    container: document.getElementById('emotes-container'),
    mode: "bubble",
    enabled: true,
    activeEmotesCount: 0, 
    MAX_GLOBAL_EMOTES: 100, 
    maxSpawnPerMsg: 20,

    applyConfig: function(config) {
        if (config.mode) this.mode = config.mode;
        if (config.enabled !== undefined) this.enabled = String(config.enabled) === 'true';
        if (config.maxEmotes) this.maxSpawnPerMsg = parseInt(config.maxEmotes) || 20;
    },

    spawn: function(emotesList) {
        if (!this.enabled || !emotesList || emotesList.length === 0 || !this.container) return;
        if (this.activeEmotesCount >= this.MAX_GLOBAL_EMOTES) return;

        let spawned = 0;
        let delayIndex = 0;
        const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

        for (let emote of emotesList) {
            for (let i = 0; i < emote.count; i++) {
                if (spawned >= this.maxSpawnPerMsg || this.activeEmotesCount >= this.MAX_GLOBAL_EMOTES) break;
                this.createEmoteDOM(emote.url, delayIndex, fragment);
                spawned++;
                delayIndex++;
            }
            if (spawned >= this.maxSpawnPerMsg || this.activeEmotesCount >= this.MAX_GLOBAL_EMOTES) break;
        }
        
        this.container.appendChild(fragment);
    },

    createEmoteDOM: function(url, delayIndex, fragment) {
        this.activeEmotesCount++;
        const wrap = document.createElement('div');
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.src = url;

        const staggerDelay = delayIndex * (0.05 + Math.random() * 0.03); 
        let fallBackDestroyTime = 0;
        
        if (this.mode === 'bubble') {
            wrap.className = 'emote-bubble';
            const size = Math.random(); 
            const scale = 0.5 + size * 1.5; 
            const duration = 5 + (1 - size) * 5; 
            
            let blur = '0px';
            if (size > 0.85) blur = `${(size - 0.8) * 20}px`; 
            else if (size < 0.2) blur = '2px'; 
            
            const xPos = 5 + Math.random() * 90; 
            const swayDir = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1; 
            
            wrap.style.left = `${xPos}%`;
            wrap.style.animationDelay = `${staggerDelay}s`;
            wrap.style.setProperty('--e-dur', `${duration}s`);
            
            img.style.setProperty('--e-blur', blur);
            img.style.setProperty('--e-scale', scale);
            img.style.setProperty('--e-dir', swayDir);
            wrap.appendChild(img);
            
            fallBackDestroyTime = (duration + staggerDelay + 1) * 1000;
        } 
        else if (this.mode === 'fountain') {
            wrap.className = 'emote-fountain-x';
            img.className = 'emote-fountain-y';
            
            const dir = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
            const distanceX = (100 + Math.random() * 600) * dir; 
            const peakY = -300 - Math.random() * 600; 
            const rot = (Math.random() * 720 - 360); 
            const scale = 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.2; 
            
            const startOffsetX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100;
            wrap.style.left = `calc(50% + ${startOffsetX}px)`;
            wrap.style.animationDelay = `${staggerDelay}s`;
            img.style.animationDelay = `${staggerDelay}s`;
            
            wrap.style.setProperty('--f-x', `${distanceX}px`);
            img.style.setProperty('--f-y', `${peakY}px`);
            img.style.setProperty('--f-rot', `${rot}deg`);
            img.style.setProperty('--f-scale', scale);
            wrap.appendChild(img);
            
            fallBackDestroyTime = (3 + staggerDelay + 1) * 1000;
        }

        fragment.appendChild(wrap);

        let isDestroyed = false;
        const destroyEmote = () => {
            if (isDestroyed) return;
            isDestroyed = true;
            img.src = ''; 
            wrap.remove();
            this.activeEmotesCount--;
            if (this.activeEmotesCount < 0) this.activeEmotesCount = 0;
        };

        wrap.addEventListener('animationend', (e) => {
            if (e.target === wrap) destroyEmote();
        });

        setTimeout(destroyEmote, fallBackDestroyTime);
    }
};

// ==========================================
// ПОДКЛЮЧЕНИЕ ЯДРА WIDGET CORE
// ==========================================
WidgetCore.init({
    onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
        if (config.widgets?.emotes) AppEmotes.applyConfig(config.widgets.emotes);
    },

    onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => {
        if (cmd === '!emotes' || cmd === '!смайлы') {
            const arg = args[0];
            let newEmotesConf = { ...(WidgetCore.globalConfig.widgets.emotes || {}) };
            let changed = false;

            if (['bubble', 'fountain'].includes(arg)) {
                newEmotesConf.mode = arg;
                changed = true;
            } else if (['on', 'off'].includes(arg)) {
                newEmotesConf.enabled = (arg === 'on') ? 'true' : 'false';
                changed = true;
            }
            
            if (changed) {
                WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('emotes', newEmotesConf);
            }
        }
    },

    onTwitchMessage: (tags, message) => {
        // Ядро само вытаскивает все нативные и сторонние смайлы в готовый массив [{ url, count }]
        const extractedEmotes = WidgetCore.getEmotesFromMessage(message, tags.emotes);
        AppEmotes.spawn(extractedEmotes);
    },

    onWidgetAction: (action, payload) => {
        if (action === 'TEST_EMOTES') {
            // Тестовые смайлы из лаунчера
            AppEmotes.spawn([
                { url: 'https://static-cdn.jtvnw.net/emoticons/v2/25/default/dark/3.0', count: 2 },
                { url: 'https://cdn.7tv.app/emote/60ae3e54259ac5a73e56c426/2x.webp', count: 1 }
            ]);
        }
    }
});
