const titleEl = document.getElementById('title-el');
const subtitleEl = document.getElementById('subtitle-el');

function applyConfig(config) {
  if (!config || !config.widgets || !config.widgets.endscreen) return;
  const endConfig = config.widgets.endscreen;

  // Разрешаем использование HTML тега <br> для переноса строк
  if (endConfig.title !== undefined) {
    titleEl.innerHTML = endConfig.title;
  }
  
  if (endConfig.subtitle !== undefined) {
    subtitleEl.innerHTML = endConfig.subtitle;
  }
  
  if (endConfig.accentPink) document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent-pink', endConfig.accentPink);
  if (endConfig.accentGreen) document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent-green', endConfig.accentGreen);
}

function connectWS() {
  const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:42069');
  
  ws.onmessage = (event) => {
    try {
      const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
      if (message.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED') {
        applyConfig(message.data);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Ошибка WebSocket (EndScreen):', e);
    }
  };
  
  ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(connectWS, 3000);
}

// Первичная загрузка
fetch('http://localhost:42069/api/config')
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(config => {
    applyConfig(config);
    connectWS();
  })
  .catch(() => connectWS());

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/frame/script.js — v2 (телеметрия FRAME_STATE + чат-команды рамки и лисы) */
import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';

const PARAMS = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const IS_PREVIEW = PARAMS.get('preview') === '1';
const SOURCE = IS_PREVIEW ? 'preview' : 'obs';
const HEARTBEAT_MS = 4000;

const frameContainer = document.getElementById('webcam-container');

function isTrue(v) { return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }
function normalizeHex(value, fallback) {
let h = String(value ?? '').trim();
if (!h) return fallback;
if (!h.startsWith('#')) h = '#' + h;
if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(h)) h = '#' + h.slice(1).split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
return /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(h) ? h.toLowerCase() : fallback;
}
function clampInt(value, min, max, fallback) {
const n = parseInt(value, 10);
if (isNaN(n)) return fallback;
return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));
}
function splitList(value) {
return String(value ?? '').split(',').map(s => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
}

const AppPet = {
container: document.getElementById('pet-container'),
baseStack: ['idle'],
activeState: null,
currentPriority: 0,
savedState: null,
particleInterval: null,
emotionTimeout: null,
sleepTimer: null,
onStateChange: null,
priorities: {
'angry': 10, 'scared': 9, 'nom': 8,
'love': 5, 'greet': 4, 'bye': 4, 'alert': 3, 'hype': 1
},
config: { enabled: true, sleepTimeout: 120, feedRewardName: "Покормить лису", vipUsers: [], forbiddenWords: [] },
init: function() {
this.resetSleepTimer();
window.addEventListener('click', () => this.wakeUp());
},
updateConfig: function(petConf) {
if (!petConf) return;
this.config.enabled = petConf.enabled !== false && String(petConf.enabled) !== 'false';
if (this.container) {
if (this.config.enabled) this.container.classList.remove('hidden');
else this.container.classList.add('hidden');
}
this.config.sleepTimeout = clampInt(petConf.sleepTimeout, 5, 3600, 120);
if (petConf.feedRewardName !== undefined) {
this.config.feedRewardName = String(petConf.feedRewardName || '').trim() || "Покормить лису";
}
if (petConf.vipUsers !== undefined) this.config.vipUsers = splitList(petConf.vipUsers);
if (petConf.forbiddenWords !== undefined) this.config.forbiddenWords = splitList(petConf.forbiddenWords);
this.resetSleepTimer();
this.notify();
},
notify: function() {
if (typeof this.onStateChange === 'function') {
try { this.onStateChange(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[Frame] onStateChange:', e); }
}
},
/** Текущее видимое состояние лисы (для телеметрии дашборда). */
currentState: function() {
if (!this.config.enabled) return 'off';
return this.activeState || this.baseStack[this.baseStack.length - 1] || 'idle';
},
setBaseState: function(state, active) {
if (active) {
if (!this.baseStack.includes(state)) this.baseStack.push(state);
} else {
this.baseStack = this.baseStack.filter(s => s !== state);
}
if (this.baseStack.length === 0) this.baseStack.push('idle');
if (!this.activeState) this.applyVisualState(this.baseStack[this.baseStack.length - 1]);
this.notify();
},
setEmotion: function(state, durationMs = 0) {
if (!this.container || !this.config.enabled) return;
this.resetSleepTimer();
const incomingPriority = this.priorities[state] || 1;
if (this.activeState && incomingPriority <= this.currentPriority) return;
if (this.activeState && this.savedState === null && this.emotionTimeout) {
this.savedState = { emotion: this.activeState, priority: this.currentPriority, timeLeft: 2000 };
}
clearTimeout(this.emotionTimeout);
this.activeState = state;
this.currentPriority = incomingPriority;
this.applyVisualState(state);
if (durationMs > 0) {
this.emotionTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
if (this.savedState) {
const nextState = this.savedState;
this.savedState = null;
this.activeState = null;
this.currentPriority = 0;
this.setEmotion(nextState.emotion, nextState.timeLeft);
} else {
this.activeState = null;
this.currentPriority = 0;
this.applyVisualState(this.baseStack[this.baseStack.length - 1]);
}
}, durationMs);
}
},
applyVisualState: function(state) {
clearInterval(this.particleInterval);
this.container.className = '';
this.container.classList.add(`state-${state}`);
// Класс hidden не должен слетать при смене состояния выключенной лисы.
if (!this.config.enabled) this.container.classList.add('hidden');
if (state === 'sleep') this.particleInterval = setInterval(() => this.spawnParticle('Z', 'part-zzz', 60, 50), 800);
if (state === 'alert') this.spawnParticle('!', 'part-alert', 55, 10);
if (state === 'love') this.particleInterval = setInterval(() => this.spawnParticle('❤', 'part-heart', 50 + Math.random()*20, 20), 400);
if (state === 'greet') this.particleInterval = setInterval(() => this.spawnParticle('👋', 'part-greet', 50 + Math.random()*15, 20), 600);
if (state === 'bye') this.particleInterval = setInterval(() => this.spawnParticle('💜', 'part-bye', 50 + Math.random()*15, 20), 800);
if (state === 'jam') this.particleInterval = setInterval(() => this.spawnParticle('🎵', 'part-note', 45 + Math.random()*25, 10), 600);
if (state === 'listen') this.particleInterval = setInterval(() => this.spawnParticle('?', 'part-question', 60 + Math.random()*10, 10), 1500);
if (state === 'nom') {
this.particleInterval = setInterval(() => {
const icon = Math.random() > 0.5 ? '🍪' : '✨';
this.spawnParticle(icon, 'part-cookie', 80, 40);
}, 300);
}
this.notify();
},
wakeUp: function() {
if (this.baseStack.includes('sleep')) {
this.setBaseState('sleep', false);
this.setEmotion('alert', 2000);
}
this.resetSleepTimer();
},
resetSleepTimer: function() {
clearTimeout(this.sleepTimer);
if (this.baseStack.includes('sleep')) this.setBaseState('sleep', false);
this.sleepTimer = setTimeout(() => {
if (this.baseStack[this.baseStack.length - 1] === 'idle' && !this.activeState) {
this.setBaseState('sleep', true);
}
}, this.config.sleepTimeout * 1000);
},
spawnParticle: function(text, cssClass, leftOffset, topOffset) {
if (!this.container) return;
const p = document.createElement('div');
p.innerText = text;
p.className = `pet-particle ${cssClass}`;
p.style.left = `${leftOffset + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20}px`;
p.style.top = `${topOffset}px`;
this.container.appendChild(p);
setTimeout(() => p.remove(), 2000);
}
};

const AppFrame = {
color1: '#00ff66',
color2: '#ff007f',
visible: true,
_lastReport: 0,
_reportTimer: null,
apply: function(conf) {
if (!conf || !frameContainer) return;
if (conf.color1 !== undefined) this.color1 = normalizeHex(conf.color1, this.color1);
if (conf.color2 !== undefined) this.color2 = normalizeHex(conf.color2, this.color2);
if (conf.isVisible !== undefined) this.visible = isTrue(conf.isVisible);
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--color-1', this.color1);
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--color-2', this.color2);
frameContainer.style.opacity = this.visible ? '1' : '0';
this.report();
},
report: function(force) {
const now = Date.now();
if (!force && now - this._lastReport < 300) {
if (this._reportTimer) return;
this._reportTimer = setTimeout(() => {
this._reportTimer = null;
this.report(true);
}, 320);
return;
}
this._lastReport = now;
WidgetCore.sendAction('FRAME_STATE', {
source: SOURCE,
visible: this.visible,
color1: this.color1,
color2: this.color2,
petEnabled: AppPet.config.enabled,
petState: AppPet.currentState(),
ts: now
});
},
handleAction: function(action) {
if (action === 'FRAME_REQUEST_STATE') this.report(true);
},
handleChat: function(cmd, args) {
// Команды приходят и мастеру, и слейвам через шину — пишет только мастер.
if (!WidgetCore.isMaster) return false;
if (cmd === '!color1' || cmd === '!color2') {
const hex = normalizeHex(args[0], null);
if (!hex) return false;
const key = cmd === '!color1' ? 'color1' : 'color2';
WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('frame', { [key]: hex });
console.log(`[Frame] ${cmd} → ${hex}`);
return true;
}
if (cmd === '!frame') {
const conf = WidgetCore.globalConfig?.widgets?.frame || {};
const cur = conf.isVisible === undefined ? true : isTrue(conf.isVisible);
const arg = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
const next = arg === 'on' || arg === 'show' ? true : (arg === 'off' || arg === 'hide' ? false : !cur);
WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('frame', { isVisible: next });
console.log(`[Frame] !frame → ${next ? 'видна' : 'скрыта'}`);
return true;
}
if (cmd === '!peton') {
const conf = WidgetCore.globalConfig?.widgets?.pet || {};
const cur = conf.enabled === undefined ? true : isTrue(conf.enabled);
const arg = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
const next = arg === 'on' ? true : (arg === 'off' ? false : !cur);
WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('pet', { enabled: next });
console.log(`[Frame] !peton → ${next}`);
return true;
}
if (cmd === '!petsleep') {
const value = clampInt(args[0], 5, 3600, NaN);
if (isNaN(value)) return false;
WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('pet', { sleepTimeout: value });
console.log(`[Frame] !petsleep → ${value}s`);
return true;
}
if (cmd === '!petfeed' || cmd === '!petvip' || cmd === '!petban') {
const text = (args || []).join(' ').trim();
const key = cmd === '!petfeed' ? 'feedRewardName' : (cmd === '!petvip' ? 'vipUsers' : 'forbiddenWords');
WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('pet', { [key]: text });
console.log(`[Frame] ${cmd} → ${text || 'очищено'}`);
return true;
}
return false;
}
};

AppPet.onStateChange = () => AppFrame.report();
AppPet.init();

// Интеграция с Ядром
WidgetCore.init({
onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
if (config.widgets?.frame) AppFrame.apply(config.widgets.frame);
if (config.widgets?.pet) AppPet.updateConfig(config.widgets.pet);
AppFrame.report();
},
onTwitchMessage: (tags, message) => {
if (!AppPet.config.enabled) return;
const isMod = tags.mod || (tags.badges && tags.badges.broadcaster === '1');
const msgLow = message.trim().toLowerCase();
const userLow = (tags['display-name'] || tags.username).toLowerCase();
const hasForbidden = AppPet.config.forbiddenWords.some(w => w && msgLow.includes(w));
if (hasForbidden) {
AppPet.setEmotion('angry', 4000);
return;
}
if (tags['custom-reward-id']) {
AppPet.setEmotion('hype', 3000);
return;
}
if (AppPet.config.vipUsers.includes(userLow) || isMod) AppPet.setEmotion('love', 4000);
else if (tags.emotes) AppPet.setEmotion('hype', 4000);
AppPet.resetSleepTimer();
},
onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => {
if (AppFrame.handleChat(cmd, args)) return;
if (!AppPet.config.enabled) return;
if (cmd === '!fox' || cmd === '!лиса' || cmd === '!лис') {
const action = args[0]?.toLowerCase();
const states = ['idle', 'sleep', 'alert', 'hype', 'love', 'scared', 'angry', 'greet', 'bye', 'jam', 'listen', 'nom'];
if (states.includes(action)) AppPet.setEmotion(action, 5000);
else if (action === "кусь" || action === "ням") AppPet.setEmotion('nom', 5000);
else if (action === "привет") AppPet.setEmotion('greet', 5000);
else if (action === "пока") AppPet.setEmotion('bye', 5000);
else if (action === "танцуй" || action === "вайб") AppPet.setEmotion('jam', 5000);
}
},
onWidgetAction: (action, payload) => {
AppFrame.handleAction(action);
if (action === 'PET_BASE_STATE') AppPet.setBaseState(payload.state, payload.active);
if (action === 'PET_EMOTION') AppPet.setEmotion(payload.emotion, payload.duration);
}
});

setInterval(() => AppFrame.report(true), HEARTBEAT_MS);
setTimeout(() => AppFrame.report(true), 600);
console.log(`[Frame] v2 инициализирован (${SOURCE})`);

export function isTrue(v) { return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }

export function normalizeHex(value, fallback) {
let h = String(value ?? '').trim();
if (!h) return fallback;
if (!h.startsWith('#')) h = '#' + h;
if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(h)) h = '#' + h.slice(1).split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
return /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(h) ? h.toLowerCase() : fallback;
}

export function clampInt(value, min, max, fallback) {
const n = parseInt(value, 10);
if (isNaN(n)) return fallback;
return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));
}

export function splitList(value) {
return String(value ?? '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

export function setText(id, value) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
const next = String(value);
if (el && el.textContent !== next) el.textContent = next;
}

export function paintRange(input) {
if (!input) return;
const min = Number(input.min || 0);
const max = Number(input.max || 100);
const val = Number(input.value);
const pct = max > min ? ((val - min) / (max - min)) * 100 : 0;
input.style.setProperty('--range-fill', `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct)).toFixed(2)}%`);
}

export function frameOf(state) { return state.config.widgets.frame || {}; }
export function petOf(state) { return state.config.widgets.pet || {}; }

export function frameVisible(conf) {
return conf.isVisible === undefined ? true : isTrue(conf.isVisible);
}
export function petEnabled(conf) {
return conf.enabled === undefined ? true : isTrue(conf.enabled);
}

/** Случайная неоновая пара: два разнесённых по кругу оттенка. */
export function randomPair() {
const h1 = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360);
const h2 = (h1 + 120 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)) % 360;
const toHex = (h) => {
const s = 0.92, l = 0.55;
const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l);
const f = (n) => {
const k = (n + h / 30) % 12;
const c = l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k - 3, Math.min(9 - k, 1)));
return Math.round(255 * c).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
};
return `#${f(0)}${f(8)}${f(4)}`;
};
return { c1: toHex(h1), c2: toHex(h2) };
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/frame/dashboard/Dashboard.js — v1 (оркестратор: CSS-first, живой сигнал, статус, жизненный цикл) */
import { store } from '../../../js/store.js';
import { Toast } from '../../../js/components/toast.js';
import { renderTemplate } from './template.js';
import { StageController } from './stage.js';
import { FramePanel } from './framePanel.js';
import { PetPanel } from './petPanel.js';
import {
CSS_FILES, CSS_TIMEOUT, LIVE_TTL, BRAND_1, BRAND_2, EMOTION_LABELS,
normalizeHex, setText, frameOf, petOf, frameVisible, petEnabled
} from './constants.js';

export default { render: renderTemplate, preload, mount, onParamsChange, unmount };

let ctx = null;
let cssPromise = null;

/* ---------- стили: параллельные <link>, идемпотентно, никогда не реджектится ---------- */
function loadOneCss({ id, href }) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const existing = document.getElementById(id);
if (existing) {
if (existing.dataset.loaded === '1') { resolve(true); return; }
existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(true), { once: true });
existing.addEventListener('error', () => resolve(false), { once: true });
return;
}
const link = document.createElement('link');
link.id = id;
link.rel = 'stylesheet';
link.href = href;
link.dataset.loaded = '0';
link.onload = () => { link.dataset.loaded = '1'; resolve(true); };
link.onerror = () => {
console.error(`[FrameDash:css] Файл стиля не загрузился: ${href}`);
link.remove();
resolve(false);
};
document.head.appendChild(link);
});
}

function preload() {
if (cssPromise) return cssPromise;
const t0 = performance.now();
console.log('[FrameDash:css] preload: параллельная загрузка стилей...');
const loadAll = Promise.all(CSS_FILES.map(loadOneCss)).then((results) => {
const ok = results.every(Boolean);
if (ok) console.log(`[FrameDash:css] Стили готовы за ${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}мс`);
else console.warn('[FrameDash:css] Часть стилей недоступна — возможен деградированный вид.');
return ok;
});
let guardTimer = null;
const guard = new Promise((resolve) => {
guardTimer = setTimeout(() => {
console.warn(`[FrameDash:css] Таймаут ${CSS_TIMEOUT}мс — рендерим без ожидания стилей.`);
resolve(false);
}, CSS_TIMEOUT);
});
cssPromise = Promise.race([loadAll, guard]).then((ok) => {
if (guardTimer) { clearTimeout(guardTimer); guardTimer = null; }
if (!ok) cssPromise = null;
return ok;
});
return cssPromise;
}

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function pickLive() {
if (!ctx) return null;
const now = Date.now();
const { obs, preview } = ctx.live;
if (obs && now - obs.ts < LIVE_TTL) return obs;
if (preview && now - preview.ts < LIVE_TTL) return preview;
return null;
}

function setBadge(id, cls, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (!el) return;
el.className = `fd-badge ${cls}`;
el.innerHTML = `<span class="fd-badge-dot"></span>${text}`;
}

function renderStatus(state, live) {
const f = frameOf(state);
const p = petOf(state);
const visible = frameVisible(f);
const on = petEnabled(p);
const online = Boolean(state.serverOnline);
const c1 = normalizeHex(f.color1, BRAND_1);
const c2 = normalizeHex(f.color2, BRAND_2);

setBadge('fd-badge-server', online ? 'fd-badge-live' : 'fd-badge-off', online ? 'СЕРВЕР ONLINE' : 'СЕРВЕР OFFLINE');
setBadge('fd-badge-state', visible ? 'fd-badge-live' : 'fd-badge-warn', visible ? 'НА ЭКРАНЕ' : 'СКРЫТА');
setBadge('fd-badge-source',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'fd-badge-live' : 'fd-badge-info') : 'fd-badge-off',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ OBS' : 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ ПРЕВЬЮ') : 'НЕТ СИГНАЛА');
setBadge('fd-badge-pet', on ? 'fd-badge-info' : 'fd-badge-off', on ? 'ЛИСА ВКЛ' : 'ЛИСА ВЫКЛ');

const swatch = document.getElementById('fd-now-swatch');
if (swatch) swatch.style.background = `linear-gradient(135deg, ${c1}, ${c2})`;
setText('fd-now-title', visible ? 'Рамка видна на стриме' : 'Рамка скрыта вместе с лисой');
setText('fd-now-hex', `${c1} → ${c2}`);

const petState = live ? live.petState : (on ? 'idle' : 'off');
const label = on ? (EMOTION_LABELS[petState] || petState) : 'выключена';
setText('fd-now-pet', `ЛИСА: ${String(label).toUpperCase()}`);
setText('fd-now-source', live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'OBS STUDIO' : 'ПРЕВЬЮ') : 'НЕТ СИГНАЛА');

const now = document.getElementById('fd-now');
if (now) {
now.classList.toggle('is-off', !visible);
now.style.setProperty('--now-1', c1);
now.style.setProperty('--now-2', c2);
}
const petChip = document.getElementById('fd-now-pet');
if (petChip) petChip.classList.toggle('is-off', !on);
}

function evaluate() {
if (!ctx) return;
try {
const state = store.getState();
const live = pickLive();
renderStatus(state, live);
ctx.stage.evaluate(state, live);
ctx.frame.render(state);
ctx.pet.render(state, live);
} catch (e) {
console.error('[FrameDash] evaluate провален:', e);
}
}

/* ---------- жизненный цикл ---------- */
function mount(params, state) {
const root = document.getElementById('fd-main');
if (!root) return;
unmount();
// V2-вью уже дождалась preload() — здесь мгновенный no-op (страховка для прямого монтажа).
preload();
const toast = new Toast(document.getElementById('fd-toasts'), { className: 'fd-toast' });
ctx = {
root,
toast,
stage: new StageController({ root, store, toast }),
frame: new FramePanel({ root, store, toast }),
pet: new PetPanel({ root, store, toast }),
live: { obs: null, preview: null },
unsub: null,
unsubAction: null,
tick: null
};
ctx.stage.mount();
ctx.frame.mount();
ctx.pet.mount();
ctx.unsub = store.subscribe(() => evaluate());
ctx.unsubAction = store.onAction((action, payload) => {
if (!ctx || action !== 'FRAME_STATE' || !payload) return;
const source = payload.source === 'obs' ? 'obs' : 'preview';
ctx.live[source] = {
source,
visible: payload.visible !== false,
color1: normalizeHex(payload.color1, BRAND_1),
color2: normalizeHex(payload.color2, BRAND_2),
petEnabled: payload.petEnabled !== false,
petState: String(payload.petState || 'idle'),
ts: Number(payload.ts || Date.now())
};
evaluate();
});
ctx.tick = setInterval(() => evaluate(), 2500);
evaluate();
store.broadcastAction('FRAME_REQUEST_STATE', {});
console.log('[FrameDash] v1 смонтирован', params);
}

function onParamsChange(params) {
if (!ctx) return false;
return (params?.id || 'player') === 'frame';
}

function unmount() {
if (!ctx) return;
console.log('[FrameDash] Размонтирование');
if (ctx.unsub) ctx.unsub();
if (ctx.unsubAction) ctx.unsubAction();
if (ctx.tick) clearInterval(ctx.tick);
ctx.stage.unmount();
ctx.frame.unmount();
ctx.pet.unmount();
ctx = null;
// Стили (fd-css-*) намеренно остаются в <head> — кэш между вкладками против FOUC.
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#fd-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/frame/dashboard/framePanel.js — v1 (цвета, пресеты,.swap/random, чипы команд) */
import {
ic, PRESETS, BRAND_1, BRAND_2, normalizeHex, randomPair,
frameOf, frameVisible, setText
} from './constants.js';
import { copyText } from '../../../js/utils/clipboard.js';

export class FramePanel {
constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
this.root = root;
this.store = store;
this.toast = toast;
this.inputHandler = null;
this.changeHandler = null;
this.clickHandler = null;
this.chipTimers = new Map();
}
mount() {
this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
this.root.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
this.root.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
console.log('[FrameDash:frame] смонтирован');
}
unmount() {
if (this.inputHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
if (this.changeHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
for (const t of this.chipTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
this.chipTimers.clear();
}
_scoped(t) { return Boolean(t && t.closest && t.closest('[data-fd-scope="frame"]')); }
_conf() { return frameOf(this.store.getState()); }
_set(patch) {
try {
this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { frame: patch } });
return true;
} catch (e) {
console.error('[FrameDash:frame] Настройка не сохранилась:', e);
this.toast.error('Настройка не сохранилась.');
return false;
}
}
_onInput(e) {
const t = e.target;
if (!this._scoped(t) || !t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-fd-key')) return;
if (t.type !== 'color') return;
const key = t.getAttribute('data-fd-key');
if (key !== 'color1' && key !== 'color2') return;
this._set({ [key]: t.value });
setText(key === 'color1' ? 'fd-hex-1' : 'fd-hex-2', t.value);
}
_onChange(e) {
const t = e.target;
if (!this._scoped(t) || t.type !== 'checkbox') return;
if (t.getAttribute('data-fd-key') !== 'isVisible') return;
this._set({ isVisible: t.checked });
this.toast.show(
t.checked ? 'Рамка показана на стриме.' : 'Рамка скрыта — лиса скрыта вместе с ней.',
t.checked ? 'success' : 'info'
);
}
_onClick(e) {
const t = e.target;
const chip = t.closest && t.closest('.fd-chip');
if (chip && this._scoped(chip)) {
e.preventDefault();
this._copyChip(chip);
return;
}
const btn = t.closest && t.closest('[data-fd-act]');
if (!btn || !this._scoped(btn)) return;
const act = btn.getAttribute('data-fd-act');
const arg = btn.getAttribute('data-arg');
const c = this._conf();
const c1 = normalizeHex(c.color1, BRAND_1);
const c2 = normalizeHex(c.color2, BRAND_2);
switch (act) {
case 'preset': {
e.preventDefault();
const pr = PRESETS.find(x => x.id === arg);
if (!pr) return;
if (this._set({ color1: pr.c1, color2: pr.c2 })) {
btn.classList.remove('is-picked');
void btn.offsetWidth;
btn.classList.add('is-picked');
this.toast.success(`Градиент «${pr.title}» применён.`);
}
return;
}
case 'swap':
e.preventDefault();
if (this._set({ color1: c2, color2: c1 })) this.toast.info('Цвета поменялись местами.');
return;
case 'random': {
e.preventDefault();
const pair = randomPair();
if (this._set(pair)) this.toast.success(`Случайный градиент: ${pair.c1} → ${pair.c2}`);
return;
}
case 'brand1':
e.preventDefault();
if (this._set({ color1: BRAND_1 })) this.toast.info('Цвет 1 возвращён к фирменному.');
return;
case 'brand2':
e.preventDefault();
if (this._set({ color2: BRAND_2 })) this.toast.info('Цвет 2 возвращён к фирменному.');
return;
case 'reset-frame':
e.preventDefault();
this.store.resetWidgetToDefaults('frame');
this.toast.success('Настройки рамки сброшены.');
return;
default:
return;
}
}
async _copyChip(chip) {
const text = chip.getAttribute('data-copy') || '';
const ok = await copyText(text);
if (!ok) { this.toast.error(`Не удалось скопировать. Команда: ${text}`); return; }
this.toast.success(`Скопировано: ${text}`);
const iconEl = chip.querySelector('.fd-chip-ic');
if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = ic('check');
chip.classList.add('is-copied');
const old = this.chipTimers.get(chip);
if (old) clearTimeout(old);
this.chipTimers.set(chip, setTimeout(() => {
this.chipTimers.delete(chip);
if (!chip.isConnected) return;
chip.classList.remove('is-copied');
const el = chip.querySelector('.fd-chip-ic');
if (el) el.innerHTML = ic('copy');
}, 1400));
}
render(state) {
const c = frameOf(state);
const c1 = normalizeHex(c.color1, BRAND_1);
const c2 = normalizeHex(c.color2, BRAND_2);
const visible = frameVisible(c);
const pairs = [['fd-color-1', 'fd-hex-1', c1], ['fd-color-2', 'fd-hex-2', c2]];
pairs.forEach(([inputId, hexId, value]) => {
const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
if (input && document.activeElement !== input && input.value !== value) input.value = value;
setText(hexId, value);
});
const master = document.getElementById('fd-master');
if (master && document.activeElement !== master && master.checked !== visible) master.checked = visible;
const bar = document.getElementById('fd-gradient');
if (bar) {
bar.style.setProperty('--g1', c1);
bar.style.setProperty('--g2', c2);
}
this.root.querySelectorAll('.fd-preset').forEach(btn => {
const pr = PRESETS.find(x => x.id === btn.getAttribute('data-arg'));
const on = Boolean(pr) && pr.c1.toLowerCase() === c1 && pr.c2.toLowerCase() === c2;
btn.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
});
}
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/frame/dashboard/petPanel.js — v1 (тумблер, эмоции, таймаут сна, VIP и бан-слова) */
import {
ic, EMOTIONS, EMOTION_LABELS, SLEEP_MIN, SLEEP_MAX, SLEEP_RANGE_MAX,
DUR_MIN, DUR_MAX, clampInt, splitList, paintRange, setText, petOf, petEnabled
} from './constants.js';
import { copyText } from '../../../js/utils/clipboard.js';

export class PetPanel {
constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
this.root = root;
this.store = store;
this.toast = toast;
this.duration = 5;
this.inputHandler = null;
this.changeHandler = null;
this.clickHandler = null;
this.chipTimers = new Map();
this.fireTimers = new Map();
}
mount() {
this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
this.root.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
this.root.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
this._syncDuration();
console.log('[FrameDash:pet] смонтирован');
}
unmount() {
if (this.inputHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
if (this.changeHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
for (const t of this.chipTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
this.chipTimers.clear();
for (const t of this.fireTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
this.fireTimers.clear();
}
_scoped(t) { return Boolean(t && t.closest && t.closest('[data-fd-scope="pet"]')); }
_conf() { return petOf(this.store.getState()); }
_set(patch) {
try {
this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { pet: patch } });
return true;
} catch (e) {
console.error('[FrameDash:pet] Настройка не сохранилась:', e);
this.toast.error('Настройка не сохранилась.');
return false;
}
}
_syncDuration() {
setText('fd-dur-val', this.duration);
const minus = document.getElementById('fd-dur-minus');
const plus = document.getElementById('fd-dur-plus');
if (minus) minus.disabled = this.duration <= DUR_MIN;
if (plus) plus.disabled = this.duration >= DUR_MAX;
}
_onInput(e) {
const t = e.target;
if (!this._scoped(t)) return;
if (t.id === 'fd-sleep') {
const value = clampInt(t.value, SLEEP_MIN, SLEEP_MAX, 120);
paintRange(t);
const num = document.getElementById('fd-sleep-num');
if (num && document.activeElement !== num) num.value = String(value);
this._set({ sleepTimeout: value });
return;
}
if (t.id === 'fd-sleep-num') {
if (t.value === '') return;
const value = clampInt(t.value, SLEEP_MIN, SLEEP_MAX, 120);
const range = document.getElementById('fd-sleep');
if (range) { range.value = String(Math.min(SLEEP_RANGE_MAX, value)); paintRange(range); }
this._set({ sleepTimeout: value });
return;
}
if (!t.hasAttribute('data-fd-key')) return;
const key = t.getAttribute('data-fd-key');
if (key === 'enabled') return;
if (t.type === 'text' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
this._set({ [key]: t.value });
if (key === 'vipUsers') setText('fd-vip-count', splitList(t.value).length);
if (key === 'forbiddenWords') setText('fd-ban-count', splitList(t.value).length);
}
}
_onChange(e) {
const t = e.target;
if (!this._scoped(t)) return;
if (t.id === 'fd-sleep-num') {
const value = clampInt(t.value, SLEEP_MIN, SLEEP_MAX, 120);
t.value = String(value);
this._set({ sleepTimeout: value });
return;
}
if (t.type === 'checkbox' && t.getAttribute('data-fd-key') === 'enabled') {
this._set({ enabled: t.checked });
this.toast.show(
t.checked ? 'Лиса снова на рамке.' : 'Лиса скрыта. Рамка осталась.',
t.checked ? 'success' : 'info'
);
}
}
_onClick(e) {
const t = e.target;
const chip = t.closest && t.closest('.fd-chip');
if (chip && this._scoped(chip)) {
e.preventDefault();
this._copyChip(chip);
return;
}
const btn = t.closest && t.closest('[data-fd-act]');
if (!btn || !this._scoped(btn)) return;
const act = btn.getAttribute('data-fd-act');
const arg = btn.getAttribute('data-arg');
switch (act) {
case 'dur-minus':
e.preventDefault();
this.duration = Math.max(DUR_MIN, this.duration - 1);
this._syncDuration();
return;
case 'dur-plus':
e.preventDefault();
this.duration = Math.min(DUR_MAX, this.duration + 1);
this._syncDuration();
return;
case 'emotion': {
e.preventDefault();
if (!petEnabled(this._conf())) {
this.toast.info('Сначала включите лису тумблером выше.');
return;
}
const meta = EMOTIONS.find(x => x.id === arg);
if (!meta) return;
this.store.broadcastAction('PET_EMOTION', { emotion: arg, duration: this.duration * 1000 });
btn.classList.remove('is-fired');
void btn.offsetWidth;
btn.classList.add('is-fired');
const old = this.fireTimers.get(btn);
if (old) clearTimeout(old);
this.fireTimers.set(btn, setTimeout(() => {
this.fireTimers.delete(btn);
if (btn.isConnected) btn.classList.remove('is-fired');
}, 700));
this.toast.success(`«${meta.label}» на ${this.duration} с — отправлено в превью и OBS.`);
return;
}
case 'reset-pet':
e.preventDefault();
this.store.resetWidgetToDefaults('pet');
this.toast.success('Настройки лисы сброшены.');
return;
default:
return;
}
}
async _copyChip(chip) {
const text = chip.getAttribute('data-copy') || '';
const ok = await copyText(text);
if (!ok) { this.toast.error(`Не удалось скопировать. Команда: ${text}`); return; }
this.toast.success(`Скопировано: ${text}`);
const iconEl = chip.querySelector('.fd-chip-ic');
if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = ic('check');
chip.classList.add('is-copied');
const old = this.chipTimers.get(chip);
if (old) clearTimeout(old);
this.chipTimers.set(chip, setTimeout(() => {
this.chipTimers.delete(chip);
if (!chip.isConnected) return;
chip.classList.remove('is-copied');
const el = chip.querySelector('.fd-chip-ic');
if (el) el.innerHTML = ic('copy');
}, 1400));
}
render(state, live) {
const c = petOf(state);
const on = petEnabled(c);
const sleep = clampInt(c.sleepTimeout, SLEEP_MIN, SLEEP_MAX, 120);
const toggle = document.getElementById('fd-pet-enabled');
if (toggle && document.activeElement !== toggle && toggle.checked !== on) toggle.checked = on;
const range = document.getElementById('fd-sleep');
if (range && document.activeElement !== range) {
const v = String(Math.min(SLEEP_RANGE_MAX, sleep));
if (range.value !== v) range.value = v;
paintRange(range);
}
const num = document.getElementById('fd-sleep-num');
if (num && document.activeElement !== num && num.value !== String(sleep)) num.value = String(sleep);
const fields = [['fd-feed', 'feedRewardName', 'Покормить лису'], ['fd-vip', 'vipUsers', ''], ['fd-ban', 'forbiddenWords', '']];
fields.forEach(([id, key, fallback]) => {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (!el || document.activeElement === el) return;
const value = String(c[key] ?? fallback);
if (el.value !== value) el.value = value;
});
setText('fd-vip-count', splitList(c.vipUsers).length);
setText('fd-ban-count', splitList(c.forbiddenWords).length);
const liveState = live && live.petState ? live.petState : null;
this.root.querySelectorAll('.fd-emotion').forEach(btn => {
const id = btn.getAttribute('data-arg');
btn.disabled = !on;
btn.classList.toggle('is-live', Boolean(on) && liveState === id);
btn.title = on
? `Показать эмоцию «${EMOTION_LABELS[id] || id}»`
: 'Лиса выключена — включите тумблер выше';
});
const note = document.getElementById('fd-emotion-note');
if (note) {
const text = !on
? 'Лиса выключена: эмоции не показываются, но настройки сохраняются.'
: (liveState && liveState !== 'idle'
? `Сейчас лиса в состоянии «${EMOTION_LABELS[liveState] || liveState}». Более приоритетная эмоция перебьёт текущую.`
: 'Тестовая эмоция уходит и в превью, и в OBS. Конфиг она не меняет.');
if (note.textContent !== text) note.textContent = text;
}
this._syncDuration();
}
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/frame/dashboard/stage.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/frame/dashboard/stage.js — v1 (живое превью рамки 1400×850 поверх мока камеры) */
import { WIDGET_W, WIDGET_H, CAM_W, CAM_H, EMOTION_LABELS, setText, frameOf, frameVisible, petOf, petEnabled } from './constants.js';

export class StageController {
constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
this.root = root;
this.store = store;
this.toast = toast;
this.iframe = null;
this.loaded = false;
this.resizeObs = null;
this.clickHandler = null;
this.loadTimer = null;
}
mount() {
this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
const stage = document.getElementById('fd-stage');
this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.scale());
if (stage) this.resizeObs.observe(stage);
this.createIframe();
console.log('[FrameDash:stage] смонтирован');
}
unmount() {
if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
if (this.resizeObs) { this.resizeObs.disconnect(); this.resizeObs = null; }
this.destroyIframe();
}
_onClick(e) {
const t = e.target;
if (t.closest('#fd-refresh')) {
e.preventDefault();
const btn = document.getElementById('fd-refresh');
if (btn) {
btn.classList.add('is-spin');
setTimeout(() => { if (btn.isConnected) btn.classList.remove('is-spin'); }, 900);
}
this.refresh();
this.toast.info('Превью перезапущено.');
return;
}
if (t.closest('#fd-off-show')) {
e.preventDefault();
try {
this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { frame: { isVisible: true } } });
this.toast.success('Рамка снова на экране.');
} catch (err) {
console.error('[FrameDash:stage] Не удалось показать рамку:', err);
this.toast.error('Настройка не сохранилась.');
}
}
}
refresh() {
this.destroyIframe();
this.createIframe();
}
createIframe() {
if (this.iframe) return;
const host = document.getElementById('fd-frame-host');
if (!host) return;
this.loaded = false;
const loading = document.getElementById('fd-stage-loading');
if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');
const f = document.createElement('iframe');
f.id = 'fd-preview-iframe';
f.className = 'fd-iframe';
f.title = 'Превью неоновой рамки и лисы';
f.setAttribute('scrolling', 'no');
// Относительный путь: работает и в Electron (file://), и по http.
f.src = `widgets/frame/index.html?preview=1&cb=${Date.now()}`;
f.onload = () => {
if (this.iframe !== f) return;
this.loaded = true;
const l = document.getElementById('fd-stage-loading');
if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
this.scale();
this.store.broadcastAction('FRAME_REQUEST_STATE', {});
};
f.onerror = () => {
if (this.iframe !== f) return;
const l = document.getElementById('fd-stage-loading');
if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
this.toast.error('Не удалось загрузить превью виджета.');
};
host.appendChild(f);
this.iframe = f;
clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
this.loadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
if (!this.loaded) {
const l = document.getElementById('fd-stage-loading');
if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
}
}, 6000);
this.scale();
}
destroyIframe() {
clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
this.loadTimer = null;
if (this.iframe) {
const f = this.iframe;
this.iframe = null;
try { f.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (e) {}
f.remove();
}
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#fd-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
this.loaded = false;
}
scale() {
const stage = document.getElementById('fd-stage');
const inner = document.getElementById('fd-stage-inner');
if (!stage || !inner) return;
const w = stage.clientWidth;
const h = stage.clientHeight;
if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
const s = Math.min(w / WIDGET_W, h / WIDGET_H) * 0.96;
inner.style.width = `${WIDGET_W}px`;
inner.style.height = `${WIDGET_H}px`;
inner.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${s.toFixed(4)})`;
const cam = inner.querySelector('.fd-cam-mock');
if (cam) {
cam.style.width = `${CAM_W}px`;
cam.style.height = `${CAM_H}px`;
}
}
evaluate(state, live) {
const visible = frameVisible(frameOf(state));
const petOn = petEnabled(petOf(state));
const stage = document.getElementById('fd-stage');
if (stage) stage.classList.toggle('is-off', !visible);
const off = document.getElementById('fd-stage-off');
if (off) off.classList.toggle('is-hidden', visible);
const loading = document.getElementById('fd-stage-loading');
if (loading && this.loaded) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');
const petState = live ? live.petState : (petOn ? 'idle' : 'off');
const label = petOn ? (EMOTION_LABELS[petState] || petState) : 'выключена';
setText('fd-hud-pet', `ЛИСА: ${String(label).toUpperCase()}`);
const chip = document.getElementById('fd-hud-pet');
if (chip) chip.classList.toggle('is-off', !petOn || !visible);
this.scale();
}
}

import { icons } from '/js/utils/icons.js';

const GoalModule = {
  currentFollowers: -1,
  displayFollowers: 0, 
  animationFrameId: null,
  target: 200,
  title: "ФОЛЛОВЕРЫ:",
  channel: "",

  init: function() {
    document.getElementById('goal-icon').innerHTML = icons.target();
    this.fetchData();
    setInterval(() => this.fetchData(), 30000);
  },

  updateConfig: function(globalConfig) {
    if (globalConfig.twitchChannel) this.channel = globalConfig.twitchChannel;
    
    const goalConf = globalConfig.widgets?.goal || {};
    
    if (goalConf.goalTarget) this.target = parseInt(goalConf.goalTarget);
    if (goalConf.goalTitle) this.title = goalConf.goalTitle;
    
    if (goalConf.goalColor) {
      document.getElementById('goal-container').style.setProperty('--goal-color', goalConf.goalColor);
    }

    document.getElementById('goal-title-el').textContent = this.title;
    document.getElementById('goal-max').textContent = this.target;

    if (this.currentFollowers !== -1) {
      this.animateValue(this.currentFollowers, true);
    }
  },

  fetchData: async function() {
    if (!this.channel) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`https://api.ivr.fi/v2/twitch/user?login=${this.channel}`);
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = await res.json();
      
      if (data && data.length > 0) {
        const followers = data[0].followers || 0;
        if (followers !== this.currentFollowers) {
          this.animateValue(followers);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) { 
      console.warn("[Goal] Не удалось обновить фолловеров."); 
    }
  },

  animateValue: function(targetValue, forceUpdate = false) {
    const elCurrent = document.getElementById('goal-current');
    const elBar = document.getElementById('goal-bar-fill');
    const elIcon = document.getElementById('goal-icon');
    const maxTarget = this.target;
    const container = document.getElementById('goal-container');

    const isFirstLoad = this.currentFollowers === -1 || forceUpdate;
    this.currentFollowers = targetValue;

    let percent = Math.min((targetValue / maxTarget) * 100, 100);
    elBar.style.width = `${percent}%`;

    if (targetValue >= maxTarget) container.classList.add('goal-completed');
    else container.classList.remove('goal-completed');

    if (!isFirstLoad && this.displayFollowers < targetValue) {
      elIcon.classList.remove('icon-beat');
      void elIcon.offsetWidth; 
      elIcon.classList.add('icon-beat');
    }

    const startValue = this.displayFollowers;
    const diff = Math.abs(targetValue - startValue);
    const duration = diff <= 1 ? 400 : Math.min(1500, Math.max(600, diff * 50));
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const updateCounter = (currentTime) => {
      const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      const easeOut = progress === 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * progress);
      
      this.displayFollowers = Math.floor(startValue + (targetValue - startValue) * easeOut);
      elCurrent.innerText = this.displayFollowers;

      if (progress < 1) {
        this.animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(updateCounter);
      } else {
        elCurrent.innerText = targetValue;
        this.displayFollowers = targetValue;
        if (!isFirstLoad && diff > 0) {
          elCurrent.classList.add('pop-text');
          setTimeout(() => elCurrent.classList.remove('pop-text'), 300);
        }
      }
    };

    cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationFrameId);
    this.animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(updateCounter);
  }
};

function connectWS() {
  const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:42069');
  ws.onmessage = (event) => {
    try {
      const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
      if (message.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED') {
        GoalModule.updateConfig(message.data);
      }
    } catch (e) { }
  };
  ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(connectWS, 3000);
}

fetch('http://localhost:42069/api/config')
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(config => {
    GoalModule.updateConfig(config);
    GoalModule.init();
    connectWS();
  })
  .catch(() => {
    GoalModule.init();
    connectWS();
  });

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/media/script.js — v3 (обложки работают и в file://-превью, и в OBS) */
import { MediaLibrary } from './media-db.js';
import { icons } from '../../js/utils/icons.js';

function normalizeHex(value, fallback) {
    let h = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!h) return fallback;
    if (!h.startsWith('#')) h = '#' + h;
    if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(h)) {
        h = '#' + h.slice(1).split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
    }
    return /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(h) ? h : fallback;
}

function isTrue(v) { return v === true || String(v) === 'true'; }

/**
 * Пути в media-db заданы от корня проекта ("/data/covers/...").
 * В OBS документ лежит на http://host/media/index.html, а в превью лаунчера —
 * на file:///<проект>/widgets/media/index.html. Резолвим относительно документа,
 * чтобы обложки грузились в обоих случаях.
 */
function resolveAsset(path) {
    const s = String(path || '').trim();
    if (!s) return '';
    if (/^(https?:|data:|blob:)/i.test(s)) return s;
    const clean = s.replace(/^\/+/, '');
    try {
        return new URL('../../' + clean, document.baseURI).href;
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Media] Не удалось.resolve обложку, использую относительный путь:', e);
        return '../../' + clean;
    }
}

const AppMediaInfo = {
    container: document.getElementById('media-info-container'),
    posterBreakout: document.querySelector('.mi-poster-breakout'),
    coverEl: document.getElementById('mi-cover'),
    noMediaEl: document.getElementById('mi-no-media'),
    noIconSlot: document.getElementById('mi-no-icon-slot'),
    ytPlayEl: document.getElementById('mi-yt-play'),
    typeBadgeEl: document.getElementById('mi-type-badge'),
    titleWrapper: document.getElementById('mi-title-wrapper'),
    titleEl: document.getElementById('mi-title'),
    metaRowEl: document.getElementById('mi-meta-row'),

    config: {},
    _sig: null,
    _token: 0,
    _marqueeTimer: null,

    init: function () {
        try {
            if (this.ytPlayEl) this.ytPlayEl.innerHTML = icons.play();
            if (this.noIconSlot) this.noIconSlot.innerHTML = icons.noSignal();

            fetch('http://localhost:42069/api/config')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(config => this.applyConfig(config.widgets?.media || {}))
                .catch(() => {
                    try {
                        const saved = localStorage.getItem('stream_pack_config');
                        if (saved) this.applyConfig(JSON.parse(saved).widgets?.media || {});
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.warn('[Media] Локальный конфиг не читается:', e);
                    }
                });

            window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'stream_pack_config' && e.newValue) {
                    try {
                        this.applyConfig(JSON.parse(e.newValue).widgets?.media || {});
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.warn('[Media] Ошибка разбора storage-конфига:', err);
                    }
                }
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                clearTimeout(this._marqueeTimer);
                this._marqueeTimer = setTimeout(() => this.checkMarquee(), 200);
            });

            this.connectWS();
            console.log('[Media] v3 инициализирован');
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[Media] Ошибка инициализации:', e);
        }
    },

    connectWS: function () {
        let ws;
        try { ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:42069'); }
        catch (e) { setTimeout(() => this.connectWS(), 3000); return; }
        ws.onmessage = (event) => {
            try {
                const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
                if (message.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED' && message.data?.widgets?.media) {
                    this.applyConfig(message.data.widgets.media);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        };
        ws.onerror = () => { try { ws.close(); } catch (e) {} };
        ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(() => this.connectWS(), 3000);
    },

    applyConfig: function (config) {
        if (!this.container) return;
        this.config = config || {};

        const isOff = this.config.isActive === false || String(this.config.isActive) === 'false';
        if (isOff) {
            this.hide();
            this._sig = null;
            this._token++;
            return;
        }

        const sig = JSON.stringify([
            String(this.config.libId || ''),
            String(this.config.ytLink || ''),
            isTrue(this.config.autoColor === undefined ? true : this.config.autoColor),
            String(this.config.accentColor || ''),
            String(this.config.badgeText || '')
        ]);

        if (sig !== this._sig) {
            this._sig = sig;
            this.set(this.config.libId, this.config.ytLink);
        } else if (this.container.classList.contains('hidden')) {
            this.container.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
    },

    set: async function (libId, ytLink) {
        const token = ++this._token;
        if (!this.container) { this.hide(); return; }

        let mediaData = null;
        const link = String(ytLink || '').trim();

        if (link && (link.includes('youtu.be') || link.includes('youtube.com'))) {
            mediaData = await this.fetchFromYouTube(link);
            if (token !== this._token) return;
            if (!mediaData) {
                mediaData = { title: 'YouTube Video', cover: 'generated', themeColor: '#FF0000', type: 'youtube', meta: ['Видео загружается...'] };
            }
        } else if (libId) {
            mediaData = MediaLibrary[String(libId).toLowerCase()];
            if (!mediaData) {
                mediaData = { title: String(libId).toUpperCase(), cover: 'generated', themeColor: '#ff007f', type: 'game', meta: ['Неизвестно'] };
            }
        }

        if (token !== this._token) return;

        if (mediaData) {
            this.render(mediaData);
            this.container.classList.remove('hidden');
            this.container.classList.remove('pop-anim');
            void this.container.offsetWidth;
            this.container.classList.add('pop-anim');
            clearTimeout(this._marqueeTimer);
            this._marqueeTimer = setTimeout(() => this.checkMarquee(), 100);
        } else {
            this.hide();
        }
    },

    checkMarquee: function () {
        if (!this.titleEl || !this.titleWrapper) return;
        if (this.titleEl.scrollWidth > this.titleWrapper.clientWidth + 5) {
            this.titleEl.classList.add('marquee-active');
        } else {
            this.titleEl.classList.remove('marquee-active');
        }
    },

    fetchFromYouTube: async function (urlOrId) {
        try {
            let videoId = String(urlOrId || '').trim();
            const match = videoId.match(/^.*(youtu.be\/|v\/|u\/\w\/|embed\/|watch\?v=|&v=)([^#&?]*).*/);
            if (match && match[2].length === 11) videoId = match[2];
            const response = await fetch(`https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${videoId}&format=json`);
            if (response.ok) {
                const data = await response.json();
                return {
                    title: data.title,
                    cover: data.thumbnail_url,
                    themeColor: '#FF0000',
                    type: 'youtube',
                    meta: [data.author_name]
                };
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn('[Media] oEmbed недоступен, показываю заглушку:', err && err.message);
            return null;
        }
        return null;
    },

    generateGradientPlaceholder: function (title) {
        const text = String(title || '??');
        let hash = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) hash = text.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
        const hue1 = Math.abs(hash % 360);
        const hue2 = (hue1 + 40) % 360;
        this.posterBreakout.style.background = `linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(${hue1}, 80%, 50%), hsl(${hue2}, 80%, 40%))`;
        let initials = text.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
        const words = text.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
        if (words.length > 1) initials = (words[0][0] + words[1][0]).toUpperCase();
        this.noMediaEl.innerHTML = `<div class="mi-generated-initials">${initials}</div>`;
        this.noMediaEl.style.display = 'flex';
        this.noMediaEl.style.background = 'transparent';
    },

    render: function (data) {
        const autoColor = this.config.autoColor === undefined ? true : isTrue(this.config.autoColor);
        const color = autoColor
            ? (data.themeColor || '#ff007f')
            : normalizeHex(this.config.accentColor, data.themeColor || '#ff007f');

        this.container.style.setProperty('--media-color', color);
        this.container.style.setProperty('--media-glow', `${color}33`);

        const customBadge = String(this.config.badgeText || '').trim();
        const autoBadge = data.type === 'youtube'
            ? 'РЕАКЦИЯ НА ВИДЕО'
            : (data.type === 'series' ? 'СЕЙЧАС СМОТРИМ' : 'СЕЙЧАС ИГРАЕМ');

        if (data.type === 'youtube') {
            this.container.classList.add('is-youtube');
            this.ytPlayEl.style.display = (data.cover && data.cover !== 'generated') ? 'flex' : 'none';
        } else {
            this.container.classList.remove('is-youtube');
            this.ytPlayEl.style.display = 'none';
        }
        this.typeBadgeEl.innerText = customBadge || autoBadge;

        this.titleEl.innerText = data.title || 'Неизвестно';
        this.titleEl.classList.remove('marquee-active');
        this.posterBreakout.style.background = '';

        if (data.cover === 'generated') {
            this.coverEl.src = '';
            this.coverEl.classList.add('hidden');
            this.generateGradientPlaceholder(data.title);
        } else if (data.cover && String(data.cover).trim() !== '') {
            const url = resolveAsset(data.cover);
            this.coverEl.onerror = () => {
                console.warn('[Media] Обложка не загрузилась:', url);
                this.coverEl.classList.add('hidden');
                this.generateGradientPlaceholder(data.title);
            };
            this.coverEl.src = url;
            this.coverEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            this.noMediaEl.style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            this.coverEl.src = '';
            this.coverEl.classList.add('hidden');
            this.noMediaEl.innerHTML = `
<div id="mi-no-icon-slot">${icons.noSignal()}</div>
<div class="mi-no-text">NO SIGNAL</div>`;
            this.noMediaEl.style.display = 'flex';
            this.noMediaEl.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a24, #0a0a0f)';
        }

        this.metaRowEl.innerHTML = '';
        if (Array.isArray(data.meta)) {
            data.meta.forEach(itemText => {
                if (itemText) {
                    const span = document.createElement('span');
                    span.className = 'mi-meta-item';
                    span.innerText = itemText;
                    this.metaRowEl.appendChild(span);
                }
            });
        }
    },

    hide: function () {
        if (this.container) this.container.classList.add('hidden');
    }
};

AppMediaInfo.init();

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/media/dashboard/controls.js — v2 (ссылка, оформление, сброс — без пустых переключателей) */
import { youTubeId } from './library.js';

export class ControlsController {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.inputHandler = null;
        this.changeHandler = null;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.keyHandler = null;
        this._lastSig = '';
    }

    mount() {
        this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
        this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.keyHandler = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target && e.target.id === 'md-yt-input') {
                e.preventDefault();
                this._applyLink();
            }
        };
        this.root.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.inputHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        if (this.changeHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.keyHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
    }

    _set(patch) {
        try {
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { media: patch } });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[MediaControls] Не удалось сохранить настройку:', e);
            this.toast.error('Настройка не сохранилась.');
        }
    }

    _onInput(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.id === 'md-yt-input') { this._previewLink(t.value); return; }
        if (!t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-md-key')) return;
        const key = t.getAttribute('data-md-key');
        if (t.type === 'color') {
            const hex = document.getElementById('md-color-hex');
            if (hex) hex.textContent = t.value;
            this._set({ [key]: t.value });
        } else if (t.type === 'text') {
            this._set({ [key]: t.value });
        }
    }

    _onChange(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (!t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-md-key')) return;
        if (t.type === 'checkbox') {
            const key = t.getAttribute('data-md-key');
            this._set({ [key]: t.checked });
            if (key === 'isActive') {
                this.toast.show(t.checked ? 'Карточка показана на стриме.' : 'Карточка скрыта со стрима.', t.checked ? 'success' : 'info');
            }
        }
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.closest('#md-yt-apply')) { e.preventDefault(); this._applyLink(); return; }

        if (t.closest('#md-yt-clear')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const input = document.getElementById('md-yt-input');
            if (input) input.value = '';
            this._set({ ytLink: '' });
            this._previewLink('');
            this.toast.info('Ссылка убрана — показываем выбранное из библиотеки.');
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#md-reset')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const input = document.getElementById('md-yt-input');
            if (input) input.value = '';
            this.store.resetWidgetToDefaults('media');
            this._previewLink('');
            this.toast.success('Настройки карточки сброшены.');
        }
    }

    _applyLink() {
        const input = document.getElementById('md-yt-input');
        if (!input) return;
        const raw = input.value.trim();
        if (!raw) { this.toast.info('Вставьте ссылку на YouTube.'); return; }
        const id = youTubeId(raw);
        if (!id) { this.toast.error('Не распознал ссылку YouTube.'); return; }
        this._set({ ytLink: raw, isActive: true });
        this.toast.success('Реакция показана на экране.');
    }

    _previewLink(value) {
        const raw = String(value || '').trim();
        const id = youTubeId(raw);
        const wrap = document.getElementById('md-yt-preview');
        const thumb = document.getElementById('md-yt-thumb');
        const idEl = document.getElementById('md-yt-id');
        const note = document.getElementById('md-yt-error');
        const apply = document.getElementById('md-yt-apply');

        if (wrap) wrap.classList.toggle('is-visible', Boolean(raw));
        if (apply) apply.disabled = !id;

        if (thumb) {
            const url = id ? `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${id}/mqdefault.jpg` : '';
            if (thumb.dataset.src !== url) {
                thumb.dataset.src = url;
                if (url) { thumb.src = url; thumb.classList.remove('is-broken'); }
                else { thumb.removeAttribute('src'); thumb.classList.add('is-broken'); }
            }
        }
        if (idEl) idEl.textContent = id ? `ID: ${id}` : 'Ссылка не распознана';
        if (note) {
            note.classList.toggle('is-error', Boolean(raw) && !id);
            note.textContent = !raw
                ? 'Вставьте ссылку — карточка переключится в режим реакции.'
                : (id ? 'Готово к показу. Нажмите «Показать».' : 'Нужна ссылка youtu.be / youtube.com или ID из 11 символов.');
        }
    }

    evaluate(state) {
        const c = state.config.widgets.media || {};
        const link = String(c.ytLink || '').trim();

        const autoColor = c.autoColor === undefined ? true : (c.autoColor === true || String(c.autoColor) === 'true');
        const colorRow = document.getElementById('md-color-row');
        if (colorRow) colorRow.classList.toggle('is-disabled', autoColor);
        const colorInput = this.root.querySelector('[data-md-key="accentColor"]');
        if (colorInput) {
            colorInput.disabled = autoColor;
            if (document.activeElement !== colorInput && c.accentColor && colorInput.value !== String(c.accentColor)) {
                colorInput.value = String(c.accentColor);
            }
        }
        const hex = document.getElementById('md-color-hex');
        if (hex) hex.textContent = autoColor ? 'АВТО' : String(c.accentColor || '#ff4d85');

        this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-md-key]').forEach(input => {
            const key = input.getAttribute('data-md-key');
            const val = c[key];
            if (val === undefined || document.activeElement === input) return;
            if (input.type === 'checkbox') {
                const checked = val === true || String(val) === 'true';
                if (input.checked !== checked) input.checked = checked;
            } else if (input.type === 'text') {
                if (input.value !== String(val)) input.value = String(val);
            }
        });

        const ytInput = document.getElementById('md-yt-input');
        if (ytInput && document.activeElement !== ytInput && ytInput.value !== link) {
            ytInput.value = link;
        }

        const sig = JSON.stringify([link, c.libId, c.isActive]);
        if (sig !== this._lastSig) {
            this._lastSig = sig;
            this._previewLink(ytInput ? ytInput.value : link);
        }
    }
}
