/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/media/dashboard/Dashboard.js — v3 (CSS-first: параллельные стили + preload, кэш линков в head) */
import { store } from '../../../js/store.js';
import { renderTemplate } from './template.js';
import { StageController } from './stage.js';
import { LibraryController, normalizeCover, youTubeId } from './library.js';
import { ControlsController } from './controls.js';
import { Toast } from '../../../js/components/toast.js';
import { setHashParams } from '../../../js/utils/hashParams.js';
import { MediaLibrary } from '../media-db.js';
let ctx = null;
const titleCache = new Map();
// === CSS-first загрузчик: параллельные <link> вместо @import-водопада ===
const CSS_VERSION = 'v3';
const CSS_TIMEOUT = 3000;
const CSS_FILES = [
{ id: 'md-css-base', href: `widgets/media/dashboard/styles/base.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'md-css-stage', href: `widgets/media/dashboard/styles/stage.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'md-css-panels', href: `widgets/media/dashboard/styles/panels.css?${CSS_VERSION}` }
];
let cssPromise = null;
function loadOneCss({ id, href }) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const existing = document.getElementById(id);
if (existing) {
if (existing.dataset.loaded === '1') { resolve(true); return; }
existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(true), { once: true });
existing.addEventListener('error', () => resolve(false), { once: true });
return;
}
const link = document.createElement('link');
link.id = id;
link.rel = 'stylesheet';
link.href = href;
link.dataset.loaded = '0';
link.onload = () => { link.dataset.loaded = '1'; resolve(true); };
link.onerror = () => {
console.error(`[MediaDash:css] Файл стиля не загрузился: ${href}`);
link.remove();
resolve(false);
};
document.head.appendChild(link);
});
}
/** Идемпотентно грузит стили дашборда. Резолвится true/false, никогда не реджектится. */
function preload() {
if (cssPromise) return cssPromise;
const t0 = performance.now();
console.log('[MediaDash:css] preload: параллельная загрузка стилей...');
const loadAll = Promise.all(CSS_FILES.map(loadOneCss)).then((results) => {
const ok = results.every(Boolean);
if (ok) console.log(`[MediaDash:css] Стили готовы за ${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}мс`);
else console.warn('[MediaDash:css] Часть стилей недоступна — возможен деградированный вид.');
return ok;
});
let guardTimer = null;
const guard = new Promise((resolve) => {
guardTimer = setTimeout(() => {
console.warn(`[MediaDash:css] Таймаут ${CSS_TIMEOUT}мс — рендерим без ожидания стилей.`);
resolve(false);
}, CSS_TIMEOUT);
});
cssPromise = Promise.race([loadAll, guard]).then((ok) => {
if (guardTimer) { clearTimeout(guardTimer); guardTimer = null; }
if (!ok) cssPromise = null;
return ok;
});
return cssPromise;
}
function setText(id, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (el && el.textContent !== text) el.textContent = text;
}
function setBadge(id, cls, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (!el) return;
el.className = `md-badge ${cls}`;
el.innerHTML = `<span class="md-badge-dot"></span>${text}`;
}
async function resolveYouTubeTitle(id) {
if (!id) return null;
if (titleCache.has(id)) return titleCache.get(id);
titleCache.set(id, null);
try {
const res = await fetch(`https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${id}&format=json`);
if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
const data = await res.json();
const value = { title: data.title || null, author: data.author_name || null };
titleCache.set(id, value);
if (ctx) renderStatus(store.getState());
return value;
} catch (e) {
console.warn('[MediaDash] Название видео не получено:', e && e.message);
return null;
}
}
function renderStatus(state) {
const c = state.config.widgets.media || {};
const active = c.isActive === true || String(c.isActive) === 'true';
const online = Boolean(state.serverOnline);
setBadge('md-badge-server', online ? 'md-badge-live' : 'md-badge-off', online ? 'СЕРВЕР ONLINE' : 'СЕРВЕР OFFLINE');
setBadge('md-badge-state', active ? 'md-badge-live' : 'md-badge-warn', active ? 'НА ЭКРАНЕ' : 'СКРЫТА');
const cover = document.getElementById('md-now-cover');
const fallback = document.getElementById('md-now-fallback');
const link = String(c.ytLink || '').trim();
const vid = youTubeId(link);
const entry = !vid ? MediaLibrary[String(c.libId || '').toLowerCase()] : null;
let title = 'Ничего не выбрано';
let meta = 'Выберите игру или вставьте ссылку';
let source = '—';
let initials = '??';
let coverUrl = null;
if (vid) {
const cached = titleCache.get(vid);
title = (cached && cached.title) || `YouTube · ${vid}`;
meta = (cached && cached.author) || 'Реакция на видео';
source = 'YOUTUBE';
coverUrl = `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${vid}/mqdefault.jpg`;
initials = 'YT';
if (!titleCache.has(vid)) resolveYouTubeTitle(vid);
} else if (entry) {
title = entry.title;
meta = Array.isArray(entry.meta) ? entry.meta.filter(Boolean).join(' · ') : '';
source = entry.type === 'series' ? 'КИНО / СЕРИАЛ' : 'ИГРА';
coverUrl = normalizeCover(entry.cover);
initials = String(entry.title || '??').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
} else if (c.libId) {
title = String(c.libId).toUpperCase();
meta = 'Нет в библиотеке — будет заглушка';
source = 'БИБЛИОТЕКА';
}
setText('md-now-title', title);
setText('md-now-meta', meta || '—');
setText('md-now-source', active ? source : 'СКРЫТА');
if (fallback) fallback.textContent = initials;
if (cover) {
const key = coverUrl || '';
if (cover.dataset.src !== key) {
cover.dataset.src = key;
if (key) {
cover.classList.remove('is-broken');
cover.src = key;
} else {
cover.removeAttribute('src');
cover.classList.add('is-broken');
}
}
}
const strip = document.getElementById('md-now');
if (strip) strip.classList.toggle('is-off', !active);
}
function evaluate() {
if (!ctx) return;
const state = store.getState();
renderStatus(state);
ctx.stage.evaluate(state);
ctx.controls.evaluate(state);
ctx.library.render(state);
}
function mount(params, state) {
const root = document.getElementById('md-main');
if (!root) return;
unmount();
// V2-вью уже дождалась preload() — здесь мгновенный no-op (страховка для прямого монтажа).
preload();
const toast = new Toast(document.getElementById('md-toasts'), { className: 'md-toast' });
const stage = new StageController({ root, store, toast });
const controls = new ControlsController({ root, store, toast });
const library = new LibraryController({
root,
store,
toast,
params,
onPick: (id, entry) => {
store.updateConfig({ widgets: { media: { libId: id, ytLink: '', isActive: true } } });
toast.success(`На экране: ${entry ? entry.title : id}`);
},
onHash: (updates) => setHashParams({ ...updates, id: 'media' })
});
ctx = { root, toast, stage, controls, library, unsub: null };
stage.mount();
controls.mount();
library.mount();
ctx.unsub = store.subscribe(() => evaluate());
evaluate();
console.log('[MediaDash] v3 смонтирован', params);
}
function onParamsChange(params) {
if (!ctx) return false;
if ((params?.id || 'player') !== 'media') return false;
ctx.library.setParams(params);
evaluate();
return true;
}
function unmount() {
if (!ctx) return;
console.log('[MediaDash] Размонтирование');
if (ctx.unsub) ctx.unsub();
ctx.stage.unmount();
ctx.controls.unmount();
ctx.library.unmount();
ctx = null;
// Стили (md-css-*) намеренно остаются в <head> — кэш между вкладками против FOUC.
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#md-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
}
export default {
render: (state, params) => renderTemplate(state, params),
preload,
mount,
onParamsChange,
unmount
};

--- START OF FILE widgets/media/dashboard/library.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/media/dashboard/library.js — v2 (только Игры/Кино, собственный select, без двойных кликов) */
import { MediaLibrary } from '../media-db.js';
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');

export const SORT_OPTIONS = [
    { id: 'title', label: 'А → Я' },
    { id: 'title-desc', label: 'Я → А' },
    { id: 'id', label: 'По ID' }
];

const CATEGORIES = ['game', 'series'];

export function normalizeCover(path) {
    const s = String(path || '').trim();
    if (!s) return null;
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;
    return s.replace(/^\/+/, '');
}

export function youTubeId(input) {
    const s = String(input || '').trim();
    if (!s) return null;
    const m = s.match(/(?:youtu\.be\/|v=|embed\/|shorts\/|live\/|v\/)([\w-]{11})/);
    if (m) return m[1];
    if (/^[\w-]{11}$/.test(s)) return s;
    return null;
}

export function libraryEntries() {
    try {
        return Object.entries(MediaLibrary).map(([id, e]) => ({
            id,
            title: e.title || id,
            cover: e.cover || '',
            themeColor: e.themeColor || '#ff007f',
            type: e.type === 'series' ? 'series' : 'game',
            meta: Array.isArray(e.meta) ? e.meta : []
        }));
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[MediaLib] Библиотека недоступна:', e);
        return [];
    }
}

function initialsOf(title) {
    const words = String(title || '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    if (words.length > 1) return (words[0][0] + words[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    return String(title || '??').substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function normCat(value) { return CATEGORIES.includes(value) ? value : 'game'; }
function normSort(value) { return SORT_OPTIONS.some(s => s.id === value) ? value : 'title'; }

export class LibraryController {
    constructor({ root, store, toast, params, onPick, onHash }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.onPick = onPick;
        this.onHash = onHash;
        this.entries = libraryEntries();
        this.filter = '';
        this.cat = normCat(params?.cat);
        this.sort = normSort(params?.sort);
        this.rows = new Map();
        this.sortOpen = false;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.keyHandler = null;
        this.searchHandler = null;
        this.docHandler = null;
    }

    mount() {
        const panel = this.root.querySelector('.md-lib-panel');
        const search = document.getElementById('md-lib-search');

        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.keyHandler = (e) => this._onKey(e);
        this.searchHandler = (e) => { this.filter = e.target.value; this.render(this.store.getState()); };
        this.docHandler = (e) => {
            if (!this.sortOpen) return;
            const t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest || !t.closest('#md-sort')) this._closeSort();
        };

        // Один слушатель на всю панель — карточки не получают двойной клик.
        if (panel) {
            panel.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
            panel.addEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        }
        if (search) search.addEventListener('input', this.searchHandler);
        document.addEventListener('click', this.docHandler);
    }

    unmount() {
        const panel = this.root.querySelector('.md-lib-panel');
        const search = document.getElementById('md-lib-search');
        if (panel && this.clickHandler) panel.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (panel && this.keyHandler) panel.removeEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        if (search && this.searchHandler) search.removeEventListener('input', this.searchHandler);
        if (this.docHandler) document.removeEventListener('click', this.docHandler);
        this.rows.clear();
        this.sortOpen = false;
    }

    setParams(params) {
        this.cat = normCat(params?.cat);
        this.sort = normSort(params?.sort);
        this._closeSort();
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.closest('#md-sort-btn')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (this.sortOpen) this._closeSort();
            else this._openSort();
            return;
        }

        const opt = t.closest('.md-sort-opt');
        if (opt) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this._setSort(opt.getAttribute('data-value'));
            this._closeSort();
            const btn = document.getElementById('md-sort-btn');
            if (btn) btn.focus();
            return;
        }

        const catBtn = t.closest('[data-md-cat]');
        if (catBtn) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.cat = normCat(catBtn.getAttribute('data-md-cat'));
            this.onHash({ cat: this.cat === 'game' ? null : this.cat });
            this.render(this.store.getState());
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#md-lib-reset')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.filter = '';
            const search = document.getElementById('md-lib-search');
            if (search) { search.value = ''; search.focus(); }
            this.render(this.store.getState());
            return;
        }

        const card = t.closest('.md-lib-card');
        if (card) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const id = card.getAttribute('data-id');
            const entry = this.entries.find(x => x.id === id);
            card.classList.add('is-picked');
            setTimeout(() => { if (card.isConnected) card.classList.remove('is-picked'); }, 420);
            this.onPick(id, entry);
        }
    }

    _onKey(e) {
        const inSort = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#md-sort');
        if (!inSort) return;
        const btn = document.getElementById('md-sort-btn');
        const pop = document.getElementById('md-sort-pop');
        const opts = pop ? Array.from(pop.querySelectorAll('.md-sort-opt')) : [];

        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            if (this.sortOpen) {
                e.preventDefault();
                this._closeSort();
                if (btn) btn.focus();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (e.target === btn) {
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                this._openSort();
                const active = opts.find(o => o.classList.contains('is-active')) || opts[0];
                if (active) active.focus();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
            e.preventDefault();
            const i = opts.indexOf(document.activeElement);
            const next = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(opts.length - 1, i + 1) : Math.max(0, i - 1);
            if (opts[next]) opts[next].focus();
        } else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
            this._closeSort();
        }
    }

    _openSort() {
        const root = document.getElementById('md-sort');
        const pop = document.getElementById('md-sort-pop');
        const btn = document.getElementById('md-sort-btn');
        if (!root || !pop || !btn) return;
        this.sortOpen = true;
        root.classList.add('is-open');
        pop.hidden = false;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    }

    _closeSort() {
        const root = document.getElementById('md-sort');
        const pop = document.getElementById('md-sort-pop');
        const btn = document.getElementById('md-sort-btn');
        this.sortOpen = false;
        if (root) root.classList.remove('is-open');
        if (pop) pop.hidden = true;
        if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

    _setSort(value) {
        this.sort = normSort(value);
        this.onHash({ sort: this.sort === 'title' ? null : this.sort });
        this._syncSortUI();
        this.render(this.store.getState());
    }

    _syncSortUI() {
        const root = document.getElementById('md-sort');
        const label = document.getElementById('md-sort-val');
        const pop = document.getElementById('md-sort-pop');
        const current = SORT_OPTIONS.find(s => s.id === this.sort) || SORT_OPTIONS[0];
        if (root) root.setAttribute('data-value', this.sort);
        if (label && label.textContent !== current.label) label.textContent = current.label;
        if (pop) {
            pop.querySelectorAll('.md-sort-opt').forEach(o => {
                const on = o.getAttribute('data-value') === this.sort;
                o.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
                o.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
            });
        }
    }

    visible() {
        const q = this.filter.trim().toLowerCase();
        const list = this.entries.filter(item => {
            if (item.type !== this.cat) return false;
            if (!q) return true;
            return `${item.title} ${item.id} ${item.meta.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        });
        const byTitle = (a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, 'ru');
        if (this.sort === 'title-desc') list.sort((a, b) => byTitle(b, a));
        else if (this.sort === 'id') list.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id, 'en'));
        else list.sort(byTitle);
        return list;
    }

    _makeCard(item) {
        const el = document.createElement('button');
        el.type = 'button';
        el.className = 'md-lib-card';
        el.setAttribute('data-id', item.id);
        el.style.setProperty('--card-accent', item.themeColor);

        const cover = document.createElement('span');
        cover.className = 'md-lib-cover';

        const fb = document.createElement('span');
        fb.className = 'md-lib-initials';
        fb.textContent = initialsOf(item.title);
        cover.appendChild(fb);

        const url = normalizeCover(item.cover);
        if (url) {
            const img = document.createElement('img');
            img.alt = '';
            img.loading = 'lazy';
            img.onerror = () => { img.classList.add('is-broken'); };
            img.src = url;
            cover.appendChild(img);
        }

        const type = document.createElement('span');
        type.className = 'md-lib-type';
        type.innerHTML = item.type === 'series' ? ic('alert_movie') : ic('alert_game');
        type.title = item.type === 'series' ? 'Кино / сериал' : 'Игра';
        cover.appendChild(type);

        const flag = document.createElement('span');
        flag.className = 'md-lib-flag';
        flag.textContent = 'В ЭФИРЕ';
        cover.appendChild(flag);

        const body = document.createElement('span');
        body.className = 'md-lib-body';

        const title = document.createElement('span');
        title.className = 'md-lib-title';
        title.textContent = item.title;

        const meta = document.createElement('span');
        meta.className = 'md-lib-meta';
        meta.textContent = item.meta.filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—';

        const idChip = document.createElement('span');
        idChip.className = 'md-lib-id';
        idChip.textContent = item.id;

        body.appendChild(title);
        body.appendChild(meta);
        body.appendChild(idChip);

        el.appendChild(cover);
        el.appendChild(body);
        el.title = `${item.title} — показать на экране`;
        return el;
    }

    render(state) {
        const grid = document.getElementById('md-lib-grid');
        if (!grid) return;

        const c = state.config.widgets.media || {};
        const hasLink = Boolean(String(c.ytLink || '').trim());
        const liveId = hasLink ? null : String(c.libId || '').toLowerCase();
        const list = this.visible();
        const catTotal = this.entries.filter(x => x.type === this.cat).length;

        const count = document.getElementById('md-lib-count');
        if (count) count.textContent = `${list.length} / ${catTotal}`;

        this._syncSortUI();

        this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-md-cat]').forEach(b => {
            const on = b.getAttribute('data-md-cat') === this.cat;
            b.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
            b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
        });

        const empty = document.getElementById('md-lib-empty');
        if (empty) empty.classList.toggle('is-hidden', list.length > 0);

        const seen = new Set();
        let cursor = grid.firstElementChild;
        for (const item of list) {
            seen.add(item.id);
            let el = this.rows.get(item.id);
            if (!el || !el.isConnected) {
                el = this._makeCard(item);
                this.rows.set(item.id, el);
            }
            el.classList.toggle('is-live', item.id === liveId);
            if (el === cursor) cursor = cursor.nextElementSibling;
            else grid.insertBefore(el, cursor);
        }
        for (const [id, el] of this.rows) {
            if (!seen.has(id)) { el.remove(); this.rows.delete(id); }
        }
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/media/dashboard/stage.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/media/dashboard/stage.js — v2 (один тёмный стенд, живое превью виджета) */

const WIDGET_W = 520;
const WIDGET_H = 220;

export class StageController {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.iframe = null;
        this.loaded = false;
        this.resizeObs = null;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.loadTimer = null;
    }

    mount() {
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        const stage = document.getElementById('md-stage');
        this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.scale());
        if (stage) this.resizeObs.observe(stage);
        this.createIframe();
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.resizeObs) this.resizeObs.disconnect();
        this.destroyIframe();
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.closest('#md-refresh')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('md-refresh');
            if (btn) { btn.classList.add('is-spin'); setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('is-spin'), 900); }
            this.destroyIframe();
            this.createIframe();
            this.toast.info('Превью перезапущено.');
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#md-stage-show')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { media: { isActive: true } } });
            this.toast.success('Карточка снова на экране.');
        }
    }

    createIframe() {
        if (this.iframe) return;
        const frame = document.getElementById('md-stage-frame');
        if (!frame) return;
        this.loaded = false;
        const loading = document.getElementById('md-stage-loading');
        if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');

        const f = document.createElement('iframe');
        f.id = 'md-preview-iframe';
        f.className = 'md-iframe';
        f.title = 'Превью карточки активности';
        f.setAttribute('scrolling', 'no');
        // Относительный путь: работает и в Electron (file://), и по http.
        f.src = `widgets/media/index.html?preview=1&cb=${Date.now()}`;
        f.onload = () => {
            if (this.iframe !== f) return;
            this.loaded = true;
            const l = document.getElementById('md-stage-loading');
            if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            this.scale();
        };
        f.onerror = () => {
            if (this.iframe !== f) return;
            const l = document.getElementById('md-stage-loading');
            if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            this.toast.error('Не удалось загрузить превью виджета.');
        };
        frame.appendChild(f);
        this.iframe = f;

        clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
        this.loadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (!this.loaded) {
                const l = document.getElementById('md-stage-loading');
                if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            }
        }, 6000);

        this.scale();
    }

    destroyIframe() {
        clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
        if (this.iframe) {
            const f = this.iframe;
            this.iframe = null;
            try { f.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (e) {}
            f.remove();
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('iframe#md-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
        this.loaded = false;
    }

    scale() {
        const stage = document.getElementById('md-stage');
        if (!stage || !this.iframe) return;
        const s = Math.min(stage.clientWidth / WIDGET_W, stage.clientHeight / WIDGET_H) * 0.92;
        this.iframe.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${s.toFixed(4)})`;
    }

    evaluate(state) {
        const c = state.config.widgets.media || {};
        const active = c.isActive === true || String(c.isActive) === 'true';

        const stage = document.getElementById('md-stage');
        if (stage) stage.classList.toggle('is-off', !active);

        const hidden = document.getElementById('md-stage-hidden');
        if (hidden) hidden.classList.toggle('is-hidden', active);

        const loading = document.getElementById('md-stage-loading');
        if (loading && this.loaded) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');

        this.scale();
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/media/dashboard/template.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/media/dashboard/template.js — v2 (без лишних переключателей, свой select) */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { SORT_OPTIONS } from './library.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

export function renderTemplate(state, params) {
    const c = state.config.widgets.media || {};
    const active = c.isActive === true || String(c.isActive) === 'true';
    const autoColor = c.autoColor === undefined ? true : (c.autoColor === true || String(c.autoColor) === 'true');
    const accent = c.accentColor || '#ff4d85';
    const badge = c.badgeText || '';
    const yt = c.ytLink || '';

    const cat = params?.cat === 'series' ? 'series' : 'game';
    const sort = SORT_OPTIONS.some(s => s.id === params?.sort) ? params.sort : 'title';
    const sortLabel = (SORT_OPTIONS.find(s => s.id === sort) || SORT_OPTIONS[0]).label;

    const catBtn = (id, label, icon) => `
<button class="md-seg-btn ${cat === id ? 'is-active' : ''}" type="button" data-md-cat="${id}" aria-pressed="${cat === id}">
${ic(icon)} ${label}
</button>`;

    const sortOptions = SORT_OPTIONS.map(s => `
<button class="md-sort-opt ${s.id === sort ? 'is-active' : ''}" type="button" role="option" data-value="${s.id}" aria-selected="${s.id === sort}">${esc(s.label)}</button>`).join('');

    return `
<div class="md-main" id="md-main">
    <section class="md-card card">
        <header class="md-head">
            <div class="md-head-left">
                <h3 class="md-title">${ic('eye')} Карточка активности</h3>
                <span class="md-badge" id="md-badge-server">СЕРВЕР</span>
                <span class="md-badge" id="md-badge-state">НА ЭКРАНЕ</span>
            </div>
            <div class="md-head-right">
                <label class="md-toggle md-toggle-head" title="Мастер-выключатель: показывать карточку на стриме">
                    <span>КАРТОЧКА ВКЛ.</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" data-md-key="isActive" ${active ? 'checked' : ''}>
                    <div class="md-track"></div>
                </label>
                <button class="md-icon-btn" id="md-refresh" type="button" title="Перезапустить превью виджета" aria-label="Перезапустить превью">${ic('sync')}</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <div class="md-stage" id="md-stage">
            <div class="md-stage-frame" id="md-stage-frame"></div>
            <div class="md-stage-loading" id="md-stage-loading"><div class="md-spinner"></div><span>Загружаю виджет…</span></div>
            <div class="md-stage-hidden is-hidden" id="md-stage-hidden">
                <div class="md-stage-hidden-icon">${ic('noSignal')}</div>
                <div class="md-stage-hidden-title">Карточка скрыта</div>
                <div class="md-stage-hidden-sub">Виджет работает, но не показывается на стриме.</div>
                <button class="md-btn md-btn-primary" id="md-stage-show" type="button">${ic('power')} Показать на экране</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="md-now" id="md-now">
            <div class="md-now-cover">
                <img id="md-now-cover" alt="">
                <span class="md-now-fallback" id="md-now-fallback">??</span>
            </div>
            <div class="md-now-body">

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/panel/script.js — v2 (+ карточка «Сцены OBS»: горячий рефреш с телефона) */
import { widgetsManifest } from '/data/widgetsManifest.js';
let ws = null;
let config = { widgets: {} };
let currentMode = 'ws';
let scenesRefreshTimer = null;
const statusEl = document.getElementById('status');
const container = document.getElementById('widgets-container');
const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
document.getElementById('btn-ws').addEventListener('click', (e) => setMode('ws', e.target));
document.getElementById('btn-chat').addEventListener('click', (e) => setMode('chat', e.target));
function setMode(mode, targetBtn) {
currentMode = mode;
document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
targetBtn.classList.add('active');
}
function showToast(text) {
toast.textContent = text;
toast.classList.add('show');
setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
}
function setScenesBtnBusy(busy) {
const btn = document.getElementById('panel-refresh-scenes');
if (!btn) return;
btn.disabled = busy;
btn.textContent = busy ? '⏳ Перезагрузка сцен...' : '⟳ Перезагрузить сцены';
}
function renderUI() {
const scenesCard = `
<div class="card">
<h2 class="card-title">Сцены OBS</h2>
<div class="control-group">
<button class="panel-btn-action" id="panel-refresh-scenes">⟳ Перезагрузить сцены</button>
</div>
<div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5;">
Перезагружает все виджеты в OBS, кроме плеера — музыка не прервётся. Из чата: <b>!refresh</b>
</div>
</div>`;
container.innerHTML = scenesCard + widgetsManifest.map(widget => {
const widgetConfig = config.widgets[widget.id] || {};
let controlsHtml = widget.controls.map(control => {
// ИСПОЛНЯЕМЫЕ КНОПКИ В ПАНЕЛИ
if (control.type === 'button') {
return `
<div class="control-group">
<button class="panel-btn-action" data-action="${control.action}" data-payload='${JSON.stringify(control.payload)}'>
▶ ${control.label}
</button>
</div>`;
}
const val = widgetConfig[control.key] !== undefined ? widgetConfig[control.key] : control.default;
let inputHtml = '';
if (control.type === 'range') {
inputHtml = `<input type="range" data-widget="${widget.id}" data-key="${control.key}" data-cmd="${control.cmd}" value="${val}" min="0" max="100">`;
} else if (control.type === 'checkbox') {
inputHtml = `<input type="checkbox" class="toggle-switch" data-widget="${widget.id}" data-key="${control.key}" data-cmd="${control.cmd}" ${val ? 'checked' : ''}>`;
} else if (control.type === 'select') {
const opts = control.options.map(o => `<option value="${o.value}" ${val === o.value ? 'selected' : ''}>${o.label}</option>`).join('');
inputHtml = `<select data-widget="${widget.id}" data-key="${control.key}" data-cmd="${control.cmd}">${opts}</select>`;
} else if (control.type === 'textarea') {
inputHtml = `<textarea data-widget="${widget.id}" data-key="${control.key}" data-cmd="${control.cmd}">${val}</textarea>`;
} else {
inputHtml = `<input type="${control.type}" data-widget="${widget.id}" data-key="${control.key}" data-cmd="${control.cmd}" value="${val}">`;
}
return `
<div class="control-group">
<div class="label-row">
<span>${control.label}</span>
${control.type === 'range' ? `<span id="val-${widget.id}-${control.key}">${val}</span>` : `<span style="color:var(--text-muted)">${control.cmd || ''}</span>`}
</div>
${inputHtml}
</div>`;
}).join('');
// КАСТОМНЫЙ ИНЖЕКТ ДЛЯ ПЛЕЕРА (Возвращаем поле ввода треков для телефонов)
if (widget.id === 'player') {
const addTrackHtml = `
<div class="control-group">
<div class="label-row">
<span style="color: var(--accent-primary);">Добавить трек (Вне очереди)</span>
</div>
<div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
<input type="text" id="panel-add-track-input" placeholder="Ссылка на YouTube..." style="flex: 1;">
<button class="panel-btn-action" id="panel-btn-add-track" style="width: auto; padding: 0 20px;">+</button>
</div>
</div>
`;
controlsHtml = addTrackHtml + controlsHtml;
}
return `<div class="card"><h2 class="card-title">${widget.title}</h2>${controlsHtml}</div>`;
}).join('');
}
// ОБРАБОТЧИК КНОПОК ДЕЙСТВИЙ
container.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
const btn = e.target.closest('.panel-btn-action');
if (btn) {
// 0. Горячий рефреш сцен
if (btn.id === 'panel-refresh-scenes') {
if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action: 'SCENES_REFRESH', payload: { widgets: 'all', origin: 'panel' } }));
setScenesBtnBusy(true);
if (scenesRefreshTimer) clearTimeout(scenesRefreshTimer);
scenesRefreshTimer = setTimeout(() => { scenesRefreshTimer = null; setScenesBtnBusy(false); }, 12000);
showToast('Команда отправлена...');
} else {
showToast('Нет подключения к стриму!');
}
return;
}
// 1. Кастомная кнопка добавления трека
if (btn.id === 'panel-btn-add-track') {
const input = document.getElementById('panel-add-track-input');
if (input && input.value.trim() !== '') {
if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
ws.send(JSON.stringify({
event: 'WIDGET_ACTION',
action: 'PLAYER_ADD_TRACK',
payload: { url: input.value.trim(), user: 'Модератор' }
}));
showToast('Трек отправлен!');
input.value = '';
} else {
showToast('Нет подключения к стриму!');
}
}
return;
}
// 2. Стандартные кнопки из манифеста
const action = btn.getAttribute('data-action');
const payload = JSON.parse(btn.getAttribute('data-payload') || '{}');
if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action, payload }));
showToast('Команда выполнена!');
} else {
showToast('Нет подключения к стриму!');
}
}
});
// ОБРАБОТЧИК ИНПУТОВ НАСТРОЕК
function handleInput(e) {
const target = e.target;
if (!target.hasAttribute('data-widget')) return;
const widgetId = target.getAttribute('data-widget');
const key = target.getAttribute('data-key');
const cmd = target.getAttribute('data-cmd');
const value = target.type === 'checkbox' ? target.checked : target.value;
if (target.type === 'range') {
const valLabel = document.getElementById(`val-${widgetId}-${key}`);
if (valLabel) valLabel.textContent = value;
}
if (currentMode === 'ws') {
if (!config.widgets[widgetId]) config.widgets[widgetId] = {};
config.widgets[widgetId][key] = value;
if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'UPDATE_CONFIG', data: config }));
}
} else {
if (!cmd) {
showToast('У этой настройки нет чат-команды');
return;
}
let cmdValue = value;
if (target.type === 'checkbox') cmdValue = value ? 'on' : 'off';
const fullCmd = `${cmd} ${cmdValue}`;
navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullCmd)
.then(() => showToast(`Скопировано: ${fullCmd}`))
.catch(() => showToast(`Команда: ${fullCmd}`));
}
}
container.addEventListener('input', handleInput);
async function init() {
try {
const res = await fetch('/api/config');
config = await res.json();
renderUI();
connectWS();
} catch (e) {
statusEl.textContent = 'Ошибка загрузки';
}
}
function connectWS() {
const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss://' : 'ws://';
ws = new WebSocket(protocol + window.location.host);
ws.onopen = () => {
statusEl.textContent = 'Online';
statusEl.classList.add('online');
};
ws.onmessage = (event) => {
try {
const msg = JSON.parse(event.data);
if (msg.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED') {
config = msg.data;
widgetsManifest.forEach(w => w.controls.forEach(c => {
if (c.type === 'button') return;
const input = document.querySelector(`[data-widget="${w.id}"][data-key="${c.key}"]`);
if (input && document.activeElement !== input) {
const newVal = config.widgets[w.id]?.[c.key] ?? c.default;
let isChanged = false;
if (input.type === 'checkbox') {
const isChecked = newVal === true || String(newVal) === 'true';
if (input.checked !== isChecked) {
input.checked = isChecked;
isChanged = true;
}
} else {
if (input.value !== String(newVal)) {
input.value = newVal;
isChanged = true;
if (c.type === 'range') {
const valLabel = document.getElementById(`val-${w.id}-${c.key}`);
if (valLabel) valLabel.textContent = newVal;
}
}
}
if (isChanged) {
const group = input.closest('.control-group');
if (group) {
group.classList.remove('flash-update');
void group.offsetWidth;
group.classList.add('flash-update');
}
}
}
}));
}
else if (msg.event === 'WIDGET_ACTION' && msg.action === 'SCENES_REFRESH_RESULT') {
if (scenesRefreshTimer) { clearTimeout(scenesRefreshTimer); scenesRefreshTimer = null; }
setScenesBtnBusy(false);
showToast((msg.payload && msg.payload.message) || 'Сцены перезагружены');
}
} catch (e) {}
};
ws.onclose = () => {
statusEl.textContent = 'Offline';
statusEl.classList.remove('online');
setTimeout(connectWS, 2000);
};
}
init();

import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';

const AppParticles = {
    canvas: document.getElementById('particles-canvas'),
    ctx: null,
    particlesArray: [],
    animationId: null,
    isLoopRunning: false,
    
    spriteCanvas: null,
    spriteCtx: null,
    
    enabled: true,
    
    // СТРОГИЕ ЛИМИТЫ (Защита от краша OBS)
    LIMITS: {
        MAX_COUNT: 80,   // Снизил до 80 для производительности OBS
        MAX_DIST: 200,  
        MAX_SPEED: 2.0  
    },

    settings: { count: 35, speed: 0.2, distance: 100, color: '#ff4d85' },
    cachedRgb: { r: 255, g: 77, b: 133 },
    lastHexColor: '#ff4d85',

    init: function() {
        if (!this.canvas) return;
        
        this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true });
        this.spriteCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        this.spriteCtx = this.spriteCanvas.getContext('2d');
        
        this.resize();
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            // Debounce для оптимизации при ресайзе
            clearTimeout(this.resizeTimer);
            this.resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => this.resize(), 200);
        });
    },

    applyConfig: function(config) {
        if (!config) return;

        const wasEnabled = this.enabled;
        this.enabled = config.enabled !== false && String(config.enabled) !== 'false';

        const oldCount = this.settings.count;
        const oldColor = this.settings.color;
        
        if (config.count !== undefined) this.settings.count = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(config.count), 10), this.LIMITS.MAX_COUNT);
        if (config.distance !== undefined) this.settings.distance = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(config.distance), 25), this.LIMITS.MAX_DIST);
        if (config.speed !== undefined) this.settings.speed = Math.min(Math.max(parseFloat(config.speed), 0), this.LIMITS.MAX_SPEED);
        if (config.color !== undefined) this.settings.color = config.color;
        
        if (oldCount !== this.settings.count) this.initParticles();
        if (oldColor !== this.settings.color) this.preRenderSprite();

        // Главная оптимизация: Запускаем цикл только если включено, убиваем если выключено
        if (this.enabled && !this.isLoopRunning) {
            this.animate();
        } else if (!this.enabled && this.isLoopRunning) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
            this.isLoopRunning = false;
            // Очищаем экран, чтобы не висели застывшие точки
            this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
        }
    },

    resize: function() {
        this.canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        this.canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        // При ресайзе переинициализируем точки, чтобы они не улетели за новые границы
        if (this.particlesArray.length > 0) this.initParticles();
    },

    hexToRgbCached: function(hex) {
        if (hex === this.lastHexColor) return this.cachedRgb;
        let result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
        if (result) {
            this.cachedRgb = { r: parseInt(result[1], 16), g: parseInt(result[2], 16), b: parseInt(result[3], 16) };
            this.lastHexColor = hex;
        }
        return this.cachedRgb;
    },

    preRenderSprite: function() {
        const rgb = this.hexToRgbCached(this.settings.color);
        const radius = 3; 
        const glow = 10;  
        const size = (radius + glow) * 2;
        
        this.spriteCanvas.width = size;
        this.spriteCanvas.height = size;
        
        this.spriteCtx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);
        this.spriteCtx.beginPath();
        this.spriteCtx.arc(size/2, size/2, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        this.spriteCtx.fillStyle = `rgba(${rgb.r}, ${rgb.g}, ${rgb.b}, 0.8)`;
        this.spriteCtx.shadowBlur = glow;
        this.spriteCtx.shadowColor = `rgba(${rgb.r}, ${rgb.g}, ${rgb.b}, 1)`;
        this.spriteCtx.fill();
    },

    initParticles: function() {
        this.particlesArray = [];
        const maxParticles = Math.min(this.settings.count, this.LIMITS.MAX_COUNT); 
        for (let i = 0; i < maxParticles; i++) {
            this.particlesArray.push({
                x: Math.random() * this.canvas.width,
                y: Math.random() * this.canvas.height,
                radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
                vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5
            });
        }
    },

    animate: function() {
        if (!this.enabled) {
            this.isLoopRunning = false;
            return; // Прерываем цикл, сохраняем 100% CPU
        }
        
        this.isLoopRunning = true;
        this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);

        const rgb = this.cachedRgb; 
        const speedMult = this.settings.speed;
        const linkDist = this.settings.distance;
        const linkDistSq = linkDist * linkDist; 

        // 1. Движение частиц
        for (let i = 0; i < this.particlesArray.length; i++) {
            let p = this.particlesArray[i];

            p.x += p.vx * speedMult;
            p.y += p.vy * speedMult;

            if (p.x < 0 || p.x > this.canvas.width) p.vx *= -1;
            if (p.y < 0 || p.y > this.canvas.height) p.vy *= -1;

            const spriteOffset = (p.radius + 10); 
            this.ctx.drawImage(this.spriteCanvas, p.x - spriteOffset, p.y - spriteOffset);
        }

        // 2. Линии ( Constellation )
        const BUCKET_COUNT = 20; 
        const MAX_OPACITY = 0.4;
        const lineBuckets = Array.from({length: BUCKET_COUNT}, () => []);

        for (let a = 0; a < this.particlesArray.length; a++) {
            let p1 = this.particlesArray[a];
            for (let b = a + 1; b < this.particlesArray.length; b++) {
                let p2 = this.particlesArray[b];
                
                // Предварительный быстрый тест по осям
                if (Math.abs(p1.x - p2.x) > linkDist || Math.abs(p1.y - p2.y) > linkDist) continue;

                let dx = p1.x - p2.x;
                let dy = p1.y - p2.y;
                let distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;

                if (distSq < linkDistSq) {
                    let distance = Math.sqrt(distSq);
                    let opacity = 1 - (distance / linkDist);
                    opacity *= MAX_OPACITY; 
                    
                    let bucketIndex = Math.floor((opacity / MAX_OPACITY) * BUCKET_COUNT);
                    if (bucketIndex >= BUCKET_COUNT) bucketIndex = BUCKET_COUNT - 1;
                    if (bucketIndex < 0) continue;

                    lineBuckets[bucketIndex].push(p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y);
                }
            }
        }

        // Отрисовка батчами (значительно экономит CPU)
        this.ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < BUCKET_COUNT; i++) {
            let bucket = lineBuckets[i];
            if (bucket.length === 0) continue;
            
            let alpha = (i / BUCKET_COUNT) * MAX_OPACITY + (MAX_OPACITY / BUCKET_COUNT / 2);
            this.ctx.beginPath();
            this.ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rgb.r}, ${rgb.g}, ${rgb.b}, ${alpha})`;

            for (let j = 0; j < bucket.length; j += 4) {
                this.ctx.moveTo(bucket[j], bucket[j+1]);
                this.ctx.lineTo(bucket[j+2], bucket[j+3]);
            }
            this.ctx.stroke(); 
        }

        this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(this.animate.bind(this));
    }
};

// ==========================================
// ИНИЦИАЛИЗАЦИЯ ЧЕРЕЗ ЯДРО
// ==========================================

AppParticles.init();

WidgetCore.init({
    onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
        if (config.widgets?.particles) AppParticles.applyConfig(config.widgets.particles);
    },

    onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => {
        if (cmd === '!particles' || cmd === '!частицы') {
            const arg0 = args[0] ? args[0].toLowerCase() : null;
            let conf = { ...(WidgetCore.globalConfig.widgets.particles || {}) };
            let changed = false;

            if (arg0 === 'on') {
                conf.enabled = true;
                changed = true;
            } 
            else if (arg0 === 'off') {
                conf.enabled = false;
                changed = true;
            } 
            // Парсим: !particles [count] [dist] [speed] [color]
            else if (args.length >= 4) {
                const count = parseInt(args[0]);
                const dist = parseInt(args[1]);
                const speed = parseFloat(args[2]);
                let color = args[3];
                
                if (!color.startsWith('#')) color = `#${color}`;

                if (!isNaN(count) && !isNaN(dist) && !isNaN(speed)) {
                    conf.count = count;
                    conf.distance = dist;
                    conf.speed = speed;
                    conf.color = color;
                    conf.enabled = true; // Автоматически включаем
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            if (changed) {
                WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('particles', conf);
            }
        }
    }
});

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/queue.js — v6 (зеркало серверной очереди + утилиты) */

export function extractYouTubeId(url) {
if (!url) return null;
const s = String(url).trim();
const list = s.match(/[?&]list=([^#&?]+)/);
if (list) return { type: 'playlist', id: list[1] };
const video = s.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/|embed\/|shorts\/|live\/)([\w-]{11})/);
if (video) return { type: 'video', id: video[1] };
if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(s)) return { type: 'video', id: s };
return null;
}

export function formatTime(sec) {
const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(sec) || 0));
const h = Math.floor(s / 3600);
const m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
const r = s % 60;
if (h > 0) return `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(r).padStart(2, '0')}`;
return `${m}:${String(r).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function thumbnailUrl(track, quality = 'mqdefault') {
if (!track || !track.id || track.type === 'playlist') return null;
return `https://img.youtube.com/vi/${track.id}/${quality}.jpg`;
}

export class QueueMirror {
constructor() {
this.orders = [];
this.playlist = [];
this.order = [];
this.nowPlaying = null;
this.cursor = -1;
this.shuffle = false;
this.bgEnabled = false;
this.enabled = true;
this.canPrev = false;
this.receivedAt = 0;
this.hasSnapshot = false;
}

apply(payload) {
if (!payload) return;
this.orders = Array.isArray(payload.orders) ? payload.orders : [];
this.playlist = Array.isArray(payload.playlist) ? payload.playlist : [];
this.order = Array.isArray(payload.order) ? payload.order : this.playlist.map(t => t.uid);
this.nowPlaying = payload.nowPlaying || null;
this.cursor = Number(payload.cursor ?? -1);
this.shuffle = !!payload.shuffle;
this.bgEnabled = !!payload.bgEnabled;
this.enabled = payload.enabled !== false;
this.canPrev = !!payload.canPrev;
this.receivedAt = Date.now();
this.hasSnapshot = true;
}

get currentUid() { return this.nowPlaying ? this.nowPlaying.uid : null; }

orderedPlaylist() {
const map = new Map(this.playlist.map(t => [t.uid, t]));
const seen = new Set();
const out = [];
this.order.forEach(uid => {
const t = map.get(uid);
if (t && !seen.has(uid)) { out.push(t); seen.add(uid); }
});
this.playlist.forEach(t => {
if (!seen.has(t.uid)) { out.push(t); seen.add(t.uid); }
});
return out;
}

filter(term) {
const q = String(term || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const match = (t) => !q
|| String(t.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
|| String(t.user || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
|| String(t.id || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
return {
orders: this.orders.filter(match),
playlist: this.orderedPlaylist().filter(match)
};
}

get total() {
return this.orders.length + this.playlist.filter(t => !t.removed).length;
}
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/script.js — v6.1 (сохранение позиции при эстафете + команды !bgplay / !playerc) */
import { YouTubeWrapper } from './youtube.js';
import { extractYouTubeId } from './queue.js';
import { AvatarManager } from '../shared/AvatarManager.js';
import { icons } from '../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';

const PARAMS = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const IS_DEMO = PARAMS.get('demo') === '1';
const IS_PREVIEW = PARAMS.get('preview') === '1';
const MODE = IS_DEMO ? 'demo' : 'obs';
const INSTANCE_ID = MODE + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
console.log(`[Player:${MODE}] v6.1 старт, id=${INSTANCE_ID}`);

if (IS_PREVIEW && !IS_DEMO) {
    console.log('[Player] Статичное превью — логика отключена.');
} else {
    function hexToRgb(hex) {
        let h = String(hex || '#ff4d85').replace('#', '');
        if (h.length === 3) h = h.split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
        const r = parseInt(h.substring(0, 2), 16);
        const g = parseInt(h.substring(2, 4), 16);
        const b = parseInt(h.substring(4, 6), 16);
        return `${isNaN(r) ? 255 : r}, ${isNaN(g) ? 77 : g}, ${isNaN(b) ? 133 : b}`;
    }

    const UI = {
        container: document.getElementById('widget-container'),
        nameLabel: document.getElementById('requester-name'),
        infoLabelText: document.getElementById('info-label-text'),
        avatarEl: document.getElementById('requester-avatar'),
        volLabel: document.getElementById('volume-level'),
        queueCount: document.getElementById('queue-count'),
        progressBar: document.getElementById('yt-progress-bar'),
        initIcons() {
            const v = document.getElementById('icon-volume');
            const q = document.getElementById('icon-queue');
            const vinyl = document.getElementById('bg-vinyl-icon');
            if (v && icons.volume) v.innerHTML = icons.volume();
            if (q && icons.queue) q.innerHTML = icons.queue();
            if (vinyl && icons.vinyl) vinyl.innerHTML = icons.vinyl();
        },
        updateStats(vol, qCount) {
            if (this.volLabel) this.volLabel.innerText = vol;
            if (this.queueCount && this.queueCount.innerText !== String(qCount)) {
                this.queueCount.innerText = qCount;
                this.queueCount.classList.remove('animate-pop');
                void this.queueCount.offsetWidth;
                this.queueCount.classList.add('animate-pop');
            }
        },
        showTrack(track, accentColor) {
            if (!this.container || !track) return;
            this.container.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (track.isBackground) {
                this.nameLabel.innerText = 'Фоновая музыка';
                this.infoLabelText.innerText = 'АВТОПЛЕЙЛИСТ';
                this.container.classList.add('mode-background');
            } else {
                this.nameLabel.innerText = track.user || 'Гость';
                this.infoLabelText.innerText = 'СЕЙЧАС ИГРАЕТ ЗАКАЗ';
                this.container.classList.remove('mode-background');
                AvatarManager.get(track.user || 'Гость', accentColor || '#ff4d85')
                    .then(url => { if (this.avatarEl) this.avatarEl.src = url; })
                    .catch(() => {});
            }
        },
        setPlayingState(isPlaying) {
            if (!this.container) return;
            this.container.classList.toggle('is-playing', !!isPlaying);
        },
        setProgress(p) {
            if (this.progressBar) this.progressBar.style.transform = `scaleX(${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p || 0))})`;
        },
        hide() {
            this.setPlayingState(false);
            if (this.container) this.container.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    };

    const AppPlayer = {
        yt: null,
        track: null,
        state: 'IDLE',
        muted: false,
        active: MODE === 'obs',
        ordersCount: 0,
        wantPaused: false,
        watchdog: null,
        _endedTimer: null,
        _errorTimer: null,
        _verifyTimer: null,
        _expectedStart: null,
        _expectedSince: 0,
        config: { volume: 30, bgVolume: 15, accentColor: '#ff4d85', enabled: true, playlistEnabled: false },

        init() {
            UI.initIcons();
            this.yt = new YouTubeWrapper(MODE.toUpperCase(), 'yt-player', {
                onReady: () => {
                    this.applyVolume();
                    this.register();
                    this.report();
                },
                onStateChange: (code) => this.onYtState(code),
                onError: (code) => this.reportError('yt-error-' + code)
            });
            setInterval(() => this.register(), 2500);
            setInterval(() => this.report(), 1000);
            setInterval(() => this.tickProgress(), 400);
            setTimeout(() => this.register(), 250);
            setTimeout(() => this.register(), 1200);
        },

        register() {
            const ws = WidgetCore.ws;
            if (ws && ws.readyState === 1) {
                try { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'PLAYER_REGISTER', mode: MODE, instanceId: INSTANCE_ID })); } catch (e) {}
            }
        },

        send(action, payload) { WidgetCore.sendAction(action, payload || {}); },

        cancelPendingReports() {
            if (this._endedTimer) { clearTimeout(this._endedTimer); this._endedTimer = null; }
            if (this._errorTimer) { clearTimeout(this._errorTimer); this._errorTimer = null; }
        },

        _clearSeekVerify() {
            if (this._verifyTimer) { clearTimeout(this._verifyTimer); this._verifyTimer = null; }
        },

        /**
         * YouTube иногда игнорирует startSeconds при повторной загрузке того же видео.
         * Контролируем фактическую позицию и доводим её принудительным seek.
         */
        _scheduleSeekVerify(uid, start) {
            this._clearSeekVerify();
            if (!(start > 1)) return;
            const run = (delay, retries) => {
                this._verifyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    this._verifyTimer = null;
                    if (!this.active || this.wantPaused) return;
                    if (!this.track || this.track.uid !== uid) return;
                    if (!this.yt || !this.yt.isReady) return;
                    const cur = this.yt.getCurrentTime();
                    if (Math.abs(cur - start) > 3) {
                        console.warn(`[Player:${MODE}] Позиция сброшена (${cur.toFixed(1)}s ≠ ${start.toFixed(1)}s) — принудительный seek`);
                        this.yt.seekTo(start);
                        this._expectedStart = start;
                        this._expectedSince = Date.now();
                        if (retries > 0) run(1500, retries - 1);
                    } else {
                        this._expectedStart = null;
                    }
                }, delay);
            };
            run(1300, 1);
        },

        report() {
            if (!this.active || !this.yt) return;
            const ws = WidgetCore.ws;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== 1) return;
            const t = this.yt.getTimes();
            let current = t.current;
            // Пока YouTube не подтвердил переданную позицию — не отдаём серверу ноль/старое значение.
            if (this._expectedStart !== null) {
                const expected = this._expectedStart;
                if (current >= expected - 2) {
                    this._expectedStart = null;
                } else if (Date.now() - this._expectedSince < 6000) {
                    current = Math.max(current, expected);
                } else {
                    this._expectedStart = null;
                }
            }
            try {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                    event: 'PLAYER_TRANSPORT',
                    instanceId: INSTANCE_ID,
                    uid: this.track ? this.track.uid : null,
                    state: this.state,
                    currentTime: current,
                    duration: t.duration,
                    muted: this.muted
                }));
            } catch (e) {}
        },

        reportEnded() {
            if (!this.active || !this.track) return;
            if (this._endedTimer || this._errorTimer) return;
            const uid = this.track.uid;
            this._endedTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                this._endedTimer = null;
                if (!this.active || !this.track || this.track.uid !== uid) return;
                const ws = WidgetCore.ws;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== 1) return;
                console.log(`[Player:${MODE}] Трек завершён: ${uid}`);
                try { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'PLAYER_TRACK_ENDED', uid, instanceId: INSTANCE_ID })); } catch (e) {}
            }, 350);
        },

        reportError(reason) {
            if (!this.active || !this.track) return;
            if (this._errorTimer) return;
            if (this._endedTimer) { clearTimeout(this._endedTimer); this._endedTimer = null; }
            const uid = this.track.uid;
            this._errorTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                this._errorTimer = null;
                if (!this.active || !this.track || this.track.uid !== uid) return;
                const ws = WidgetCore.ws;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== 1) return;
                console.warn(`[Player:${MODE}] Ошибка воспроизведения (${reason}): ${uid}`);
                try { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'PLAYER_TRACK_ERROR', uid, instanceId: INSTANCE_ID, reason })); } catch (e) {}
            }, 900);
        },

        applyRoster(payload) {
            if (!payload) return;
            const nextActive = payload.active === MODE;
            if (nextActive === this.active) return;
            this.active = nextActive;
            if (!nextActive) {
                console.log(`[Player:${MODE}] Эстафета передана → пауза`);
                this.cancelPendingReports();
                this.clearWatchdog();
                this._clearSeekVerify();
                this._expectedStart = null;
                this.wantPaused = true;
                if (this.yt) this.yt.pause();
                this.state = 'PAUSED';
                UI.setPlayingState(false);
                UI.hide();
                this.pet(false);
            } else {
                console.log(`[Player:${MODE}] Принял эстафету`);
                this.register();
            }
        },

        loadTrack(payload, isAdopt) {
            if (!this.active || !payload || !payload.track) return;
            this.cancelPendingReports();
            this.clearWatchdog();
            this._clearSeekVerify();
            const track = payload.track;
            const start = Number(payload.startSeconds) || 0;
            const wantState = payload.state === 'PAUSED' ? 'PAUSED' : 'PLAYING';
            this.track = track;
            this.muted = !!payload.muted;
            this.wantPaused = wantState === 'PAUSED';
            this.state = wantState;
            this._expectedStart = start > 1 ? start : null;
            this._expectedSince = Date.now();
            UI.showTrack(track, this.config.accentColor);
            UI.setProgress(0);
            this.applyVolume();
            if (this.yt) {
                this.yt.load(track, start, wantState === 'PLAYING');
                if (wantState === 'PLAYING') this.yt.resume();
            }
            UI.setPlayingState(wantState === 'PLAYING');
            this.pet(wantState === 'PLAYING');
            this.startWatchdog();
            if (!this.wantPaused) this._scheduleSeekVerify(track.uid, start);
            console.log(`[Player:${MODE}] ${isAdopt ? 'Эстафета' : 'Загрузка'}: ${track.title || track.id} @ ${start.toFixed(1)}s (${wantState})`);
        },

        applyVolume() {
            if (!this.yt) return;
            const vol = this.track && this.track.isBackground ? this.config.bgVolume : this.config.volume;
            const safe = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parseInt(vol) || 0));
            this.yt.setVolume(safe);
            UI.updateStats(safe, this.ordersCount);
        },

        applyConfig(pConf) {
            if (!pConf) return;
            this.config = { ...this.config, ...pConf };
            if (this.config.accentColor) {
                const hex = String(this.config.accentColor).startsWith('#') ? this.config.accentColor : `#${this.config.accentColor}`;
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--player-accent', hex);
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--player-accent-rgb', hexToRgb(hex));
            }
            this.applyVolume();
            this.register();
        },

        pet(active) {
            if (!this.active) return;
            if (WidgetCore.callbacks.onWidgetAction) {
                WidgetCore.callbacks.onWidgetAction('PET_BASE_STATE', { state: 'jam', active });
            }
        },

        onYtState(code) {
            if (!this.active) return;
            if (code === 1) {
                this.cancelPendingReports();
                this.clearWatchdog();
                if (this.wantPaused) { this.yt.pause(); return; }
                this.state = 'PLAYING';
                UI.setPlayingState(true);
                if (!this.muted) this.yt.unMute();
                this.pet(true);
                this.report();
            } else if (code === 2) {
                UI.setPlayingState(false);
                if (this.wantPaused) {
                    this.state = 'PAUSED';
                    this.pet(false);
                    this.report();
                }
            } else if (code === 3) {
                this.clearWatchdog();
                this.startWatchdog();
            } else if (code === 0) {
                UI.setPlayingState(false);
                this.pet(false);
                if (this.track && this.track.type === 'playlist' && !this.yt.isPlaylistEnded()) return;
                this.reportEnded();
            }
        },

        startWatchdog() {
            this.clearWatchdog();
            if (!this.active || this.wantPaused) return;
            this.watchdog = setTimeout(() => this._watchdogCheck(), 10000);
        },

        _watchdogCheck() {
            this.watchdog = null;
            if (!this.active || this.wantPaused || this.state !== 'PLAYING') return;
            const st = this.yt ? this.yt.getState() : -1;
            if (st === 1) return;
            if (st === 3) {
                this.watchdog = setTimeout(() => this._watchdogCheck(), 6000);
                return;
            }
            if (this.yt) this.yt.forcePlay();
            this.watchdog = setTimeout(() => {
                this.watchdog = null;
                if (!this.active || this.wantPaused || this.state !== 'PLAYING') return;
                const st2 = this.yt ? this.yt.getState() : -1;
                if (st2 === 1 || st2 === 3) return;
                this.reportError('watchdog');
            }, 4000);
        },

        clearWatchdog() {
            if (this.watchdog) clearTimeout(this.watchdog);
            this.watchdog = null;
        },

        tickProgress() {
            if (this.state === 'PLAYING' && this.yt && this.yt.isReady) {
                UI.setProgress(this.yt.getProgress());
            }
        },

        handleAction(action, payload = {}) {
            if (action === 'PLAYER_ROSTER') { this.applyRoster(payload); return; }
            if (action === 'PLAYER_QUEUE_STATE') {
                this.ordersCount = Array.isArray(payload.orders) ? payload.orders.length : 0;
                this.applyVolume();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'PLAYER_LOAD_TRACK') { this.loadTrack(payload, false); return; }
            if (action === 'PLAYER_ADOPT_STATE') { this.loadTrack(payload, true); return; }
            if (action === 'PLAYER_STOP') {
                this.cancelPendingReports();
                this.clearWatchdog();
                this._clearSeekVerify();
                this._expectedStart = null;
                this.track = null;
                this.state = 'IDLE';
                this.wantPaused = false;
                if (this.yt) this.yt.stop();
                UI.hide();
                UI.setProgress(0);
                this.pet(false);
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'PLAYER_PAUSE') {
                if (!this.active || !this.track) return;
                const next = payload.state === 'PAUSED' ? 'PAUSED' : 'PLAYING';
                this.cancelPendingReports();
                this.wantPaused = next === 'PAUSED';
                this.state = next;
                if (this.wantPaused) {
                    this._clearSeekVerify();
                    this._expectedStart = null;
                }
                if (this.yt) { if (this.wantPaused) this.yt.pause(); else this.yt.resume(); }
                UI.setPlayingState(!this.wantPaused);
                this.pet(!this.wantPaused);
                if (!this.wantPaused) this.startWatchdog(); else this.clearWatchdog();
                this.report();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'PLAYER_MUTE') {
                this.muted = !!payload.muted;
                if (this.yt) {
                    if (this.muted) this.yt.mute();
                    else if (this.state === 'PLAYING') this.yt.unMute();
                }
                this.report();
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'PLAYER_SEEK') {
                if (!this.active || !this.yt) return;
                this.cancelPendingReports();
                this._clearSeekVerify();
                this._expectedStart = null;
                this.yt.seekTo(Number(payload.seconds) || 0);
                UI.setProgress(this.yt.getProgress());
                this.startWatchdog();
                this.report();
                return;
            }
        },

        handleChat(cmd, args, tags) {
            if (!this.active) return;
            if (String(this.config.enabled) === 'false') return;
            const user = (tags && (tags['display-name'] || tags.username)) || 'Зритель';
            const url = (args || []).join(' ').trim();
            if (cmd === '!play' || cmd === '!sr') {
                if (url && extractYouTubeId(url)) this.send('PLAYER_ADD_TRACK', { url, user });
            } else if (cmd === '!skip') {
                this.send('PLAYER_SKIP', {});
            } else if (cmd === '!prev') {
                this.send('PLAYER_PREV', {});
            } else if (cmd === '!pause') {
                this.send('PLAYER_PAUSE', {});
            } else if (cmd === '!clear') {
                this.send('PLAYER_CLEAR', {});
            } else if (cmd === '!vol') {
                const vol = parseInt(args[0], 10);
                if (!isNaN(vol)) WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('player', { volume: Math.max(0, Math.min(100, vol)) });
            } else if (cmd === '!bgplay') {
                const arg = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
                const cur = this.config.playlistEnabled === true || String(this.config.playlistEnabled) === 'true';
                const next = arg === 'on' ? true : (arg === 'off' ? false : !cur);
                WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('player', { playlistEnabled: next });
                console.log(`[Player:${MODE}] !bgplay → фоновый плейлист ${next ? 'включён' : 'выключен'}`);
            } else if (cmd === '!playerc') {
                let color = (args[0] || '').trim();
                if (!color) return;
                if (!color.startsWith('#')) color = '#' + color;
                if (/^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(color)) {
                    WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('player', { accentColor: color });
                    console.log(`[Player:${MODE}] !playerc → ${color}`);
                }
            }
        }
    };

    AppPlayer.init();

    WidgetCore.init({
        onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
            if (config.widgets?.player) AppPlayer.applyConfig(config.widgets.player);
            AppPlayer.register();
        },
        onWidgetAction: (action, payload) => AppPlayer.handleAction(action, payload),
        onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args, tags) => AppPlayer.handleChat(cmd, args, tags)
    });
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/youtube.js — v6 */
export class YouTubeWrapper {
constructor(instanceId, containerId, callbacks = {}) {
this.instanceId = instanceId;
this.containerId = containerId;
this.callbacks = callbacks;
this.isReady = false;
this.yt = null;
this._pendingPause = null;
this.initAPI();
}

initAPI() {
const check = () => {
if (window.YT && window.YT.Player && typeof window.YT.Player === 'function') this.createPlayer();
else setTimeout(check, 100);
};
if (!document.querySelector('script[src*="youtube.com/iframe_api"]')) {
const tag = document.createElement('script');
tag.src = 'https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api';
tag.async = true;
document.head.appendChild(tag);
}
check();
}

createPlayer() {
if (this.yt) return;
let origin = window.location.origin;
if (!origin || origin === 'null' || origin === 'file://') origin = 'http://localhost:42069';
try {
this.yt = new YT.Player(this.containerId, {
host: 'https://www.youtube.com',
playerVars: {
autoplay: 1, controls: 0, disablekb: 1, enablejsapi: 1,
fs: 0, modestbranding: 1, playsinline: 1, rel: 0,
origin, mute: 1
},
events: {
onReady: () => {
this.isReady = true;
console.log(`[YT:${this.instanceId}] готов (origin ${origin})`);
if (this.callbacks.onReady) this.callbacks.onReady();
},
onStateChange: (e) => { if (this.callbacks.onStateChange) this.callbacks.onStateChange(e.data); },
onError: (e) => {
console.error(`[YT:${this.instanceId}] ошибка ${e.data}`);
if (this.callbacks.onError) this.callbacks.onError(e.data);
}
}
});
} catch (e) {
console.error(`[YT:${this.instanceId}] не создан:`, e);
}
}

load(track, startSeconds = 0, autoplay = true) {
if (!this.isReady || !this.yt || !track) return;
if (this._pendingPause) { clearTimeout(this._pendingPause); this._pendingPause = null; }
try { this.yt.mute(); } catch (e) {}
const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(startSeconds) || 0));
try {
if (track.type === 'playlist') {
this.yt.loadPlaylist({ list: track.id, index: 0, startSeconds: s });
} else if (s > 0) {
this.yt.loadVideoById({ videoId: track.id, startSeconds: s });
} else {
this.yt.loadVideoById({ videoId: track.id });
}
if (!autoplay) {
this._pendingPause = setTimeout(() => {
this._pendingPause = null;
this.pause();
}, 500);
}
} catch (e) {
console.error(`[YT:${this.instanceId}] загрузка не удалась:`, e);
}
}

play(track) { this.load(track, 0, true); }

seekTo(seconds) {
if (!this.isReady || !this.yt || !this.yt.seekTo) return;
try { this.yt.seekTo(Math.max(0, Number(seconds) || 0), true); } catch (e) {}
}

pause() {
if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.pauseVideo) {
try { this.yt.pauseVideo(); } catch (e) {}
}
}

resume() {
if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.playVideo) {
try { this.yt.playVideo(); } catch (e) {}
}
}

stop() {
if (this._pendingPause) { clearTimeout(this._pendingPause); this._pendingPause = null; }
if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.stopVideo) {
try { this.yt.mute(); this.yt.stopVideo(); } catch (e) {}
}
}

setVolume(vol) {
const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parseInt(vol) || 0));
if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.setVolume) {
try { this.yt.setVolume(v); } catch (e) {}
}
}

mute() { if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.mute) { try { this.yt.mute(); } catch (e) {} } }
unMute() { if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.unMute) { try { this.yt.unMute(); } catch (e) {} } }
forcePlay() { if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.playVideo) { try { this.yt.playVideo(); } catch (e) {} } }
getState() { return this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.getPlayerState ? this.yt.getPlayerState() : -1; }

getCurrentTime() {
if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.getCurrentTime) {
try { return this.yt.getCurrentTime() || 0; } catch (e) {}
}
return 0;
}

getDuration() {
if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.getDuration) {
try { return this.yt.getDuration() || 0; } catch (e) {}
}
return 0;
}

getTimes() { return { current: this.getCurrentTime(), duration: this.getDuration() }; }

getProgress() {
const { current, duration } = this.getTimes();
return duration > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, current / duration)) : 0;
}

isPlaylistEnded() {
if (this.isReady && this.yt && this.yt.getPlaylist && this.yt.getPlaylistIndex) {
try {
const pl = this.yt.getPlaylist();
const idx = this.yt.getPlaylistIndex();
return (!pl || pl.length === 0 || idx === pl.length - 1);
} catch (e) {}
}
return true;
}

destroy() {
if (this._pendingPause) clearTimeout(this._pendingPause);
if (this.yt && this.yt.destroy) { try { this.yt.destroy(); } catch (e) {} }
this.yt = null;
this.isReady = false;
}
}
