/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/configBindings.js — v6 (заливка ползунков + синхронизация) */
import { paintRange } from '../../../js/utils/rangeFill.js';

export class ConfigBindings {
    constructor({ root, store, onAfterChange }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.onAfterChange = onAfterChange;
        this.inputHandler = null;
        this.changeHandler = null;
        this.unsub = null;
        this.lastJson = '';
    }

    mount() {
        this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
        this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
        this.root.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        this.unsub = this.store.subscribe((state) => this.sync(state));
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.inputHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        if (this.changeHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        if (this.unsub) this.unsub();
    }

    _onInput(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (!t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-pd-key')) return;
        const key = t.getAttribute('data-pd-key');
        if (t.type === 'range') {
            const lbl = document.getElementById(`val-player-${key}`);
            if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `${t.value}%`;
            paintRange(t);
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { player: { [key]: Number(t.value) } } });
        } else if (t.type === 'color') {
            const hex = document.getElementById('pd-color-hex');
            if (hex) hex.textContent = t.value;
            const stage = document.getElementById('pd-stage');
            if (stage) stage.style.borderColor = t.value;
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { player: { [key]: t.value } } });
        }
    }

    _onChange(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (!t.hasAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-pd-key')) return;
        if (t.type === 'checkbox') {
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { player: { [t.getAttribute('data-pd-key')]: t.checked } } });
            if (this.onAfterChange) this.onAfterChange();
        }
    }

    sync(state) {
        const c = state.config.widgets.player || {};
        const json = JSON.stringify(c);
        if (json === this.lastJson) return;
        this.lastJson = json;
        this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-pd-key]').forEach(input => {
            try {
                const key = input.getAttribute('data-pd-key');
                const val = c[key];
                if (val === undefined) return;
                const focused = document.activeElement === input;
                if (input.type === 'checkbox') {
                    if (focused) return;
                    const checked = val === true || String(val) === 'true';
                    if (input.checked !== checked) input.checked = checked;
                } else if (input.type === 'range') {
                    if (!focused && input.value !== String(val)) {
                        input.value = val;
                        const lbl = document.getElementById(`val-player-${key}`);
                        if (lbl) lbl.textContent = `${val}%`;
                    }
                    // Красим всегда: и при программной синхронизации, и при первом монтировании.
                    paintRange(input);
                } else if (input.type === 'color') {
                    if (focused) return;
                    if (input.value !== String(val)) {
                        input.value = val;
                        const hex = document.getElementById('pd-color-hex');
                        if (hex) hex.textContent = val;
                        const stage = document.getElementById('pd-stage');
                        if (stage) stage.style.borderColor = val;
                    }
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('[Dash:config] Ошибка синхронизации поля:', err);
            }
        });
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/player/dashboard/controls.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/controls.js — v7 (▶-старт, shuffle-кнопка, копирование чипов, mute) */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { copyText } from '../../../js/utils/clipboard.js';
import { formatTime } from '../queue.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');

export class ControlsController {
    constructor({ root, state, toast, onCmd, onAddTrack }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.state = state;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.onCmd = onCmd;
        this.onAddTrack = onAddTrack;
        this.raf = null;
        this.dragging = false;
        this.dragRatio = 0;
        this.clearArmed = false;
        this.clearTimer = null;
        this.chipTimers = new Map();
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.keyHandler = null;
        this.seekDown = null;
        this.seekMove = null;
        this.seekUp = null;
    }

    mount() {
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.keyHandler = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target && e.target.id === 'pd-input') {
                e.preventDefault();
                this._addTrack();
            }
        };
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        const seek = document.getElementById('pd-seek');
        this.seekDown = (e) => this._onSeekDown(e);
        this.seekMove = (e) => this._onSeekMove(e);
        this.seekUp = (e) => this._onSeekUp(e);
        if (seek) seek.addEventListener('pointerdown', this.seekDown);
        window.addEventListener('pointermove', this.seekMove);
        window.addEventListener('pointerup', this.seekUp);
        const loop = () => { this._tickProgress(); this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
        this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
        if (this.clearTimer) clearTimeout(this.clearTimer);
        for (const t of this.chipTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
        this.chipTimers.clear();
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.keyHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        const seek = document.getElementById('pd-seek');
        if (seek && this.seekDown) seek.removeEventListener('pointerdown', this.seekDown);
        if (this.seekMove) window.removeEventListener('pointermove', this.seekMove);
        if (this.seekUp) window.removeEventListener('pointerup', this.seekUp);
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        const chip = t.closest('.pd-chip');
        if (chip) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this._copyChip(chip);
            return;
        }

        const shuffle = t.closest('#pd-shuffle');
        if (shuffle && !shuffle.disabled) {
            e.preventDefault();
            shuffle.classList.add('is-spin');
            setTimeout(() => { if (shuffle.isConnected) shuffle.classList.remove('is-spin'); }, 620);
            this.onCmd('PLAYER_SHUFFLE_PLAYLIST', {}, { okToast: 'Плейлист перемешан.' });
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#pd-mute')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.onCmd('PLAYER_MUTE', { muted: !this.state.transport.muted }, { silent: true });
            return;
        }

        const clear = t.closest('#pd-clear');
        if (clear && !clear.disabled) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!this.clearArmed) {
                this.clearArmed = true;
                clear.classList.add('is-armed');
                this.toast.info('Очистить все заказы? Нажмите корзину ещё раз.');
                clearTimeout(this.clearTimer);
                this.clearTimer = setTimeout(() => { this.clearArmed = false; clear.classList.remove('is-armed'); }, 3000);
            } else {
                this.clearArmed = false;
                clearTimeout(this.clearTimer);
                clear.classList.remove('is-armed');
                this.onCmd('PLAYER_CLEAR', {}, { okToast: 'Очередь заказов очищена.' });
            }
            return;
        }

        // Центральная кнопка в простое = СТАРТ очереди (сначала заказы, потом фон).
        const main = t.closest('#pd-pause');
        if (main && !main.disabled && !this.state.queue.nowPlaying) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const q = this.state.queue;
            const playable = q.orders.length > 0 || (q.bgEnabled && q.playlist.some(x => !x.removed));
            if (!playable) {
                this.toast.info('Очередь пуста. Добавьте трек или включите фоновый плейлист.');
                return;
            }
            this.onCmd('PLAYER_SKIP', {}, { silent: true });
            return;
        }

        const cmd = t.closest('[data-pd-cmd]');
        if (cmd && !cmd.disabled) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.onCmd(cmd.getAttribute('data-pd-cmd'), {}, { silent: true });
            return;
        }

        const add = t.closest('#pd-add');
        if (add && !add.disabled) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this._addTrack();
        }
    }

    async _copyChip(chip) {
        const text = chip.getAttribute('data-copy') || '';
        const ok = await copyText(text);
        if (!ok) {
            this.toast.error(`Не удалось скопировать. Команда: ${text.trim()}`);
            return;
        }
        this.toast.success(`Скопировано: ${text.trim()}`);
        const iconEl = chip.querySelector('.pd-chip-ic');
        if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = ic('check');
        chip.classList.add('is-copied');
        const old = this.chipTimers.get(chip);
        if (old) clearTimeout(old);
        this.chipTimers.set(chip, setTimeout(() => {
            this.chipTimers.delete(chip);
            if (!chip.isConnected) return;
            chip.classList.remove('is-copied');
            const el = chip.querySelector('.pd-chip-ic');
            if (el) el.innerHTML = ic('copy');
        }, 1400));
    }

    _addTrack() {
        const input = document.getElementById('pd-input');
        if (!input) return;
        const url = input.value.trim();
        if (!url) return;
        if (this.onAddTrack(url)) input.value = '';
    }

    _liveSeconds() {
        const t = this.state.transport;
        if (this.dragging) return this.dragRatio * (t.duration || 0);
        let cur = t.currentTime || 0;
        if (t.state === 'PLAYING' && t.duration > 0) {
            cur = Math.min(t.duration, cur + (performance.now() - (t._recv || performance.now())) / 1000);
        }
        return cur;
    }

    _tickProgress() {
        const t = this.state.transport;
        const dur = t.duration || 0;
        const cur = this._liveSeconds();
        const ratio = dur > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, cur / dur)) : 0;
        const fill = document.getElementById('pd-seek-fill');
        const knob = document.getElementById('pd-seek-knob');
        const curEl = document.getElementById('pd-time-cur');
        const durEl = document.getElementById('pd-time-dur');
        if (fill) fill.style.width = `${(ratio * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
        if (knob) knob.style.left = `${(ratio * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
        if (curEl) curEl.textContent = formatTime(cur);
        if (durEl) durEl.textContent = dur > 0 ? formatTime(dur) : '—:—';
    }

    _seekRatioFromEvent(e) {
        const seek = document.getElementById('pd-seek');
        if (!seek) return 0;
        const rect = seek.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.width <= 0) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
    }

    _onSeekDown(e) {
        const seek = document.getElementById('pd-seek');
        if (!seek || seek.classList.contains('is-disabled')) return;
        if (!this.state.transport.duration) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        this.dragging = true;
        this.dragRatio = this._seekRatioFromEvent(e);
        seek.classList.add('is-dragging');
        try { seek.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
        this._tickProgress();
    }

    _onSeekMove(e) {
        if (!this.dragging) return;
        this.dragRatio = this._seekRatioFromEvent(e);
        this._tickProgress();
    }

    _onSeekUp() {
        if (!this.dragging) return;
        this.dragging = false;
        const seek = document.getElementById('pd-seek');
        if (seek) seek.classList.remove('is-dragging');
        const seconds = this.dragRatio * (this.state.transport.duration || 0);
        this.state.transport.currentTime = seconds;
        this.state.transport._recv = performance.now();
        this.onCmd('PLAYER_SEEK', { seconds }, { silent: true });
        this._tickProgress();
    }

    evaluate(online) {
        const mode = this.state.activeMode();
        const q = this.state.queue;
        const t = this.state.transport;
        const now = q.nowPlaying;
        const canCmd = Boolean(mode) && online && q.enabled;

        this.root.querySelectorAll('[data-pd-cmd]').forEach(b => { b.disabled = !canCmd; });

        const pauseBtn = document.getElementById('pd-pause');
        if (pauseBtn) {
            const idle = !now;
            pauseBtn.innerHTML = idle ? ic('play') : (t.state === 'PAUSED' ? ic('play') : ic('pause'));
            pauseBtn.title = idle ? 'Запустить плеер' : (t.state === 'PAUSED' ? 'Продолжить' : 'Пауза');
            pauseBtn.disabled = !canCmd;
            pauseBtn.classList.toggle('is-start', idle && canCmd);
        }

        const muteBtn = document.getElementById('pd-mute');
        if (muteBtn) {
            muteBtn.disabled = !canCmd;
            muteBtn.classList.toggle('is-muted', t.muted);
            muteBtn.innerHTML = t.muted ? ic('volumeX') : ic('volume');
            muteBtn.title = t.muted ? 'Включить звук' : 'Заглушить всё (громкость сохранится)';
        }

        const shuffleBtn = document.getElementById('pd-shuffle');
        if (shuffleBtn) shuffleBtn.disabled = !online || !q.enabled || q.playlist.length < 2;

        const input = document.getElementById('pd-input');
        const addBtn = document.getElementById('pd-add');
        const canAdd = Boolean(mode) && online && q.enabled;
        if (input) input.disabled = !canAdd;
        if (addBtn) addBtn.disabled = !canAdd;

        const nowTitle = document.getElementById('pd-now-title');
        const nowMeta = document.getElementById('pd-now-meta');
        if (nowTitle) nowTitle.textContent = now ? (now.title || 'Загрузка названия…') : (q.enabled ? 'Ничего не играет' : 'Плеер выключен');
        if (nowMeta) {
            nowMeta.textContent = now ? (now.isBackground ? 'ФОНОВЫЙ ПЛЕЙЛИСТ' : `ЗАКАЗ: ${now.user}`) : '—';
            nowMeta.classList.toggle('is-bg', !now || !!now.isBackground);
        }

        const seek = document.getElementById('pd-seek');
        if (seek) seek.classList.toggle('is-disabled', !now || !canCmd);
    }
}

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/Dashboard.js — v6.2 (CSS-first: параллельные стили + preload, кэш линков в head) */
import { store } from '../../../js/store.js';
import { renderTemplate } from './template.js';
import { DashboardState } from './state.js';
import { DashboardTransport } from './transport.js';
import { StageController } from './stage.js';
import { QueueList } from './queueList.js';
import { ControlsController } from './controls.js';
import { ConfigBindings } from './configBindings.js';
import { Toast } from '../../../js/components/toast.js';
import { setHashParams } from '../../../js/utils/hashParams.js';
import { extractYouTubeId } from '../queue.js';
const WS_URL = 'ws://127.0.0.1:42069';
let ctx = null;
// === CSS-first загрузчик: параллельные <link> вместо @import-водопада ===
const CSS_VERSION = 'v7';
const CSS_TIMEOUT = 3000;
const CSS_FILES = [
{ id: 'pd-css-base', href: `widgets/player/dashboard/styles/base.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'pd-css-stage', href: `widgets/player/dashboard/styles/stage.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'pd-css-controls', href: `widgets/player/dashboard/styles/controls.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'pd-css-queue', href: `widgets/player/dashboard/styles/queue.css?${CSS_VERSION}` }
];
let cssPromise = null;
function loadOneCss({ id, href }) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const existing = document.getElementById(id);
if (existing) {
if (existing.dataset.loaded === '1') { resolve(true); return; }
// Линк ещё грузится — подписываемся на тот же результат.
existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(true), { once: true });
existing.addEventListener('error', () => resolve(false), { once: true });
return;
}
const link = document.createElement('link');
link.id = id;
link.rel = 'stylesheet';
link.href = href;
link.dataset.loaded = '0';
link.onload = () => { link.dataset.loaded = '1'; resolve(true); };
link.onerror = () => {
console.error(`[PlayerDash:css] Файл стиля не загрузился: ${href}`);
link.remove();
resolve(false);
};
document.head.appendChild(link);
});
}
/** Идемпотентно грузит стили дашборда. Резолвится true/false, никогда не реджектится. */
function preload() {
if (cssPromise) return cssPromise;
const t0 = performance.now();
console.log('[PlayerDash:css] preload: параллельная загрузка стилей...');
const loadAll = Promise.all(CSS_FILES.map(loadOneCss)).then((results) => {
const ok = results.every(Boolean);
if (ok) console.log(`[PlayerDash:css] Стили готовы за ${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}мс`);
else console.warn('[PlayerDash:css] Часть стилей недоступна — возможен деградированный вид.');
return ok;
});
let guardTimer = null;
const guard = new Promise((resolve) => {
guardTimer = setTimeout(() => {
console.warn(`[PlayerDash:css] Таймаут ${CSS_TIMEOUT}мс — рендерим без ожидания стилей.`);
resolve(false);
}, CSS_TIMEOUT);
});
cssPromise = Promise.race([loadAll, guard]).then((ok) => {
if (guardTimer) { clearTimeout(guardTimer); guardTimer = null; }
if (!ok) cssPromise = null; // ошибка/таймаут → повторная попытка при следующем открытии
return ok;
});
return cssPromise;
}
function evaluate() {
if (!ctx) return;
const online = ctx.transport.isOnline();
ctx.stage.evaluate(online);
ctx.queueList.render(online);
ctx.controls.evaluate(online);
}
function mount(params, state) {
const root = document.getElementById('pd-main');
if (!root) return;
unmount();
// В нормальном потоке V2-вью уже дождалась preload() — здесь мгновенный no-op.
// Вызов оставлен для совместимости, если дашборд монтируют напрямую.
preload();
const dashState = new DashboardState();
dashState.setDemoWanted(params?.demo === '1');
const toast = new Toast(document.getElementById('pd-toasts'));
const transport = new DashboardTransport({
url: WS_URL,
onAction: (action, payload) => {
if (action === 'PLAYER_ROSTER') dashState.applyRoster(payload);
else if (action === 'PLAYER_QUEUE_STATE') dashState.applyQueue(payload);
else if (action === 'PLAYER_TRANSPORT') dashState.applyTransport(payload);
else if (action === 'PLAYER_NOTICE') {
const level = payload && payload.level === 'error' ? 'error' : (payload && payload.level === 'warn' ? 'info' : 'info');
toast.show((payload && payload.text) || 'Событие плеера', level);
}
},
onStatus: () => evaluate(),
onAck: ({ ok, message, silent, okToast }) => {
if (!ok && !silent) toast.error(message || 'Команда отклонена.');
else if (ok && okToast) toast.success(okToast);
}
});
transport.setConfigHandler((data) => store.syncFromRemote(data));
const stage = new StageController({
root,
state: dashState,
toast,
onSetSource: (mode) => {
if (!transport.sendRaw({ event: 'PLAYER_SET_ACTIVE', mode })) {
toast.error('Нет связи с сервером.');
return;
}
toast.success(mode === 'demo'
? 'Музыка переключена в лаунчер без потери позиции.'
: 'Музыка возвращена в OBS без потери позиции.');
},
// Присутствие демо-плеера управляет URL (?demo=1) — роутер создаёт/закрывает iframe.
onSpawnDemo: () => setHashParams({ demo: '1', id: 'player' }),
onDespawnDemo: () => setHashParams({ demo: null, id: 'player' }),
onReconnect: () => {
const btn = document.getElementById('pd-reconnect');
if (btn) { btn.classList.add('is-spin'); setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('is-spin'), 900); }
transport.connect();
if (dashState.demoWanted && !dashState.has('demo')) {
stage.destroyIframe();
stage.createIframe();
stage.expectDemoHandoff();
}
setTimeout(() => transport.requestSync(), 600);
toast.info('Переподключение к серверу...');
},
onRequestSync: () => transport.requestSync()
});
const queueList = new QueueList({
root,
state: dashState,
mountAt: Date.now(),
onPlay: (uid) => transport.cmd('PLAYER_PLAY_SPECIFIC', { uid }, { silent: true }),
onRemove: (uid) => transport.cmd('PLAYER_REMOVE_TRACK', { uid }, { silent: true }),
onRestore: (uid) => transport.cmd('PLAYER_RESTORE_TRACK', { uid }, { silent: true }),
onRestart: () => transport.cmd('PLAYER_PLAYLIST_RESTART', {}, { okToast: 'Плейлист запущен с начала.' })
});
const controls = new ControlsController({
root,
state: dashState,
toast,
onCmd: (action, payload, opts) => transport.cmd(action, payload, opts),
onAddTrack: (url) => {
if (!extractYouTubeId(url)) {
toast.error('Не распознал ссылку YouTube.');
return false;
}
return transport.cmd('PLAYER_ADD_TRACK', { url, user: 'Стример' }, { okToast: 'Трек добавлен в очередь.' });
}
});
const configBindings = new ConfigBindings({
root,
store,
onAfterChange: () => setTimeout(() => transport.requestSync(), 350)
});
ctx = {
root,
state: dashState,
transport,
stage,
queueList,
controls,
config: configBindings,
toast,
tickTimer: null,
unsubState: null,
lastPing: 0
};
stage.mount();
queueList.mount();
controls.mount();
configBindings.mount();
configBindings.sync(store.getState());
ctx.unsubState = dashState.subscribe(() => evaluate());
transport.connect();
// Deep link ?demo=1: создаём плеер и сразу планируем авто-эстафету в лаунчер.
if (dashState.demoWanted) {
stage.createIframe();
stage.expectDemoHandoff();
}
ctx.tickTimer = setInterval(() => {
if (!transport.isOnline()) transport.connect();
evaluate();
const q = dashState.queue;
const now = Date.now();
if ((!q.hasSnapshot || now - q.receivedAt > 8000) && now - ctx.lastPing > 4000) {
ctx.lastPing = now;
transport.requestSync();
}
}, 1000);
evaluate();
console.log('[Dashboard] v6.2 смонтирован', params);
}
function onParamsChange(params) {
if (!ctx) return false;
if ((params?.id || 'player') !== 'player') return false;
const want = params?.demo === '1';
if (want !== ctx.state.demoWanted) {
ctx.state.setDemoWanted(want);
if (want) {
ctx.stage.createIframe();
ctx.stage.expectDemoHandoff();
} else {
ctx.stage.cancelPending();
ctx.stage.destroyIframe();
}
}
return true;
}
function unmount() {
if (!ctx) return;
console.log('[Dashboard] Размонтирование');
if (ctx.tickTimer) clearInterval(ctx.tickTimer);
if (ctx.unsubState) ctx.unsubState();
ctx.stage.unmount();
ctx.queueList.unmount();
ctx.controls.unmount();
ctx.config.unmount();
ctx.transport.close();
ctx = null;
// Стили (pd-css-*) намеренно остаются в <head>: кэш между вкладками
// убивает FOUC при повторном открытии. Селекторы изолированы префиксом pd-.
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#pd-demo-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
}
export default {
render: (state, params) => renderTemplate(state, params),
preload,
mount,
onParamsChange,
unmount
};

--- START OF FILE widgets/player/dashboard/queueList.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/queueList.js — v5 */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { thumbnailUrl } from '../queue.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
const SNAPSHOT_WAIT = 6000;

export class QueueList {
constructor({ root, state, mountAt, onPlay, onRemove, onRestore, onRestart }) {
this.root = root;
this.state = state;
this.mountAt = mountAt;
this.onPlay = onPlay;
this.onRemove = onRemove;
this.onRestore = onRestore;
this.onRestart = onRestart;
this.filter = '';
this.rowMap = new Map();
this.optTimers = new Map();
this.clickHandler = null;
this.searchHandler = null;
this.restartHandler = null;
}

mount() {
const list = document.getElementById('pd-queue');
const search = document.getElementById('pd-search');
const restart = document.getElementById('pd-restart');
this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
this.searchHandler = (e) => { this.filter = e.target.value; this.render(); };
this.restartHandler = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!restart.disabled) this.onRestart(); };
if (list) list.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
if (search) search.addEventListener('input', this.searchHandler);
if (restart) restart.addEventListener('click', this.restartHandler);
}

unmount() {
const list = document.getElementById('pd-queue');
const search = document.getElementById('pd-search');
const restart = document.getElementById('pd-restart');
if (list && this.clickHandler) list.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
if (search && this.searchHandler) search.removeEventListener('input', this.searchHandler);
if (restart && this.restartHandler) restart.removeEventListener('click', this.restartHandler);
for (const t of this.optTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
this.optTimers.clear();
this.rowMap.clear();
}

_onClick(e) {
const rm = e.target.closest('.pd-btn-remove');
if (rm) {
e.preventDefault();
e.stopPropagation();
const uid = rm.getAttribute('data-uid');
const row = rm.closest('.pd-q-item');
if (rm.classList.contains('is-restore')) {
this.onRestore(uid);
} else {
this._optimistic('o-' + uid, row);
this._optimistic('p-' + uid, row);
this.onRemove(uid);
}
return;
}
const track = e.target.closest('.clickable-track');
if (track) {
e.preventDefault();
const uid = track.getAttribute('data-uid');
this._optimistic('o-' + uid, track);
this.onPlay(uid);
}
}

_optimistic(key, el) {
if (!el) return;
el.classList.add('optimistic-action');
const old = this.optTimers.get(key);
if (old) clearTimeout(old);
this.optTimers.set(key, setTimeout(() => {
this.optTimers.delete(key);
if (el.isConnected) el.classList.remove('optimistic-action');
}, 2200));
}

_row(item) {
const el = document.createElement('div');
el.dataset.kind = item.kind;
if (item.kind === 'hdr') {
el.className = 'pd-q-hdr';
el.innerHTML = `<span class="pd-q-hdr-label"></span><span class="pd-q-hdr-note"></span>`;
} else if (item.kind === 'loading') {
el.className = 'pd-sk-row';
el.innerHTML = `<div class="pd-sk-thumb"></div><div class="pd-sk-lines"><div class="pd-sk-line" style="width:75%"></div><div class="pd-sk-line" style="width:40%"></div></div>`;
} else if (item.kind === 'empty') {
el.className = 'pd-empty';
el.innerHTML = `${ic('music')}<div class="pd-empty-title"></div><div class="pd-empty-sub"></div>`;
} else {
el.className = 'pd-q-item clickable-track' + (item.bg ? ' is-bg' : '');
el.innerHTML = `<div class="pd-q-thumb"></div><div class="pd-q-info"><div class="pd-q-title"></div><div class="pd-q-user${item.bg ? ' is-muted' : ''}"></div></div><button class="pd-btn-remove" title="Убрать">${ic('trash')}</button>`;
}
return el;
}

_updateRow(el, item) {
if (item.kind === 'hdr') {
const label = el.querySelector('.pd-q-hdr-label');
const note = el.querySelector('.pd-q-hdr-note');
if (label && label.textContent !== item.label) label.textContent = item.label;
if (note && note.textContent !== (item.note || '')) note.textContent = item.note || '';
return;
}
if (item.kind === 'loading') return;
if (item.kind === 'empty') {
const t = el.querySelector('.pd-empty-title');
const s = el.querySelector('.pd-empty-sub');
if (t && t.textContent !== item.title) t.textContent = item.title;
if (s && s.textContent !== item.sub) s.textContent = item.sub;
return;
}
const t = item.track;
const titleEl = el.querySelector('.pd-q-title');
const userEl = el.querySelector('.pd-q-user');
const thumbEl = el.querySelector('.pd-q-thumb');
const btn = el.querySelector('.pd-btn-remove');
const title = t.title || (t.isBackground ? 'Фоновый трек' : 'Трек');
if (titleEl && titleEl.textContent !== title) titleEl.textContent = title;

const isCurrent = item.current;
el.classList.toggle('is-current', isCurrent);
el.classList.toggle('is-played', !!t.played && !isCurrent);
el.classList.toggle('is-removed', !!t.removed);
el.dataset.uid = t.uid;

if (userEl) {
const parts = [];
if (item.bg) parts.push(`<span class="pd-q-index">${String(t.index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>`);
if (isCurrent) parts.push(`<span class="pd-q-flag is-live">ИГРАЕТ</span>`);
else if (t.removed) parts.push(`<span class="pd-q-flag">СКРЫТ</span>`);
else if (t.played) parts.push(`<span class="pd-q-flag">ПРОСЛУШАН</span>`);
parts.push(`<span>${esc(item.bg ? 'Фоновая музыка' : (t.user || 'Гость'))}</span>`);
const html = parts.join('');
if (userEl.innerHTML !== html) userEl.innerHTML = html;
}

const key = String(t.id) + String(t.type);
if (thumbEl && thumbEl.dataset.id !== key) {
thumbEl.dataset.id = key;
const url = thumbnailUrl(t, 'mqdefault');
if (url) { thumbEl.innerHTML = ''; thumbEl.style.backgroundImage = `url("${url}")`; }
else { thumbEl.style.backgroundImage = 'none'; thumbEl.innerHTML = ic('music'); }
}
if (btn) {
btn.dataset.uid = t.uid;
btn.classList.toggle('is-restore', !!t.removed);
btn.title = t.removed ? 'Вернуть в плейлист' : 'Убрать';
btn.innerHTML = t.removed ? ic('sync') : ic('trash');
}
}

render() {
const list = document.getElementById('pd-queue');
if (!list) return;
const q = this.state.queue;
const desired = [];
const now = Date.now();

if (!q.hasSnapshot && now - this.mountAt < SNAPSHOT_WAIT) {
desired.push({ key: 'sk1', kind: 'loading' });
desired.push({ key: 'sk2', kind: 'loading' });
desired.push({ key: 'sk3', kind: 'loading' });
} else if (!q.hasSnapshot) {
desired.push({ key: 'empty', kind: 'empty', title: 'Нет данных от сервера', sub: 'Нажмите кнопку переподключения в шапке стенда.' });
} else {
const { orders, playlist } = q.filter(this.filter);
const currentUid = q.currentUid;
if (orders.length > 0) {
desired.push({ key: 'hdr-o', kind: 'hdr', label: `ЗАКАЗЫ · ${orders.length}`, note: 'играют первыми' });
orders.forEach(t => desired.push({ key: 'o-' + t.uid, kind: 'track', track: t, bg: false, current: t.uid === currentUid }));
}
if (playlist.length > 0) {
desired.push({ key: 'hdr-p', kind: 'hdr', label: `ПЛЕЙЛИСТ (ФОН) · ${playlist.filter(t => !t.removed).length}`, note: q.shuffle ? 'случайный порядок' : 'по порядку' });
playlist.forEach(t => desired.push({ key: 'p-' + t.uid, kind: 'track', track: t, bg: true, current: t.uid === currentUid }));
}
if (desired.length === 0) {
if (this.filter) {
desired.push({ key: 'empty', kind: 'empty', title: 'Ничего не найдено', sub: `По запросу «${this.filter}» совпадений нет.` });
} else {
desired.push({ key: 'empty', kind: 'empty', title: 'Очередь пуста', sub: 'Добавьте трек ссылкой слева, дождитесь заказов из чата (!play) или включите фоновый плейлист.' });
}
}
}

const count = document.getElementById('pd-q-count');
if (count) count.textContent = `${q.orders.length} + ${q.playlist.filter(x => !x.removed).length}`;
const restart = document.getElementById('pd-restart');
if (restart) restart.disabled = q.playlist.length === 0;

const seen = new Set();
let cursor = list.firstElementChild;
for (const item of desired) {
seen.add(item.key);
let el = this.rowMap.get(item.key);
if (!el || el.dataset.kind !== item.kind || !el.isConnected) {
if (el) el.remove();
el = this._row(item);
this.rowMap.set(item.key, el);
}
this._updateRow(el, item);
if (el === cursor) cursor = cursor.nextElementSibling;
else list.insertBefore(el, cursor);
}
for (const [key, el] of this.rowMap) {
if (!seen.has(key)) {
el.remove();
this.rowMap.delete(key);
const timer = this.optTimers.get(key);
if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); this.optTimers.delete(key); }
}
}
}
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/player/dashboard/stage.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/stage.js — v6 (единый переключатель источника: один клик, авто-эстафета, демо закрывается при возврате в OBS) */
import { thumbnailUrl } from '../queue.js';

const SERVER_HTTP = 'http://localhost:42069';
const IFRAME_WAIT = 8000;
const HANDOFF_TIMEOUT = 14000;

export class StageController {
    constructor({ root, state, toast, onSetSource, onSpawnDemo, onDespawnDemo, onReconnect, onRequestSync }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.state = state;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.onSetSource = onSetSource;
        this.onSpawnDemo = onSpawnDemo;
        this.onDespawnDemo = onDespawnDemo;
        this.onReconnect = onReconnect;
        this.onRequestSync = onRequestSync;
        this.iframe = null;
        this.iframeLoaded = false;
        this.iframeFailed = false;
        this.iframeTimer = null;
        this.resizeObs = null;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.pendingDemo = false;
        this.pendingSince = 0;
        this._lastOnline = false;
        this._lastHint = '';
    }

    mount() {
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        const stage = document.getElementById('pd-stage');
        this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.scaleIframe());
        if (stage) this.resizeObs.observe(stage);
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.resizeObs) this.resizeObs.disconnect();
        this.cancelPending();
        this.destroyIframe();
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.closest('#pd-reconnect')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.onReconnect();
            return;
        }
        const idleCta = t.closest('#pd-idle-demo');
        if (idleCta && !idleCta.disabled) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.requestSource('demo');
            return;
        }
        const seg = t.closest('.pd-seg-btn');
        if (seg && !seg.disabled) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.requestSource(seg.getAttribute('data-source'));
        }
    }

    /** Единая точка входа для сегмента и idle-CTA. */
    requestSource(mode) {
        const online = this._lastOnline;
        if (!online) {
            this.toast.error('Нет связи с локальным сервером.');
            return;
        }
        const current = this.state.activeMode();

        if (mode === 'demo') {
            if (this.pendingDemo) return;
            if (current === 'demo' && this.state.has('demo')) return;
            if (this.state.has('demo')) {
                this.onSetSource('demo');
                return;
            }
            if (this.iframeFailed) this.destroyIframe();
            this.expectDemoHandoff();
            if (!this.state.demoWanted) this.onSpawnDemo();
            else this.createIframe();
            this.toast.info('Запускаю плеер в лаунчере…');
            this.evaluate(online);
            return;
        }

        if (mode === 'obs') {
            if (!this.state.has('obs')) {
                this.toast.info('OBS-плеер не подключён. Откройте OBS с виджетом плеера.');
                return;
            }
            if (current === 'obs' && !this.state.demoWanted) return;
            this.cancelPending();
            // Сначала сервер замораживает позицию и передаёт эстафету в OBS…
            this.onSetSource('obs');
            // …затем закрываем демо-iframe (вариант «закрывать при возврате в OBS»).
            if (this.state.demoWanted) this.onDespawnDemo();
        }
    }

    expectDemoHandoff() {
        this.pendingDemo = true;
        this.pendingSince = Date.now();
    }

    cancelPending() {
        this.pendingDemo = false;
        this.pendingSince = 0;
    }

    createIframe() {
        if (this.iframe) return;
        const layer = document.getElementById('pd-iframe-layer');
        if (!layer) return;
        this.iframeLoaded = false;
        this.iframeFailed = false;
        const f = document.createElement('iframe');
        f.className = 'pd-iframe';
        f.id = 'pd-demo-iframe';
        f.title = 'Демо-плеер';
        f.allow = 'autoplay; encrypted-media';
        f.src = `${SERVER_HTTP}/player/index.html?preview=1&demo=1&cb=${Date.now()}`;
        f.onload = () => {
            if (this.iframe !== f) return;
            setTimeout(() => { if (this.iframe === f && this.onRequestSync) this.onRequestSync(); }, 400);
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (this.iframe !== f) return;
                if (this.state.has('demo')) { this.iframeLoaded = true; this.evaluate(this._lastOnline); }
            }, 2500);
        };
        f.onerror = () => { this.iframeFailed = true; this.evaluate(this._lastOnline); };
        layer.appendChild(f);
        this.iframe = f;
        const loading = document.getElementById('pd-stage-loading');
        if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');
        if (this.iframeTimer) clearTimeout(this.iframeTimer);
        this.iframeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (!this.iframe) return;
            if (!this.state.has('demo')) { this.iframeFailed = true; this.evaluate(this._lastOnline); }
        }, IFRAME_WAIT);
        this.evaluate(this._lastOnline);
    }

    destroyIframe() {
        if (this.iframeTimer) { clearTimeout(this.iframeTimer); this.iframeTimer = null; }
        if (this.iframe) {
            const f = this.iframe;
            this.iframe = null;
            try { f.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (e) {}
            f.remove();
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('iframe#pd-demo-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
        this.iframeLoaded = false;
        this.iframeFailed = false;
        this.cancelPending();
        const loading = document.getElementById('pd-stage-loading');
        if (loading) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');
        // Страховка: если демо исчезло, будучи активным, — возвращаем звук в OBS.
        if (this.state.roster.active === 'demo' && this.onSetSource) {
            this.onSetSource('obs');
        }
        if (this.onRequestSync) this.onRequestSync();
        this.evaluate(this._lastOnline);
    }

    scaleIframe() {
        const stage = document.getElementById('pd-stage');
        if (!stage || !this.iframe) return;
        const s = Math.min(stage.clientWidth / 480, stage.clientHeight / 380) * 0.96;
        this.iframe.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${s})`;
    }

    evaluate(online) {
        this._lastOnline = online;

        // Авто-эстафета: как только демо зарегистрировалось — переводим звук одним действием.
        if (this.pendingDemo) {
            if (this.state.has('demo')) {
                this.cancelPending();
                this.onSetSource('demo');
            } else if (Date.now() - this.pendingSince > HANDOFF_TIMEOUT) {
                this.cancelPending();
                this.toast.error('Демо-плеер не запустился. Нажмите «Переподключить» и попробуйте снова.');
            }
        }

        const hasObs = this.state.has('obs');
        const hasDemo = this.state.has('demo');
        const mode = this.state.activeMode();
        const q = this.state.queue;
        const t = this.state.transport;
        const now = q.nowPlaying;

        const setBadge = (id, cls, text) => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!el) return;
            el.className = `pd-badge ${cls}`;
            el.innerHTML = `<span class="pd-badge-dot"></span>${text}`;
        };
        setBadge('pd-server', online ? 'pd-badge-live' : 'pd-badge-off', online ? 'СЕРВЕР ONLINE' : 'СЕРВЕР OFFLINE');
        setBadge('pd-obs', hasObs ? 'pd-badge-live' : 'pd-badge-off', hasObs ? 'OBS ПЛЕЕР ЖИВ' : 'OBS НЕ НАЙДЕН');

        const launching = this.pendingDemo || (Boolean(this.iframe) && !hasDemo && !this.iframeFailed);

        const segObs = document.getElementById('pd-seg-obs');
        const segDemo = document.getElementById('pd-seg-demo');
        if (segObs) {
            segObs.classList.toggle('is-active', mode === 'obs');
            segObs.setAttribute('aria-pressed', mode === 'obs' ? 'true' : 'false');
            segObs.disabled = !online || !hasObs;
        }
        if (segDemo) {
            segDemo.classList.toggle('is-active', mode === 'demo');
            segDemo.setAttribute('aria-pressed', mode === 'demo' ? 'true' : 'false');
            segDemo.disabled = !online || this.pendingDemo;
        }
        const dotObs = document.getElementById('pd-seg-dot-obs');
        if (dotObs) dotObs.className = 'pd-seg-dot' + (hasObs ? ' is-live' : '');
        const dotDemo = document.getElementById('pd-seg-dot-demo');
        if (dotDemo) dotDemo.className = 'pd-seg-dot' + (hasDemo ? ' is-live' : (launching ? ' is-launching' : ''));

        const hint = document.getElementById('pd-source-hint');
        if (hint) {
            let text;
            if (!online) text = 'Нет связи с локальным сервером.';
            else if (launching) text = 'Запускаю плеер в лаунчере…';
            else if (mode === 'demo') text = 'Звук идёт из лаунчера. Верните в OBS одним кликом.';
            else if (mode === 'obs') text = 'Звук идёт в OBS Studio.';
            else text = 'Откройте OBS или включите «Лаунчер», чтобы слушать здесь.';
            if (this._lastHint !== text) {
                this._lastHint = text;
                hint.textContent = text;
            }
        }

        const showIframe = Boolean(this.iframe) && mode === 'demo';
        const showMirror = mode === 'obs' && hasObs;
        const showIdle = !showIframe && !showMirror;
        const mirror = document.getElementById('pd-mirror');
        const iframeLayer = document.getElementById('pd-iframe-layer');
        const idle = document.getElementById('pd-idle');
        if (mirror) mirror.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !showMirror);
        if (iframeLayer) iframeLayer.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !showIframe);
        if (idle) idle.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !showIdle);

        const idleTitle = document.getElementById('pd-idle-title');
        const idleSub = document.getElementById('pd-idle-sub');
        const idleCta = document.getElementById('pd-idle-demo');
        if (idleTitle && idleSub) {
            if (!online) {
                idleTitle.textContent = 'Сервер недоступен';
                idleSub.textContent = 'Лаунчер должен быть запущен через npm start — сервер поднимается автоматически.';
            } else {
                idleTitle.textContent = 'Плеер не найден';
                idleSub.textContent = 'Откройте OBS с виджетом плеера — или нажмите «Слушать в лаунчере», чтобы слушать музыку прямо здесь.';
            }
        }
        if (idleCta) idleCta.disabled = !online || this.pendingDemo;

        const loading = document.getElementById('pd-stage-loading');
        if (loading) loading.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !(Boolean(this.iframe) && !this.iframeFailed && !hasDemo));

        const note = document.getElementById('pd-stage-note');
        if (note) {
            let text = '';
            if (this.iframeFailed && this.state.demoWanted) text = 'Демо-плеер не ответил. Нажмите «Переподключить».';
            if (text) { note.textContent = text; note.classList.add('is-visible'); }
            else note.classList.remove('is-visible');
        }

        const stage = document.getElementById('pd-stage');
        if (stage) stage.classList.toggle('is-live', Boolean(now && t.state === 'PLAYING'));

        if (showMirror) this.renderMirror(now, t);
        this.scaleIframe();
    }

    renderMirror(now, t) {
        const titleEl = document.getElementById('pd-mirror-title');
        const userEl = document.getElementById('pd-mirror-user');
        const coverEl = document.getElementById('pd-mirror-cover');
        if (!titleEl || !coverEl) return;
        if (now) {
            titleEl.textContent = now.title || 'Играет трек…';
            titleEl.classList.remove('pd-mirror-stopped');
            if (userEl) {
                userEl.textContent = now.isBackground ? 'Автоплейлист' : `Заказ: ${now.user}`;
                userEl.style.display = '';
            }
            const hi = thumbnailUrl(now, 'maxresdefault');
            const lo = thumbnailUrl(now, 'hqdefault');
            if (hi && coverEl.dataset.id !== now.id) {
                coverEl.dataset.id = now.id;
                coverEl.onerror = () => { if (lo) coverEl.src = lo; };
                coverEl.src = hi;
                coverEl.style.display = '';
            } else if (!hi) {
                coverEl.style.display = 'none';
                coverEl.dataset.id = '';
            }
        } else {
            titleEl.textContent = t.state === 'IDLE' ? 'ПЛЕЕР ОСТАНОВЛЕН' : 'ОЖИДАНИЕ ТРЕКА';
            titleEl.classList.add('pd-mirror-stopped');
            if (userEl) userEl.style.display = 'none';
            coverEl.style.display = 'none';
            coverEl.dataset.id = '';
        }
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/player/dashboard/state.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/state.js — v5.1 (hotfix: удалена задвоенная копия модуля) */
import { QueueMirror } from '../queue.js';

export class DashboardState {
    constructor() {
        this.roster = { players: [], active: null, preferred: null };
        this.queue = new QueueMirror();
        this.transport = { state: 'IDLE', currentTime: 0, duration: 0, muted: false, uid: null, _recv: 0 };
        this.demoWanted = false;
        this.listeners = new Set();
        console.log('[Dash:state] v5.1 инициализирован (единая копия модуля)');
    }

    subscribe(fn) {
        this.listeners.add(fn);
        return () => this.listeners.delete(fn);
    }

    emit() {
        this.listeners.forEach(fn => {
            try { fn(this); } catch (e) { console.error('[Dash:state] Ошибка слушателя:', e); }
        });
    }

    applyRoster(payload) {
        if (!payload) {
            console.warn('[Dash:state] applyRoster: пустой payload, пропускаю');
            return;
        }
        const prevActive = this.roster.active;
        this.roster = {
            players: Array.isArray(payload.players) ? payload.players : [],
            active: payload.active || null,
            preferred: payload.preferred || null
        };
        if (this.roster.active !== prevActive) {
            console.log(`[Dash:state] Активный плеер: ${prevActive || 'нет'} → ${this.roster.active || 'нет'}`);
        }
        this.emit();
    }

    applyQueue(payload) {
        if (!payload) {
            console.warn('[Dash:state] applyQueue: пустой payload, пропускаю');
            return;
        }
        this.queue.apply(payload);
        this.emit();
    }

    applyTransport(payload) {
        if (!payload) {
            console.warn('[Dash:state] applyTransport: пустой payload, пропускаю');
            return;
        }
        this.transport = {
            state: payload.state || 'IDLE',
            currentTime: Number(payload.currentTime) || 0,
            duration: Number(payload.duration) || 0,
            muted: !!payload.muted,
            uid: payload.uid || null,
            _recv: performance.now()
        };
        this.emit();
    }

    has(mode) { return this.roster.players.some(p => p.mode === mode); }

    activeMode() {
        if (this.roster.active) return this.roster.active;
        if (this.has('obs')) return 'obs';
        if (this.has('demo')) return 'demo';
        return null;
    }

    setDemoWanted(value) {
        this.demoWanted = !!value;
        this.emit();
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/player/dashboard/template.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/template.js — v7 (мастер-тумблер в шапке, shuffle-кнопка, чипы команд) */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

const CHAT_COMMANDS = [
    { cmd: '!play', copy: '!play ', title: 'Заказать трек: !play <ссылка YouTube>' },
    { cmd: '!sr', copy: '!sr ', title: 'Алиас команды !play' },
    { cmd: '!skip', copy: '!skip', title: 'Следующий трек (он же ручной старт)' },
    { cmd: '!prev', copy: '!prev', title: 'Предыдущий трек из истории' },
    { cmd: '!pause', copy: '!pause', title: 'Пауза / продолжить' },
    { cmd: '!vol', copy: '!vol 40', title: 'Громкость заказов: !vol 0–100' },

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/player/dashboard/transport.js — v5 */
const ACK_TIMEOUT = 600;

export class DashboardTransport {
constructor({ url, onAction, onStatus, onAck }) {
this.url = url;
this.onAction = onAction;
this.onStatus = onStatus;
this.onAck = onAck;
this.onConfig = null;
this.ws = null;
this.retry = 1200;
this.timer = null;
this.pending = new Map();
this.seq = 0;
this.closed = false;
}

setConfigHandler(fn) { this.onConfig = fn; }

connect() {
if (this.closed) return;
if (this.timer) { clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = null; }
if (this.ws) {
const old = this.ws;
this.ws = null;
old.onopen = old.onmessage = old.onerror = old.onclose = null;
try { old.close(); } catch (e) {}
}
let sock;
try { sock = new WebSocket(this.url); } catch (e) { this._schedule(); return; }
this.ws = sock;
sock.onopen = () => {
if (this.ws !== sock) return;
this.retry = 1200;
if (this.onStatus) this.onStatus(true);
this.requestSync();
};
sock.onmessage = (e) => {
if (this.ws !== sock) return;
try {
const msg = JSON.parse(e.data);
if (msg.event === 'WIDGET_ACTION') {
if (msg.action === 'PLAYER_ACK') this._handleAck(msg.payload || {});
else if (this.onAction) this.onAction(msg.action, msg.payload || {});
} else if (msg.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED' && msg.data) {
if (this.onConfig) this.onConfig(msg.data);
} else if (msg.event === 'SERVER_HELLO') {
if (this.onStatus) this.onStatus(true);
}
} catch (err) {}
};
sock.onerror = () => { try { sock.close(); } catch (e) {} };
sock.onclose = () => {
if (this.ws !== sock) return;
this.ws = null;
if (this.onStatus) this.onStatus(false);
this._schedule();
};
}

_schedule() {
if (this.closed || this.timer) return;
this.timer = setTimeout(() => { this.timer = null; this.connect(); }, this.retry);
this.retry = Math.min(Math.round(this.retry * 1.5), 6000);
}

isOnline() { return Boolean(this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1); }

sendRaw(obj) {
if (this.isOnline()) {
try { this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(obj)); return true; } catch (e) {}
}
return false;
}

requestSync() {
this.sendRaw({ event: 'PLAYER_ROSTER_REQUEST' });
this.sendRaw({ event: 'PLAYER_QUEUE_REQUEST' });
}

cmd(action, payload = {}, opts = {}) {
if (!this.isOnline()) {
if (this.onAck) this.onAck({ ok: false, message: 'Нет связи с сервером. Команда не доставлена.', action, silent: opts.silent });
return false;
}
const cmdId = 'c' + (++this.seq) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36);
const body = { ...payload, cmdId };
const entry = { action, body, attempts: 1, timer: null, silent: !!opts.silent, okToast: opts.okToast };
const arm = () => {
entry.timer = setTimeout(() => {
const cur = this.pending.get(cmdId);
if (!cur) return;
if (cur.attempts < 2) {
cur.attempts++;
this.sendRaw({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action, payload: body });
arm();
} else {
this.pending.delete(cmdId);
if (this.onAck) this.onAck({ ok: false, message: `Команда ${action} не подтверждена сервером.`, action, silent: cur.silent });
}
}, ACK_TIMEOUT);
};
this.pending.set(cmdId, entry);
this.sendRaw({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action, payload: body });
arm();
return true;
}

_handleAck(payload) {
const entry = this.pending.get(payload.cmdId);
if (!entry) return;
clearTimeout(entry.timer);
this.pending.delete(payload.cmdId);
if (this.onAck) {
this.onAck({ ok: !!payload.ok, message: payload.message, action: payload.action, silent: entry.silent, okToast: entry.okToast });
}
}

close() {
this.closed = true;
if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
for (const entry of this.pending.values()) clearTimeout(entry.timer);
this.pending.clear();
if (this.ws) {
const s = this.ws;
this.ws = null;
s.onopen = s.onmessage = s.onerror = s.onclose = null;
try { s.close(); } catch (e) {}
}
}
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/shared/AvatarManager.js ---

/* ====================================================================
   МЕНЕДЖЕР АВАТАРОК (Shared Module)
   Кэширует аватарки Twitch в RAM и LocalStorage.
   Доступен для импорта во все виджеты.
   ==================================================================== */

export const AvatarManager = {
  CACHE_KEY: 'uso_avatars_lru',
  MAX_CACHED_USERS: 150, 
  ramCache: {},
  saveTimeout: null,

  init: function() {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(this.CACHE_KEY);
      if (saved) this.ramCache = JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch(e) { 
      this.ramCache = {}; 
    }
  },

  syncToDisk: function() {
    const keys = Object.keys(this.ramCache);
    if (keys.length > this.MAX_CACHED_USERS) {
      keys.sort((a, b) => this.ramCache[a].ts - this.ramCache[b].ts);
      const itemsToRemove = keys.length - this.MAX_CACHED_USERS;
      for (let i = 0; i < itemsToRemove; i++) delete this.ramCache[keys[i]];
    }
    try { 
      localStorage.setItem(this.CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.ramCache)); 
    } catch(e) { 
      this.ramCache = {}; 
      localStorage.removeItem(this.CACHE_KEY); 
    }
  },

  get: async function(username, fallbackColor = '#FF4477') {
    const cleanName = username.toLowerCase();
    
    // 1. Быстрый ответ из RAM (Кэш)
    if (this.ramCache[cleanName]) {
      this.ramCache[cleanName].ts = Date.now();
      return this.ramCache[cleanName].value;
    }
    
    // 2. Запрос к API Twitch
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`https://api.ivr.fi/v2/twitch/user?login=${cleanName}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("API Error");
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data && data.length > 0 && data[0].logo) {
        this._saveToRam(cleanName, data[0].logo);
        return data[0].logo;
      }
      throw new Error("No Avatar");
    } catch (e) {
      // 3. Заглушка, если API недоступно или у юзера нет авы
      const hexColor = fallbackColor.replace('#', '');
      const fallbackUrl = `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${cleanName}&background=${hexColor}&color=fff&size=64&bold=true`;
      this._saveToRam(cleanName, fallbackUrl);
      return fallbackUrl;
    }
  },

  _saveToRam: function(key, value) {
    this.ramCache[key] = { value: value, ts: Date.now() };
    
    // Отложенная запись на диск (Debounce 5 сек)
    // Чтобы при массовом спаме не насиловать LocalStorage
    clearTimeout(this.saveTimeout);
    this.saveTimeout = setTimeout(() => this.syncToDisk(), 5000);
  }
};

// Автоматическая инициализация при импорте
AvatarManager.init();

--- START OF FILE widgets/shared/WidgetCore.js ---

/* ====================================================================
WIDGET CORE — v4.1
Leader Election, автономная работа (file://), Event Bus.
+ sendAction: WS → localStorage fallback.
+ onTwitchEvent: событие канала рассылается всем экземплярам по шине.
+ WIDGET_HELLO: регистрация виджета на сервере.
+ onSocketOpen: колбэк сразу после открытия WS — телеметрия уходит без задержки.
==================================================================== */
const INSTANCE_ID = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);
const IS_LOCAL_FILE = window.location.protocol === 'file:';
const HOST = window.location.host || 'localhost:42069';
const IS_PREVIEW = window.location.search.includes('preview=1');
const FOLLOW_POLL_MS = 60000;

function detectWidgetId() {
try {
const m = window.location.pathname.match(/\/([a-z0-9_-]+)\/index\.html$/i);
if (m) return m[1].toLowerCase();
} catch (e) {}
return 'unknown';
}

export const WidgetCore = {
globalConfig: null,
ws: null,
tmiClient: null,
currentChannel: null,
thirdPartyEmotes: new Map(),
isMaster: false,
bus: null,
widgetId: detectWidgetId(),
source: IS_PREVIEW ? 'preview' : 'obs',
instanceId: INSTANCE_ID,
_electionInterval: null,
_wsUpdateTimer: null,
_helloTimer: null,
_followTimer: null,
_eventsBound: false,
callbacks: {
onConfigUpdate: (config) => {},
onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args, tags, message) => {},
onTwitchMessage: (tags, message) => {},
onTwitchEvent: (kind, payload) => {},
onWidgetAction: (action, payload) => {},
onMasterStatusChange: (isMaster) => {},
onSocketOpen: () => {}
},
init: function(callbacks = {}) {
const { widgetId, source, ...rest } = callbacks;
if (widgetId) this.widgetId = String(widgetId);
if (source) this.source = String(source);
this.callbacks = { ...this.callbacks, ...rest };
this._setupStorageListeners();
this._loadConfig();
},
updateWidgetConfig: function(widgetId, newWidgetData) {
if (!this.globalConfig) return;
if (!this.globalConfig.widgets) this.globalConfig.widgets = {};
if (!this.globalConfig.widgets[widgetId]) this.globalConfig.widgets[widgetId] = {};
this.globalConfig.widgets[widgetId] = { ...this.globalConfig.widgets[widgetId], ...newWidgetData };
if (this.callbacks.onConfigUpdate) this.callbacks.onConfigUpdate(this.globalConfig);
if (!IS_LOCAL_FILE && this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1) {
if (this._wsUpdateTimer) clearTimeout(this._wsUpdateTimer);
this._wsUpdateTimer = setTimeout(() => {
try { this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'UPDATE_CONFIG', data: this.globalConfig })); }
catch (e) { console.warn('[WidgetCore] UPDATE_CONFIG не отправлен:', e); }
}, 50);
} else {
try { localStorage.setItem('stream_pack_config', JSON.stringify(this.globalConfig)); } catch (e) {}
}
},
sendAction: function(action, payload) {
if (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1) {
try {
this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', action, payload }));
return true;
} catch (e) { console.warn('[WidgetCore] WS send упал, пробую шину:', e); }
}
try {
localStorage.setItem('stream_pack_action', JSON.stringify({ action, payload, _n: Date.now() + Math.random() }));
return true;
} catch (e) { return false; }
},
broadcastState: function(payload) {
if (this.isMaster && this.bus) this.bus.postMessage({ type: 'SYNC_STATE', payload });
},
_emitEvent: function(kind, payload) {
if (!this.isMaster || !payload) return;
const body = { ...payload, kind, eventId: `${kind}:${Date.now()}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}` };
console.log(`[WidgetCore:${this.widgetId}] Событие канала → ${kind}`, body);
try { if (this.callbacks.onTwitchEvent) this.callbacks.onTwitchEvent(kind, body); }
catch (e) { console.error('[WidgetCore] onTwitchEvent:', e); }
if (this.bus) { try { this.bus.postMessage({ type: 'EVENT', kind, payload: body }); } catch (e) {} }
},
_setupTMI: async function(channel) {
if (typeof tmi === 'undefined' || !channel) return;
this.currentChannel = channel;
if (!this.bus) {
try {
this.bus = new BroadcastChannel('stream_pack_tmi_bus');
this.bus.onmessage = (e) => {
const d = e.data || {};
if (d.type === 'EVENT') {
try { if (this.callbacks.onTwitchEvent) this.callbacks.onTwitchEvent(d.kind, d.payload); }
catch (err) { console.error('[WidgetCore] EVENT:', err); }
return;
}
if (this.isMaster) return;
if (d.type === 'MSG') { if (this.callbacks.onTwitchMessage) this.callbacks.onTwitchMessage(d.tags, d.message); }
else if (d.type === 'CMD') { if (this.callbacks.onTwitchCommand) this.callbacks.onTwitchCommand(d.cmd, d.args, d.tags, d.message); }
else if (d.type === 'SYNC_STATE') { if (this.callbacks.onWidgetAction) this.callbacks.onWidgetAction('SYNC_STATE', d.payload); }
};
} catch (e) { console.warn('[WidgetCore] BroadcastChannel недоступен:', e); }
}
if (this._electionInterval) clearInterval(this._electionInterval);
this._electionInterval = setInterval(() => this._checkMaster(), 2000);
this._checkMaster();
this._startFollowWatcher();
},
_checkMaster: function() {
const now = Date.now();
if (!IS_PREVIEW) { try { localStorage.setItem('TMI_OBS_HEARTBEAT', now.toString()); } catch (e) {} }
if (IS_PREVIEW) {
const obsHb = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('TMI_OBS_HEARTBEAT') || '0', 10);
if (now - obsHb < 4000) {
if (this.isMaster) {
this.isMaster = false;
if (this.tmiClient) { try { this.tmiClient.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} }
if (this.callbacks.onMasterStatusChange) this.callbacks.onMasterStatusChange(false);
}
return;
}
}
const lastHb = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('TMI_HEARTBEAT') || '0', 10);
if (this.isMaster) { try { localStorage.setItem('TMI_HEARTBEAT', now.toString()); } catch (e) {} return; }
if (now - lastHb > 4000) {
this.isMaster = true;
try {
localStorage.setItem('TMI_MASTER_ID', INSTANCE_ID);
localStorage.setItem('TMI_HEARTBEAT', now.toString());
} catch (e) {}
console.log(`[WidgetCore:${this.widgetId}] Стал мастером (${this.source})`);
if (this.callbacks.onMasterStatusChange) this.callbacks.onMasterStatusChange(true);
this._connectTMI();
}
},
_bindTmiEvents: function() {
if (this._eventsBound || !this.tmiClient) return;
this._eventsBound = true;
const nameOf = (tags, fb) => (tags && (tags['display-name'] || tags.login || tags.username)) || fb || 'Зритель';
try {
this.tmiClient.on('subscription', (ch, username, method, message, tags) => {
this._emitEvent('sub', { user: nameOf(tags, username), message: String(message || ''), value: 0 });
});
this.tmiClient.on('resub', (ch, username, months, message, tags) => {
this._emitEvent('resub', { user: nameOf(tags, username), message: String(message || ''), value: parseInt(months, 10) || 1 });
});
this.tmiClient.on('subgift', (ch, username, streak, recipient, methods, tags) => {
this._emitEvent('gift', { user: nameOf(tags, username), message: recipient ? `для ${recipient}` : '', value: 1 });
});
this.tmiClient.on('submysterygift', (ch, username, count, methods, tags) => {
const n = parseInt(count, 10) || 1;
this._emitEvent('gift', { user: nameOf(tags, username), message: `раздал ${n} подписок`, value: n });
});
this.tmiClient.on('cheer', (ch, tags, message) => {
this._emitEvent('cheer', { user: nameOf(tags), message: String(message || ''), value: parseInt(tags && tags.bits, 10) || 0 });
});
this.tmiClient.on('raided', (ch, username, viewers) => {
this._emitEvent('raid', { user: username || 'Стример', message: '', value: parseInt(viewers, 10) || 0 });
});
console.log(`[WidgetCore:${this.widgetId}] Слушатели событий канала подключены`);
} catch (e) {
console.error('[WidgetCore] События канала не подключились:', e);
this._eventsBound = false;
}
},
_startFollowWatcher: function() {
if (this._followTimer) return;
const key = () => `uso_follow_count_${this.currentChannel}`;
const poll = async () => {
if (!this.isMaster || !this.currentChannel) return;
try {
const res = await fetch(`https://api.ivr.fi/v2/twitch/user?login=${this.currentChannel}`);
if (!res.ok) return;
const data = await res.json();
const count = data && data[0] ? Number(data[0].followers) : NaN;
if (isNaN(count)) return;
let prev = null;
try { prev = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(key()) || '', 10); } catch (e) {}
try { localStorage.setItem(key(), String(count)); } catch (e) {}
if (prev === null || isNaN(prev)) return;
const delta = count - prev;
if (delta > 0) {
this._emitEvent('follow', { user: delta > 1 ? `${delta} новых фолловеров` : 'Новый фолловер', message: '', value: delta });
}
} catch (e) { /* сеть недоступна — молчим */ }
};
this._followTimer = setInterval(poll, FOLLOW_POLL_MS);
setTimeout(poll, 4000);
},
_connectTMI: async function() {
if (this.tmiClient) { try { await this.tmiClient.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} }
this._eventsBound = false;
this.tmiClient = new tmi.Client({ channels: [this.currentChannel] });
this.tmiClient.on('message', (chan, tags, message) => {
if (this.callbacks.onTwitchMessage) this.callbacks.onTwitchMessage(tags, message);
if (this.bus) { try { this.bus.postMessage({ type: 'MSG', tags, message }); } catch (e) {} }
const isMod = tags.mod || (tags.badges && tags.badges.broadcaster === '1') || tags.username === this.currentChannel;
const t = message.trim();
if (isMod && t.startsWith('!')) {
const parts = t.split(' ');
const cmd = parts[0].toLowerCase();
const args = parts.slice(1);
if (this.callbacks.onTwitchCommand) this.callbacks.onTwitchCommand(cmd, args, tags, message);
if (this.bus) { try { this.bus.postMessage({ type: 'CMD', cmd, args, tags, message }); } catch (e) {} }
}
});
this._bindTmiEvents();
try {
await this.tmiClient.connect();
console.log(`[WidgetCore:${this.widgetId}] TMI подключён к #${this.currentChannel}`);
} catch (e) { console.warn('[WidgetCore] TMI не подключился:', e && e.message); }
},
parseMessageToHTML: function(text, twitchEmotes) {
let tokens = [];
let nativePositions = [];
if (twitchEmotes) {
Object.entries(twitchEmotes).forEach(([id, positions]) => {
positions.forEach(pos => {
const [start, end] = pos.split('-').map(Number);
nativePositions.push({ start, end, id });
});
});
}
nativePositions.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
let currentIndex = 0;
const processTextFor3rdParty = (textPart) => {
textPart.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(part => {
if (part.trim() === '') tokens.push({ type: 'text', content: part });
else if (this.thirdPartyEmotes.has(part)) tokens.push({ type: 'emote', url: this.thirdPartyEmotes.get(part), alt: part });
else tokens.push({ type: 'text', content: part });
});
};
nativePositions.forEach(({ start, end, id }) => {
if (start > currentIndex) processTextFor3rdParty(text.substring(currentIndex, start));
tokens.push({ type: 'emote', url: `https://static-cdn.jtvnw.net/emoticons/v2/${id}/default/dark/2.0`, alt: text.substring(start, end + 1) });
currentIndex = end + 1;
});
if (currentIndex < text.length) processTextFor3rdParty(text.substring(currentIndex));
const escapeHtml = (str) => str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
return tokens.map(t => t.type === 'emote' ? `<img class="chat-emote" src="${t.url}" alt="${t.alt}">` : escapeHtml(t.content)).join('');
},
getEmotesFromMessage: function(text, twitchEmotes) {
let result = [];
if (twitchEmotes) {
Object.entries(twitchEmotes).forEach(([id, positions]) => {
result.push({ url: `https://static-cdn.jtvnw.net/emoticons/v2/${id}/default/dark/3.0`, count: positions.length });
});
}
const counts = {};
text.split(/\s+/).forEach(w => { if (this.thirdPartyEmotes.has(w)) counts[w] = (counts[w] || 0) + 1; });
Object.entries(counts).forEach(([name, count]) => result.push({ url: this.thirdPartyEmotes.get(name), count }));
return result;
},
async _loadThirdPartyEmotes(channelLogin) {
const cacheKey = `uso_emotes_cache_${channelLogin}`;
try {
const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
if (cached) {
const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
if (Date.now() - parsed.ts < 6 * 3600 * 1000) { this.thirdPartyEmotes = new Map(parsed.emotes); return; }
}
} catch (e) {}
this.thirdPartyEmotes.clear();
try {
const ivrRes = await fetch(`https://api.ivr.fi/v2/twitch/user?login=${channelLogin}`);
const ivrData = await ivrRes.json();
const twitchId = ivrData[0]?.id;
if (!twitchId) return;
await Promise.allSettled([
fetch('https://7tv.io/v3/emote-sets/global').then(r=>r.json()).then(d => d.emotes?.forEach(e => this.thirdPartyEmotes.set(e.name, `https://cdn.7tv.app/emote/${e.id}/2x.webp`))),
fetch(`https://7tv.io/v3/users/twitch/${twitchId}`).then(r=>r.json()).then(d => d.emote_set?.emotes?.forEach(e => this.thirdPartyEmotes.set(e.name, `https://cdn.7tv.app/emote/${e.id}/2x.webp`))),
fetch('https://api.betterttv.net/3/cached/emotes/global').then(r=>r.json()).then(d => d.forEach(e => this.thirdPartyEmotes.set(e.code, `https://cdn.betterttv.net/emote/${e.id}/2x`))),
fetch(`https://api.betterttv.net/3/cached/users/twitch/${twitchId}`).then(r=>r.json()).then(d => { d.channelEmotes?.forEach(e => this.thirdPartyEmotes.set(e.code, `https://cdn.betterttv.net/emote/${e.id}/2x`)); d.sharedEmotes?.forEach(e => this.thirdPartyEmotes.set(e.code, `https://cdn.betterttv.net/emote/${e.id}/2x`)); }),
fetch('https://api.frankerfacez.com/v1/set/global').then(r=>r.json()).then(d => { if(d.sets) Object.values(d.sets).forEach(s => s.emoticons?.forEach(e => this.thirdPartyEmotes.set(e.name, e.urls['2']||e.urls['1']))) }),
fetch(`https://api.frankerfacez.com/v1/room/id/${twitchId}`).then(r=>r.json()).then(d => { if(d.sets) Object.values(d.sets).forEach(s => s.emoticons?.forEach(e => this.thirdPartyEmotes.set(e.name, e.urls['2']||e.urls['1']))) })
]);
try { localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify({ ts: Date.now(), emotes: Array.from(this.thirdPartyEmotes.entries()) })); } catch (e) {}
} catch (e) {}
},
_loadConfig: function() {
try {
const saved = localStorage.getItem('stream_pack_config');
if (saved) this._handleNewConfig(JSON.parse(saved));
} catch (e) {}
if (!IS_LOCAL_FILE) {
fetch(`http://${HOST}/api/config`)
.then(res => res.json())
.then(config => { this._handleNewConfig(config); this._setupWS(); })
.catch(() => this._setupWS());
}
},
_handleNewConfig: function(config) {
this.globalConfig = config;
if (this.callbacks.onConfigUpdate) this.callbacks.onConfigUpdate(this.globalConfig);
const newChannel = (config.twitchChannel || '').replace(/[@#]/g, '').trim().toLowerCase();
if (newChannel && newChannel !== this.currentChannel) {
this._loadThirdPartyEmotes(newChannel);
this._setupTMI(newChannel);
}
},
_hello: function() {
if (!this.ws || this.ws.readyState !== 1) return;
try {
this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({
event: 'WIDGET_HELLO',
widget: this.widgetId,
source: this.source,
instanceId: this.instanceId,
master: this.isMaster
}));
} catch (e) {}
},
_setupWS: function() {
if (IS_LOCAL_FILE) return;
const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
this.ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${HOST}`);
this.ws.onopen = () => {
this._hello();
if (this._helloTimer) clearInterval(this._helloTimer);
this._helloTimer = setInterval(() => this._hello(), 5000);
// Виджет отдаёт своё состояние сразу, а не ждёт ближайшего heartbeat.
try { if (this.callbacks.onSocketOpen) this.callbacks.onSocketOpen(); }
catch (e) { console.error('[WidgetCore] onSocketOpen:', e); }
};
this.ws.onmessage = (event) => {
try {
const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
if (message.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED') {
try { localStorage.setItem('stream_pack_config', JSON.stringify(message.data)); } catch (e) {}
this._handleNewConfig(message.data);
} else if (message.event === 'WIDGET_ACTION' && this.callbacks.onWidgetAction) {
this.callbacks.onWidgetAction(message.action, message.payload);
}
} catch (e) {}
};
this.ws.onclose = () => {
if (this._helloTimer) { clearInterval(this._helloTimer); this._helloTimer = null; }
setTimeout(() => this._setupWS(), 3000);
};
},
_setupStorageListeners: function() {
window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
if (e.key === 'stream_pack_config' && e.newValue) {
if (!IS_LOCAL_FILE && this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1) return;
try { this._handleNewConfig(JSON.parse(e.newValue)); } catch (err) {}
}
if (e.key === 'stream_pack_action' && e.newValue) {
if (!IS_LOCAL_FILE && this.ws && this.ws.readyState === 1) return;
try {
const data = JSON.parse(e.newValue);
if (this.callbacks.onWidgetAction) this.callbacks.onWidgetAction(data.action, data.payload);
} catch (err) {}
}
});
}
};

import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';

async function safeFetch(url, options = {}, maxRetries = 2) {
    for (let i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++) {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, options);
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP Ошибка: ${response.status}`);
            return await response.json();
        } catch (err) {
            if (i === maxRetries - 1) throw err; 
            await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 500));
        }
    }
}

const AppShoutout = {
    container: document.getElementById('shoutout-container'),
    queue: [],
    isPlaying: false,
    duration: 8000, 

    applyConfig: function(config) {
        if (config.duration !== undefined) {
            this.duration = parseInt(config.duration) * 1000;
            if (isNaN(this.duration) || this.duration <= 0) this.duration = 8000;
        }
    },

    add: function(username) {
        const cleanName = username.replace('@', '').split(' ')[0].trim().toLowerCase();
        if (cleanName) {
            this.queue.push(cleanName);
            if (!this.isPlaying) this.playNext();
        }
    },

    playNext: async function() {
        if (this.queue.length === 0) {
            this.isPlaying = false;
            return;
        }

        this.isPlaying = true;
        const targetUser = this.queue.shift();

        try {
            const data = await safeFetch(`https://api.ivr.fi/v2/twitch/user?login=${targetUser}`);
            if (data && data.length > 0) this.render(data[0]);
            else this.playNext();
        } catch (err) {
            console.error("[Shoutout] Ошибка получения данных:", err);
            this.playNext();
        }
    },

    render: function(userData) {
        const displayName = userData.displayName || userData.login;
        const userColor = userData.chatColor || "#ff007f"; 
        const avatarUrl = userData.logo || `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${displayName}&background=1a1a1e&color=fff`;
        const followers = userData.followers ? userData.followers.toLocaleString('ru-RU') : "0";
        const category = (userData.lastBroadcast && userData.lastBroadcast.game) ? userData.lastBroadcast.game.displayName : "Just Chatting";

        this.container.style.setProperty('--user-color', userColor);
        this.container.style.setProperty('--user-glow', `${userColor}44`);

        this.container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="so-card">
                <div class="so-shine"></div>
                <div class="so-left">
                    <div class="so-avatar-wrapper">
                        <img src="${avatarUrl}" class="so-avatar">
                        <div class="so-avatar-ring"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="so-right">
                    <div class="so-badge">
                        <div class="so-dot"></div>
                        ВНИМАНИЕ, РЕКОМЕНДАЦИЯ
                    </div>
                    <div class="so-name" style="background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, ${userColor} 0%, #1a1a1a 120%);">
                        ${displayName}
                    </div>
                    <div class="so-meta">
                        <div class="so-meta-item">🎮 ${category}</div>
                        <div class="so-meta-item">👥 ${followers} фолл.</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="so-url">
                        twitch.tv/<span>${userData.login}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;

        this.container.classList.remove('hidden', 'shoutout-out');
        
        try {
            const audio = new Audio('../../data/sounds/shoutout.mp3');
            audio.volume = 0.5;
            audio.play().catch(e => {});
        } catch (e) {}

        this.container.classList.add('shoutout-in');

        setTimeout(() => {
            this.container.classList.remove('shoutout-in');
            this.container.classList.add('shoutout-out');
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.container.classList.add('hidden');
                this.playNext();
            }, 800); 
        }, this.duration);
    }
};

// Интеграция с Ядром
WidgetCore.init({
    onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
        if (config.widgets?.shoutout) AppShoutout.applyConfig(config.widgets.shoutout);
    },
    onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => {
        if (cmd === '!so' || cmd === '!shoutout') {
            if (args.length > 0 && args[0] !== "") {
                AppShoutout.add(args[0]);
            }
        }
    },
    onWidgetAction: (action, payload) => {
        if (action === 'TEST_SHOUTOUT') {
            AppShoutout.add(payload.user);
        }
    }
});
