/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/socials/networks.js — v1 (каталог платформ + единый нормализатор списка) */

export const PLATFORMS = {
    telegram: { id: 'telegram', title: 'Telegram', icon: 'telegram', color: '#24A1DE', placeholder: 't.me/channel', hint: 'Ссылка на канал или @ник', legacyKey: 'tgHandle' },
    tiktok: { id: 'tiktok', title: 'TikTok', icon: 'tiktok', color: '#FF0050', placeholder: '@nickname', hint: '@ник профиля', legacyKey: 'ttHandle', legacyAlt: 'tiktokHandle' },
    vk: { id: 'vk', title: 'ВКонтакте', icon: 'vk', color: '#0077FF', placeholder: 'vk.com/club123', hint: 'Ссылка на группу', legacyKey: 'vkHandle' },
    youtube: { id: 'youtube', title: 'YouTube', icon: 'youtube', color: '#FF0033', placeholder: 'youtube.com/@channel', hint: 'Ссылка на канал', legacyKey: null },
    discord: { id: 'discord', title: 'Discord', icon: 'discord', color: '#5865F2', placeholder: 'discord.gg/invite', hint: 'Инвайт сервера', legacyKey: null },
    instagram: { id: 'instagram', title: 'Instagram', icon: 'instagram', color: '#E1306C', placeholder: '@nickname', hint: '@ник профиля', legacyKey: null },
    twitch: { id: 'twitch', title: 'Twitch', icon: 'twitch', color: '#9146FF', placeholder: 'twitch.tv/channel', hint: 'Ссылка на канал', legacyKey: null },
    website: { id: 'website', title: 'Сайт', icon: 'globe', color: '#00E5FF', placeholder: 'example.com', hint: 'Любой адрес', legacyKey: null }
};

export function platformList() { return Object.values(PLATFORMS); }
export function getPlatform(id) { return PLATFORMS[String(id || '').toLowerCase()] || null; }

export function normalizeHex(value, fallback) {
    let h = String(value || '').trim();
    if (!h) return fallback;
    if (!h.startsWith('#')) h = '#' + h;
    if (/^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(h)) h = '#' + h.slice(1).split('').map(c => c + c).join('');
    return /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(h) ? h : fallback;
}

export function intervalFrom(config) {
    const n = parseInt((config || {}).interval, 10);
    if (isNaN(n)) return 30;
    return Math.max(3, Math.min(600, n));
}

function legacyValue(config, platform) {
    const conf = config || {};
    const main = String(conf[platform.legacyKey] ?? '').trim();
    if (main) return main;
    if (platform.legacyAlt) return String(conf[platform.legacyAlt] ?? '').trim();
    return '';
}

/** Список по умолчанию — из старых плоских ключей конфига. */
export function defaultNetworks(config) {
    const out = [];
    platformList().forEach(p => {
        if (!p.legacyKey) return;
        const handle = legacyValue(config, p);
        if (!handle) return;
        out.push({ id: p.id, handle, color: p.color, enabled: true });
    });
    return out;
}

/**
 * Единый источник правды для виджета и панели.
 * Порядок, состав, цвет и включённость — из массива networks.
 * Значения handle для Telegram/TikTok/VK читаются из старых ключей,
 * чтобы старые «Оверлеи», мобильная панель и чат-команды не расходились.
 */
export function normalizeNetworks(config) {
    const conf = config || {};
    const raw = Array.isArray(conf.networks) ? conf.networks : null;
    const source = raw && raw.length ? raw : defaultNetworks(conf);
    const out = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    source.forEach(item => {
        if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
        const id = String(item.id || '').toLowerCase();
        const p = PLATFORMS[id];
        if (!p || seen.has(id)) return;
        seen.add(id);
        let handle = String(item.handle ?? '').trim();
        if (p.legacyKey) {
            const legacy = legacyValue(conf, p);
            if (legacy) handle = legacy;
        }
        out.push({
            id,
            handle,
            color: normalizeHex(item.color, p.color),
            enabled: item.enabled !== false && String(item.enabled) !== 'false'
        });
    });
    return out;
}

export function activeNetworks(config) {
    return normalizeNetworks(config).filter(n => n.enabled && n.handle);
}

export function serializeNetworks(list) {
    return (list || []).map(n => ({ id: n.id, handle: n.handle, color: n.color, enabled: !!n.enabled }));
}

/** Обратная запись в плоские ключи — мост совместимости. */
export function legacyPatch(list) {
    const patch = { tgHandle: '', ttHandle: '', vkHandle: '', tiktokHandle: '' };
    (list || []).forEach(n => {
        const p = getPlatform(n.id);
        if (p && p.legacyKey) patch[p.legacyKey] = n.handle || '';
    });
    return patch;
}

        const config = conf || {};
        const isOff = config.isActive === false || String(config.isActive) === 'false';
        const next = activeNetworks(config);
        const interval = intervalFrom(config);
        const sig = JSON.stringify([isOff, interval, next.map(n => [n.id, n.handle, n.color])]);
        if (sig === this._sig) return;
        this._sig = sig;

        this.enabled = !isOff;
        this.intervalSec = interval;
        this.list = next;

        if (isOff || next.length === 0) {
            this.stopRotation();
            this.cancelFade();
            this.hide();
            this.report();
            return;
        }

        if (!next.some(n => n.id === this.currentId)) this.currentId = next[0].id;
        this.container.classList.remove('hidden');
        this.render();
        this.restartRotation();
        this.reveal();
        this.report();
    },

    stopRotation() {
        if (this.timer) { clearInterval(this.timer); this.timer = null; }
    },

    restartRotation() {
        this.stopRotation();
        if (this.list.length > 1) {
            this.timer = setInterval(() => this.next(), this.intervalSec * 1000);
        }
    },

    cancelFade() {
        if (this.fadeTimer) { clearTimeout(this.fadeTimer); this.fadeTimer = null; }
        this.transitioning = false;
        if (this.container) this.container.classList.remove('fade-out');
    },

    reveal() {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            if (this.container) this.container.classList.remove('fade-out');
        }));
    },

    hide() {
        if (this.container) this.container.classList.add('hidden');
    },

    next() {
        if (this.transitioning || this.list.length < 2) return;
        const idx = this.list.findIndex(n => n.id === this.currentId);
        const item = this.list[((idx < 0 ? 0 : idx) + 1) % this.list.length];
        if (item) this.show(item.id, true, false);
    },

    show(id, animate = true, resetTimer = true) {
        const item = this.list.find(n => n.id === id);
        if (!item) return;
        if (!animate) {
            this.currentId = item.id;
            this.render();
            this.reveal();
            if (resetTimer) this.restartRotation();
            this.report();
            return;
        }
        if (this.transitioning) return;
        this.transitioning = true;
        this.container.classList.add('fade-out');
        if (this.fadeTimer) clearTimeout(this.fadeTimer);
        this.fadeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.fadeTimer = null;
            if (!this.list.some(n => n.id === item.id)) { this.transitioning = false; return; }
            this.currentId = item.id;
            this.render();
            requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                this.container.classList.remove('fade-out');
                this.transitioning = false;
            }));
            if (resetTimer) this.restartRotation();
            this.report();
        }, FADE_MS);
    },

    render() {
        if (!this.container) return;
        const item = this.list.find(n => n.id === this.currentId) || this.list[0];
        if (!item) return;
        this.currentId = item.id;
        const p = getPlatform(item.id);
        const color = item.color;
        const iconFn = p && typeof icons[p.icon] === 'function' ? icons[p.icon] : null;
        const iconSvg = iconFn ? iconFn() : '';

        this.container.style.setProperty('--social-color', color);
        this.container.style.setProperty('--social-glow', `${color}26`);
        this.container.innerHTML = `
<div class="social-icon-wrapper" style="color: ${color}; background: ${color}15; border: 1px solid ${color}25;">${iconSvg}</div>
<div class="social-info">
<div class="social-badge">
<div class="social-dot" style="background: ${color}; box-shadow: 0 0 6px ${color};"></div>
<span style="color: ${color};"></span>
</div>
<span class="social-handle"></span>
</div>`;
        const titleEl = this.container.querySelector('.social-badge span');
        const handleEl = this.container.querySelector('.social-handle');
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = p ? p.title : item.id;
        if (handleEl) handleEl.textContent = item.handle;
    },

    report() {
        const idx = this.list.findIndex(n => n.id === this.currentId);
        WidgetCore.sendAction('SOCIALS_STATE', {
            source: SOURCE,
            id: this.currentId,
            index: idx,
            total: this.list.length,
            interval: this.intervalSec,
            enabled: this.enabled,
            ts: Date.now()
        });
    },

    handleAction(action, payload = {}) {
        if (action === 'SOCIALS_SHOW') {
            if (payload && payload.id) this.show(String(payload.id), true, true);
            return;
        }
        if (action === 'SOCIALS_NEXT') { this.next(); return; }
        if (action === 'SOCIALS_REQUEST_STATE') { this.report(); }
    },

    writeList(list, extra) {
        const networks = serializeNetworks(list);
        WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('socials', { networks, ...legacyPatch(networks), ...(extra || {}) });
    },

    handleChat(cmd, args) {
        // Команды приходят и мастеру, и слейвам через шину — пишет только мастер.
        if (!WidgetCore.isMaster) return;
        const conf = { ...(WidgetCore.globalConfig?.widgets?.socials || {}) };
        const list = normalizeNetworks(conf);

        if (cmd === '!socials') {
            const arg = (args[0] || '').toLowerCase();
            const cur = conf.isActive === true || String(conf.isActive) === 'true';
            const next = arg === 'on' ? true : (arg === 'off' ? false : !cur);
            WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('socials', { isActive: next });
            console.log(`[Socials] !socials → ${next ? 'включён' : 'выключен'}`);
            return;
        }

        if (cmd === '!socialsint') {
            const n = parseInt(args[0], 10);
            if (isNaN(n)) return;
            const value = Math.max(3, Math.min(600, n));
            WidgetCore.updateWidgetConfig('socials', { interval: value });
            console.log(`[Socials] !socialsint → ${value}s`);
            return;
        }

        const map = { '!stg': 'telegram', '!stt': 'tiktok', '!svk': 'vk' };
        const platformId = map[cmd];
        if (!platformId) return;
        const value = (args || []).join(' ').trim();
        const p = getPlatform(platformId);
        const existing = list.find(n => n.id === platformId);
        if (existing) existing.handle = value;
        else if (value) list.push({ id: platformId, handle: value, color: p.color, enabled: true });
        this.writeList(list);
        console.log(`[Socials] ${cmd} → ${value || 'очищено'}`);
    }
};

WidgetCore.init({
    onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
        if (config?.widgets?.socials) AppSocials.applyConfig(config.widgets.socials);
    },
    onWidgetAction: (action, payload) => AppSocials.handleAction(action, payload),
    onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => AppSocials.handleChat(cmd, args)
});

setInterval(() => AppSocials.report(), HEARTBEAT_MS);
console.log(`[Socials] v2 инициализирован (${SOURCE})`);

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/socials/dashboard/Dashboard.js — v2 (CSS-first: параллельные стили + preload, кэш линков в head) */
import { store } from '../../../js/store.js';
import { renderTemplate } from './template.js';
import { StageController } from './stage.js';
import { NetworksPanel } from './networksPanel.js';
import { RotationPanel } from './rotationPanel.js';
import { Toast } from '../../../js/components/toast.js';
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { activeNetworks, normalizeNetworks, getPlatform } from '../networks.js';
const LIVE_TTL = 15000;
let ctx = null;
// === CSS-first загрузчик: параллельные <link> вместо @import-водопада ===
const CSS_VERSION = 'v2';
const CSS_TIMEOUT = 3000;
const CSS_FILES = [
{ id: 'sd-css-base', href: `widgets/socials/dashboard/styles/base.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'sd-css-stage', href: `widgets/socials/dashboard/styles/stage.css?${CSS_VERSION}` },
{ id: 'sd-css-panels', href: `widgets/socials/dashboard/styles/panels.css?${CSS_VERSION}` }
];
let cssPromise = null;
function loadOneCss({ id, href }) {
return new Promise((resolve) => {
const existing = document.getElementById(id);
if (existing) {
if (existing.dataset.loaded === '1') { resolve(true); return; }
existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(true), { once: true });
existing.addEventListener('error', () => resolve(false), { once: true });
return;
}
const link = document.createElement('link');
link.id = id;
link.rel = 'stylesheet';
link.href = href;
link.dataset.loaded = '0';
link.onload = () => { link.dataset.loaded = '1'; resolve(true); };
link.onerror = () => {
console.error(`[SocialsDash:css] Файл стиля не загрузился: ${href}`);
link.remove();
resolve(false);
};
document.head.appendChild(link);
});
}
/** Идемпотентно грузит стили дашборда. Резолвится true/false, никогда не реджектится. */
function preload() {
if (cssPromise) return cssPromise;
const t0 = performance.now();
console.log('[SocialsDash:css] preload: параллельная загрузка стилей...');
const loadAll = Promise.all(CSS_FILES.map(loadOneCss)).then((results) => {
const ok = results.every(Boolean);
if (ok) console.log(`[SocialsDash:css] Стили готовы за ${Math.round(performance.now() - t0)}мс`);
else console.warn('[SocialsDash:css] Часть стилей недоступна — возможен деградированный вид.');
return ok;
});
let guardTimer = null;
const guard = new Promise((resolve) => {
guardTimer = setTimeout(() => {
console.warn(`[SocialsDash:css] Таймаут ${CSS_TIMEOUT}мс — рендерим без ожидания стилей.`);
resolve(false);
}, CSS_TIMEOUT);
});
cssPromise = Promise.race([loadAll, guard]).then((ok) => {
if (guardTimer) { clearTimeout(guardTimer); guardTimer = null; }
if (!ok) cssPromise = null;
return ok;
});
return cssPromise;
}
function pickLive() {
if (!ctx) return null;
const now = Date.now();
const obs = ctx.live.obs;
const preview = ctx.live.preview;
if (obs && now - obs.ts < LIVE_TTL) return obs;
if (preview && now - preview.ts < LIVE_TTL) return preview;
return null;
}
function setBadge(id, cls, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (!el) return;
el.className = `sd-badge ${cls}`;
el.innerHTML = `<span class="sd-badge-dot"></span>${text}`;
}
function setText(id, text) {
const el = document.getElementById(id);
if (el && el.textContent !== text) el.textContent = text;
}
function renderStatus(state, live) {
const c = state.config.widgets.socials || {};
const isOn = c.isActive === true || String(c.isActive) === 'true';
const list = activeNetworks(c);
const online = Boolean(state.serverOnline);
const visible = isOn && list.length > 0;
setBadge('sd-badge-server', online ? 'sd-badge-live' : 'sd-badge-off', online ? 'СЕРВЕР ONLINE' : 'СЕРВЕР OFFLINE');
setBadge('sd-badge-state', visible ? 'sd-badge-live' : 'sd-badge-warn', visible ? 'НА ЭКРАНЕ' : (isOn ? 'НЕТ СОЦСЕТЕЙ' : 'СКРЫТА'));
setBadge('sd-badge-source',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'sd-badge-live' : 'sd-badge-info') : 'sd-badge-off',
live ? (live.source === 'obs' ? 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ OBS' : 'СИГНАЛ ИЗ ПРЕВЬЮ') : 'НЕТ СИГНАЛА');
const current = live && live.id ? list.find(n => n.id === live.id) : null;
const item = current || list[0] || null;
const p = item ? getPlatform(item.id) : null;
const iconEl = document.getElementById('sd-now-icon');
if (iconEl) {
const key = p ? p.id : 'none';
if (iconEl.dataset.key !== key) {
iconEl.dataset.key = key;
iconEl.innerHTML = p && typeof icons[p.icon] === 'function' ? icons[p.icon]() : icons.noSignal();
}
iconEl.style.setProperty('--now-accent', item ? item.color : 'var(--sd-ink-3)');
}
setText('sd-now-title', p ? p.title : (list.length ? 'Ожидание виджета' : 'Соцсети не добавлены'));
setText('sd-now-handle', item ? (item.handle || '—') : (list.length ? 'Откройте OBS или подождите превью' : 'Добавьте платформу слева'));
setText('sd-now-pos', live && live.total > 0 && live.index >= 0 ? `${live.index + 1} / ${live.total}` : `${list.length} в списке`);
const strip = document.getElementById('sd-now');
if (strip) {
strip.classList.toggle('is-off', !visible);
strip.style.setProperty('--now-accent', item ? item.color : 'var(--sd-ink-3)');
}
}
function evaluate() {
if (!ctx) return;
const state = store.getState();
const live = pickLive();
renderStatus(state, live);
ctx.stage.evaluate(state, live);
ctx.networks.render(state);
ctx.rotation.render(state, live);
}
function mount(params, state) {
const root = document.getElementById('sd-main');
if (!root) return;
unmount();
// V2-вью уже дождалась preload() — здесь мгновенный no-op (страховка для прямого монтажа).
preload();
const toast = new Toast(document.getElementById('sd-toasts'), { className: 'sd-toast' });
const stage = new StageController({ root, store, toast });
const networks = new NetworksPanel({ root, store, toast });
const rotation = new RotationPanel({ root, store, toast });
ctx = { root, toast, stage, networks, rotation, live: { obs: null, preview: null }, unsub: null, unsubAction: null, tick: null };
stage.mount();
networks.mount();
rotation.mount();
ctx.unsub = store.subscribe(() => evaluate());
ctx.unsubAction = store.onAction((action, payload) => {
if (action !== 'SOCIALS_STATE' || !payload) return;
const source = payload.source === 'obs' ? 'obs' : 'preview';
ctx.live[source] = {
source,
id: payload.id || null,
index: Number(payload.index ?? -1),
total: Number(payload.total ?? 0),
interval: Number(payload.interval ?? 30),
enabled: payload.enabled !== false,
ts: Number(payload.ts || Date.now())
};
evaluate();
});
ctx.tick = setInterval(() => evaluate(), 2000);
evaluate();
store.broadcastAction('SOCIALS_REQUEST_STATE', {});
console.log('[SocialsDash] v2 смонтирован', params);
}
function onParamsChange(params) {
if (!ctx) return false;
return (params?.id || 'player') === 'socials';
}
function unmount() {
if (!ctx) return;
console.log('[SocialsDash] Размонтирование');
if (ctx.unsub) ctx.unsub();
if (ctx.unsubAction) ctx.unsubAction();
if (ctx.tick) clearInterval(ctx.tick);
ctx.stage.unmount();
ctx.networks.unmount();
ctx.rotation.unmount();
ctx = null;
// Стили (sd-css-*) намеренно остаются в <head> — кэш между вкладками против FOUC.
document.querySelectorAll('iframe#sd-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
}
export default {
render: (state, params) => renderTemplate(state, params),
preload,
mount,
onParamsChange,
unmount
};

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/socials/dashboard/networksPanel.js — v1 (список платформ: порядок, цвет, ссылка, состав) */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { PLATFORMS, platformList, getPlatform, normalizeNetworks, serializeNetworks, legacyPatch } from '../networks.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');

export class NetworksPanel {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.rows = new Map();
        this.addId = null;
        this.selectOpen = false;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.inputHandler = null;
        this.changeHandler = null;
        this.keyHandler = null;
        this.docHandler = null;
        this._optSig = '';
    }

    mount() {
        const panel = this.root.querySelector('.sd-net-panel');
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
        this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
        this.keyHandler = (e) => this._onKey(e);
        this.docHandler = (e) => {
            if (!this.selectOpen) return;
            const t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest || !t.closest('#sd-add-select')) this._closeSelect();
        };
        if (panel) {
            panel.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
            panel.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
            panel.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
            panel.addEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        }
        document.addEventListener('click', this.docHandler);
    }

    unmount() {
        const panel = this.root.querySelector('.sd-net-panel');
        if (panel) {
            if (this.clickHandler) panel.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
            if (this.inputHandler) panel.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
            if (this.changeHandler) panel.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
            if (this.keyHandler) panel.removeEventListener('keydown', this.keyHandler);
        }
        if (this.docHandler) document.removeEventListener('click', this.docHandler);
        this.rows.clear();
        this.selectOpen = false;
    }

    _list() { return normalizeNetworks(this.store.getState().config.widgets.socials || {}); }

    _write(list, extra) {
        const networks = serializeNetworks(list);
        try {
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { socials: { networks, ...legacyPatch(networks), ...(extra || {}) } } });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[SocialsNet] Не удалось сохранить список:', e);
            this.toast.error('Настройка не сохранилась.');
        }
    }

    _onInput(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        const row = t.closest && t.closest('.sd-net-row');
        if (!row) return;
        const id = row.getAttribute('data-id');
        const list = this._list();
        const item = list.find(n => n.id === id);
        if (!item) return;

        if (t.classList.contains('sd-net-handle')) {
            item.handle = t.value;
            this._write(list);
        } else if (t.type === 'color') {
            item.color = t.value;
            const hex = row.querySelector('.sd-net-hex');
            if (hex) hex.textContent = t.value;
            row.style.setProperty('--row-accent', t.value);
            this._write(list);
        }
    }

    _onChange(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.type !== 'checkbox') return;
        const row = t.closest && t.closest('.sd-net-row');
        if (!row) return;
        const id = row.getAttribute('data-id');
        const list = this._list();
        const item = list.find(n => n.id === id);
        if (!item) return;
        item.enabled = t.checked;
        this._write(list);
        const p = getPlatform(id);
        this.toast.show(`${p ? p.title : id}: ${t.checked ? 'в ротации' : 'выключена'}`, t.checked ? 'success' : 'info');
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.closest('#sd-add-btn')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (this.selectOpen) this._closeSelect(); else this._openSelect();
            return;
        }

        const opt = t.closest('.sd-select-opt');
        if (opt) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.addId = opt.getAttribute('data-value');
            this._syncSelect();
            this._closeSelect();
            const btn = document.getElementById('sd-add-btn');
            if (btn) btn.focus();
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#sd-add-confirm')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this._addPlatform();
            return;
        }

        const row = t.closest('.sd-net-row');
        if (!row) return;
        const id = row.getAttribute('data-id');
        const list = this._list();
        const idx = list.findIndex(n => n.id === id);
        if (idx < 0) return;

        if (t.closest('.sd-net-up')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (idx === 0) return;
            const [item] = list.splice(idx, 1);
            list.splice(idx - 1, 0, item);
            this._write(list);
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('.sd-net-down')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (idx >= list.length - 1) return;
            const [item] = list.splice(idx, 1);
            list.splice(idx + 1, 0, item);
            this._write(list);
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('.sd-net-remove')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const p = getPlatform(id);
            list.splice(idx, 1);
            this._write(list);
            this.toast.info(`${p ? p.title : id} убрана из ротации.`);
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('.sd-net-brand')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const item = list[idx];
            const p = getPlatform(id);
            if (!item || !p) return;
            item.color = p.color;
            this._write(list);
            this.toast.info(`Цвет ${p.title} возвращён к фирменному.`);
        }
    }

    _onKey(e) {
        const inSelect = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#sd-add-select');
        if (inSelect) {
            const btn = document.getElementById('sd-add-btn');
            const pop = document.getElementById('sd-add-pop');
            const opts = pop ? Array.from(pop.querySelectorAll('.sd-select-opt')) : [];
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                if (this.selectOpen) { e.preventDefault(); this._closeSelect(); if (btn) btn.focus(); }
                return;
            }
            if (e.target === btn) {
                if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', 'Enter', ' '].includes(e.key)) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this._openSelect();
                    const active = opts.find(o => o.classList.contains('is-active')) || opts[0];
                    if (active) active.focus();
                }
                return;
            }
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                e.preventDefault();
                const i = opts.indexOf(document.activeElement);
                const next = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(opts.length - 1, i + 1) : Math.max(0, i - 1);
                if (opts[next]) opts[next].focus();
            } else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                this._closeSelect();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('sd-net-handle')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.target.blur();
        }
    }

    _available() {
        const used = new Set(this._list().map(n => n.id));
        return platformList().filter(p => !used.has(p.id));
    }

    _addPlatform() {
        const avail = this._available();
        if (avail.length === 0) { this.toast.info('Все платформы уже добавлены.'); return; }
        const p = avail.find(x => x.id === this.addId) || avail[0];
        const list = this._list();
        list.push({ id: p.id, handle: '', color: p.color, enabled: true });
        this._write(list);
        this.addId = null;
        this.toast.success(`${p.title} добавлена — заполните ссылку.`);
        setTimeout(() => {
            const input = this.root.querySelector(`.sd-net-row[data-id="${p.id}"] .sd-net-handle`);
            if (input) { input.focus(); input.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' }); }
        }, 60);
    }

    _openSelect() {
        const root = document.getElementById('sd-add-select');
        const pop = document.getElementById('sd-add-pop');
        const btn = document.getElementById('sd-add-btn');
        if (!root || !pop || !btn || btn.disabled) return;
        this.selectOpen = true;
        root.classList.add('is-open');
        pop.hidden = false;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    }

    _closeSelect() {
        const root = document.getElementById('sd-add-select');
        const pop = document.getElementById('sd-add-pop');
        const btn = document.getElementById('sd-add-btn');
        this.selectOpen = false;
        if (root) root.classList.remove('is-open');
        if (pop) pop.hidden = true;
        if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

    _syncSelect() {
        const avail = this._available();
        const btn = document.getElementById('sd-add-btn');
        const val = document.getElementById('sd-add-val');
        const pop = document.getElementById('sd-add-pop');
        const confirm = document.getElementById('sd-add-confirm');
        if (!avail.some(p => p.id === this.addId)) this.addId = avail[0] ? avail[0].id : null;
        const current = avail.find(p => p.id === this.addId) || null;

        if (val) val.textContent = current ? current.title : 'Все добавлены';
        if (btn) btn.disabled = avail.length === 0;
        if (confirm) confirm.disabled = avail.length === 0;

        const sig = avail.map(p => p.id).join('|') + '#' + this.addId;
        if (pop && sig !== this._optSig) {
            this._optSig = sig;
            pop.innerHTML = avail.map(p => `
<button class="sd-select-opt ${p.id === this.addId ? 'is-active' : ''}" type="button" role="option" data-value="${p.id}" aria-selected="${p.id === this.addId}" style="--opt-accent:${p.color}">
<span class="sd-select-ic">${ic(p.icon)}</span><span>${p.title}</span>
</button>`).join('');
        }
    }

    _makeRow(item) {
        const p = getPlatform(item.id);
        const el = document.createElement('article');
        el.className = 'sd-net-row';
        el.setAttribute('data-id', item.id);
        el.innerHTML = `
<div class="sd-net-top">
<span class="sd-net-num"></span>
<button class="sd-net-brand" type="button" title="Вернуть фирменный цвет">${ic(p.icon)}</button>
<span class="sd-net-name"></span>
<label class="sd-toggle sd-toggle-mini" title="Участвует в ротации">
<input type="checkbox" class="sd-net-enabled">
<div class="sd-track"></div>
</label>
<button class="sd-mini-btn sd-net-up" type="button" title="Выше">${ic('chevronUp')}</button>
<button class="sd-mini-btn sd-net-down" type="button" title="Ниже">${ic('chevronDown')}</button>
<button class="sd-mini-btn is-danger sd-net-remove" type="button" title="Убрать платформу">${ic('trash')}</button>
</div>
<div class="sd-net-bottom">
<input type="text" class="sd-net-handle" placeholder="${p.placeholder}" aria-label="Ссылка ${p.title}">
<span class="sd-net-hex"></span>
<input type="color" class="sd-net-color" aria-label="Цвет ${p.title}">
</div>
<div class="sd-net-hint"></div>`;
        const nameEl = el.querySelector('.sd-net-name');
        if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = p.title;
        const hintEl = el.querySelector('.sd-net-hint');
        if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = p.hint;
        return el;
    }

    _updateRow(el, item, index, total, liveId) {
        const p = getPlatform(item.id);
        el.style.setProperty('--row-accent', item.color);
        el.classList.toggle('is-off', !item.enabled);
        el.classList.toggle('is-empty', !item.handle);
        el.classList.toggle('is-live', item.id === liveId && item.enabled && !!item.handle);

        const num = el.querySelector('.sd-net-num');
        if (num) num.textContent = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0');

        const enabled = el.querySelector('.sd-net-enabled');
        if (enabled && document.activeElement !== enabled && enabled.checked !== item.enabled) enabled.checked = item.enabled;

        const handle = el.querySelector('.sd-net-handle');
        if (handle && document.activeElement !== handle && handle.value !== item.handle) handle.value = item.handle;

        const color = el.querySelector('.sd-net-color');
        if (color && document.activeElement !== color && color.value !== item.color) color.value = item.color;

        const hex = el.querySelector('.sd-net-hex');
        if (hex && hex.textContent !== item.color) hex.textContent = item.color;

        const up = el.querySelector('.sd-net-up');
        const down = el.querySelector('.sd-net-down');
        if (up) up.disabled = index === 0;
        if (down) down.disabled = index >= total - 1;

        const brand = el.querySelector('.sd-net-brand');
        if (brand) brand.title = item.color.toLowerCase() === p.color.toLowerCase() ? 'Фирменный цвет' : 'Вернуть фирменный цвет';
    }

    render(state) {
        const listEl = document.getElementById('sd-net-list');
        if (!listEl) return;
        const c = state.config.widgets.socials || {};
        const list = normalizeNetworks(c);
        const activeCount = list.filter(n => n.enabled && n.handle).length;

        const count = document.getElementById('sd-net-count');
        if (count) count.textContent = `${activeCount} / ${list.length}`;

        const empty = document.getElementById('sd-net-empty');
        if (empty) empty.classList.toggle('is-hidden', list.length > 0);

        let liveId = null;
        const nowTitle = document.getElementById('sd-now-title');
        if (nowTitle) {
            const found = list.find(n => (getPlatform(n.id) || {}).title === nowTitle.textContent);
            if (found) liveId = found.id;
        }

        const seen = new Set();
        let cursor = listEl.firstElementChild;
        list.forEach((item, index) => {
            seen.add(item.id);
            let el = this.rows.get(item.id);
            if (!el || !el.isConnected) {
                el = this._makeRow(item);
                this.rows.set(item.id, el);
            }
            this._updateRow(el, item, index, list.length, liveId);
            if (el === cursor) cursor = cursor.nextElementSibling;
            else listEl.insertBefore(el, cursor);
        });
        for (const [id, el] of this.rows) {
            if (!seen.has(id)) { el.remove(); this.rows.delete(id); }
        }

        this._syncSelect();
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/socials/dashboard/rotationPanel.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/socials/dashboard/rotationPanel.js — v1 (интервал, порядок, живой цикл, команды) */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { activeNetworks, getPlatform, intervalFrom, defaultNetworks } from '../networks.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');

async function copyText(text) {
    const value = String(text ?? '');
    if (!value) return false;
    try {
        if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
            return true;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[SocialsRotation] Clipboard API недоступен, пробую fallback:', e);
    }
    let ta = null;
    try {
        ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = value;
        ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
        ta.style.position = 'fixed';
        ta.style.top = '-1000px';
        ta.style.opacity = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(ta);
        ta.select();
        ta.setSelectionRange(0, value.length);
        return document.execCommand('copy');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[SocialsRotation] Копирование не удалось:', e);
        return false;
    } finally {
        if (ta && ta.parentNode) ta.remove();
    }
}

export class RotationPanel {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.live = null;
        this.raf = null;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.inputHandler = null;
        this.changeHandler = null;
        this.chipTimers = new Map();
        this._orderSig = '';
    }

    mount() {
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.inputHandler = (e) => this._onInput(e);
        this.changeHandler = (e) => this._onChange(e);
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        this.root.addEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        const loop = () => { this._tickCycle(); this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
        this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.inputHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('input', this.inputHandler);
        if (this.changeHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('change', this.changeHandler);
        for (const t of this.chipTimers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
        this.chipTimers.clear();
    }

    _paint(input) {
        if (!input) return;
        const min = Number(input.min || 3);
        const max = Number(input.max || 120);
        const val = Number(input.value);
        const pct = max > min ? ((val - min) / (max - min)) * 100 : 0;
        input.style.setProperty('--range-fill', `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct)).toFixed(2)}%`);
    }

    _setInterval(value) {
        const n = parseInt(value, 10);
        if (isNaN(n)) return;
        const clamped = Math.max(3, Math.min(600, n));
        this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { socials: { interval: clamped } } });
    }

    _onInput(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.id === 'sd-interval') {
            this._paint(t);
            const num = document.getElementById('sd-interval-num');
            if (num && document.activeElement !== num) num.value = t.value;
            this._setInterval(t.value);
        } else if (t.id === 'sd-interval-num') {
            const n = parseInt(t.value, 10);
            if (isNaN(n)) return;
            const clamped = Math.max(3, Math.min(600, n));
            const range = document.getElementById('sd-interval');
            if (range) { range.value = String(Math.max(3, Math.min(120, clamped))); this._paint(range); }
            this._setInterval(clamped);
        }
    }

    _onChange(e) {
        const t = e.target;
        if (t.id === 'sd-interval-num') {
            const n = Math.max(3, Math.min(600, parseInt(t.value, 10) || 30));
            t.value = String(n);
            this._setInterval(n);
        }
        if (t.hasAttribute && t.hasAttribute('data-sd-key') && t.type === 'checkbox') {
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { socials: { [t.getAttribute('data-sd-key')]: t.checked } } });
            this.toast.show(t.checked ? 'Ротатор показан на стриме.' : 'Ротатор скрыт со стрима.', t.checked ? 'success' : 'info');
        }
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        const chip = t.closest('.sd-chip');
        if (chip) { e.preventDefault(); this._copyChip(chip); return; }

        if (t.closest('#sd-next')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.store.broadcastAction('SOCIALS_NEXT', {});
            this.toast.info('Переключаю на следующую соцсеть.');
            return;
        }

        const show = t.closest('.sd-order-show');
        if (show) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const id = show.getAttribute('data-id');
            this.store.broadcastAction('SOCIALS_SHOW', { id });
            const p = getPlatform(id);
            this.toast.success(`Показываю ${p ? p.title : id}.`);
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#sd-reset')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const manifest = this.store.getState().widgetsManifest.find(w => w.id === 'socials');
            const def = {};
            if (manifest) manifest.controls.forEach(c => { if (c.type !== 'button') def[c.key] = c.default; });
            const networks = defaultNetworks(def);
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { socials: { ...def, networks } } });
            this.toast.success('Настройки ротатора сброшены.');
        }
    }

    async _copyChip(chip) {
        const text = chip.getAttribute('data-copy') || '';
        const ok = await copyText(text);
        if (!ok) { this.toast.error(`Не удалось скопировать. Команда: ${text}`); return; }
        this.toast.success(`Скопировано: ${text}`);
        const iconEl = chip.querySelector('.sd-chip-ic');
        if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = ic('check');
        chip.classList.add('is-copied');
        const old = this.chipTimers.get(chip);
        if (old) clearTimeout(old);
        this.chipTimers.set(chip, setTimeout(() => {
            this.chipTimers.delete(chip);
            if (!chip.isConnected) return;
            chip.classList.remove('is-copied');
            const el = chip.querySelector('.sd-chip-ic');
            if (el) el.innerHTML = ic('copy');
        }, 1400));
    }

    _tickCycle() {
        const fill = document.getElementById('sd-cycle-fill');
        const left = document.getElementById('sd-cycle-left');
        if (!fill || !left) return;
        const live = this.live;
        if (!live || !live.enabled || live.total < 2 || !live.interval) {
            fill.style.width = '0%';
            const text = live && live.total < 2 ? 'ротация не нужна' : 'нет сигнала';
            if (left.textContent !== text) left.textContent = text;
            return;
        }
        const elapsed = (Date.now() - live.ts) / 1000;
        const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / live.interval));
        fill.style.width = `${(ratio * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
        const rest = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(live.interval - elapsed));
        const text = `смена через ${rest} с`;
        if (left.textContent !== text) left.textContent = text;
    }

    render(state, live) {
        this.live = live;
        const c = state.config.widgets.socials || {};
        const interval = intervalFrom(c);
        const list = activeNetworks(c);

        const range = document.getElementById('sd-interval');
        if (range && document.activeElement !== range) {
            const v = String(Math.max(3, Math.min(120, interval)));
            if (range.value !== v) range.value = v;
            this._paint(range);
        }
        const num = document.getElementById('sd-interval-num');
        if (num && document.activeElement !== num && num.value !== String(interval)) num.value = String(interval);

        const master = this.root.querySelector('[data-sd-key="isActive"]');
        if (master && document.activeElement !== master) {
            const on = c.isActive === true || String(c.isActive) === 'true';
            if (master.checked !== on) master.checked = on;
        }

        const next = document.getElementById('sd-next');
        if (next) next.disabled = list.length < 2;

        const orderEl = document.getElementById('sd-order');
        const emptyEl = document.getElementById('sd-order-empty');
        if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.toggle('is-hidden', list.length > 0);
        if (!orderEl) return;

        const liveId = live && live.id ? live.id : null;
        const sig = JSON.stringify([list.map(n => [n.id, n.handle, n.color]), liveId]);
        if (sig === this._orderSig) return;
        this._orderSig = sig;

        orderEl.innerHTML = list.map((n, i) => {
            const p = getPlatform(n.id);
            const isLive = n.id === liveId;
            return `
<div class="sd-order-row ${isLive ? 'is-live' : ''}" style="--row-accent:${n.color}">
<span class="sd-order-num">${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
<span class="sd-order-ic">${ic(p ? p.icon : 'globe')}</span>
<span class="sd-order-body">
<span class="sd-order-title">${p ? p.title : n.id}${isLive ? '<em class="sd-order-flag">В ЭФИРЕ</em>' : ''}</span>
<span class="sd-order-handle"></span>
</span>
<button class="sd-mini-btn sd-order-show" type="button" data-id="${n.id}" title="Показать сейчас">${ic('play')}</button>
</div>`;
        }).join('');
        list.forEach((n, i) => {
            const row = orderEl.children[i];
            if (!row) return;
            const handle = row.querySelector('.sd-order-handle');
            if (handle) handle.textContent = n.handle;
        });
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/socials/dashboard/stage.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/socials/dashboard/stage.js — v1 (живое превью настоящего виджета) */
import { activeNetworks, getPlatform } from '../networks.js';

const WIDGET_W = 400;
const WIDGET_H = 120;

export class StageController {
    constructor({ root, store, toast }) {
        this.root = root;
        this.store = store;
        this.toast = toast;
        this.iframe = null;
        this.loaded = false;
        this.resizeObs = null;
        this.clickHandler = null;
        this.loadTimer = null;
    }

    mount() {
        this.clickHandler = (e) => this._onClick(e);
        this.root.addEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        const stage = document.getElementById('sd-stage');
        this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.scale());
        if (stage) this.resizeObs.observe(stage);
        this.createIframe();
    }

    unmount() {
        if (this.clickHandler) this.root.removeEventListener('click', this.clickHandler);
        if (this.resizeObs) this.resizeObs.disconnect();
        this.destroyIframe();
    }

    _onClick(e) {
        const t = e.target;

        if (t.closest('#sd-refresh')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('sd-refresh');
            if (btn) { btn.classList.add('is-spin'); setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('is-spin'), 900); }
            this.destroyIframe();
            this.createIframe();
            this.toast.info('Превью перезапущено.');
            return;
        }

        if (t.closest('#sd-off-show')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            this.store.updateConfig({ widgets: { socials: { isActive: true } } });
            this.toast.success('Ротатор снова на экране.');
        }
    }

    createIframe() {
        if (this.iframe) return;
        const frame = document.getElementById('sd-stage-frame');
        if (!frame) return;
        this.loaded = false;
        const loading = document.getElementById('sd-stage-loading');
        if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');

        const f = document.createElement('iframe');
        f.id = 'sd-preview-iframe';
        f.className = 'sd-iframe';
        f.title = 'Превью ротатора соцсетей';
        f.setAttribute('scrolling', 'no');
        // Относительный путь: работает и в Electron (file://), и по http.
        f.src = `widgets/socials/index.html?preview=1&cb=${Date.now()}`;
        f.onload = () => {
            if (this.iframe !== f) return;
            this.loaded = true;
            const l = document.getElementById('sd-stage-loading');
            if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            this.scale();
        };
        f.onerror = () => {
            if (this.iframe !== f) return;
            const l = document.getElementById('sd-stage-loading');
            if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            this.toast.error('Не удалось загрузить превью виджета.');
        };
        frame.appendChild(f);
        this.iframe = f;

        clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
        this.loadTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (!this.loaded) {
                const l = document.getElementById('sd-stage-loading');
                if (l) l.classList.add('is-hidden');
            }
        }, 6000);

        this.scale();
    }

    destroyIframe() {
        clearTimeout(this.loadTimer);
        if (this.iframe) {
            const f = this.iframe;
            this.iframe = null;
            try { f.src = 'about:blank'; } catch (e) {}
            f.remove();
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('iframe#sd-preview-iframe').forEach(f => f.remove());
        this.loaded = false;
    }

    scale() {
        const stage = document.getElementById('sd-stage');
        if (!stage || !this.iframe) return;
        const s = Math.min(stage.clientWidth / WIDGET_W, stage.clientHeight / WIDGET_H) * 0.88;
        this.iframe.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${s.toFixed(4)})`;
    }

    evaluate(state, live) {
        const c = state.config.widgets.socials || {};
        const isOn = c.isActive === true || String(c.isActive) === 'true';
        const list = activeNetworks(c);
        const visible = isOn && list.length > 0;

        const current = live && live.id ? list.find(n => n.id === live.id) : null;
        const item = current || list[0] || null;
        const accent = item ? item.color : null;

        const stage = document.getElementById('sd-stage');
        if (stage) {
            stage.classList.toggle('is-off', !visible);
            if (accent) stage.style.setProperty('--stage-accent', accent);
            else stage.style.removeProperty('--stage-accent');
        }

        const off = document.getElementById('sd-stage-off');
        if (off) off.classList.toggle('is-hidden', visible);

        const title = document.getElementById('sd-off-title');
        const sub = document.getElementById('sd-off-sub');
        const show = document.getElementById('sd-off-show');
        if (title && sub && show) {
            if (!isOn) {
                title.textContent = 'Ротатор скрыт';
                sub.textContent = 'Виджет работает, но не показывается на стриме.';
                show.style.display = list.length > 0 ? '' : 'none';
            } else {
                title.textContent = 'Нет активных соцсетей';
                sub.textContent = 'Добавьте платформу слева и заполните ссылку — карточка появится сразу.';
                show.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        const loading = document.getElementById('sd-stage-loading');
        if (loading && this.loaded) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');

        this.scale();
    }
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/socials/dashboard/template.js ---

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/socials/dashboard/template.js — v1 */
import { icons } from '../../../js/utils/icons.js';
import { normalizeNetworks, intervalFrom } from '../networks.js';

const ic = (n) => (typeof icons[n] === 'function' ? icons[n]() : '');
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

const CHAT_COMMANDS = [
    { cmd: '!socials on', copy: '!socials on', title: 'Включить ротатор' },
    { cmd: '!socials off', copy: '!socials off', title: 'Выключить ротатор' },
    { cmd: '!socialsint', copy: '!socialsint 30', title: 'Интервал смены в секундах (3–600)' },
    { cmd: '!stg', copy: '!stg t.me/channel', title: 'Telegram: ссылка или @канал' },
    { cmd: '!stt', copy: '!stt @nickname', title: 'TikTok: @ник профиля' },
    { cmd: '!svk', copy: '!svk vk.com/club', title: 'ВКонтакте: ссылка на группу' }
];

export function renderTemplate(state) {
    const c = state.config.widgets.socials || {};
    const active = c.isActive === true || String(c.isActive) === 'true';
    const interval = intervalFrom(c);
    const list = normalizeNetworks(c);
    const sliderVal = Math.max(3, Math.min(120, interval));
    const fill = ((sliderVal - 3) / 117) * 100;

    const chips = CHAT_COMMANDS.map(item => `
<button class="sd-chip" type="button" data-copy="${esc(item.copy)}" title="${esc(item.title)}">
<span class="sd-chip-ic">${ic('copy')}</span><code>${esc(item.cmd)}</code>
</button>`).join('');

    return `
<div class="sd-main" id="sd-main">
    <section class="sd-card card">
        <header class="sd-head">
            <div class="sd-head-left">
                <h3 class="sd-title">${ic('sync')} Ротатор соцсетей</h3>
                <span class="sd-badge" id="sd-badge-server">СЕРВЕР</span>
                <span class="sd-badge" id="sd-badge-state">НА ЭКРАНЕ</span>
                <span class="sd-badge" id="sd-badge-source">СИГНАЛ</span>
            </div>
            <div class="sd-head-right">
                <label class="sd-toggle sd-toggle-head" title="Мастер-выключатель: показывать ротатор на стриме">
                    <span>РОТАТОР ВКЛ.</span>
                    <input type="checkbox" data-sd-key="isActive" ${active ? 'checked' : ''}>
                    <div class="sd-track"></div>
                </label>
                <button class="sd-icon-btn" id="sd-refresh" type="button" title="Перезапустить превью виджета" aria-label="Перезапустить превью">${ic('sync')}</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <div class="sd-stage" id="sd-stage">
            <div class="sd-stage-frame" id="sd-stage-frame"></div>
            <div class="sd-stage-loading" id="sd-stage-loading"><div class="sd-spinner"></div><span>Загружаю виджет…</span></div>
            <div class="sd-stage-off is-hidden" id="sd-stage-off">
                <div class="sd-stage-off-icon">${ic('noSignal')}</div>
                <div class="sd-stage-off-title" id="sd-off-title">Ротатор скрыт</div>
                <div class="sd-stage-off-sub" id="sd-off-sub">Виджет работает, но не показывается на стриме.</div>
                <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-primary" id="sd-off-show" type="button">${ic('power')} Показать на экране</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sd-now" id="sd-now">
            <div class="sd-now-icon" id="sd-now-icon">${ic('noSignal')}</div>
            <div class="sd-now-body">
                <span class="sd-now-label">Сейчас на экране</span>
                <span class="sd-now-title" id="sd-now-title">Ожидание виджета</span>
                <span class="sd-now-handle" id="sd-now-handle">—</span>
            </div>
            <span class="sd-now-pos" id="sd-now-pos">${list.length} в списке</span>
        </div>
    </section>

    <div class="sd-grid">
        <section class="sd-net-panel">
            <header class="sd-panel-head">
                <div class="sd-panel-top">
                    <span>Платформы</span>
                    <span class="sd-badge" id="sd-net-count">0</span>
                </div>
                <div class="sd-panel-note">Порядок сверху вниз = порядок показа на стриме.</div>
            </header>
            <div class="sd-net-scroll" id="sd-net-scroll">
                <div class="sd-net-list" id="sd-net-list"></div>
                <div class="sd-net-empty is-hidden" id="sd-net-empty">
                    ${ic('globe')}
                    <div class="sd-net-empty-title">Список пуст</div>
                    <div class="sd-net-empty-sub">Добавьте первую платформу ниже — она сразу появится на стенде.</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <footer class="sd-add-row">
                <div class="sd-select" id="sd-add-select">
                    <button class="sd-select-btn" type="button" id="sd-add-btn" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Выбор платформы">
                        <span class="sd-select-val" id="sd-add-val">Платформа</span>
                        <span class="sd-caret" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                    </button>
                    <div class="sd-select-pop" id="sd-add-pop" role="listbox" aria-label="Доступные платформы" hidden></div>
                </div>
                <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-primary" id="sd-add-confirm" type="button">${ic('plus')} Добавить</button>
            </footer>
        </section>

        <section class="sd-panel">
            <div class="sd-block">
                <span class="sd-label">Интервал смены</span>
                <div class="sd-interval">
                    <input type="range" id="sd-interval" min="3" max="120" step="1" value="${sliderVal}" style="--range-fill:${fill.toFixed(2)}%;" aria-label="Интервал смены, секунды">
                    <input type="number" id="sd-interval-num" class="sd-num" min="3" max="600" step="1" value="${interval}" aria-label="Интервал смены числом">
                    <span class="sd-unit">сек</span>
                </div>
                <div class="sd-cycle" id="sd-cycle">
                    <div class="sd-cycle-track"><div class="sd-cycle-fill" id="sd-cycle-fill"></div></div>
                    <span class="sd-cycle-left" id="sd-cycle-left">—</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sd-block">
                <div class="sd-block-head">
                    <span class="sd-label">Порядок показа</span>
                    <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-ghost sd-btn-sm" id="sd-next" type="button">${ic('skip')} Следующая</button>
                </div>
                <div class="sd-order-scroll" id="sd-order-scroll">
                    <div class="sd-order" id="sd-order"></div>
                    <div class="sd-order-empty is-hidden" id="sd-order-empty">Активных соцсетей нет — включите платформу и заполните ссылку.</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sd-actions">
                <button class="sd-btn sd-btn-ghost" id="sd-reset" type="button">${ic('trash')} Сбросить виджет к настройкам по умолчанию</button>
            </div>

            <div class="sd-cmds">
                <div class="sd-cmds-head">${ic('twitch')} <span>Команды чата для модераторов — клик копирует</span></div>
                <div class="sd-chips">${chips}</div>
            </div>
        </section>
    </div>
    <div class="sd-toasts" id="sd-toasts"></div>
</div>`;
}

--- START OF FILE widgets/startscreen/script.js ---

const line1 = document.getElementById('line1');
const line2 = document.getElementById('line2');
const line3 = document.getElementById('line3');
const timerEl = document.getElementById('starting-timer');

let countdownInterval = null;
let currentConfiguredMinutes = -1; 

function startTimer(minutes) {
  clearInterval(countdownInterval);
  let totalSeconds = parseInt(minutes) * 60;
  timerEl.classList.remove('timer-done');
  
  if (totalSeconds <= 0) {
    timerEl.textContent = "ПОГНАЛИ!";
    timerEl.classList.add('timer-done');
    return;
  }

  updateTimerDisplay(totalSeconds);
  countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
    totalSeconds--;
    if (totalSeconds <= 0) {
      clearInterval(countdownInterval);
      timerEl.textContent = "ПОГНАЛИ!";
      timerEl.classList.add('timer-done');
      return;
    }
    updateTimerDisplay(totalSeconds);
  }, 1000);
}

function updateTimerDisplay(totalSeconds) {
  const m = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const s = (totalSeconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  timerEl.textContent = `${m}:${s}`;
}

function applyConfig(config) {
  if (!config || !config.widgets || !config.widgets.startscreen) return;
  const sConf = config.widgets.startscreen;

  if (sConf.text1 !== undefined) line1.textContent = sConf.text1;
  if (sConf.text2 !== undefined) line2.textContent = sConf.text2;
  if (sConf.text3 !== undefined) line3.textContent = sConf.text3;
  
  if (sConf.accentPink) document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent-pink', sConf.accentPink);
  if (sConf.accentGreen) document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent-green', sConf.accentGreen);

  const targetMinutes = sConf.timerMinutes !== undefined ? sConf.timerMinutes : 5;
  if (targetMinutes !== currentConfiguredMinutes) {
    currentConfiguredMinutes = targetMinutes;
    startTimer(targetMinutes);
  }
}

function connectWS() {
  const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:42069');
  ws.onmessage = (event) => {
    try {
      const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
      if (message.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED') applyConfig(message.data);
    } catch (e) { }
  };
  ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(connectWS, 3000);
}

fetch('http://localhost:42069/api/config')
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(config => {
    applyConfig(config);
    connectWS();
  })
  .catch(() => {
    if (currentConfiguredMinutes === -1) {
      currentConfiguredMinutes = 5;
      startTimer(5);
    }
    connectWS();
  });

const AppTicker = {
    container: document.getElementById('ticker-container'),
    maskEl: document.getElementById('ticker-mask'),
    textEl: document.getElementById('ticker-text'),
    badgeTextEl: document.getElementById('ticker-badge-text'),
    badgeDotEl: document.querySelector('#ticker-badge .t-dot'),
    
    priorityQueue: [],      
    messageBagRaw: [],      
    messageBag: [],         
    
    state: 0,               
    currentIsPriority: false, 
    
    intervalTimerId: null,
    textMotionTimerId: null,
    hideTimerId: null,
    
    speed: 120, 
    intervalMs: 60000, 

    init: function() {
        // Подключаем слушатели LocalStorage для Live Preview тестов
        fetch('/api/config')
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(config => {
              this.applyConfig(config.widgets?.ticker || {});
              this.connectWS();
          })
          .catch(() => {
              const saved = localStorage.getItem('stream_pack_config');
              if (saved) {
                  const conf = JSON.parse(saved);
                  this.applyConfig(conf.widgets?.ticker || {});
              }
              this.connectWS();
          });

        window.addEventListener('storage', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'stream_pack_config' && e.newValue) {
                const conf = JSON.parse(e.newValue);
                this.applyConfig(conf.widgets?.ticker || {});
            }
            if (e.key === 'stream_pack_action' && e.newValue) {
                try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(e.newValue);
                    if (data.action === 'TICKER_CUSTOM') {
                        this.forceShowImmediate(data.payload.msg, data.payload.badge, data.payload.color);
                    }
                } catch(err){}
            }
        });
    },

    connectWS: function() {
        const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:42069');
        ws.onmessage = (event) => {
            const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
            if (message.event === 'CONFIG_UPDATED') {
                this.applyConfig(message.data.widgets?.ticker);
            } 
            else if (message.event === 'WIDGET_ACTION' && message.action === 'TICKER_CUSTOM') {
                this.forceShowImmediate(message.payload.msg, message.payload.badge, message.payload.color);
            }
        };
        ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(() => this.connectWS(), 3000);
    },

    applyConfig: function(config) {
        if (!config) return;
        const isOff = config.isActive === false || String(config.isActive) === 'false';
        if (isOff) {
            this.container.classList.add('hidden');
            clearTimeout(this.intervalTimerId);
            return;
        }

        this.speed = parseInt(config.speed) || 120;
        this.intervalMs = (parseInt(config.interval) || 60) * 1000;

        const msgStr = config.messages || "<span class='t-highlight'>СИСТЕМА</span> Настройте бегущую строку в панели.";
        this.messageBagRaw = msgStr.split('\n').map(m => m.trim()).filter(m => m !== '');

        if (this.state === 0 && this.priorityQueue.length === 0) {
           this.fillBag();
           this.scheduleNext();
        }
    },

    fillBag: function() {
        let msgs = [...(this.messageBagRaw || [])];
        if (msgs.length === 0) msgs = ["Пусто"];
        
        for (let i = msgs.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
            [msgs[i], msgs[j]] = [msgs[j], msgs[i]];
        }
        this.messageBag = msgs;
    },

    getDefaultMessage: function() {
        if (this.messageBag.length === 0) this.fillBag();
        const msg = this.messageBag.pop();
        return { html: msg, badge: "ИНФО", color: "#00ff66" };
    },

    scheduleNext: function() {
        clearTimeout(this.intervalTimerId);
        this.intervalTimerId = setTimeout(() => {
            if (this.state === 0 && this.priorityQueue.length === 0) {
                this.playNext();
            }
        }, this.intervalMs);
    },

    forceShowImmediate: function(msg, badgeName = "СИСТЕМА", color = "#ff007f") {
        this.priorityQueue.push({ html: msg, badge: badgeName, color: color });
        
        if (this.state === 0) {
            this.playNext();
        } 
        else if (this.state === 1 && !this.currentIsPriority) {
            this.interrupt();
        }
    },

    interrupt: function() {
        if (this.state !== 1) return; 
        this.state = 2; 
        
        clearTimeout(this.textMotionTimerId);
        clearTimeout(this.hideTimerId);
        
        this.textEl.style.transition = 'none'; 
        this.container.classList.remove('visible');
        this.container.classList.add('is-leaving');
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.container.classList.add('hidden');
            this.container.classList.remove('is-leaving');
            this.state = 0; 
            this.playNext(); 
        }, 600);
    },

    playNext: function() {
        if (this.state !== 0) return; 
        this.state = 1; 
        clearTimeout(this.intervalTimerId);
        
        let item;
        if (this.priorityQueue.length > 0) {
            item = this.priorityQueue.shift();
            this.currentIsPriority = true; 
        } else {
            item = this.getDefaultMessage();
            this.currentIsPriority = false; 
        }
        
        this.badgeTextEl.innerText = item.badge;
        this.badgeDotEl.style.backgroundColor = item.color;
        this.badgeDotEl.style.boxShadow = `0 0 10px ${item.color}`;
        this.textEl.innerHTML = item.html;
        this.textEl.style.transition = 'none';
        
        this.container.classList.remove('hidden', 'is-leaving');
        void this.container.offsetWidth; 
        
        const maskWidth = this.maskEl.offsetWidth;
        const textWidth = this.textEl.scrollWidth;
        this.textEl.style.transform = `translate3d(${maskWidth}px, 0, 0)`;
        void this.textEl.offsetWidth; 
        
        const distance = maskWidth + textWidth; 
        const duration = distance / this.speed;

        this.container.classList.add('visible'); 
        
        this.textMotionTimerId = setTimeout(() => {
            this.textEl.style.transition = `transform ${duration}s linear`;
            this.textEl.style.transform = `translate3d(-${textWidth + 50}px, 0, 0)`;
        }, 800);
        
        this.hideTimerId = setTimeout(() => {
            this.hideTicker();
        }, 800 + (duration * 1000) + 200); 
    },

    hideTicker: function() {
        if (this.state !== 1) return; 
        this.state = 2; 
        
        this.container.classList.remove('visible');
        this.container.classList.add('is-leaving');
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.container.classList.add('hidden');
            this.container.classList.remove('is-leaving');
            this.state = 0; 
            
            if (this.priorityQueue.length > 0) this.playNext();
            else this.scheduleNext(); 
        }, 600);
    }
};

AppTicker.init();

/* ФАЙЛ: widgets/tts/script.js */
import { WidgetCore } from '../shared/WidgetCore.js';

const AppTTS = {
    container: document.getElementById('tts-container'),
    userText: document.getElementById('tts-user'),
    bars: document.querySelectorAll('.tts-bar'),
    
    synth: window.speechSynthesis,
    queue: [],
    isPlaying: false,
    eqInterval: null,
    keepAliveInterval: null,
    activeUtterance: null, 
    
    config: { enabled: true, volume: 100, maxLength: 150, customVoices: {} },

    init: function() {
        console.log('[TTS] Инициализация встроенного синтезатора (Web Speech API)...');
        
        // Жесткий сброс зависших сообщений в движке
        if (this.synth.speaking || this.synth.pending) {
            this.synth.cancel();
        }

        // Принудительная подгрузка голосов
        let voices = this.synth.getVoices();
        if (voices.length === 0) {
            this.synth.onvoiceschanged = () => { 
                voices = this.synth.getVoices(); 
                console.log(`[TTS] Загружено системных голосов: ${voices.length}`);
            };
        } else {
            console.log(`[TTS] Загружено системных голосов: ${voices.length}`);
        }

        // Хак для браузера (клик по экрану для разблокировки звука в Предпросмотре)
        window.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (this.synth.getVoices().length > 0) {
                const unlock = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('');
                unlock.volume = 0;
                this.synth.speak(unlock);
                console.log('[TTS] Звук разблокирован кликом.');
            }
        }, { once: true });
    },

    applyConfig: function(tConf) {
        if (!tConf) return;
        this.config.enabled = tConf.enabled !== false && String(tConf.enabled) !== 'false';
        
        this.config.volume = parseInt(tConf.volume);
        if (isNaN(this.config.volume)) this.config.volume = 100;
        
        this.config.maxLength = parseInt(tConf.maxLength) || 150;
        
        try {
            this.config.customVoices = typeof tConf.customVoices === 'string' 
                ? JSON.parse(tConf.customVoices) 
                : tConf.customVoices || {};
        } catch (e) { 
            this.config.customVoices = {}; 
        }

        if (!this.config.enabled && this.isPlaying) {
            this.stop();
        }
    },

    add: function(user, text) {
        if (!this.config.enabled || !text) return;
        
        // Фильтрация ссылок и спама одинаковыми буквами
        let cleanText = text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/g, "ссылка").replace(/www\.[^\s]+/g, "ссылка"); 
        cleanText = cleanText.replace(/(.)\1{10,}/g, "$1$1$1"); 
        
        if (cleanText.length > this.config.maxLength) {
            cleanText = cleanText.substring(0, this.config.maxLength) + "...";
        }
        
        if (cleanText.trim().length > 0) {
            this.queue.push({ user: user, text: cleanText.trim() });
            console.log(`[TTS] Добавлено в очередь: ${cleanText.trim()}`);
            if (!this.isPlaying) this.playNext();
        }
    },

    playNext: function() {
        if (this.queue.length === 0) {
            this.isPlaying = false;
            this.hideVisual();
            return;
        }

        this.isPlaying = true;
        const currentData = this.queue.shift();
        
        console.log(`[TTS] Начинаем озвучку: [${currentData.user}] ${currentData.text}`);
        this.showVisual(currentData.user);

        const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(currentData.text);
        utterance.lang = 'ru-RU'; 
        
        // Линейная громкость: от 0.0 до 1.0
        utterance.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.0, this.config.volume / 100));

        // Персонализация голосов из JSON-конфига
        const customSettings = this.config.customVoices[currentData.user.toLowerCase()];
        utterance.pitch = customSettings?.pitch !== undefined ? customSettings.pitch : 1.0;
        utterance.rate = customSettings?.rate !== undefined ? customSettings.rate : 1.1;

        // Поиск русского голоса
        const voices = this.synth.getVoices();
        let selectedVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang === 'ru-RU' && v.name.includes('Google')) 
                         || voices.find(v => v.lang.includes('ru'));
        
        if (selectedVoice) {
            utterance.voice = selectedVoice;
        }

        utterance.onstart = () => {
            this.startEq();
            this.triggerPet(true);
            
            // Защита от остановки Garbage Collector'ом
            this.keepAliveInterval = setInterval(() => { 
                if (this.synth.speaking) { 
                    this.synth.pause(); 
                    this.synth.resume(); 
                } 
            }, 10000);
        };
        
        utterance.onboundary = (event) => { 
            if (event.name === 'word') this.spikeEq(); 
        };
        
        const finishTTS = () => {
            if (this.keepAliveInterval) clearInterval(this.keepAliveInterval);
            this.stopEq();
            this.triggerPet(false);
            this.activeUtterance = null;
            setTimeout(() => this.playNext(), 500);
        };

        utterance.onend = finishTTS;
        utterance.onerror = finishTTS;

        this.activeUtterance = utterance; 
        
        try {
            this.synth.speak(utterance);
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[TTS] Ошибка synth.speak():', err);
            finishTTS();
        }
    },

    stop: function() {
        console.log('[TTS] Принудительная остановка.');
        this.queue = []; 
        this.synth.cancel(); 
        this.isPlaying = false;
        
        if (this.keepAliveInterval) clearInterval(this.keepAliveInterval);
        this.stopEq();
        this.hideVisual();
        this.triggerPet(false);
    },

    triggerPet: function(isActive) {
        if (WidgetCore.ws && WidgetCore.ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            WidgetCore.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ 
                event: 'WIDGET_ACTION', 
                action: 'PET_BASE_STATE', 
                payload: { state: 'listen', active: isActive } 
            }));
        }
    },

    showVisual: function(user) {
        this.userText.innerText = user;
        this.container.classList.remove('hidden', 'tts-out', 'tts-in');
        void this.container.offsetWidth;
        this.container.classList.add('tts-in');
    },

    hideVisual: function() {
        this.container.classList.remove('tts-in');
        void this.container.offsetWidth;
        this.container.classList.add('tts-out');
        setTimeout(() => this.container.classList.add('hidden'), 500);
    },

    startEq: function() {
        if (this.eqInterval) clearInterval(this.eqInterval);
        this.eqInterval = setInterval(() => {
            this.bars.forEach(bar => { 
                bar.style.height = `${20 + Math.random() * 40}%`; 
                bar.classList.remove('active-spike'); 
            });
        }, 120); 
    },

    spikeEq: function() {
        this.bars.forEach(bar => { 
            bar.style.height = `${70 + Math.random() * 30}%`; 
            bar.classList.add('active-spike'); 
        });
    },

    stopEq: function() {
        if (this.eqInterval) clearInterval(this.eqInterval);
        this.bars.forEach(bar => { 
            bar.style.height = '15%'; 
            bar.classList.remove('active-spike'); 
        });
    }
};

AppTTS.init();

// ==========================================
// ИНИЦИАЛИЗАЦИЯ ЧЕРЕЗ ЯДРО WIDGET CORE
// ==========================================
WidgetCore.init({
    onConfigUpdate: (config) => {
        if (config.widgets?.tts) AppTTS.applyConfig(config.widgets.tts);
    },

    onTwitchMessage: (tags, message) => {
        const msgLow = message.trim().toLowerCase();
        
        if (msgLow.startsWith('!tts ')) {
            const text = message.substring(5).trim();
            if (text.toLowerCase() !== "stop" && text.toLowerCase() !== "skip" && text.toLowerCase() !== "clear") {
                const user = tags['display-name'] || tags.username;
                AppTTS.add(user, text);
            }
        }
    },

    onTwitchCommand: (cmd, args) => {
        if (cmd === '!tts') {
            const action = args[0] ? args[0].toLowerCase() : '';
            if (action === 'stop' || action === 'skip' || action === 'clear') {
                AppTTS.stop();
                WidgetCore.ws?.send(JSON.stringify({ event: 'SYSTEM_LOG', type: 'info', message: 'Озвучка (TTS) принудительно очищена.' }));
            }
        }
    }
});
